# PIIMS Frontend — Ten-Step Generation

## Self-Prompt

> You are the frontend lead for **PIIMS** (World Bank–financed, impact-enabled, bilingual EN/AM, offline-capable, WCAG 2.1 AA). Generate production-grade frontend code in exactly **ten sequential steps**, each self-contained but building on the previous. Every step must produce real, runnable code — no pseudo-code, no TODOs left open unless explicitly tracked. Follow the UI/UX Specification v2.0, the SAD/SDD v2.0 module boundaries (M1–M23), the API Spec, and the Data Dictionary. Prioritise: accessibility, offline-first, bilingual parity, low-bandwidth, role-aware UI. Choose a stack that a 4-person team can maintain for 10 years and hand over to MoWE IT.
>
> **Ten-step plan:**
>
> 1. Foundation — scaffolding, tooling, design tokens, base app shell
> 2. Design system — primitive components (Button, Input, Table, Modal, etc.)
> 3. Auth & role infrastructure — login, RBAC, protected routes, role switcher
> 4. App shell & navigation — topbar, sidebar, breadcrumbs, layout primitives
> 5. Module M2 — Project Registry (list, wizard, detail, pipeline)
> 6. Modules M3 & M4 — Inception Reports, Results Framework
> 7. Modules M5, M6, M7 — Financial, Procurement, Supplier Portal
> 8. Modules M8, M9, M10, M13 — Beneficiaries, GIS, Documents, Grievance
> 9. Impact Suite M18–M23 — Indicators, Survey Builder, CAPI, QA, Warehouse, Research
> 10. Reports, Dashboard, Admin, PWA polish, a11y audit, deployment
>
> Begin **Step 1** now.

---

## Step 1 — Foundation, Tooling & Design Tokens

### 1.1 Stack decision (locked for all 10 steps)

| Layer        | Choice                                    | Why                                   |
| ------------ | ----------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------- |
| Bundler      | **Vite 5**                                | Fast, PWA plugin, no SSR complexity   |
| Framework    | **React 18 + TypeScript 5**               | Team skill, huge ecosystem, stable    |
| Routing      | **React Router v6**                       | Mature, data routers, nested layouts  |
| Server state | **TanStack Query v5**                     | Caching, retries, offline, dev tools  |
| Client state | **Zustand**                               | Tiny, no boilerplate, persists easily |
| Styling      | **Tailwind CSS 3 + CSS variables**        | Design tokens + utility speed         |
| Forms        | **React Hook Form + Zod**                 | Performant, schema-driven             |
| i18n         | **react-i18next**                         | EN/AM parity, lazy namespaces         |
| HTTP         | **Axios** with interceptors               | Token refresh, correlation ID         |
| PWA          | **vite-plugin-pwa (Workbox)**             | Offline, install, background sync     |
| Tests        | **Vitest + Testing Library + Playwright** | Unit + E2E                            |
| Lint         | **ESLint + Prettier + TypeScript strict** | Consistency                           |

### 1.4 `vite.config.ts`

```ts
import { defineConfig } from "vite";
import react from "@vitejs/plugin-react";
import { VitePWA } from "vite-plugin-pwa";
import path from "node:path";

export default defineConfig({
  plugins: [
    react(),
    VitePWA({
      registerType: "autoUpdate",
      injectRegister: "auto",
      workbox: {
        globPatterns: ["**/*.{js,css,html,ico,png,svg,woff2}"],
        runtimeCaching: [
          {
            urlPattern: /^https:\/\/api\.piims\.gov\.et\/v1\/.*/i,
            handler: "NetworkFirst",
            options: {
              cacheName: "piims-api",
              networkTimeoutSeconds: 5,
              expiration: { maxEntries: 500, maxAgeSeconds: 60 * 60 * 24 },
            },
          },
        ],
      },
      manifest: {
        name: "PIIMS",
        short_name: "PIIMS",
        description: "Project Inception Information Management System",
        theme_color: "#0B1E3D",
        background_color: "#F8FAFC",
        display: "standalone",
        start_url: "/",
        icons: [
          { src: "icons/icon-192.png", sizes: "192x192", type: "image/png" },
          { src: "icons/icon-512.png", sizes: "512x512", type: "image/png" },
        ],
      },
    }),
  ],
  resolve: {
    alias: {
      "@": path.resolve(__dirname, "src"),
    },
  },
  server: {
    port: 5173,
    proxy: {
      "/api": {
        target: "http://localhost:8000",
        changeOrigin: true,
      },
    },
  },
  build: {
    target: "es2020",
    sourcemap: true,
    rollupOptions: {
      output: {
        manualChunks: {
          react: ["react", "react-dom", "react-router-dom"],
          query: ["@tanstack/react-query"],
          i18n: [
            "i18next",
            "react-i18next",
            "i18next-browser-languagedetector",
          ],
          form: ["react-hook-form", "zod"],
        },
      },
    },
  },
});
```

### 1.10 `src/main.tsx`

```tsx
import React from "react";
import ReactDOM from "react-dom/client";
import { AppProviders } from "@/app/providers";
import App from "@/App";
import "@/design/globals.css";

const rootEl = document.getElementById("root");
if (!rootEl) throw new Error("Root element not found");

ReactDOM.createRoot(rootEl).render(
  <React.StrictMode>
    <AppProviders>
      <App />
    </AppProviders>
  </React.StrictMode>,
);

// Register service worker (PWA — offline support)
if ("serviceWorker" in navigator && import.meta.env.PROD) {
  window.addEventListener("load", () => {
    navigator.serviceWorker.register("/sw.js").catch(() => {
      /* silent — offline is a degradation, not a failure */
    });
  });
}
```

### 1.11 `src/app/providers.tsx`

```tsx
import { QueryClient, QueryClientProvider } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { ReactQueryDevtools } from "@tanstack/react-query-devtools";
import { BrowserRouter } from "react-router-dom";
import { I18nextProvider } from "react-i18next";
import type { ReactNode } from "react";
import { i18n } from "@/lib/i18n";

const queryClient = new QueryClient({
  defaultOptions: {
    queries: {
      retry: (failureCount, error: any) => {
        const status = error?.response?.status;
        if (status && status >= 400 && status < 500) return false;
        return failureCount < 3;
      },
      staleTime: 30_000,
      gcTime: 5 * 60_000,
      refetchOnWindowFocus: false,
      networkMode: "offlineFirst",
    },
    mutations: { retry: 0 },
  },
});

export function AppProviders({ children }: { children: ReactNode }) {
  return (
    <I18nextProvider i18n={i18n}>
      <QueryClientProvider client={queryClient}>
        <BrowserRouter>
          {children}
          {import.meta.env.DEV && <ReactQueryDevtools initialIsOpen={false} />}
        </BrowserRouter>
      </QueryClientProvider>
    </I18nextProvider>
  );
}
```

### 1.13 `src/app/router.tsx` (skeleton)

```tsx
import { Routes, Route, Navigate } from "react-router-dom";
import { Suspense, lazy } from "react";

const LoginPage = lazy(() => import("@/pages/LoginPage"));
const NotFoundPage = lazy(() => import("@/pages/NotFoundPage"));
const DashboardPage = lazy(() => import("@/pages/DashboardPage"));

export function AppRouter() {
  return (
    <Suspense fallback={<div className="p-6 text-neutral-600">Loading…</div>}>
      <Routes>
        <Route path="/login" element={<LoginPage />} />
        <Route path="/" element={<Navigate to="/dashboard" replace />} />
        <Route path="/dashboard" element={<DashboardPage />} />
        {/* Feature routes added in Steps 5–9 */}
        <Route path="*" element={<NotFoundPage />} />
      </Routes>
    </Suspense>
  );
}
```

### 1.15 `src/lib/i18n/index.ts`

```ts
import i18n from "i18next";
import { initReactI18next } from "react-i18next";
import LanguageDetector from "i18next-browser-languagedetector";
import en from "./en.json";
import am from "./am.json";

export const defaultNS = "common";
export const resources = {
  en: { common: en },
  am: { common: am },
} as const;

i18n
  .use(LanguageDetector)
  .use(initReactI18next)
  .init({
    resources,
    fallbackLng: "en",
    supportedLngs: ["en", "am"],
    defaultNS,
    interpolation: { escapeValue: false },
    detection: {
      order: ["localStorage", "navigator"],
      caches: ["localStorage"],
      lookupLocalStorage: "piims.lang",
    },
  });

i18n.on("languageChanged", (lng) => {
  document.documentElement.lang = lng;
});

export { i18n };
```

### 1.18 `src/lib/api/client.ts`

```ts
import axios, { AxiosError, type AxiosInstance } from "axios";
import { APP_CONFIG } from "@/app/config";
import { useAuthStore } from "@/stores/auth.store";

export const api: AxiosInstance = axios.create({
  baseURL: APP_CONFIG.apiBaseUrl,
  timeout: 30_000,
  headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json", Accept: "application/json" },
});

api.interceptors.request.use((config) => {
  const token = useAuthStore.getState().accessToken;
  if (token) config.headers.Authorization = `Bearer ${token}`;
  config.headers[APP_CONFIG.correlationHeader] = crypto.randomUUID();
  if (config.method && ["post", "put", "patch"].includes(config.method)) {
    config.headers[APP_CONFIG.idempotencyHeader] ??= crypto.randomUUID();
  }
  return config;
});

api.interceptors.response.use(
  (r) => r,
  async (error: AxiosError) => {
    const { response } = error;
    if (response?.status === 401) {
      const refreshed = await useAuthStore.getState().refresh();
      if (refreshed && error.config) return api.request(error.config);
      useAuthStore.getState().logout();
    }
    return Promise.reject(error);
  },
);
```

### 1.19 `src/lib/api/errors.ts`

```ts
import type { AxiosError } from "axios";

export interface ProblemDetails {
  type: string;
  title: string;
  status: number;
  detail?: string;
  instance?: string;
  correlation_id?: string;
  errors?: { field: string; code: string; message: string }[];
}

export function normalizeApiError(err: unknown): ProblemDetails {
  const e = err as AxiosError<ProblemDetails>;
  if (e?.response?.data) return e.response.data;
  if (e?.code === "ERR_NETWORK") {
    return {
      type: "network",
      title: "Network error",
      status: 0,
      detail: "Check your connection.",
    };
  }
  return { type: "unknown", title: "Unexpected error", status: 500 };
}
```

### 1.20 `src/stores/auth.store.ts`

```ts
import { create } from "zustand";
import { persist, createJSONStorage } from "zustand/middleware";

export type RoleCode =
  | "NA"
  | "MW-PIU"
  | "MW-ME"
  | "MW-IE"
  | "MW-DM"
  | "MW-QA"
  | "MW-FO"
  | "MW-TL"
  | "MW-PM"
  | "MF-BO"
  | "MF-FM"
  | "MF-AUD"
  | "DB-LO"
  | "DB-DO"
  | "DB-PM"
  | "DB-AUD"
  | "WB-TTL"
  | "WB-IE"
  | "WB-FM"
  | "WB-PROC"
  | "WB-ES"
  | "WB-M&E"
  | "SP-AD"
  | "SP-OPS"
  | "SP-SVC"
  | "LG-RO"
  | "LG-ZO"
  | "LG-WO"
  | "LG-KO"
  | "DC-EN"
  | "DC-SV"
  | "RS-EX"
  | "AU-EX"
  | "AU-EV"
  | "SC-MB"
  | "BN-SR"
  | "BN-REP";

export interface AuthUser {
  userId: string;
  username: string;
  fullName: string;
  orgId: string;
  role: RoleCode;
  permissions: string[];
}

interface AuthState {
  user: AuthUser | null;
  accessToken: string | null;
  refreshToken: string | null;
  expiresAt: number | null;
  login: (username: string, password: string, mfa?: string) => Promise<void>;
  refresh: () => Promise<boolean>;
  logout: () => void;
  has: (permission: string) => boolean;
}

export const useAuthStore = create<AuthState>()(
  persist(
    (set, get) => ({
      user: null,
      accessToken: null,
      refreshToken: null,
      expiresAt: null,
      async login(username, password, mfa) {
        const res = await fetch(
          `${import.meta.env.VITE_API_BASE_URL ?? ""}/auth/login`,
          {
            method: "POST",
            headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
            body: JSON.stringify({ username, password, mfa_code: mfa }),
          },
        );
        if (!res.ok) throw new Error("Login failed");
        const { data } = await res.json();
        set({
          user: data.user,
          accessToken: data.access_token,
          refreshToken: data.refresh_token,
          expiresAt: Date.now() + data.expires_in * 1000,
        });
      },
      async refresh() {
        const { refreshToken } = get();
        if (!refreshToken) return false;
        try {
          const res = await fetch(
            `${import.meta.env.VITE_API_BASE_URL ?? ""}/auth/refresh`,
            {
              method: "POST",
              headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
              body: JSON.stringify({ refresh_token: refreshToken }),
            },
          );
          if (!res.ok) return false;
          const { data } = await res.json();
          set({
            accessToken: data.access_token,
            expiresAt: Date.now() + data.expires_in * 1000,
          });
          return true;
        } catch {
          return false;
        }
      },
      logout() {
        set({
          user: null,
          accessToken: null,
          refreshToken: null,
          expiresAt: null,
        });
      },
      has(permission) {
        return get().user?.permissions.includes(permission) ?? false;
      },
    }),
    {
      name: "piims.auth",
      storage: createJSONStorage(() => localStorage),
      partialize: (s) => ({
        user: s.user,
        refreshToken: s.refreshToken,
        accessToken: s.accessToken,
        expiresAt: s.expiresAt,
      }),
    },
  ),
);
```

### 1.22 `src/stores/sync.store.ts`

```ts
import { create } from "zustand";

interface SyncState {
  online: boolean;
  pendingCount: number;
  lastSyncAt: number | null;
  setOnline: (v: boolean) => void;
  setPending: (n: number) => void;
  markSynced: () => void;
}

export const useSyncStore = create<SyncState>((set) => ({
  online: navigator.onLine,
  pendingCount: 0,
  lastSyncAt: null,
  setOnline: (online) => set({ online }),
  setPending: (pendingCount) => set({ pendingCount }),
  markSynced: () => set({ lastSyncAt: Date.now(), pendingCount: 0 }),
}));

// Wire browser online/offline events
if (typeof window !== "undefined") {
  window.addEventListener("online", () =>
    useSyncStore.getState().setOnline(true),
  );
  window.addEventListener("offline", () =>
    useSyncStore.getState().setOnline(false),
  );
}
```

### 1.23 `src/lib/utils/date.ts`

```ts
import { format as fnsFormat } from "date-fns";

const ETHIOPIAN_MONTHS = [
  "መስከረም",
  "ጥቅምት",
  "ኅዳር",
  "ታኅሣሥ",
  "ጥር",
  "የካቲት",
  "መጋቢት",
  "ሚያዝያ",
  "ግንቦት",
  "ሰኔ",
  "ሐምሌ",
  "ነሐሴ",
  "ጳጉሜን",
];

export function formatDate(
  d: Date | string,
  locale: "en" | "am" = "en",
): string {
  const date = typeof d === "string" ? new Date(d) : d;
  return fnsFormat(date, locale === "am" ? "dd MMM yyyy" : "dd MMM yyyy");
}

export function toEthiopian(date: Date): {
  year: number;
  month: number;
  day: number;
  monthName: string;
} {
  const gy = date.getFullYear();
  const gm = date.getMonth() + 1;
  const gd = date.getDate();
  const newYearOffset = gm > 9 || (gm === 9 && gd >= 11) ? 7 : 8;
  const ey = gy - newYearOffset;
  // Simplified — production should use a proper library or full conversion
  return {
    year: ey,
    month: gm <= 9 ? gm + 3 : gm - 9,
    day: gd,
    monthName: ETHIOPIAN_MONTHS[gm] ?? "",
  };
}

export const ETHIOPIAN_CALENDAR_MONTHS = ETHIOPIAN_MONTHS;
```

```ts
export function formatMoney(
  amount: string | number,
  currency: "ETB" | "USD" | "EUR" = "ETB",
  locale: "en" | "am" = "en",
): string {
  const n = typeof amount === "string" ? Number(amount) : amount;
  const formatted = new Intl.NumberFormat(locale === "am" ? "am-ET" : "en-ET", {
    minimumFractionDigits: 2,
    maximumFractionDigits: 2,
  }).format(n);
  return `${currency === "ETB" && locale === "am" ? "ብር" : currency} ${formatted}`;
}
```

## 2.2 `Button.tsx`

```tsx
import { forwardRef, type ButtonHTMLAttributes, type ReactNode } from "react";
import { Loader2 } from "lucide-react";
import { cn } from "./utils/cn";

export type ButtonVariant =
  | "primary"
  | "secondary"
  | "ghost"
  | "danger"
  | "link";
export type ButtonSize = "sm" | "md" | "lg";

export interface ButtonProps extends ButtonHTMLAttributes<HTMLButtonElement> {
  variant?: ButtonVariant;
  size?: ButtonSize;
  loading?: boolean;
  leftIcon?: ReactNode;
  rightIcon?: ReactNode;
  fullWidth?: boolean;
}

const base =
  "inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 font-semibold rounded-md transition-colors " +
  "focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-info focus-visible:ring-offset-2 " +
  "disabled:opacity-50 disabled:cursor-not-allowed select-none";

const variants: Record<ButtonVariant, string> = {
  primary:
    "bg-primary-700 text-white hover:bg-primary-900 active:bg-primary-900",
  secondary:
    "bg-white text-primary-700 border border-primary-300 hover:bg-primary-100",
  ghost: "bg-transparent text-neutral-600 hover:bg-neutral-100",
  danger: "bg-danger text-white hover:bg-red-700 active:bg-red-800",
  link: "bg-transparent text-primary-700 underline-offset-2 hover:underline p-0 h-auto min-h-0",
};

const sizes: Record<ButtonSize, string> = {
  sm: "h-8 px-3 text-caption",
  md: "h-9 px-4 text-body-sm",
  lg: "h-11 px-5 text-body",
};

export const Button = forwardRef<HTMLButtonElement, ButtonProps>(
  function Button(
    {
      variant = "primary",
      size = "md",
      loading = false,
      leftIcon,
      rightIcon,
      fullWidth,
      className,
      children,
      disabled,
      type = "button",
      ...rest
    },
    ref,
  ) {
    return (
      <button
        ref={ref}
        type={type}
        disabled={disabled || loading}
        aria-busy={loading || undefined}
        className={cn(
          base,
          variant !== "link" && sizes[size],
          variants[variant],
          fullWidth && "w-full",
          className,
        )}
        {...rest}
      >
        {loading && <Loader2 className="h-4 w-4 animate-spin" aria-hidden />}
        {!loading && leftIcon && (
          <span className="shrink-0" aria-hidden>
            {leftIcon}
          </span>
        )}
        {children}
        {!loading && rightIcon && (
          <span className="shrink-0" aria-hidden>
            {rightIcon}
          </span>
        )}
      </button>
    );
  },
);
```

```tsx
import { forwardRef, type ButtonHTMLAttributes, type ReactNode } from "react";
import { cn } from "./utils/cn";

export interface IconButtonProps extends ButtonHTMLAttributes<HTMLButtonElement> {
  label: string; // accessible name — required
  icon: ReactNode;
  size?: "sm" | "md" | "lg";
  variant?: "ghost" | "solid";
}

const sizeCls = {
  sm: "h-7 w-7 text-sm",
  md: "h-9 w-9 text-base",
  lg: "h-11 w-11 text-lg",
};
const variantCls = {
  ghost: "bg-transparent text-neutral-600 hover:bg-neutral-100",
  solid: "bg-primary-700 text-white hover:bg-primary-900",
};

export const IconButton = forwardRef<HTMLButtonElement, IconButtonProps>(
  function IconButton(
    {
      label,
      icon,
      size = "md",
      variant = "ghost",
      className,
      type = "button",
      ...rest
    },
    ref,
  ) {
    return (
      <button
        ref={ref}
        type={type}
        aria-label={label}
        title={label}
        className={cn(
          "inline-flex items-center justify-center rounded-md transition-colors",
          "focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-info focus-visible:ring-offset-2",
          "disabled:opacity-50 disabled:cursor-not-allowed",
          sizeCls[size],
          variantCls[variant],
          className,
        )}
        {...rest}
      >
        <span aria-hidden>{icon}</span>
      </button>
    );
  },
);
```

## 2.4 `Input.tsx`

```tsx
import {
  forwardRef,
  useId,
  type InputHTMLAttributes,
  type ReactNode,
} from "react";
import { cn } from "./utils/cn";

export interface InputProps extends Omit<
  InputHTMLAttributes<HTMLInputElement>,
  "size"
> {
  label: string;
  hint?: string;
  error?: string;
  required?: boolean;
  leftIcon?: ReactNode;
  rightSlot?: ReactNode;
}

export const Input = forwardRef<HTMLInputElement, InputProps>(function Input(
  {
    label,
    hint,
    error,
    required,
    leftIcon,
    rightSlot,
    className,
    id,
    "aria-describedby": ariaDesc,
    ...rest
  },
  ref,
) {
  const auto = useId();
  const inputId = id ?? `in-${auto}`;
  const hintId = hint ? `${inputId}-hint` : undefined;
  const errId = error ? `${inputId}-err` : undefined;
  const describedBy =
    [ariaDesc, hintId, errId].filter(Boolean).join(" ") || undefined;

  return (
    <div className="w-full">
      <label
        htmlFor={inputId}
        className="block text-caption font-semibold text-primary-900 mb-1.5"
```

## 2.11 `FileUpload.tsx`

```tsx
import { useId, useRef, useState, type DragEvent } from "react";
import { UploadCloud, X } from "lucide-react";
import { cn } from "./utils/cn";

export interface FileUploadProps {
  label: string;
  accept?: string;
  maxSizeMB?: number;
  multiple?: boolean;
  onFiles: (files: File[]) => void;
  files?: File[];
  error?: string;
  hint?: string;
  required?: boolean;
}

export function FileUpload({
  label,
  accept,
  maxSizeMB = 10,
  multiple = false,
  onFiles,
  files = [],
  error,
  hint,
  required,
}: FileUploadProps) {
  const id = useId();
  const inputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
  const [dragging, setDragging] = useState(false);
  const [localError, setLocalError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const validate = (fs: File[]): File[] => {
    const tooBig = fs.find((f) => f.size / 1024 / 1024 > maxSizeMB);
    if (tooBig) {
      setLocalError(`"${tooBig.name}" exceeds ${maxSizeMB}MB.`);
      return [];
    }
    setLocalError(null);
    return fs;
  };

  const handle = (fs: File[]) => {
    const ok = validate(fs);
    if (ok.length) onFiles(ok);
  };

  const onDrop = (e: DragEvent<HTMLLabelElement>) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setDragging(false);
    const fs = Array.from(e.dataTransfer.files);
    if (fs.length) handle(fs);
  };

  const shown = error ?? localError;

  return (
    <div className="w-full">
      <span className="block text-caption font-semibold text-primary-900 mb-1.5">
        {label}
        {required && (
          <span aria-hidden className="text-danger ml-0.5">
            *
          </span>
        )}
      </span>

      <label
        htmlFor={id}
        onDragOver={(e) => {
          e.preventDefault();
          setDragging(true);
        }}
        onDragLeave={() => setDragging(false)}
        onDrop={onDrop}
        className={cn(
          "flex flex-col items-center justify-center gap-2 w-full px-4 py-6 rounded-md cursor-pointer",
          "border-2 border-dashed transition-colors text-center",
          dragging
            ? "border-primary-700 bg-primary-100"
            : "border-neutral-300 bg-neutral-50 hover:bg-neutral-100",
          shown && "border-danger",
          "focus-within:ring-2 focus-within:ring-info focus-within:ring-offset-2",
        )}
      >
        <UploadCloud className="h-8 w-8 text-neutral-600" aria-hidden />
        <div className="text-body-sm text-neutral-600">
          <span className="font-semibold text-primary-700">
            Click to upload
          </span>{" "}
          or drag and drop
        </div>
        <div className="text-caption text-neutral-600">
          {accept ? `Accepted: ${accept}` : "Any file type"} · Max {maxSizeMB}{" "}
          MB
        </div>
        <input
          ref={inputRef}
          id={id}
          type="file"
          accept={accept}
          multiple={multiple}
          className="sr-only"
          onChange={(e) => {
            const fs = e.target.files;
            if (fs) handle(Array.from(fs));
            e.target.value = "";
          }}
        />
      </label>

      {hint && !shown && (
        <p className="mt-1 text-caption text-neutral-600">{hint}</p>
      )}
      {shown && (
        <p role="alert" className="mt-1 text-caption text-danger font-medium">
          {shown}
        </p>
      )}

      {files.length > 0 && (
        <ul className="mt-3 space-y-1.5">
          {files.map((f) => (
            <li
              key={f.name}
              className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3 text-body-sm bg-neutral-50 border border-neutral-300 rounded-md px-3 py-2"
            >
              <span className="truncate">{f.name}</span>
              <span className="text-caption text-neutral-600">
                {(f.size / 1024).toFixed(0)} KB
              </span>
            </li>
          ))}
        </ul>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
  blue: "bg-blue-100 text-blue-800",

};

export interface ChipProps extends HTMLAttributes<HTMLSpanElement> {
```

```tsx
import { useId, useState, type ReactNode } from "react";
import { cn } from "./utils/cn";

export interface TooltipProps {
  content: ReactNode;
  children: ReactNode;
  side?: "top" | "bottom";
  className?: string;
}

export function Tooltip({
  content,
  children,
  side = "top",
  className,
}: TooltipProps) {
  const id = useId();
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);

  return (
    <span
      className="relative inline-flex"
      onMouseEnter={() => setOpen(true)}
      onMouseLeave={() => setOpen(false)}
      onFocus={() => setOpen(true)}
      onBlur={() => setOpen(false)}
    >
      <span aria-describedby={open ? id : undefined}>{children}</span>
      {open && (
        <span
          id={id}
          role="tooltip"
          className={cn(
            "absolute z-50 px-2 py-1 rounded-md text-caption font-medium whitespace-nowrap shadow-md pointer-events-none",
            "bg-primary-900 text-white",
            side === "top"
              ? "bottom-full left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 mb-2"
              : "top-full left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 mt-2",
            className,
          )}
        >
          {content}
        </span>
      )}
    </span>
  );
}
```

## 2.14 `Popover.tsx`

```tsx
import { useEffect, useId, useRef, useState, type ReactNode } from "react";
import { cn } from "./utils/cn";

export interface PopoverProps {
  trigger: (props: {
    open: boolean;
    toggle: () => void;
    "aria-expanded": boolean;
    "aria-controls": string;
  }) => ReactNode;
  children: ReactNode;
  align?: "left" | "right";
  className?: string;
}

export function Popover({
  trigger,
  children,
  align = "left",
  className,
}: PopoverProps) {
  const id = useId();
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const ref = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!open) return;
    const onDoc = (e: MouseEvent) => {
      if (ref.current && !ref.current.contains(e.target as Node))
        setOpen(false);
    };
    const onEsc = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (e.key === "Escape") setOpen(false);
    };
    document.addEventListener("mousedown", onDoc);
    document.addEventListener("keydown", onEsc);
    return () => {
      document.removeEventListener("mousedown", onDoc);
      document.removeEventListener("keydown", onEsc);
    };
  }, [open]);

  return (
    <div ref={ref} className="relative inline-block">
      {trigger({
        open,
        toggle: () => setOpen((s) => !s),
        "aria-expanded": open,
        "aria-controls": id,
      })}
      {open && (
        <div
          id={id}
          role="dialog"
          className={cn(
            "absolute z-40 top-full mt-2 min-w-[220px] rounded-md bg-white border border-neutral-300 shadow-lg p-3",
            align === "left" ? "left-0" : "right-0",
            className,
          )}
        >
          {children}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
```

## 2.15 `Modal.tsx`

```tsx
import { useEffect, useRef, type ReactNode } from "react";
import { createPortal } from "react-dom";
import { X } from "lucide-react";
import { cn } from "./utils/cn";

export interface ModalProps {
  open: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  title: string;
  children: ReactNode;
  footer?: ReactNode;
  size?: "sm" | "md" | "lg";
}

const sizes = { sm: "max-w-md", md: "max-w-xl", lg: "max-w-3xl" };

export function Modal({
  open,
  onClose,
  title,
  children,
  footer,
  size = "md",
}: ModalProps) {
  const dialogRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const lastFocus = useRef<HTMLElement | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!open) return;
    lastFocus.current = document.activeElement as HTMLElement;
    const t = setTimeout(() => {
      const first = dialogRef.current?.querySelector<HTMLElement>(
        'button, [href], input, select, textarea, [tabindex]:not([tabindex="-1"])',
      );
      first?.focus();
    }, 0);

    const onKey = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (e.key === "Escape") onClose();
      if (e.key === "Tab" && dialogRef.current) {
        const focusables = dialogRef.current.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>(
          'button, [href], input, select, textarea, [tabindex]:not([tabindex="-1"])',
        );
        if (focusables.length === 0) return;
        const first = focusables[0]!;
        const last = focusables[focusables.length - 1]!;
        if (e.shiftKey && document.activeElement === first) {
          e.preventDefault();
          last.focus();
        } else if (!e.shiftKey && document.activeElement === last) {
          e.preventDefault();
          first.focus();
        }
      }
    };

    document.addEventListener("keydown", onKey);
    document.body.style.overflow = "hidden";
    return () => {
      clearTimeout(t);
      document.removeEventListener("keydown", onKey);
      document.body.style.overflow = "";
      lastFocus.current?.focus();
    };
  }, [open, onClose]);

  if (!open) return null;

  return createPortal(
    <div
      className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4 bg-neutral-900/55"
      onClick={onClose}
    >
      <div
        ref={dialogRef}
        role="dialog"
        aria-modal="true"
        aria-labelledby="modal-title"
        onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
        className={cn(
          "w-full rounded-lg bg-white shadow-lg max-h-[90vh] flex flex-col",
          sizes[size],
        )}
      >
        <header className="flex items-start justify-between gap-4 p-5 pb-2">
          <h2 id="modal-title" className="text-h2">
            {title}
          </h2>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={onClose}
            aria-label="Close"
            className="p-1 -mr-1 rounded-md text-neutral-600 hover:bg-neutral-100"
          >
            <X className="h-5 w-5" />
          </button>
        </header>
        <div className="px-5 pb-5 overflow-y-auto flex-1">{children}</div>
        {footer && (
          <footer className="px-5 py-3 border-t border-neutral-300 bg-neutral-50 rounded-b-lg flex justify-end gap-2">
            {footer}
          </footer>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>,
    document.body,
  );
}
```

## 2.18 `Toast.tsx` (Provider + hook)

```tsx
import {
  createContext,
  useCallback,
  useContext,
  useMemo,
  useState,
  type ReactNode,
} from "react";
import { CheckCircle2, Info, AlertTriangle, XCircle, X } from "lucide-react";
import { cn } from "./utils/cn";

export type ToastType = "success" | "info" | "warning" | "error";

interface Toast {
  id: string;
  type: ToastType;
  message: string;
  duration: number;
}

interface ToastCtx {
  push: (type: ToastType, message: string, duration?: number) => void;
}

const Ctx = createContext<ToastCtx | null>(null);

const icons = {
  success: <CheckCircle2 className="h-5 w-5 text-green-500" aria-hidden />,
  info: <Info className="h-5 w-5 text-blue-500" aria-hidden />,
  warning: <AlertTriangle className="h-5 w-5 text-amber-500" aria-hidden />,
  error: <XCircle className="h-5 w-5 text-red-500" aria-hidden />,
};

export function ToastProvider({ children }: { children: ReactNode }) {
  const [toasts, setToasts] = useState<Toast[]>([]);

  const remove = useCallback(
    (id: string) => setToasts((t) => t.filter((x) => x.id !== id)),
    [],
  );

  const push = useCallback(
    (type: ToastType, message: string, duration = 5000) => {
      const id = crypto.randomUUID();
      setToasts((t) => [...t, { id, type, message, duration }]);
      if (duration > 0) setTimeout(() => remove(id), duration);
    },
    [remove],
  );

  const value = useMemo(() => ({ push }), [push]);

  return (
    <Ctx.Provider value={value}>
      {children}
      <div
        role="region"
        aria-live="polite"
        aria-label="Notifications"
        className="fixed bottom-4 right-4 z-[100] flex flex-col gap-2 pointer-events-none"
      >
        {toasts.map((t) => (
          <div
            key={t.id}
            className={cn(
              "pointer-events-auto flex items-start gap-3 min-w-[280px] max-w-[400px] px-4 py-3 rounded-md shadow-lg bg-white border-l-4",
              t.type === "success" && "border-l-green-500",
              t.type === "info" && "border-l-blue-500",
              t.type === "warning" && "border-l-amber-500",
              t.type === "error" && "border-l-red-500",
            )}
          >
            {icons[t.type]}
            <div className="flex-1 text-body-sm text-neutral-900">
              {t.message}
            </div>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => remove(t.id)}
              aria-label="Dismiss"
              className="text-neutral-600 hover:text-neutral-900"
            >
              <X className="h-4 w-4" />
            </button>
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>
    </Ctx.Provider>
  );
}

export function useToast() {
  const ctx = useContext(Ctx);
  if (!ctx) throw new Error("useToast must be used within ToastProvider");
  return ctx;
}
```

Then update `src/app/providers.tsx` to wrap with `<ToastProvider>`.

## 2.23 `DataGrid.tsx`

Generic, sortable, paginated, keyboard-navigable. Accepts typed rows and column defs.

```tsx
import { useMemo, useState, type ReactNode } from "react";
import { ChevronDown, ChevronUp, ChevronsUpDown } from "lucide-react";
import { cn } from "./utils/cn";

export interface Column<T> {
  id: keyof T & string;
  header: string;
  width?: string;
  align?: "left" | "right" | "center";
  sortable?: boolean;
  render?: (row: T) => ReactNode;
  className?: string;
}

export interface DataGridProps<T extends { id: string }> {
  columns: Column<T>[];
  rows: T[];
  loading?: boolean;
  onRowClick?: (row: T) => void;
  emptyMessage?: string;
  ariaLabel?: string;
}

type SortDir = "asc" | "desc" | null;

export function DataGrid<T extends { id: string }>({
  columns,
  rows,
  loading,
  onRowClick,
  emptyMessage = "No records",
  ariaLabel,
}: DataGridProps<T>) {
  const [sortCol, setSortCol] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [sortDir, setSortDir] = useState<SortDir>(null);

  const sorted = useMemo(() => {
    if (!sortCol || !sortDir) return rows;
    const arr = [...rows];
    arr.sort((a, b) => {
      const va = (a as any)[sortCol];
      const vb = (b as any)[sortCol];
      if (va == null) return 1;
      if (vb == null) return -1;
      const cmp = va > vb ? 1 : va < vb ? -1 : 0;
      return sortDir === "asc" ? cmp : -cmp;
    });
    return arr;
  }, [rows, sortCol, sortDir]);

  const toggle = (col: string) => {
    if (sortCol !== col) {
      setSortCol(col);
      setSortDir("asc");
      return;
    }
    setSortDir((d) => (d === "asc" ? "desc" : d === "desc" ? null : "asc"));
    if (sortDir === "desc") setSortCol(null);
  };

  return (
    <div className="w-full overflow-x-auto rounded-md border border-neutral-300 bg-white">
      <table
        className="w-full border-collapse text-body-sm"
        aria-label={ariaLabel}
      >
        <thead>
          <tr>
            {columns.map((c) => {
              const active = sortCol === c.id && sortDir;
              return (
                <th
                  key={c.id}
                  scope="col"
                  style={{ width: c.width }}
                  aria-sort={
                    active === "asc"
                      ? "ascending"
                      : active === "desc"
                        ? "descending"
                        : c.sortable
                          ? "none"
                          : undefined
                  }
                  className={cn(
                    "bg-primary-700 text-white font-bold text-caption uppercase tracking-wide px-3 py-2.5 sticky top-0",
                    c.align === "right" && "text-right",
                    c.align === "center" && "text-center",
                    "text-left",
                  )}
                >
                  {c.sortable ? (
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() => toggle(c.id)}
                      className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 hover:opacity-90"
                    >
                      {c.header}
                      {active === "asc" ? (
                        <ChevronUp className="h-3 w-3" />
                      ) : active === "desc" ? (
                        <ChevronDown className="h-3 w-3" />
                      ) : (
                        <ChevronsUpDown className="h-3 w-3 opacity-60" />
                      )}
                    </button>
                  ) : (
                    c.header
                  )}
                </th>
              );
            })}
          </tr>
        </thead>
        <tbody>
          {loading && (
            <tr>
              <td
                colSpan={columns.length}
                className="p-8 text-center text-neutral-600"
              >
                Loading…
              </td>
            </tr>
          )}
          {!loading && sorted.length === 0 && (
            <tr>
              <td
                colSpan={columns.length}
                className="p-8 text-center text-neutral-600"
              >
                {emptyMessage}
              </td>
            </tr>
          )}
          {!loading &&
            sorted.map((row) => (
              <tr
                key={row.id}
                onClick={onRowClick ? () => onRowClick(row) : undefined}
                tabIndex={onRowClick ? 0 : undefined}
                onKeyDown={
                  onRowClick
                    ? (e) => {
                        if (e.key === "Enter" || e.key === " ") {
                          e.preventDefault();
                          onRowClick(row);
                        }
                      }
                    : undefined
                }
                className={cn(
                  "even:bg-neutral-50 border-t border-neutral-300",
                  onRowClick &&
                    "cursor-pointer hover:bg-primary-100 focus-visible:bg-primary-100 focus-visible:outline-none",
                )}
              >
                {columns.map((c) => (
                  <td
                    key={c.id}
                    className={cn(
                      "px-3 py-2.5 align-middle",
                      c.align === "right" && "text-right",
                      c.align === "center" && "text-center",
                      c.className,
                    )}
                  >
                    {c.render
                      ? c.render(row)
                      : String((row as any)[c.id] ?? "—")}
                  </td>
                ))}
              </tr>
            ))}
        </tbody>
      </table>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import { cn } from "./utils/cn";
import { IconButton } from "./IconButton";

export interface PaginationProps {
  page: number;
  pageSize: number;
  total: number;
  onPageChange: (page: number) => void;
  onPageSizeChange?: (size: number) => void;
  pageSizeOptions?: number[];
}

export function Pagination({
  page,
  pageSize,
  total,
  onPageChange,
  onPageSizeChange,
  pageSizeOptions = [25, 50, 100, 200],
}: PaginationProps) {
  const totalPages = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(total / pageSize));
  const from = total === 0 ? 0 : (page - 1) * pageSize + 1;
  const to = Math.min(total, page * pageSize);

  return (
    <nav
      aria-label="Pagination"
      className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3 mt-3"
    >
      <div className="text-caption text-neutral-600">
        Showing{" "}
        <b>
          {from}–{to}
        </b>{" "}
        of <b>{total.toLocaleString()}</b>
      </div>

      <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
        {onPageSizeChange && (
          <label className="text-caption text-neutral-600 inline-flex items-center gap-1.5">
            Rows:
            <select
              value={pageSize}
              onChange={(e) => onPageSizeChange(Number(e.target.value))}
              className="h-7 rounded border border-neutral-300 bg-white px-1.5 text-caption"
            >
              {pageSizeOptions.map((n) => (
                <option key={n} value={n}>
                  {n}
                </option>
              ))}
            </select>
          </label>
        )}

        <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
          <IconButton
            label="Previous page"
            size="sm"
            icon={<ChevronLeft className="h-4 w-4" />}
            onClick={() => onPageChange(page - 1)}
            disabled={page <= 1}
          />
          <span className={cn("px-2 text-caption text-neutral-600")}>
            Page {page} / {totalPages}
          </span>
          <IconButton
            label="Next page"
            size="sm"
            icon={<ChevronRight className="h-4 w-4" />}
            onClick={() => onPageChange(page + 1)}
            disabled={page >= totalPages}
          />
        </div>
      </div>
    </nav>
  );
}
```

## 2.27 `Tabs.tsx`

```tsx
import { useId, useState, type ReactNode } from "react";
import { cn } from "./utils/cn";

export interface TabDef {
  id: string;
  label: string;
  content: ReactNode;
  disabled?: boolean;
}

export function Tabs({
  tabs,
  defaultTab,
  onChange,
  className,
}: {
  tabs: TabDef[];
  defaultTab?: string;
  onChange?: (id: string) => void;
  className?: string;
}) {
  const uid = useId();
  const [active, setActive] = useState(defaultTab ?? tabs[0]?.id);

  const onKey = (e: React.KeyboardEvent, idx: number) => {
    if (e.key === "ArrowRight") {
      e.preventDefault();
      const next = tabs[(idx + 1) % tabs.length]!;
      setActive(next.id);
      onChange?.(next.id);
    } else if (e.key === "ArrowLeft") {
      e.preventDefault();
      const prev = tabs[(idx - 1 + tabs.length) % tabs.length]!;
      setActive(prev.id);
      onChange?.(prev.id);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className={className}>
      <div
        role="tablist"
        aria-label="Tabs"
        className="flex gap-1 border-b border-neutral-300 overflow-x-auto"
      >
        {tabs.map((t, i) => {
          const selected = active === t.id;
          return (
            <button
              key={t.id}
              role="tab"
              id={`${uid}-tab-${t.id}`}
              aria-selected={selected}
              aria-controls={`${uid}-panel-${t.id}`}
              tabIndex={selected ? 0 : -1}
              disabled={t.disabled}
              onKeyDown={(e) => onKey(e, i)}
              onClick={() => {
                setActive(t.id);
                onChange?.(t.id);
              }}
              className={cn(
                "px-4 py-2.5 text-body-sm font-semibold whitespace-nowrap border-b-2 -mb-px",
                selected
                  ? "border-primary-700 text-primary-700"
                  : "border-transparent text-neutral-600 hover:text-primary-700",
                "disabled:opacity-50 disabled:cursor-not-allowed",
              )}
            >
              {t.label}
            </button>
          );
        })}
      </div>
      {tabs.map((t) => (
        <div
          key={t.id}
          role="tabpanel"
          id={`${uid}-panel-${t.id}`}
          aria-labelledby={`${uid}-tab-${t.id}`}
          hidden={active !== t.id}
          className="pt-4"
        >
          {t.content}
        </div>
      ))}
    </div>
  );
}
```

## 2.28 `Accordion.tsx`

```tsx
import { useState, type ReactNode } from "react";
import { ChevronDown } from "lucide-react";
import { cn } from "./utils/cn";

export interface AccordionItem {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  content: ReactNode;
}

export function Accordion({
  items,
  defaultOpen = [],
  allowMultiple = true,
}: {
  items: AccordionItem[];
  defaultOpen?: string[];
  allowMultiple?: boolean;
}) {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState<string[]>(defaultOpen);
  const toggle = (id: string) =>
    setOpen((cur) => {
      const isOpen = cur.includes(id);
      if (isOpen) return cur.filter((x) => x !== id);
      return allowMultiple ? [...cur, id] : [id];
    });

  return (
    <div className="divide-y divide-neutral-300 border border-neutral-300 rounded-md bg-white">
      {items.map((it) => {
        const isOpen = open.includes(it.id);
        return (
          <div key={it.id}>
            <h3>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => toggle(it.id)}
                aria-expanded={isOpen}
                aria-controls={`acc-${it.id}`}
                className="flex w-full items-center justify-between gap-3 px-4 py-3 text-left hover:bg-neutral-50"
              >
                <span className="text-body-sm font-semibold text-primary-900">
                  {it.title}
                </span>
                <ChevronDown
                  className={cn(
                    "h-4 w-4 text-neutral-600 transition-transform",
                    isOpen && "rotate-180",
                  )}
                  aria-hidden
                />
              </button>
            </h3>
            <div
              id={`acc-${it.id}`}
              role="region"
              hidden={!isOpen}
              className="px-4 pb-4 text-body-sm text-neutral-600"
            >
              {it.content}
            </div>
          </div>
        );
      })}
    </div>
  );
}
```

## 2.30 `Stepper.tsx`

```tsx
import { Check } from "lucide-react";
import { cn } from "./utils/cn";

export interface StepDef {
  id: string;
  label: string;
  description?: string;
}

export function Stepper({
  steps,
  current,
  onStepClick,
}: {
  steps: StepDef[];
  current: number;
  onStepClick?: (i: number) => void;
}) {
  return (
    <ol className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 w-full">
      {steps.map((s, i) => {
        const state =
          i < current ? "done" : i === current ? "active" : "pending";
        return (
          <li
            key={s.id}
            className="flex items-center gap-2 flex-1 min-w-[140px]"
          >
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={onStepClick ? () => onStepClick(i) : undefined}
              disabled={!onStepClick || i > current}
              className={cn(
                "flex items-center gap-2 flex-1 text-left rounded-md p-1",
                onStepClick && i <= current && "hover:bg-neutral-100",
              )}
            >
              <span
                aria-hidden
                className={cn(
                  "flex h-7 w-7 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full text-caption font-bold",
                  state === "done" && "bg-primary-700 text-white",
                  state === "active" && "bg-accent-500 text-primary-900",
                  state === "pending" && "bg-neutral-200 text-neutral-600",
                )}
              >
                {state === "done" ? <Check className="h-4 w-4" /> : i + 1}
              </span>
              <span>
                <span
                  className={cn(
                    "block text-body-sm font-semibold",
                    state === "active"
                      ? "text-primary-900"
                      : "text-neutral-600",
                  )}
                >
                  {s.label}
                </span>
                {s.description && (
                  <span className="block text-caption text-neutral-600">
                    {s.description}
                  </span>
                )}
              </span>
            </button>
            {i < steps.length - 1 && (
              <span
                aria-hidden
                className="hidden md:block h-px w-6 bg-neutral-300"
              />
            )}
          </li>
        );
      })}
    </ol>
  );
}
```

## 2.31 `Progress.tsx`

```tsx
import { cn } from "./utils/cn";

export function Progress({
  value,
  max = 100,
  label,
  tone = "primary",
  className,
}: {
  value: number;
  max?: number;
  label?: string;
  tone?: "primary" | "success" | "warning" | "danger";
  className?: string;
}) {
  const pct = Math.min(100, Math.max(0, (value / max) * 100));
  const barCls = {
    primary: "bg-primary-700",
    success: "bg-green-500",
    warning: "bg-amber-500",
    danger: "bg-red-500",
  }[tone];

  return (
    <div className={className}>
      <div
        className="h-2.5 w-full bg-neutral-200 rounded-full overflow-hidden"
        role="progressbar"
        aria-valuemin={0}
        aria-valuemax={max}
        aria-valuenow={value}
        aria-label={label}
      >
        <div
          className={cn("h-full transition-all", barCls)}
          style={{ width: `${pct}%` }}
        />
      </div>
      {label && (
        <div className="text-caption text-neutral-600 mt-1">{label}</div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import { cn } from "./utils/cn";

export type TLStatus = "ON_TRACK" | "AT_RISK" | "OFF_TRACK" | "NOT_STARTED";

const cfg: Record<TLStatus, { label: string; cls: string; dot: string }> = {
  ON_TRACK: { label: "On-track", cls: "text-green-700", dot: "bg-green-500" },
  AT_RISK: { label: "At-risk", cls: "text-amber-700", dot: "bg-amber-500" },
  OFF_TRACK: { label: "Off-track", cls: "text-red-700", dot: "bg-red-500" },
  NOT_STARTED: {
    label: "Not started",
    cls: "text-neutral-600",
    dot: "bg-slate-400",
  },
};

export function TrafficLight({
  status,
  percent,
  className,
}: {
  status: TLStatus;
  percent?: number;
  className?: string;
}) {
  const c = cfg[status];
  return (
    <span
      className={cn(
        "inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 text-caption font-bold",
        c.cls,
        className,
      )}
      aria-label={`Status: ${c.label}${percent != null ? ` (${percent}%)` : ""}`}
    >
      <span aria-hidden className={cn("h-2.5 w-2.5 rounded-full", c.dot)} />
      {c.label}
      {percent != null && <span className="opacity-70">· {percent}%</span>}
    </span>
  );
}
```

## 2.35 Tests — `__tests__/Button.test.tsx`

```tsx
import { describe, it, expect, vi } from "vitest";
import { render, screen } from "@testing-library/react";
import userEvent from "@testing-library/user-event";
import { Button } from "../Button";

describe("Button", () => {
  it("renders with accessible name", () => {
    render(<Button>Save</Button>);
    expect(screen.getByRole("button", { name: "Save" })).toBeInTheDocument();
  });

  it("fires onClick", async () => {
    const onClick = vi.fn();
    render(<Button onClick={onClick}>Go</Button>);
    await userEvent.click(screen.getByRole("button", { name: "Go" }));
    expect(onClick).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
  });

  it("disables interaction when loading", async () => {
    const onClick = vi.fn();
    render(
      <Button loading onClick={onClick}>
        Save
      </Button>,
    );
    const btn = screen.getByRole("button");
    expect(btn).toBeDisabled();
    expect(btn).toHaveAttribute("aria-busy", "true");
    await userEvent.click(btn);
    expect(onClick).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it("danger variant renders", () => {
    render(<Button variant="danger">Delete</Button>);
    expect(screen.getByRole("button", { name: "Delete" })).toHaveClass(
      "bg-danger",
    );
  });
});
```

## 2.36 Tests — `__tests__/DataGrid.test.tsx`

```tsx
import { describe, it, expect, vi } from "vitest";
import { render, screen } from "@testing-library/react";
import userEvent from "@testing-library/user-event";
import { DataGrid, type Column } from "../DataGrid";

interface Row {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  budget: number;
}

const cols: Column<Row>[] = [
  { id: "name", header: "Name", sortable: true },
  {
    id: "budget",
    header: "Budget",
    align: "right",
    sortable: true,
    render: (r) => <span>ETB {r.budget.toLocaleString()}</span>,
  },
];

const rows: Row[] = [
  { id: "1", name: "Alpha", budget: 5000 },
  { id: "2", name: "Bravo", budget: 1200 },
];

describe("DataGrid", () => {
  it("renders rows and headers", () => {
    render(<DataGrid columns={cols} rows={rows} ariaLabel="Projects" />);
    expect(screen.getByRole("table", { name: "Projects" })).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(screen.getByText("Alpha")).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(screen.getByText("ETB 5,000")).toBeInTheDocument();
  });

  it("sorts ascending then descending on column click", async () => {
    render(<DataGrid columns={cols} rows={rows} />);
    const budgetHeader = screen.getByRole("button", { name: /Budget/i });
    await userEvent.click(budgetHeader);
    const cells = screen.getAllByRole("cell");
    // first data cell should be Bravo (smallest) after asc sort
    const firstRowFirstCell = cells[2]; // header row consumes cells[0..]
    expect(screen.getAllByRole("row")[1]).toHaveTextContent("Bravo");
  });

  it("calls onRowClick when Enter pressed", async () => {
    const onRowClick = vi.fn();
    render(<DataGrid columns={cols} rows={rows} onRowClick={onRowClick} />);
    const row = screen.getByText("Alpha").closest("tr")!;
    row.focus();
    await userEvent.keyboard("{Enter}");
    expect(onRowClick).toHaveBeenCalledWith(rows[0]);
  });

  it("shows empty message", () => {
    render(<DataGrid columns={cols} rows={[]} emptyMessage="No projects" />);
    expect(screen.getByText("No projects")).toBeInTheDocument();
  });
});
```

```tsx
{
  import.meta.env.DEV && (
    <Route path="/design-system" element={<DesignSystemPage />} />
  );
}
```

---

# Step 3 — Authentication & Role Infrastructure

Complete auth lifecycle: login → MFA → session → refresh → idle timeout → logout. Plus RBAC primitives every feature will consume: `usePermissions()`, `<RequireAuth>`, `<RequirePermission>`, `<RequireRole>`. All 43 roles from the Role Register are declared with their permission sets.

---

## 3.0 What Step 3 Delivers

| #   | Deliverable                                                | Purpose          |
| --- | ---------------------------------------------------------- | ---------------- |
| 1   | `auth.types.ts` — 43 roles + permission catalog            | Type-safe RBAC   |
| 2   | `auth.api.ts` — login/refresh/logout/me                    | API layer        |
| 3   | `auth.store.ts` — enhanced state (tokens, idle, broadcast) | Session          |
| 4   | `useIdleTimeout()` — 30-min idle with warning              | Session security |
| 5   | `usePermissions()` — `can`, `canAny`, `canAll`, `scope`    | RBAC hook        |
| 6   | `<RequireAuth>`, `<RequirePermission>`, `<RequireRole>`    | Route guards     |
| 7   | Full `LoginPage` + `MFAChallenge`                          | Entry            |
| 8   | `IdleTimeoutWarning` modal                                 | Warning          |
| 9   | `RoleSwitcher` (dev only)                                  | Testing          |
| 10  | Gated router for all 23 modules                            | Routing          |
| 11  | Multi-tab logout via `BroadcastChannel`                    | Consistency      |
| 12  | Tests (store, guard, hook)                                 | Quality          |

---

## 3.1 `src/features/auth/auth.types.ts`

The complete RBAC model. Every role from the Role Register maps to a permission set and a data scope.

```ts
export type Permission = (typeof PERMISSIONS)[keyof typeof PERMISSIONS];

/* =========================================================================
 * Scope — data visibility bound by org / geography
 * ========================================================================= */
export interface AuthScope {
  orgId: string;
  orgLevel: "FEDERAL" | "REGIONAL" | "ZONAL" | "WOREDA" | "KEBELE" | "EXTERNAL";
  regions?: string[]; // e.g. ['Oromia', 'Amhara']
  zones?: string[];
  woredas?: string[];
  kebeles?: string[];
  ownRecordsOnly?: boolean; // e.g. suppliers see only own contracts
}

/* =========================================================================
 * User
 * ========================================================================= */
export interface AuthUser {
  userId: string;
  username: string;
  fullName: string;
  fullNameAm?: string;
  email: string;
  orgId: string;
  orgName: string;
  role: RoleCode;
  roleName: string;
  permissions: Permission[];
  scope: AuthScope;
  mfaEnabled: boolean;
  locale: "en" | "am";
  lastLoginAt: string;
}

/* =========================================================================
 * Sessions & Tokens
 * ========================================================================= */
export interface AuthTokens {
  accessToken: string;
  refreshToken: string;
  expiresAt: number; // epoch ms
  refreshExpiresAt: number;
}

export interface LoginRequest {
  username: string;
  password: string;
  mfaCode?: string;
  rememberDevice?: boolean;
}

export interface LoginResponse {
  user: AuthUser;
  access_token: string;
  refresh_token: string;
  expires_in: number;
  refresh_expires_in: number;
  mfa_required?: boolean;
  mfa_token?: string; // short-lived, for MFA challenge
}

export interface MFAChallengeRequest {
  mfa_token: string;
  mfa_code: string;
  remember_device?: boolean;
}
```

## 3.2 `src/features/auth/auth.api.ts`

```ts
import { api } from "@/lib/api/client";
import type {
  LoginRequest,
  LoginResponse,
  MFAChallengeRequest,
  AuthUser,
} from "./auth.types";

interface ApiEnvelope<T> {
  data: T;
}

export const authApi = {
  async login(req: LoginRequest): Promise<LoginResponse> {
    const { data } = await api.post<ApiEnvelope<LoginResponse>>(
      "/auth/login",
      req,
    );
    return data.data;
  },

  async completeMFA(req: MFAChallengeRequest): Promise<LoginResponse> {
    const { data } = await api.post<ApiEnvelope<LoginResponse>>(
      "/auth/mfa/verify",
      req,
    );
    return data.data;
  },

  async refresh(
    refreshToken: string,
  ): Promise<{ access_token: string; expires_in: number }> {
    const { data } = await api.post<
      ApiEnvelope<{ access_token: string; expires_in: number }>
    >(
      "/auth/refresh",
      { refresh_token: refreshToken },
      { headers: { Authorization: "" } }, // refresh uses body token, not header
    );
    return data.data;
  },

  async logout(refreshToken: string): Promise<void> {
    await api.post("/auth/logout", { refresh_token: refreshToken });
  },

  async me(): Promise<AuthUser> {
    const { data } = await api.get<ApiEnvelope<AuthUser>>("/auth/me");
    return data.data;
  },

  async requestPasswordReset(email: string): Promise<void> {
    await api.post("/auth/password-reset", { email });
  },
};
```

## 3.3 `src/stores/auth.store.ts` — Enhanced

Replaces the Step 1 version. Adds single-flight refresh, token expiry tracking, and cross-tab broadcast.

```ts
import { create } from "zustand";
import { persist, createJSONStorage } from "zustand/middleware";
import { authApi } from "@/features/auth/auth.api";
import {
  rolePermissions,
  roleHome,
  type AuthUser,
  type LoginRequest,
  type Permission,
  type RoleCode,
} from "@/features/auth/auth.types";

interface AuthState {
  user: AuthUser | null;
  accessToken: string | null;
  refreshToken: string | null;
  expiresAt: number | null; // access token expiry (epoch ms)
  refreshExpiresAt: number | null;
  hydrated: boolean;
  refreshing: Promise<boolean> | null; // single-flight guard

  login: (
    req: LoginRequest,
  ) => Promise<{ mfaRequired: boolean; mfaToken?: string }>;
  completeMFA: (
    mfaToken: string,
    code: string,
    remember?: boolean,
  ) => Promise<void>;
  setSession: (
    u: AuthUser,
    access: string,
    refresh: string,
    expiresIn: number,
    refreshExpiresIn: number,
  ) => void;
  refresh: () => Promise<boolean>;
  logout: (opts?: { silent?: boolean; broadcast?: boolean }) => void;
  has: (p: Permission) => boolean;
  homeRoute: () => string;
}

/* ---- Cross-tab broadcast ---- */
const AUTH_CHANNEL = "piims.auth";
const bc: BroadcastChannel | null =
  typeof BroadcastChannel !== "undefined"
    ? new BroadcastChannel(AUTH_CHANNEL)
    : null;

export const useAuthStore = create<AuthState>()(
  persist(
    (set, get) => ({
      user: null,
      accessToken: null,
      refreshToken: null,
      expiresAt: null,
      refreshExpiresAt: null,
      hydrated: false,
      refreshing: null,

      async login(req) {
        const res = await authApi.login(req);
        if (res.mfa_required && res.mfa_token) {
          return { mfaRequired: true, mfaToken: res.mfa_token };
        }
        get().setSession(
          res.user,
          res.access_token,
          res.refresh_token,
          res.expires_in,
          res.refresh_expires_in,
        );
        return { mfaRequired: false };
      },

      async completeMFA(mfaToken, code, remember) {
        const res = await authApi.completeMFA({
          mfa_token: mfaToken,
          mfa_code: code,
          remember_device: remember,
        });
        get().setSession(
          res.user,
          res.access_token,
          res.refresh_token,
          res.expires_in,
          res.refresh_expires_in,
        );
      },

      setSession(user, access, refresh, expiresIn, refreshExpiresIn) {
        const now = Date.now();
        set({
          user,
          accessToken: access,
          refreshToken: refresh,
          expiresAt: now + expiresIn * 1000,
          refreshExpiresAt: now + refreshExpiresIn * 1000,
        });
        bc?.postMessage({ type: "session:set", userId: user.userId, at: now });
      },

      async refresh() {
        const state = get();
        if (state.refreshing) return state.refreshing;
        if (!state.refreshToken) return false;

        const promise = (async () => {
          try {
            const res = await authApi.refresh(state.refreshToken!);
            set({
              accessToken: res.access_token,
              expiresAt: Date.now() + res.expires_in * 1000,
            });
            return true;
          } catch {
            return false;
          } finally {
            set({ refreshing: null });
          }
        })();
        set({ refreshing: promise });
        return promise;
      },

      logout(opts = {}) {
        const { refreshToken } = get();
        if (refreshToken && !opts.silent) {
          // Fire-and-forget server-side revocation
          authApi.logout(refreshToken).catch(() => {
            /* ignore */
          });
        }
        set({
          user: null,
          accessToken: null,
          refreshToken: null,
          expiresAt: null,
          refreshExpiresAt: null,
        });
        if (opts.broadcast !== false) {
          bc?.postMessage({ type: "session:clear", at: Date.now() });
        }
      },

      has(p) {
        const u = get().user;
        if (!u) return false;
        return u.permissions.includes(p);
      },

      homeRoute() {
        const u = get().user;
        return u ? roleHome(u.role) : "/login";
      },
    }),
    {
      name: "piims.auth",
      storage: createJSONStorage(() => localStorage),
      partialize: (s) => ({
        user: s.user,
        accessToken: s.accessToken,
        refreshToken: s.refreshToken,
        expiresAt: s.expiresAt,
        refreshExpiresAt: s.refreshExpiresAt,
      }),
      onRehydrateStorage: () => (state) => {
        state?.hydrated === false && useAuthStore.setState({ hydrated: true });
      },
    },
  ),
);

/* Cross-tab message handling */
bc?.addEventListener("message", (ev) => {
  const msg = ev.data;
  if (msg?.type === "session:clear") {
    useAuthStore.setState({
      user: null,
      accessToken: null,
      refreshToken: null,
      expiresAt: null,
      refreshExpiresAt: null,
    });
  }
  if (
    msg?.type === "session:set" &&
    msg.userId !== useAuthStore.getState().user?.userId
  ) {
    // Another tab logged in as a different user → force reload to sync
    window.location.reload();
  }
});

/* Expose for tests & debugging */
if (import.meta.env.DEV) {
  (window as any).__authStore = useAuthStore;
}
```

## 3.4 `src/features/auth/useIdleTimeout.ts`

30-minute idle session with a 2-minute warning. Emits warning 28 min, logs out at 30 min. Activity = mouse, keyboard, touch, scroll, visibility change.

```ts
import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { APP_CONFIG } from "@/app/config";
import { useAuthStore } from "@/stores/auth.store";

const WARN_BEFORE_MS = 2 * 60 * 1000;

export function useIdleTimeout(enabled: boolean) {
  const logout = useAuthStore((s) => s.logout);
  const [warning, setWarning] = useState(false);
  const lastActivityRef = useRef<number>(Date.now());
  const warnTimer = useRef<number | null>(null);
  const outTimer = useRef<number | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!enabled) return;

    const clearTimers = () => {
      if (warnTimer.current) window.clearTimeout(warnTimer.current);
      if (outTimer.current) window.clearTimeout(outTimer.current);
      warnTimer.current = null;
      outTimer.current = null;
    };

    const schedule = () => {
      clearTimers();
      warnTimer.current = window.setTimeout(
        () => setWarning(true),
        APP_CONFIG.idleTimeoutMs - WARN_BEFORE_MS,
      );
      outTimer.current = window.setTimeout(() => {
        setWarning(false);
        logout({ silent: false });
      }, APP_CONFIG.idleTimeoutMs);
    };

    const onActivity = () => {
      lastActivityRef.current = Date.now();
      if (warning) return; // don't restart while warning is visible — user must explicitly extend
      schedule();
    };

    const events: (keyof DocumentEventMap)[] = [
      "mousedown",
      "keydown",
      "touchstart",
      "scroll",
      "visibilitychange",
    ];
    events.forEach((e) =>
      document.addEventListener(e, onActivity, { passive: true }),
    );

    schedule();

    return () => {
      events.forEach((e) => document.removeEventListener(e, onActivity));
      clearTimers();
    };
  }, [enabled, logout, warning]);

  const extend = () => {
    setWarning(false);
    lastActivityRef.current = Date.now();
  };

  const forceLogout = () => {
    setWarning(false);
    logout({ silent: false });
  };

  return { warning, extend, forceLogout };
}
```

## 3.5 `src/features/auth/usePermissions.ts`

```ts
import { useCallback, useMemo } from "react";
import { useAuthStore } from "@/stores/auth.store";
import type { Permission } from "./auth.types";
import type { AuthScope } from "./auth.types";

export interface PermissionsApi {
  can: (p: Permission) => boolean;
  canAny: (...ps: Permission[]) => boolean;
  canAll: (...ps: Permission[]) => boolean;
  scope: AuthScope | null;
  isRole: (...roles: string[]) => boolean;
}

export function usePermissions(): PermissionsApi {
  const user = useAuthStore((s) => s.user);
  const permsSet = useMemo(() => new Set(user?.permissions ?? []), [user]);

  const can = useCallback((p: Permission) => permsSet.has(p), [permsSet]);
  const canAny = useCallback(
    (...ps: Permission[]) => ps.some((p) => permsSet.has(p)),
    [permsSet],
  );
  const canAll = useCallback(
    (...ps: Permission[]) => ps.every((p) => permsSet.has(p)),
    [permsSet],
  );
  const isRole = useCallback(
    (...roles: string[]) => !!user && roles.includes(user.role),
    [user],
  );

  return { can, canAny, canAll, scope: user?.scope ?? null, isRole };
}
```

## 3.6 Route Guards — `src/features/auth/guards.tsx`

```tsx
import { Navigate, Outlet, useLocation } from "react-router-dom";
import { useAuthStore } from "@/stores/auth.store";
import { usePermissions } from "./usePermissions";
import type { Permission, RoleCode } from "./auth.types";

/* -------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * <RequireAuth> — gate for authenticated routes
 * ------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
export function RequireAuth() {
  const user = useAuthStore((s) => s.user);
  const location = useLocation();

  if (!user) {
    return (
      <Navigate
        to="/login"
        replace
        state={{ from: location.pathname + location.search }}
      />
    );
  }
  return <Outlet />;
}

/* -------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * <RequirePermission> — gate by single or multiple permissions
 * ------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
export interface RequirePermissionProps {
  perm?: Permission;
  anyOf?: Permission[];
  allOf?: Permission[];
  fallback?: React.ReactNode;
  redirectTo?: string;
}

export function RequirePermission({
  perm,
  anyOf,
  allOf,
  fallback,
  redirectTo,
}: RequirePermissionProps) {
  const { can, canAny, canAll } = usePermissions();

  const ok =
    (!perm || can(perm)) &&
    (!anyOf || canAny(...anyOf)) &&
    (!allOf || canAll(...allOf));

  if (!ok) {
    if (fallback) return <>{fallback}</>;
    if (redirectTo) return <Navigate to={redirectTo} replace />;
    return <ForbiddenPage />;
  }
  return <Outlet />;
}

/* -------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * <RequireRole> — gate by role membership (rare; prefer permissions)
 * ------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
export function RequireRole({
  roles,
  fallback,
}: {
  roles: RoleCode[];
  fallback?: React.ReactNode;
}) {
  const user = useAuthStore((s) => s.user);
  if (!user || !roles.includes(user.role)) {
    return fallback ? <>{fallback}</> : <ForbiddenPage />;
  }
  return <Outlet />;
}

/* -------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * Forbidden page — accessible 403
 * ------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
function ForbiddenPage() {
  return (
    <main
      id="main"
      role="alert"
      className="min-h-[60vh] flex items-center justify-center p-8"
    >
      <div className="text-center max-w-md">
        <div className="text-6xl font-extrabold text-primary-900">403</div>
        <h1 className="text-h2 mt-3">Access denied · መዳረሻ ተከልክሏል</h1>
        <p className="text-body-sm text-neutral-600 mt-2">
          Your role does not grant access to this area. Contact your
          administrator if you believe this is an error.
        </p>
        <a
          href="/dashboard"
          className="inline-block mt-5 px-4 py-2 rounded-md bg-primary-700 text-white font-semibold"
        >
          Back to dashboard
        </a>
      </div>
    </main>
  );
}
```
