```tsx
  const [mfaCode, setMfaCode] = useState("");
  const [mfaToken, setMfaToken] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [submitting, setSubmitting] = useState(false);

  const firstFieldRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
  const mfaRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);

  /* Redirect if already signed in */
  useEffect(() => {
    if (user) {
      const dest =
        (location.state as LocationState | null)?.from ?? homeRoute();
      navigate(dest, { replace: true });
    }
  }, [user, location.state, navigate, homeRoute]);

  /* Autofocus the active stage input */
  useEffect(() => {
    if (stage === "credentials") firstFieldRef.current?.focus();
    if (stage === "mfa") mfaRef.current?.focus();
  }, [stage]);

  const onSubmitCredentials = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setError(null);
    setSubmitting(true);
    try {
      const res = await login({ username, password, rememberDevice: remember });
      if (res.mfaRequired && res.mfaToken) {
        setMfaToken(res.mfaToken);
        setStage("mfa");
      } else {
        navigate(
          (location.state as LocationState | null)?.from ?? homeRoute(),
          { replace: true },
        );
      }
    } catch (err) {
      const problem = normalizeApiError(err);
      setError(problem.detail ?? problem.title ?? t("errors.generic"));
    } finally {
      setSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  const onSubmitMFA = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!mfaToken) return;
    setError(null);
    setSubmitting(true);
    try {
      await completeMFA(mfaToken, mfaCode, remember);
      navigate((location.state as LocationState | null)?.from ?? homeRoute(), {
        replace: true,
      });
    } catch (err) {
      const problem = normalizeApiError(err);
      setError(problem.detail ?? problem.title ?? t("errors.generic"));
    } finally {
      setSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen grid lg:grid-cols-2 bg-neutral-50">
      {/* Branding panel */}
      <aside
        aria-hidden
        className="hidden lg:flex flex-col justify-between p-12 text-white"
        style={{
          background:
            "linear-gradient(160deg,#0B1E3D 0%,#14315E 55%,#1E4976 100%)",
        }}
      >
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
          <div
            className="h-12 w-12 rounded-xl"
            style={{
              background:
                "conic-gradient(from 210deg,#38bdf8,#818cf8,#f472b6,#38bdf8)",
            }}
          />
          <div>
            <div className="text-lg font-extrabold tracking-wide">PIIMS</div>
            <div className="text-[11px] uppercase tracking-[0.18em] opacity-75">
              Impact-Enabled
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="max-w-md">
          <h2 className="text-3xl font-extrabold leading-tight">
            Project Inception Information Management System
          </h2>
          <p className="mt-4 opacity-85 leading-relaxed">
            Ministry of Water and Energy · Federal Democratic Republic of
            Ethiopia · Financed by the World Bank.
          </p>
          <div className="mt-8 space-y-2 text-sm opacity-75">
            <div>• 23 modules · 43 roles · 14 stakeholder groups</div>
            <div>• Bilingual · Offline-capable · Auditable</div>
            <div>• Impact measurement by design</div>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="text-xs opacity-60">
          © 2026 MoWE · Classification: Restricted
        </div>
      </aside>

      {/* Form panel */}
      <main id="main" className="flex items-center justify-center p-6 sm:p-10">
        <div className="w-full max-w-md">
          {/* Mobile brand */}
          <div className="lg:hidden flex items-center gap-3 mb-8">
            <div className="h-10 w-10 rounded-lg bg-primary-700" />
            <div>
              <div className="text-base font-extrabold text-primary-900">
                PIIMS
              </div>
              <div className="text-[10px] uppercase tracking-widest text-neutral-600">
                {t("app.tagline")}
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Language toggle */}
          <div className="flex justify-end mb-3">
            <div className="inline-flex overflow-hidden rounded-md border border-neutral-300 text-caption">
              <button
                type="button"
                className={cn(
                  "px-3 py-1.5 font-semibold",
                  locale === "en"
                    ? "bg-primary-700 text-white"
                    : "bg-white text-neutral-600",
                )}
                onClick={() => setLocale("en")}
              >
                English
              </button>
              <button
                type="button"
                className={cn(
                  "px-3 py-1.5 font-semibold",
                  locale === "am"
                    ? "bg-primary-700 text-white"
                    : "bg-white text-neutral-600",
                )}
                onClick={() => setLocale("am")}
              >
                አማርኛ
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>

          <header className="mb-6">
            <h1 className="text-h1 text-primary-900">
              {stage === "credentials" && t("actions.signIn")}
              {stage === "mfa" && "Two-factor verification"}
              {stage === "reset" && "Reset password"}
            </h1>
            <p className="text-body-sm text-neutral-600 mt-1">
              {stage === "credentials" &&
                "Sign in with your government credentials."}
              {stage === "mfa" &&
                "Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app."}
              {stage === "reset" && "Enter your email to receive a reset link."}
            </p>
          </header>

          {error && (
            <Banner
              tone="error"
              className="mb-4"
              onDismiss={() => setError(null)}
            >
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <AlertCircle className="h-4 w-4" aria-hidden />
                <span>{error}</span>
              </div>
            </Banner>
          )}

          {stage === "credentials" && (
            <form
              onSubmit={onSubmitCredentials}
              className="space-y-4"
              noValidate
            >
              <Input
                ref={firstFieldRef}
                label="Username / የተጠቃሚ ስም"
                autoComplete="username"
                autoCapitalize="none"
                spellCheck={false}
                required
                value={username}
                onChange={(e) => setUsername(e.target.value)}
              />
              <Input
                label="Password / የይለፍ ቃል"
                type="password"
                autoComplete="current-password"
                required
                value={password}
                onChange={(e) => setPassword(e.target.value)}
              />
              <Checkbox
                label="Remember this device / ይህን መሳሪያ አስታውስ"
                checked={remember}
                onChange={(e) => setRemember(e.target.checked)}
              />
              <Button
                type="submit"
                fullWidth
                size="lg"
                loading={submitting}
                leftIcon={
                  !submitting ? <ShieldCheck className="h-4 w-4" /> : undefined
                }
              >
                {submitting ? "Signing in…" : t("actions.signIn")}
              </Button>
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-caption text-neutral-600 pt-1">
                <button
                  type="button"
                  className="hover:underline"
                  onClick={() => setStage("reset")}
                >
                  Forgot password?
                </button>
                <span>MFA required for privileged roles</span>
              </div>
            </form>
          )}

          {stage === "mfa" && (
            <form onSubmit={onSubmitMFA} className="space-y-4" noValidate>
              <div className="flex justify-center">
                <div className="h-12 w-12 rounded-full bg-primary-100 flex items-center justify-center">
                  <KeyRound className="h-6 w-6 text-primary-700" aria-hidden />
                </div>
              </div>
              <Input
                ref={mfaRef}
                label="6-digit code / ባለ 6 አሃዝ ኮድ"
                inputMode="numeric"
                autoComplete="one-time-code"
                pattern="[0-9]{6}"
                maxLength={6}
                required
                value={mfaCode}
                onChange={(e) =>
                  setMfaCode(e.target.value.replace(/\D/g, "").slice(0, 6))
                }
                className="text-center text-lg tracking-[0.4em]"
              />
              <Checkbox
                label="Trust this device for 30 days"
                checked={remember}
                onChange={(e) => setRemember(e.target.checked)}
              />
              <Button type="submit" fullWidth size="lg" loading={submitting}>
                {submitting ? "Verifying…" : "Verify & continue"}
              </Button>
              <div className="text-center text-caption text-neutral-600">
                <button
                  type="button"
                  className="hover:underline"
                  onClick={() => setStage("credentials")}
                >
                  ← Back to sign in
                </button>
              </div>
            </form>
          )}

          {stage === "reset" && (
            <form
              onSubmit={(e) => {
                e.preventDefault();
                setStage("credentials");
              }}
              className="space-y-4"
              noValidate
            >
              <div className="flex justify-center">
                <div className="h-12 w-12 rounded-full bg-primary-100 flex items-center justify-center">
                  <Mail className="h-6 w-6 text-primary-700" aria-hidden />
                </div>
              </div>
              <Input
                label="Email address / ኢሜይል አድራሻ"
                type="email"
                autoComplete="email"
                required
              />
              <Button type="submit" fullWidth size="lg">
                Send reset link
              </Button>
              <div className="text-center text-caption text-neutral-600">
                <button
                  type="button"
                  className="hover:underline"
                  onClick={() => setStage("credentials")}
                >
                  ← Back to sign in
                </button>
              </div>
            </form>
          )}

          <p className="text-caption text-neutral-600 mt-8 text-center">
            Need help? Contact{" "}
            <a
              href="mailto:support@piims.gov.et"
              className="text-primary-700 hover:underline"
            >
              support@piims.gov.et
            </a>
          </p>

          {/* Hidden loading indicator for slow networks */}
          {submitting && (
            <div role="status" aria-live="polite" className="sr-only">
              <Loader2 className="animate-spin" /> Signing in, please wait…
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      </main>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## 3.8 `src/features/auth/IdleTimeoutWarning.tsx`

```tsx
import { useEffect, useRef } from "react";
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";
import { Modal } from "@/components/ui/Modal";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/Button";

export interface IdleTimeoutWarningProps {
  open: boolean;
  onExtend: () => void;
  onLogout: () => void;
  secondsLeft?: number;
}

export function IdleTimeoutWarning({
  open,
  onExtend,
  onLogout,
  secondsLeft = 120,
}: IdleTimeoutWarningProps) {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const ref = useRef<HTMLButtonElement>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (open) ref.current?.focus();
  }, [open]);

  return (
    <Modal
      open={open}
      onClose={onExtend}
      title="Session about to expire"
      size="sm"
      footer={
        <>
          <Button variant="ghost" onClick={onLogout}>
            {t("actions.signOut")}
          </Button>
          <Button ref={ref} onClick={onExtend}>
            Stay signed in
          </Button>
        </>
      }
    >
      <p className="text-body-sm text-neutral-600">
        Your session will expire in about {Math.floor(secondsLeft / 60)} minute
        {secondsLeft >= 120 ? "s" : ""} due to inactivity. Choose{" "}
        <b>Stay signed in</b> to continue working, or sign out now.
      </p>
    </Modal>
  );
}
```

## 3.9 `src/features/auth/RoleSwitcher.tsx` (dev only)

Simulates switching roles without a backend. Used by QA/design during prototyping.

```tsx
import { useAuthStore } from "@/stores/auth.store";
import {
  ROLE_CODES,
  roleLabel,
  rolePermissions,
  roleHome,
  type RoleCode,
} from "./auth.types";
import { cn } from "@/components/ui/utils/cn";

export function RoleSwitcher() {
  const user = useAuthStore((s) => s.user);
  if (!user) return null;

  const switchTo = (role: RoleCode) => {
    useAuthStore.setState({
      user: {
        ...user,
        role,
        roleName: roleLabel(role),
        permissions: rolePermissions(role),
        scope:
          role === "SP-AD" || role === "SP-OPS" || role === "SP-SVC"
            ? { ...user.scope, ownRecordsOnly: true }
            : user.scope,
      },
    });
    window.location.hash = roleHome(role);
  };

  return (
    <div
      role="region"
      aria-label="Developer role switcher"
      className="fixed bottom-0 left-0 right-0 z-[200] flex items-center gap-2 overflow-x-auto bg-primary-900 text-white px-3 py-2 text-caption shadow-lg"
    >
      <span className="font-extrabold tracking-widest text-[10px] opacity-60 uppercase shrink-0">
        Dev · Role
      </span>
      {ROLE_CODES.map((role) => (
        <button
          key={role}
          type="button"
          onClick={() => switchTo(role)}
          className={cn(
            "shrink-0 rounded-md px-2 py-1 font-semibold transition-colors border",
            user.role === role
              ? "bg-accent-500 border-accent-500 text-primary-900"
              : "bg-white/8 border-white/15 hover:bg-white/20",
          )}
        >
          {role}
        </button>
      ))}
    </div>
  );
}
```

## 3.10 `src/app/AppBootstrap.tsx`

Wraps the app: hydrates auth, wires idle timeout, renders guards.

```tsx
import { useEffect } from "react";
import { useAuthStore } from "@/stores/auth.store";
import { useIdleTimeout } from "@/features/auth/useIdleTimeout";
import { IdleTimeoutWarning } from "@/features/auth/IdleTimeoutWarning";
import { SyncBadge } from "@/components/ui/SyncBadge";

export function AppBootstrap({ children }: { children: React.ReactNode }) {
  const user = useAuthStore((s) => s.user);
  const { warning, extend, forceLogout } = useIdleTimeout(!!user);

  useEffect(() => {
    // Auto-refresh token 60 s before expiry
    if (!user) return;
    const expiresAt = useAuthStore.getState().expiresAt;
    if (!expiresAt) return;
    const ms = expiresAt - Date.now() - 60_000;
    if (ms <= 0) return;
    const id = window.setTimeout(() => {
      useAuthStore.getState().refresh();
    }, ms);
    return () => window.clearTimeout(id);
  }, [user]);

  return (
    <>
      {children}
      <IdleTimeoutWarning
        open={warning}
        onExtend={extend}
        onLogout={forceLogout}
      />
      {/* Global offline badge — visible on every page when relevant */}
      {user && (
        <div className="pointer-events-none fixed bottom-4 left-4 z-40">
          <div className="pointer-events-auto">
            <SyncBadge />
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </>
  );
}
```

## 3.11 `src/app/router.tsx` — Full Gated Router

All 23 modules routed, each wrapped in `<RequireAuth>` + `<RequirePermission>` + lazy-loaded.

```tsx
import { Suspense, lazy } from "react";
import { Routes, Route, Navigate } from "react-router-dom";
import { RequireAuth, RequirePermission } from "@/features/auth/guards";
import { PERMISSIONS } from "@/features/auth/auth.types";
import { LoadingState } from "@/components/ui/LoadingState";

/* ---- Lazy pages (only loaded when needed) ---- */
const LoginPage = lazy(() => import("@/features/auth/LoginPage"));
const DashboardPage = lazy(() => import("@/pages/DashboardPage"));
const NotFoundPage = lazy(() => import("@/pages/NotFoundPage"));

/* Projects (M2) */
const ProjectListPage = lazy(
  () => import("@/features/projects/ProjectListPage"),
);
const ProjectNewPage = lazy(() => import("@/features/projects/ProjectNewPage"));
const ProjectDetailPage = lazy(
  () => import("@/features/projects/ProjectDetailPage"),
);
const PipelinePage = lazy(() => import("@/features/projects/PipelinePage"));

/* Inception (M3) */
const InceptionListPage = lazy(
  () => import("@/features/inception/InceptionListPage"),
);
const InceptionReviewPage = lazy(
  () => import("@/features/inception/InceptionReviewPage"),
);

/* Results (M4) */
const ResultsPage = lazy(() => import("@/features/results/ResultsPage"));
const IndicatorEntryPage = lazy(
  () => import("@/features/results/IndicatorEntryPage"),
);

/* Financial (M5) */
const FinancialPage = lazy(() => import("@/features/financial/FinancialPage"));
const DisbursementPage = lazy(
  () => import("@/features/financial/DisbursementPage"),
);
const FmisSyncPage = lazy(() => import("@/features/financial/FmisSyncPage"));

/* Procurement (M6) */
const ProcurementPage = lazy(
  () => import("@/features/procurement/ProcurementPage"),
);

/* Supplier (M7) */
const SupplierPortalPage = lazy(
  () => import("@/features/supplier/SupplierPortalPage"),
);

/* Beneficiary (M8) */
const BeneficiaryPage = lazy(
  () => import("@/features/beneficiaries/BeneficiaryPage"),
);
const ServiceDeliveryPage = lazy(
  () => import("@/features/beneficiaries/ServiceDeliveryPage"),
);

/* GIS (M9) */
const MapPage = lazy(() => import("@/features/geo/MapPage"));

/* Documents (M10) */
const DocumentsPage = lazy(() => import("@/features/documents/DocumentsPage"));

/* Reports (M11) */
const ReportsPage = lazy(() => import("@/features/reports/ReportsPage"));

/* Grievance (M13) */
const GrievancePage = lazy(() => import("@/features/grievances/GrievancePage"));

/* Impact (M18–M23) */
const ImpactDashboardPage = lazy(
  () => import("@/features/impact/ImpactDashboardPage"),
);
const ImpactIndicatorsPage = lazy(
  () => import("@/features/impact/ImpactIndicatorsPage"),
);
const SurveyBuilderPage = lazy(
  () => import("@/features/impact/SurveyBuilderPage"),
);
const FieldOpsPage = lazy(() => import("@/features/impact/FieldOpsPage"));
const QAPage = lazy(() => import("@/features/impact/QAPage"));
const WarehousePage = lazy(() => import("@/features/impact/WarehousePage"));

/* Research (M22–M23) */
const ResearchCataloguePage = lazy(
  () => import("@/features/research/ResearchCataloguePage"),
);
const ResearchRequestsPage = lazy(
  () => import("@/features/research/ResearchRequestsPage"),
);

/* Admin (M16) */
const AdminHomePage = lazy(() => import("@/features/admin/AdminHomePage"));
const AdminUsersPage = lazy(() => import("@/features/admin/AdminUsersPage"));
const AdminIntegrationsPage = lazy(
  () => import("@/features/admin/AdminIntegrationsPage"),
);
const AuditPage = lazy(() => import("@/features/admin/AuditPage"));

/* Design system (dev only) */
const DesignSystemPage = lazy(() => import("@/pages/DesignSystemPage"));

export function AppRouter() {
  return (
    <Suspense fallback={<LoadingState message="Loading…" />}>
      <Routes>
        {/* ---- Public ---- */}
        <Route path="/login" element={<LoginPage />} />

        {/* ---- Protected ---- */}
        <Route element={<RequireAuth />}>
          <Route path="/" element={<Navigate to="/dashboard" replace />} />
          <Route path="/dashboard" element={<DashboardPage />} />

          {/* Projects */}
          <Route element={<RequirePermission perm={PERMISSIONS.projectRead} />}>
            <Route path="/projects" element={<ProjectListPage />} />
            <Route
              path="/projects/new"
              element={
                <RequirePermission
                  perm={PERMISSIONS.projectWrite}
                  fallback={<Navigate to="/projects" replace />}
                />
              }
            />
            <Route
              path="/projects/:projectId"
              element={<ProjectDetailPage />}
            />
            <Route path="/pipeline" element={<PipelinePage />} />
          </Route>

          {/* Inception */}
          <Route
            element={<RequirePermission perm={PERMISSIONS.inceptionRead} />}
          >
            <Route path="/inception" element={<InceptionListPage />} />
            <Route
              path="/inception/:reportId/review"
              element={
                <RequirePermission
                  anyOf={[
                    PERMISSIONS.inceptionReview,
                    PERMISSIONS.inceptionApprove,
                  ]}
                >
                  <InceptionReviewPage />
                </RequirePermission>
              }
            />
          </Route>

          {/* Results */}
          <Route element={<RequirePermission perm={PERMISSIONS.resultRead} />}>
            <Route path="/results" element={<ResultsPage />} />
            <Route
              path="/results/:indicatorId/entry"
              element={
                <RequirePermission perm={PERMISSIONS.resultWrite}>
                  <IndicatorEntryPage />
                </RequirePermission>
              }
            />
          </Route>

          {/* Financial */}
          <Route
            element={
              <RequirePermission
                anyOf={[PERMISSIONS.budgetRead, PERMISSIONS.disbursementRead]}
              />
            }
          >
            <Route path="/financial" element={<FinancialPage />} />
            <Route
              path="/financial/disbursements"
              element={<DisbursementPage />}
            />
            <Route
              path="/financial/fmis"
              element={
                <RequirePermission perm={PERMISSIONS.financeReconcile}>
                  <FmisSyncPage />
                </RequirePermission>
              }
            />
          </Route>

          {/* Procurement */}
          <Route
            element={<RequirePermission perm={PERMISSIONS.procurementRead} />}
          >
            <Route path="/procurement" element={<ProcurementPage />} />
          </Route>

          {/* Supplier */}
          <Route
            element={<RequirePermission perm={PERMISSIONS.supplierSelfRead} />}
          >
            <Route path="/supplier" element={<SupplierPortalPage />} />
          </Route>

          {/* Beneficiaries */}
          <Route
            element={<RequirePermission perm={PERMISSIONS.beneficiaryRead} />}
          >
            <Route path="/beneficiaries" element={<BeneficiaryPage />} />
            <Route path="/services" element={<ServiceDeliveryPage />} />
          </Route>

          {/* GIS */}
          <Route element={<RequirePermission perm={PERMISSIONS.geoRead} />}>
            <Route path="/map" element={<MapPage />} />
          </Route>

          {/* Documents */}
          <Route element={<RequirePermission perm={PERMISSIONS.docRead} />}>
            <Route path="/documents" element={<DocumentsPage />} />
          </Route>

          {/* Reports */}
          <Route element={<RequirePermission perm={PERMISSIONS.reportRead} />}>
            <Route path="/reports" element={<ReportsPage />} />
          </Route>

          {/* Grievances */}
          <Route
            element={<RequirePermission perm={PERMISSIONS.grievanceRead} />}
          >
            <Route path="/grievances" element={<GrievancePage />} />
          </Route>

          {/* Impact suite */}
          <Route
            element={
              <RequirePermission
                anyOf={[
                  PERMISSIONS.impactIndicatorRead,
                  PERMISSIONS.impactAnalyticsRead,
                ]}
              />
            }
          >
            <Route path="/impact" element={<ImpactDashboardPage />} />
            <Route
              path="/impact/indicators"
              element={<ImpactIndicatorsPage />}
            />
            <Route
              path="/impact/surveys"
              element={
                <RequirePermission perm={PERMISSIONS.surveyWrite}>
                  <SurveyBuilderPage />
                </RequirePermission>
              }
            />
            <Route path="/impact/field" element={<FieldOpsPage />} />
            <Route
              path="/impact/qa"
              element={
                <RequirePermission perm={PERMISSIONS.qaRead}>
                  <QAPage />
                </RequirePermission>
              }
            />
            <Route
              path="/impact/warehouse"
              element={
                <RequirePermission perm={PERMISSIONS.warehouseRead}>
                  <WarehousePage />
                </RequirePermission>
              }
            />
          </Route>

          {/* Research */}
          <Route
            element={<RequirePermission perm={PERMISSIONS.researchRequest} />}
          >
            <Route path="/research" element={<ResearchCataloguePage />} />
            <Route
              path="/research/requests"
              element={<ResearchRequestsPage />}
            />
          </Route>

          {/* Admin */}
          <Route
            element={
              <RequirePermission
                anyOf={[PERMISSIONS.adminUsers, PERMISSIONS.adminSettings]}
              />
            }
          >
            <Route path="/admin" element={<AdminHomePage />} />
            <Route path="/admin/users" element={<AdminUsersPage />} />
            <Route
              path="/admin/integrations"
              element={<AdminIntegrationsPage />}
            />
          </Route>
          <Route element={<RequirePermission perm={PERMISSIONS.auditRead} />}>
            <Route path="/audit" element={<AuditPage />} />
          </Route>

          {/* Dev-only */}
          {import.meta.env.DEV && (
            <Route path="/design-system" element={<DesignSystemPage />} />
          )}
        </Route>

        {/* ---- Fallback ---- */}
        <Route path="*" element={<NotFoundPage />} />
      </Routes>
    </Suspense>
  );
}
```

```ts
import { describe, it, expect, beforeEach, vi } from "vitest";
import { useAuthStore } from "@/stores/auth.store";
import { rolePermissions } from "@/features/auth/auth.types";
import * as api from "@/features/auth/auth.api";

vi.mock("@/features/auth/auth.api", () => ({
  authApi: {
    login: vi.fn(),
    refresh: vi.fn(),
    logout: vi.fn().mockResolvedValue(undefined),
    completeMFA: vi.fn(),
  },
}));

const mockedApi = api.authApi as unknown as {
  login: ReturnType<typeof vi.fn>;
  refresh: ReturnType<typeof vi.fn>;
  logout: ReturnType<typeof vi.fn>;
};

const fakeUser = {
  userId: "u1",
  username: "test",
  fullName: "Test User",
  email: "t@x.et",
  orgId: "o1",
  orgName: "MoWE",
  role: "MW-PIU" as const,
  roleName: "MoWE PIU Officer",
  permissions: rolePermissions("MW-PIU"),
  scope: { orgId: "o1", orgLevel: "FEDERAL" as const, regions: ["Oromia"] },
  mfaEnabled: false,
  locale: "en" as const,
  lastLoginAt: "2026-10-16T00:00:00Z",
};

describe("auth.store", () => {
  beforeEach(() => {
    useAuthStore.setState({
      user: null,
      accessToken: null,
      refreshToken: null,
      expiresAt: null,
      refreshExpiresAt: null,
      refreshing: null,
    });
    vi.clearAllMocks();
  });

  it("login sets session for non-MFA user", async () => {
    mockedApi.login.mockResolvedValueOnce({
      user: fakeUser,
      access_token: "a",
      refresh_token: "r",
      expires_in: 900,
      refresh_expires_in: 28800,
    });
    const res = await useAuthStore
      .getState()
      .login({ username: "x", password: "y" });
    expect(res.mfaRequired).toBe(false);
    expect(useAuthStore.getState().user?.userId).toBe("u1");
    expect(useAuthStore.getState().accessToken).toBe("a");
  });

  it("login returns mfaRequired when backend demands it", async () => {
    mockedApi.login.mockResolvedValueOnce({
      user: fakeUser,
      access_token: "",
      refresh_token: "",
      expires_in: 0,
      refresh_expires_in: 0,
      mfa_required: true,
      mfa_token: "mtok",
    });
    const res = await useAuthStore
      .getState()
      .login({ username: "x", password: "y" });
    expect(res.mfaRequired).toBe(true);
    expect(res.mfaToken).toBe("mtok");
    expect(useAuthStore.getState().user).toBeNull();
  });

  it("has() correctly reflects permissions", () => {
    useAuthStore.setState({ user: fakeUser });
    expect(useAuthStore.getState().has("project:read" as any)).toBe(true);
    expect(useAuthStore.getState().has("admin:users" as any)).toBe(false);
  });

  it("logout clears session and calls server", () => {
    useAuthStore.setState({
      user: fakeUser,
      accessToken: "a",
      refreshToken: "r",
      expiresAt: Date.now() + 1000,
      refreshExpiresAt: Date.now() + 10000,
    });
    useAuthStore.getState().logout();
    expect(useAuthStore.getState().user).toBeNull();
    expect(useAuthStore.getState().accessToken).toBeNull();
  });

  it("single-flight refresh collapses concurrent calls", async () => {
    useAuthStore.setState({ refreshToken: "r", user: fakeUser });
    mockedApi.refresh.mockResolvedValue({
      access_token: "new",
      expires_in: 900,
    });
    const [a, b] = await Promise.all([
      useAuthStore.getState().refresh(),
      useAuthStore.getState().refresh(),
    ]);
    expect(a).toBe(true);
    expect(b).toBe(true);
    expect(mockedApi.refresh).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
  });
});
```

```tsx
import { describe, it, expect, beforeEach } from "vitest";
import { MemoryRouter, Routes, Route } from "react-router-dom";

import { RequireAuth, RequirePermission } from "../guards";

  userId: "u1",
  username: "x",

describe("guards", () => {

      </MemoryRouter>,

  });

  });
});
```

## 4.1 `src/features/auth/useKeyboardShortcut.ts`

Small key-sequence engine. Handles `g d`, `g p`, plain `?`, `/`, `⌘K`, `Esc`.

```ts
import { useEffect, useRef } from "react";

type Handler = (e: KeyboardEvent) => void;

export interface Shortcut {
  /** Sequence of keys, e.g. ['g','d'] for g-then-d. Single char array for single key. */
  keys: string[];
  handler: Handler;
  /** Ignore when focus is inside an input/textarea/select. Default true. */
  ignoreInInput?: boolean;
  /** Optional modifier set: ctrl, meta, shift, alt. Only applies to single-key. */
  modifiers?: {
    ctrl?: boolean;
    meta?: boolean;
    shift?: boolean;
    alt?: boolean;
  };
  /** Description for the help overlay. */
  description?: string;
}

const isEditable = (el: EventTarget | null): boolean => {
  if (!(el instanceof HTMLElement)) return false;
  const tag = el.tagName.toLowerCase();
  if (tag === "input" || tag === "textarea" || tag === "select") return true;
  if (el.isContentEditable) return true;
  return false;
};

export function useKeyboardShortcuts(shortcuts: Shortcut[]) {
  const bufferRef = useRef<string[]>([]);
  const timerRef = useRef<number | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    const reset = () => {
      bufferRef.current = [];
    };

    const onKey = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      // Modifier-only keypresses shouldn't be captured
      if (["Control", "Shift", "Alt", "Meta"].includes(e.key)) return;

      // Escape always resets the buffer
      if (e.key === "Escape") {
        reset();
        return;
      }

      const editable = isEditable(e.target);
      const key = e.key.length === 1 ? e.key.toLowerCase() : e.key;

      for (const s of shortcuts) {
        const ignore = s.ignoreInInput ?? true;
        if (editable && ignore) continue;

        // Single-key with modifiers
        if (s.keys.length === 1 && s.keys[0] === key) {
          const m = s.modifiers ?? {};
          const okMods =
            (m.ctrl === undefined || m.ctrl === e.ctrlKey) &&
            (m.meta === undefined || m.meta === e.metaKey) &&
            (m.shift === undefined || m.shift === e.shiftKey) &&
            (m.alt === undefined || m.alt === e.altKey);
          if (okMods) {
            e.preventDefault();
            s.handler(e);
            reset();
            return;
          }
        }
      }

      // Multi-key sequence: only advance if the first key matches some sequence
      const next = [...bufferRef.current, key];
      const candidates = shortcuts.filter(
        (s) =>
          s.keys.length === next.length &&
          s.keys.every((k, i) => k === next[i]),
      );

      // If no candidate at this length, check if any longer sequence starts with `next`
      const hasPrefix = shortcuts.some(
        (s) =>
          s.keys.length > next.length && next.every((k, i) => s.keys[i] === k),
      );

      if (candidates.length > 0) {
        const s = candidates[0]!;
        const ignore = s.ignoreInInput ?? true;
        if (!(editable && ignore)) {
          e.preventDefault();
          s.handler(e);
        }
        reset();
        return;
      }

      if (hasPrefix) {
        bufferRef.current = next;
        if (timerRef.current) window.clearTimeout(timerRef.current);
        timerRef.current = window.setTimeout(reset, 1500);
      } else {
        reset();
      }
    };

    document.addEventListener("keydown", onKey);
    return () => {
      document.removeEventListener("keydown", onKey);
      if (timerRef.current) window.clearTimeout(timerRef.current);
    };
  }, [shortcuts]);
}
```

## 4.2 `src/stores/ui.store.ts` — Extension

Adds `mobileNavOpen`, `searchOpen`, `keyboardHelpOpen`. Keeps `sidebarCollapsed` and `locale` from Step 1.

```ts
import { create } from "zustand";
import { persist } from "zustand/middleware";
import type { Locale } from "@/app/config";

interface UIState {
  sidebarCollapsed: boolean;
  locale: Locale;
  mobileNavOpen: boolean;
  searchOpen: boolean;
  keyboardHelpOpen: boolean;
  setSidebarCollapsed: (v: boolean) => void;
  toggleSidebar: () => void;
  setLocale: (l: Locale) => void;
  setMobileNavOpen: (v: boolean) => void;
  setSearchOpen: (v: boolean) => void;
  setKeyboardHelpOpen: (v: boolean) => void;
}

export const useUIStore = create<UIState>()(
  persist(
    (set, get) => ({
      sidebarCollapsed: false,
      locale: "en",
      mobileNavOpen: false,
      searchOpen: false,
      keyboardHelpOpen: false,
      setSidebarCollapsed: (sidebarCollapsed) => set({ sidebarCollapsed }),
      toggleSidebar: () => set({ sidebarCollapsed: !get().sidebarCollapsed }),
      setLocale: (locale) => set({ locale }),
      setMobileNavOpen: (mobileNavOpen) => set({ mobileNavOpen }),
      setSearchOpen: (searchOpen) => set({ searchOpen }),
      setKeyboardHelpOpen: (keyboardHelpOpen) => set({ keyboardHelpOpen }),
    }),
    {
      name: "piims.ui",
      // Only persist these two
      partialize: (s) => ({
        sidebarCollapsed: s.sidebarCollapsed,
        locale: s.locale,
      }),
    },
  ),
);
```

```ts
        label: "nav.integrations",
        to: "/admin/integrations",
        anyOf: [PERMISSIONS.integrationRead, PERMISSIONS.integrationManage],
      },
    ],

    id: "audit",
    label: "nav.audit",
    to: "/audit",
    icon: ShieldCheck,
    section: "admin",
    anyOf: [PERMISSIONS.auditRead],
  },
];
```

## 4.4 `src/components/layout/Breadcrumbs.tsx`

Derives breadcrumbs from the route and the dictionary. Project detail routes get a smart label from route params.

```tsx
import { Link, useLocation, useParams } from "react-router-dom";
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";
import { ChevronRight, Home } from "lucide-react";
import { BREADCRUMBS } from "./menu.config";

export function Breadcrumbs() {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const location = useLocation();
  const params = useParams();

  const segments = location.pathname.split("/").filter(Boolean);

  // Build cumulative paths
  const crumbs: { label: string; to?: string }[] = [
    { label: t("nav.dashboard"), to: "/dashboard" },
  ];

  // If we're already on /dashboard, don't duplicate
  if (segments[0] === "dashboard" || segments.length === 0) {
    return (
      <nav aria-label="Breadcrumb" className="text-caption text-neutral-600">
        <ol className="flex items-center gap-1">
          <li>
            <Home className="h-3.5 w-3.5" aria-hidden />
          </li>
          <li className="font-semibold text-neutral-900 ml-1">
            {t("nav.dashboard")}
          </li>
        </ol>
      </nav>
    );
  }

  let acc = "";
  segments.forEach((seg, i) => {
    acc += `/${seg}`;
    const isLast = i === segments.length - 1;

    // Prefer route-param smart labels for known detail routes
    let label: string | undefined;
    const prev = segments[i - 1];
    if (prev === "projects" && !BREADCRUMBS[seg]) {
      label = params.projectId ?? seg;
    } else if (prev === "inception" && seg !== "inception") {
      label = params.reportId ?? seg;
    } else {
      label = BREADCRUMBS[seg] ? t(BREADCRUMBS[seg]) : seg;
    }

    crumbs.push({ label, to: isLast ? undefined : acc });
  });

  return (
    <nav aria-label="Breadcrumb" className="text-caption text-neutral-600">
      <ol className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1">
        {crumbs.map((c, i) => {
          const last = i === crumbs.length - 1;
          return (
            <li key={i} className="inline-flex items-center gap-1">
              {!last && c.to ? (
                <Link
                  to={c.to}
                  className="hover:text-primary-700 hover:underline"
                >
                  {c.label}
                </Link>
              ) : (
                <span
                  aria-current={last ? "page" : undefined}
                  className={last ? "font-semibold text-neutral-900" : ""}
                >
                  {c.label}
                </span>
              )}
              {!last && (
                <ChevronRight className="h-3 w-3 opacity-60" aria-hidden />
              )}
            </li>
          );
        })}
      </ol>
    </nav>
  );
}
```

## 4.5 `src/components/layout/RouteProgress.tsx`

Thin 2px bar at the top of the content that animates on pathname change.

```tsx
import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { useLocation } from "react-router-dom";

export function RouteProgress() {
  const location = useLocation();
  const [visible, setVisible] = useState(false);
  const [progress, setProgress] = useState(0);

  useEffect(() => {
    setVisible(true);
    setProgress(20);
    const t1 = window.setTimeout(() => setProgress(70), 60);
    const t2 = window.setTimeout(() => setProgress(100), 240);
    const t3 = window.setTimeout(() => {
      setVisible(false);
      setProgress(0);
    }, 420);
    return () => {
      window.clearTimeout(t1);
      window.clearTimeout(t2);
      window.clearTimeout(t3);
    };
  }, [location.pathname]);

  return (
    <div
      aria-hidden
      className="fixed top-0 left-0 right-0 z-[300] h-[2px] pointer-events-none"
      style={{ opacity: visible ? 1 : 0, transition: "opacity 220ms ease" }}
    >
      <div
        className="h-full bg-accent-500"
        style={{
          width: `${progress}%`,
          transition: "width 240ms ease",
        }}
      />
    </div>
  );
}
```

## 4.6 `src/components/layout/NotificationBell.tsx`

Dropdown of recent notifications with mock data. In production, TanStack Query fetches `/notifications`.

```tsx
import { useState, useRef, useEffect } from "react";
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";
import {
  Bell,
  CheckCheck,
  AlertTriangle,
  Info,
  CheckCircle2,
} from "lucide-react";
import { Link } from "react-router-dom";
import { cn } from "@/components/ui/utils/cn";

interface Notification {
  id: string;
  type: "info" | "warning" | "success";
  title: string;
  body?: string;
  to?: string;
  read: boolean;
  at: string;
}

const MOCK: Notification[] = [
  {
    id: "n1",
    type: "warning",
    title: "3 inception reports overdue",
    body: "PIIMS-2026-0038, 0041, 0044",
    to: "/inception",
    read: false,
    at: "2 h ago",
  },
  {
    id: "n2",
    type: "info",
    title: "New no-objection request",
    body: "PIIMS-2026-0042 · Inception v1",
    to: "/inception",
    read: false,
    at: "5 h ago",
  },
  {
    id: "n3",
    type: "success",
    title: "FMIS sync completed",
    body: "1,247 records reconciled",
    to: "/financial/fmis",
    read: true,
    at: "Yesterday",
  },
];

export function NotificationBell() {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const [items, setItems] = useState<Notification[]>(MOCK);
  const ref = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  const unread = items.filter((i) => !i.read).length;

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!open) return;
    const onDoc = (e: MouseEvent) => {
      if (ref.current && !ref.current.contains(e.target as Node))
        setOpen(false);
    };
    const onEsc = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (e.key === "Escape") setOpen(false);
    };
    document.addEventListener("mousedown", onDoc);
    document.addEventListener("keydown", onEsc);
    return () => {
      document.removeEventListener("mousedown", onDoc);
      document.removeEventListener("keydown", onEsc);
    };
  }, [open]);

  const markAll = () => setItems((s) => s.map((i) => ({ ...i, read: true })));

  const icons = {
    info: <Info className="h-4 w-4 text-blue-500" aria-hidden />,
    warning: <AlertTriangle className="h-4 w-4 text-amber-500" aria-hidden />,
    success: <CheckCircle2 className="h-4 w-4 text-green-500" aria-hidden />,
  };

  return (
    <div ref={ref} className="relative">
      <button
        type="button"
        onClick={() => setOpen((s) => !s)}
        aria-label={t("shell.notifications")}
        aria-haspopup="menu"
        aria-expanded={open}
        className="relative h-9 w-9 rounded-md text-white hover:bg-white/10 transition-colors flex items-center justify-center"
      >
        <Bell className="h-5 w-5" />
        {unread > 0 && (
          <span
            aria-hidden
            className="absolute top-1 right-1 min-w-[16px] h-4 px-1 rounded-full bg-danger text-white text-[10px] font-bold grid place-items-center"
          >
            {unread > 9 ? "9+" : unread}
          </span>
        )}
      </button>

      {open && (
        <div
          role="menu"
          className="absolute right-0 top-full mt-2 w-[340px] rounded-md bg-white shadow-lg border border-neutral-300 overflow-hidden z-50"
        >
          <header className="flex items-center justify-between px-3 py-2 border-b border-neutral-300">
            <span className="text-caption font-bold text-primary-900 uppercase tracking-wide">
              {t("shell.notifications")}
            </span>
            {unread > 0 && (
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={markAll}
                className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-caption font-semibold text-primary-700 hover:underline"
              >
                <CheckCheck className="h-3.5 w-3.5" aria-hidden />
                {t("shell.markAllRead")}
              </button>
            )}
          </header>

          <ul className="max-h-[340px] overflow-y-auto divide-y divide-neutral-100">
            {items.length === 0 && (
              <li className="p-6 text-center text-caption text-neutral-600">
                {t("shell.noNotifications")}
              </li>
            )}
            {items.map((n) => (
              <li key={n.id}>
                <Link
                  to={n.to ?? "#"}
                  onClick={() => {
                    setItems((s) =>
                      s.map((i) => (i.id === n.id ? { ...i, read: true } : i)),
                    );
                    setOpen(false);
                  }}
                  className={cn(
                    "flex gap-3 px-3 py-2.5 hover:bg-neutral-50 transition-colors",
                    !n.read && "bg-primary-100/40",
                  )}
                >
                  <span className="shrink-0 mt-0.5">{icons[n.type]}</span>
                  <span className="flex-1 min-w-0">
                    <span className="block text-body-sm font-semibold text-neutral-900 truncate">
                      {n.title}
                    </span>
                    {n.body && (
                      <span className="block text-caption text-neutral-600 truncate">
                        {n.body}
                      </span>
                    )}
                    <span className="block text-[10px] text-neutral-500 mt-0.5">
                      {n.at}
                    </span>
                  </span>
                  {!n.read && (
                    <span
                      aria-hidden
                      className="shrink-0 h-2 w-2 rounded-full bg-accent-500 mt-2"
                    />
                  )}
                </Link>
              </li>
            ))}
          </ul>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { useNavigate } from "react-router-dom";
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";
import { ChevronDown, LogOut, User, Shield, Globe } from "lucide-react";
import { useAuthStore } from "@/stores/auth.store";
import { useUIStore } from "@/stores/ui.store";
import { roleLabel } from "@/features/auth/auth.types";
import { cn } from "@/components/ui/utils/cn";

export function UserMenu() {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const user = useAuthStore((s) => s.user);
  const logout = useAuthStore((s) => s.logout);
  const { locale, setLocale } = useUIStore();
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const ref = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!open) return;
    const onDoc = (e: MouseEvent) => {
      if (ref.current && !ref.current.contains(e.target as Node))
        setOpen(false);
    };
    const onEsc = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (e.key === "Escape") setOpen(false);
    };
    document.addEventListener("mousedown", onDoc);
    document.addEventListener("keydown", onEsc);
    return () => {
      document.removeEventListener("mousedown", onDoc);
      document.removeEventListener("keydown", onEsc);
    };
  }, [open]);

  if (!user) return null;

  const initials = user.fullName
    .split(/\s+/)
    .slice(0, 2)
    .map((p) => p[0]?.toUpperCase() ?? "")
    .join("");

  const onSignOut = () => {
    setOpen(false);
    logout();
    navigate("/login", { replace: true });
  };

  return (
    <div ref={ref} className="relative">
      <button
        type="button"
        onClick={() => setOpen((s) => !s)}
        aria-haspopup="menu"
        aria-expanded={open}
        className="flex items-center gap-2 h-9 pl-1 pr-2 rounded-md text-white hover:bg-white/10 transition-colors"
      >
        <span
          aria-hidden
          className="h-7 w-7 rounded-full bg-accent-500 text-primary-900 grid place-items-center font-bold text-[11px]"
        >
          {initials}
        </span>
        <span className="hidden md:inline text-caption font-semibold max-w-[120px] truncate">
          {user.fullName.split(" ")[0]}
        </span>
        <ChevronDown
          className={cn("h-4 w-4 transition-transform", open && "rotate-180")}
          aria-hidden
        />
      </button>

      {open && (
        <div
          role="menu"
          className="absolute right-0 top-full mt-2 w-72 rounded-md bg-white shadow-lg border border-neutral-300 overflow-hidden z-50"
        >
          {/* Identity header */}
          <div className="px-4 py-3 border-b border-neutral-300 bg-neutral-50">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
              <span
                aria-hidden
                className="h-10 w-10 rounded-full bg-primary-700 text-white grid place-items-center font-bold"
              >
                {initials}
              </span>
              <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                <div className="text-body-sm font-bold text-primary-900 truncate">
                  {user.fullName}
                </div>
                <div className="text-caption text-neutral-600 truncate">
                  {user.email}
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
            <div className="mt-2 flex items-center gap-2 text-caption">
              <Shield className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-primary-700" aria-hidden />
              <span className="font-semibold text-primary-700">
                {user.role}
              </span>
              <span className="text-neutral-500 truncate">
                · {roleLabel(user.role)}
              </span>
            </div>
            <div className="text-[11px] text-neutral-500 mt-0.5 truncate">
              {user.orgName}
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Menu items */}
          <ul className="py-1">
            <li>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => {
                  setOpen(false);
                  navigate("/profile");
                }}
                className="w-full flex items-center gap-3 px-4 py-2 text-body-sm text-neutral-900 hover:bg-neutral-100"
                role="menuitem"
              >
                <User className="h-4 w-4 text-neutral-600" aria-hidden />
                {t("shell.account")}
              </button>
            </li>
            <li>
              <div className="px-4 py-2 flex items-center gap-3 text-body-sm text-neutral-900">
                <Globe className="h-4 w-4 text-neutral-600" aria-hidden />
                <span className="flex-1">{t("shell.switchLanguage")}</span>
                <div className="inline-flex overflow-hidden rounded border border-neutral-300 text-caption">
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => setLocale("en")}
                    className={cn(
                      "px-2 py-0.5 font-semibold",
                      locale === "en"
                        ? "bg-primary-700 text-white"
                        : "bg-white text-neutral-600",
                    )}
                  >
                    EN
                  </button>
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => setLocale("am")}
                    className={cn(
                      "px-2 py-0.5 font-semibold",

                  >
                    አማ
                  </button>
                </div>
              </div>

          </ul>

          <div className="border-t border-neutral-300">
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={onSignOut}
              role="menuitem"
              className="w-full flex items-center gap-3 px-4 py-2.5 text-body-sm font-semibold text-danger hover:bg-red-50"
            >
              <LogOut className="h-4 w-4" aria-hidden />
              {t("shell.signOut")}
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
```

## 4.8 `src/components/layout/GlobalSearch.tsx`

Command palette — opens with `⌘K` or `/`. Filters mock results by the user's permissions.

```tsx
import { useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { createPortal } from "react-dom";
import { useNavigate } from "react-router-dom";
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";
import {
  Search,
  FolderKanban,
  Users,
  FileText,
  TrendingUp,
  CornerDownLeft,
} from "lucide-react";
import { useUIStore } from "@/stores/ui.store";
import { usePermissions } from "@/features/auth/usePermissions";
import { PERMISSIONS } from "@/features/auth/auth.types";
import { cn } from "@/components/ui/utils/cn";

interface Result {
  id: string;
  category: "Projects" | "Beneficiaries" | "Documents" | "Impact";
  title: string;
  subtitle?: string;
  to: string;
  icon: typeof FolderKanban;
  perm: any;
}

/* In production, these results would come from /v1/search?q=... */
const MOCK_RESULTS: Result[] = [
  {
    id: "p1",
    category: "Projects",
    title: "PIIMS-2026-0042",
    subtitle: "Solar Mini-Grid – Oromia Phase 1",
    to: "/projects/PIIMS-2026-0042",
    icon: FolderKanban,
    perm: PERMISSIONS.projectRead,
  },
  {
    id: "p2",
    category: "Projects",
    title: "PIIMS-2026-0038",
    subtitle: "Solar Home Systems – Amhara",
    to: "/projects/PIIMS-2026-0038",
    icon: FolderKanban,
    perm: PERMISSIONS.projectRead,
  },
  {
    id: "b1",
    category: "Beneficiaries",
    title: "Aster Bekele",
    subtitle: "BEN-2026-00012345 · Bora",
    to: "/beneficiaries?q=BEN-2026-00012345",
    icon: Users,
    perm: PERMISSIONS.beneficiaryRead,
  },
  {
    id: "d1",
    category: "Documents",
    title: "Feasibility Study – Oromia Phase 1",
    subtitle: "v2 · 12 Oct 2026",
    to: "/documents",
    icon: FileText,
    perm: PERMISSIONS.docRead,
  },
  {
    id: "i1",
    category: "Impact",
    title: "Household income",
    subtitle: "IMP-INC-001 · +65% change",
    to: "/impact",
    icon: TrendingUp,
    perm: PERMISSIONS.impactAnalyticsRead,
  },
];

export function GlobalSearch() {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const { searchOpen, setSearchOpen } = useUIStore();
  const { can } = usePermissions();
  const [q, setQ] = useState("");
  const [active, setActive] = useState(0);
  const inputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);

  const results = useMemo(() => {
    const term = q.trim().toLowerCase();
    if (term.length < 2) return [];
    return MOCK_RESULTS.filter((r) => can(r.perm))
      .filter(
        (r) =>
          r.title.toLowerCase().includes(term) ||
          (r.subtitle ?? "").toLowerCase().includes(term) ||
          r.category.toLowerCase().includes(term),
      )
      .slice(0, 20);
  }, [q, can]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (searchOpen) {
      setQ("");
      setActive(0);
      setTimeout(() => inputRef.current?.focus(), 20);
    }
  }, [searchOpen]);

  useEffect(() => {
    setActive(0);
  }, [q]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!searchOpen) return;
    const onKey = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (e.key === "Escape") {
        setSearchOpen(false);
        return;
      }
      if (e.key === "ArrowDown") {
        e.preventDefault();
        setActive((i) => Math.min(i + 1, results.length - 1));
      }
      if (e.key === "ArrowUp") {
        e.preventDefault();
        setActive((i) => Math.max(i - 1, 0));
      }
      if (e.key === "Enter") {
        const r = results[active];
        if (r) {
          setSearchOpen(false);
          navigate(r.to);
        }
      }
    };
    document.addEventListener("keydown", onKey);
    return () => document.removeEventListener("keydown", onKey);
  }, [searchOpen, results, active, navigate, setSearchOpen]);

  if (!searchOpen) return null;

  return createPortal(
    <div
      className="fixed inset-0 z-[400] flex items-start justify-center pt-[8vh] px-4 bg-neutral-900/55"
      onClick={() => setSearchOpen(false)}
      role="dialog"
      aria-modal="true"
      aria-label={t("shell.searchPlaceholder")}
    >
      <div
        onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
        className="w-full max-w-2xl rounded-lg bg-white shadow-lg border border-neutral-300 overflow-hidden"
      >
        {/* Search input */}
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3 px-4 py-3 border-b border-neutral-300">
          <Search className="h-5 w-5 text-neutral-600" aria-hidden />
          <input
            ref={inputRef}
            value={q}
            onChange={(e) => setQ(e.target.value)}
            placeholder={t("shell.searchPlaceholder")}
            className="flex-1 outline-none text-body bg-transparent"
            aria-autocomplete="list"
            aria-controls="search-results"
            aria-activedescendant={results[active]?.id}
          />
          <kbd className="hidden sm:inline-flex items-center px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-bold text-neutral-600 bg-neutral-100 border border-neutral-300 rounded">
            ESC
          </kbd>
        </div>

        {/* Results */}
        <div
          id="search-results"
          role="listbox"
          className="max-h-[420px] overflow-y-auto"
        >
          {q.trim().length < 2 && (
            <div className="p-6 text-center text-body-sm text-neutral-600">
              {t("shell.searchEmpty")}
            </div>
          )}
          {q.trim().length >= 2 && results.length === 0 && (
            <div className="p-6 text-center text-body-sm text-neutral-600">
              {t("shell.searchNoResults", { q })}
            </div>
          )}
          {results.map((r, i) => {
            const Icon = r.icon;
            const isActive = i === active;
            return (
              <button
                key={r.id}
                id={r.id}
                role="option"
                aria-selected={isActive}
                onMouseEnter={() => setActive(i)}
                onClick={() => {
                  setSearchOpen(false);
                  navigate(r.to);
                }}
                className={cn(
                  "w-full flex items-center gap-3 px-4 py-2.5 text-left",
                  isActive ? "bg-primary-100" : "hover:bg-neutral-50",
                )}
              >
                <Icon
                  className="h-4 w-4 text-neutral-600 shrink-0"
                  aria-hidden
                />
                <span className="flex-1 min-w-0">
                  <span className="block text-body-sm font-semibold text-neutral-900 truncate">
                    {r.title}
                  </span>
                  {r.subtitle && (
                    <span className="block text-caption text-neutral-600 truncate">
                      {r.subtitle}
                    </span>
                  )}
                </span>
                <span className="text-[10px] uppercase tracking-wide text-neutral-500 font-semibold shrink-0">
                  {r.category}
                </span>
                {isActive && (
                  <CornerDownLeft
                    className="h-4 w-4 text-neutral-500 shrink-0"
                    aria-hidden
                  />
                )}
              </button>
            );
          })}
        </div>

        {/* Footer */}
        <div className="border-t border-neutral-300 bg-neutral-50 px-4 py-2 flex items-center gap-4 text-caption text-neutral-600">
          <span>
            <kbd className="px-1 bg-white border border-neutral-300 rounded text-[10px]">
              ↑↓
            </kbd>{" "}
            navigate
          </span>
          <span>
            <kbd className="px-1 bg-white border border-neutral-300 rounded text-[10px]">
              ↵
            </kbd>{" "}
            open
          </span>
          <span className="ml-auto">{t("shell.searchHint")}</span>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>,
    document.body,
  );
}
```

```tsx
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";
```

## 4.10 `src/components/layout/SideNav.tsx`

Desktop sidebar with grouped menu and collapsible children.

```tsx
import { useState } from "react";
import { NavLink, useLocation } from "react-router-dom";
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";
import { ChevronDown, PanelLeftClose, PanelLeftOpen } from "lucide-react";
import { MENU, MENU_SECTIONS, type MenuItem } from "./menu.config";
import { usePermissions } from "@/features/auth/usePermissions";
import { useUIStore } from "@/stores/ui.store";
import { cn } from "@/components/ui/utils/cn";

export function SideNav() {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const { canAny } = usePermissions();
  const location = useLocation();
  const { sidebarCollapsed, toggleSidebar } = useUIStore();

  // Filter menu by permission
  const filtered = MENU.filter(
    (item) => !item.anyOf || canAny(...item.anyOf),
  ).map((item) => ({
    ...item,
    children: item.children?.filter((c) => !c.anyOf || canAny(...c.anyOf)),
  }));

  const grouped = MENU_SECTIONS.map((s) => ({
    ...s,
    items: filtered.filter((i) => i.section === s.id),
  })).filter((s) => s.items.length > 0);

  return (
    <aside
      aria-label="Main navigation"
      className={cn(
        "hidden md:flex flex-col shrink-0 bg-white border-r border-neutral-300 overflow-hidden",
        sidebarCollapsed ? "w-[68px]" : "w-[240px]",
        "transition-[width] duration-150",
      )}
    >
      {/* Collapse toggle */}
      <div className="flex items-center justify-end px-3 h-11 border-b border-neutral-200">
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={toggleSidebar}
          aria-label={
            sidebarCollapsed
              ? t("shell.expandSidebar")
              : t("shell.collapseSidebar")
          }
          className="p-1.5 rounded-md text-neutral-600 hover:bg-neutral-100"
        >
          {sidebarCollapsed ? (
            <PanelLeftOpen className="h-4 w-4" />
          ) : (
            <PanelLeftClose className="h-4 w-4" />
          )}
        </button>
      </div>

      <nav className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto py-3">
        {grouped.map((section) => (
          <div key={section.id} className="mb-2">
            {!sidebarCollapsed && (
              <div className="px-4 pt-3 pb-1 text-[10.5px] font-extrabold tracking-[0.14em] text-neutral-500 uppercase">
                {section.label}
              </div>
            )}
            {section.items.map((item) => (
              <NavItem
                key={item.id}
                item={item}
                currentPath={location.pathname}
                collapsed={sidebarCollapsed}
              />
            ))}
          </div>
        ))}
      </nav>
    </aside>
  );
}

function NavItem({
  item,
  currentPath,
  collapsed,
}: {
  item: MenuItem;
  currentPath: string;
  collapsed: boolean;
}) {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const Icon = item.icon;

  const inPath = (p: string) =>
    currentPath === p || currentPath.startsWith(p + "/");

  const isChildActive = item.children?.some((c) => inPath(c.to)) ?? false;
  const hasChildren = (item.children?.length ?? 0) > 0;
  const isParentActive = inPath(item.to) || isChildActive;

  const [open, setOpen] = useState(isParentActive);

  // Auto-open when route is inside
  // (handled by initial state above; re-render on path change will keep it)
  const key = `${currentPath}-${item.id}`;
  // We use a ref-free approach: derive open from active when path changes
  const shouldBeOpen = isParentActive || open;
  void key;

  /* Parent link */
  const parentLink = (
    <NavLink
      to={item.to}
      className={({ isActive }) =>
        cn(
          "flex items-center gap-3 mx-2 px-3 py-2 rounded-md text-body-sm font-semibold transition-colors",
          "border-l-[3px] border-transparent",
          isActive || isParentActive
            ? "bg-primary-100 text-primary-700 border-l-primary-700"
            : "text-neutral-900 hover:bg-neutral-100",
          collapsed && "justify-center px-2",
        )
      }
      aria-current={isParentActive ? "page" : undefined}
      end={item.to === "/dashboard"}
    >
      {Icon && <Icon className="h-[18px] w-[18px] shrink-0" aria-hidden />}
      {!collapsed && <span className="truncate flex-1">{t(item.label)}</span>}
      {!collapsed && hasChildren && (
        <ChevronDown
          className={cn(
            "h-3.5 w-3.5 shrink-0 transition-transform",
            shouldBeOpen && "rotate-180",
          )}
          aria-hidden
        />
      )}
    </NavLink>
  );

  if (!hasChildren || collapsed) return parentLink;

  return (
    <div>
      <button
        type="button"
        onClick={() => setOpen((s) => !s)}
        aria-expanded={shouldBeOpen}
        className={cn(
          "w-full flex items-center gap-3 mx-2 px-3 py-2 rounded-md text-body-sm font-semibold",
          "border-l-[3px] border-transparent transition-colors text-left",
          isParentActive || shouldBeOpen
            ? "text-primary-700"
            : "text-neutral-900 hover:bg-neutral-100",
        )}
        style={{ width: "calc(100% - 16px)" }}
      >
        {Icon && <Icon className="h-[18px] w-[18px] shrink-0" aria-hidden />}
        <span className="truncate flex-1">{t(item.label)}</span>
        <ChevronDown
          className={cn(
            "h-3.5 w-3.5 shrink-0 transition-transform",
            shouldBeOpen && "rotate-180",
          )}
          aria-hidden
        />
      </button>

      {shouldBeOpen && (
        <ul className="mt-0.5 mb-1">
          {item.children!.map((c) => {
            const active = inPath(c.to);
            return (
              <li key={c.id}>
                <NavLink
                  to={c.to}
                  end={c.to === item.to}
                  className={cn(
                    "block pl-[52px] pr-3 py-1.5 mx-2 rounded-md text-caption transition-colors",
                    active
                      ? "bg-primary-100 text-primary-700 font-semibold"
                      : "text-neutral-600 hover:bg-neutral-100 hover:text-neutral-900",
                  )}
                  aria-current={active ? "page" : undefined}
                >
                  {t(c.label)}
                </NavLink>
              </li>
            );
          })}
        </ul>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
```

## 4.11 `src/components/layout/MobileNav.tsx`

Bottom nav (5 items) plus slide-in drawer for the full menu.

```tsx
import { useEffect } from "react";
import { NavLink, useLocation } from "react-router-dom";
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";
import {
  LayoutDashboard,
  FolderKanban,
  Target,
  Menu as MenuIcon,
  X,
  TrendingUp,
  Users,
  BarChart3,
  Wallet,
  Search,
} from "lucide-react";
import { useUIStore } from "@/stores/ui.store";
import { usePermissions } from "@/features/auth/usePermissions";
import { PERMISSIONS } from "@/features/auth/auth.types";
import { MENU, MENU_SECTIONS } from "./menu.config";
import { cn } from "@/components/ui/utils/cn";

export function MobileNav() {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const { canAny } = usePermissions();
  const location = useLocation();
  const { mobileNavOpen, setMobileNavOpen, setSearchOpen } = useUIStore();

  useEffect(() => {
    setMobileNavOpen(false);
  }, [location.pathname, setMobileNavOpen]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!mobileNavOpen) return;
    const onEsc = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (e.key === "Escape") setMobileNavOpen(false);
    };
    document.addEventListener("keydown", onEsc);
    document.body.style.overflow = "hidden";
    return () => {
      document.removeEventListener("keydown", onEsc);
      document.body.style.overflow = "";
    };
  }, [mobileNavOpen, setMobileNavOpen]);

  const filterMenu = (items: typeof MENU) =>
    items
      .filter((i) => !i.anyOf || canAny(...i.anyOf))
      .map((i) => ({
        ...i,
        children: i.children?.filter((c) => !c.anyOf || canAny(...c.anyOf)),
      }));

  const filtered = filterMenu(MENU);
  const grouped = MENU_SECTIONS.map((s) => ({
    ...s,
    items: filtered.filter((i) => i.section === s.id),
  })).filter((s) => s.items.length > 0);

  return (
    <>
      {/* Bottom nav */}
      <nav
        aria-label="Primary"
        className="md:hidden fixed bottom-0 inset-x-0 z-40 bg-white border-t border-neutral-300 pb-[env(safe-area-inset-bottom)]"
      >
        <ul className="grid grid-cols-5">
          <BottomItem
            to="/dashboard"
            label={t("nav.dashboard")}
            icon={LayoutDashboard}
          />
          <BottomItem
            to="/projects"
            label={t("nav.projects")}
            icon={FolderKanban}
            disabled={!canAny(PERMISSIONS.projectRead)}
          />
          <li>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setSearchOpen(true)}
              className="w-full flex flex-col items-center justify-center py-2 text-neutral-600 hover:text-primary-700"
              aria-label={t("shell.searchHint")}
            >
              <Search className="h-5 w-5" aria-hidden />
              <span className="text-[10px] font-semibold mt-0.5">Search</span>
            </button>
          </li>
          <BottomItem
            to="/impact"
            label={t("nav.impact")}
            icon={TrendingUp}
            disabled={
              !canAny(
                PERMISSIONS.impactIndicatorRead,
                PERMISSIONS.impactAnalyticsRead,
              )
            }
          />
          <li>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setMobileNavOpen(true)}
              className="w-full flex flex-col items-center justify-center py-2 text-neutral-600 hover:text-primary-700"
              aria-label={t("shell.openMenu")}
              aria-expanded={mobileNavOpen}
            >
              <MenuIcon className="h-5 w-5" aria-hidden />
              <span className="text-[10px] font-semibold mt-0.5">More</span>
            </button>
          </li>
        </ul>
      </nav>

      {/* Drawer */}
      {mobileNavOpen && (
        <div
          className="md:hidden fixed inset-0 z-50 bg-neutral-900/55"
          onClick={() => setMobileNavOpen(false)}
          role="dialog"
          aria-modal="true"
          aria-label={t("shell.openMenu")}
        >
          <div
            className="absolute right-0 top-0 bottom-0 w-[88vw] max-w-sm bg-white shadow-lg flex flex-col"
            onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
          >
            <header className="flex items-center justify-between px-4 h-14 border-b border-neutral-300">
              <span className="text-h3 text-primary-900">PIIMS</span>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setMobileNavOpen(false)}
                aria-label={t("shell.closeMenu")}
                className="p-1.5 rounded-md text-neutral-600 hover:bg-neutral-100"
              >
                <X className="h-5 w-5" />
              </button>
            </header>

            <nav className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto py-3">
              {grouped.map((section) => (
                <div key={section.id} className="mb-2">
                  <div className="px-4 pt-3 pb-1 text-[10px] font-extrabold tracking-widest text-neutral-500 uppercase">
                    {section.label}
                  </div>
                  {section.items.map((item) => {
                    const Icon = item.icon;
                    return (
                      <div key={item.id}>
                        <NavLink
                          to={item.to}
                          className={({ isActive }) =>
                            cn(
                              "flex items-center gap-3 mx-2 px-3 py-2.5 rounded-md text-body-sm font-semibold",
                              isActive
                                ? "bg-primary-100 text-primary-700"
                                : "text-neutral-900 hover:bg-neutral-100",
                            )
                          }
                        >
                          {Icon && (
                            <Icon className="h-4 w-4 shrink-0" aria-hidden />
                          )}
                          <span className="flex-1">{t(item.label)}</span>
                        </NavLink>
                        {item.children?.map((c) => (
                          <NavLink
                            key={c.id}
                            to={c.to}
                            className={({ isActive }) =>
                              cn(
                                "block pl-12 pr-3 py-1.5 mx-2 rounded-md text-caption",
                                isActive
                                  ? "text-primary-700 font-semibold"
                                  : "text-neutral-600 hover:bg-neutral-100",
                              )
                            }
                          >
                            {t(c.label)}
                          </NavLink>
                        ))}
                      </div>
                    );
                  })}
                </div>
              ))}
            </nav>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </>
  );
}

function BottomItem({
  to,
  label,
  icon: Icon,
  disabled,
}: {
  to: string;
  label: string;
  icon: typeof Users;
  disabled?: boolean;
}) {
  if (disabled) {
    return (
      <li>
        <div className="w-full flex flex-col items-center justify-center py-2 text-neutral-300">
          <Icon className="h-5 w-5" aria-hidden />
          <span className="text-[10px] font-semibold mt-0.5">{label}</span>
        </div>
      </li>
    );
  }
  return (
    <li>
      <NavLink
        to={to}
        className={({ isActive }) =>
          cn(
            "w-full flex flex-col items-center justify-center py-2",
            isActive
              ? "text-primary-700"
              : "text-neutral-600 hover:text-primary-700",
          )
        }
      >
        <Icon className="h-5 w-5" aria-hidden />
        <span className="text-[10px] font-semibold mt-0.5">{label}</span>
      </NavLink>
    </li>
  );
}
```

## 4.12 `src/components/layout/TopBar.tsx`

```tsx
import { Menu, Search as SearchIcon, Languages } from "lucide-react";
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";
import { useUIStore } from "@/stores/ui.store";
import { NotificationBell } from "./NotificationBell";
import { UserMenu } from "./UserMenu";
import { cn } from "@/components/ui/utils/cn";

export function TopBar() {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const { locale, setLocale, setSearchOpen, setMobileNavOpen } = useUIStore();

  return (
```
