## 4.13 `src/components/layout/AppShell.tsx`

```tsx
import { useEffect } from "react";
import { Outlet, useNavigate, useLocation } from "react-router-dom";
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";
import { useKeyboardShortcuts } from "@/features/auth/useKeyboardShortcut";
import { useUIStore } from "@/stores/ui.store";
import { useAuthStore } from "@/stores/auth.store";
import { PERMISSIONS } from "@/features/auth/auth.types";
import { usePermissions } from "@/features/auth/usePermissions";

import { TopBar } from "./TopBar";
import { SideNav } from "./SideNav";
import { MobileNav } from "./MobileNav";
import { GlobalSearch } from "./GlobalSearch";
import { KeyboardHelp } from "./KeyboardHelp";
import { RouteProgress } from "./RouteProgress";
import { Breadcrumbs } from "./Breadcrumbs";
import { Banner } from "@/components/ui/Banner";

export function AppShell() {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const location = useLocation();
  const { setSearchOpen, setKeyboardHelpOpen } = useUIStore();
  const user = useAuthStore((s) => s.user);
  const { can } = usePermissions();

  /* Route-transition focus management: move focus to <main> on nav */
  useEffect(() => {
    const main = document.getElementById("main");
    if (main) {
      main.focus({ preventScroll: true });
    }
    // Scroll content to top on navigation
    const scroller = document.getElementById("main-scroll");
    if (scroller) scroller.scrollTop = 0;
  }, [location.pathname]);

  /* Global keyboard shortcuts */
  useKeyboardShortcuts([
    {
      keys: ["k"],
      modifiers: { ctrl: true },
      handler: () => setSearchOpen(true),
      ignoreInInput: false,
      description: t("shell.shortcuts.openSearch"),
    },
    {
      keys: ["k"],
      modifiers: { meta: true },
      handler: () => setSearchOpen(true),
      ignoreInInput: false,
      description: t("shell.shortcuts.openSearch"),
    },
    {
      keys: ["/"],
      handler: () => setSearchOpen(true),
      ignoreInInput: true,
      description: t("shell.shortcuts.focusSearch"),
    },
    {
      keys: ["g", "d"],
      handler: () => navigate("/dashboard"),
      ignoreInInput: true,
      description: t("shell.shortcuts.goDashboard"),
    },
    {
      keys: ["g", "p"],
      handler: () => {
        if (can(PERMISSIONS.projectRead)) navigate("/projects");
      },
      ignoreInInput: true,
      description: t("shell.shortcuts.goProjects"),
    },
    {
      keys: ["g", "i"],
      handler: () => {
        if (
          can(PERMISSIONS.impactIndicatorRead) ||
          can(PERMISSIONS.impactAnalyticsRead)
        )
          navigate("/impact");
      },
      ignoreInInput: true,
      description: t("shell.shortcuts.goImpact"),
    },
    {
      keys: ["?"],
      handler: () => setKeyboardHelpOpen(true),
      ignoreInInput: true,
      description: t("shell.shortcuts.showHelp"),
    },
  ]);

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen flex flex-col bg-neutral-50">
      <RouteProgress />

      <TopBar />

      {/* Offline banner — appears when browser goes offline */}
      <OfflineBanner />

      <div className="flex-1 flex min-h-0">
        <SideNav />

        <main
          id="main"
          tabIndex={-1}
          className="flex-1 flex flex-col min-w-0 focus:outline-none"
        >
          {/* Breadcrumb strip */}
          <div className="border-b border-neutral-200 bg-white/60 backdrop-blur-sm">
            <div className="px-4 md:px-6 py-2">
              <Breadcrumbs />
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Scrollable content */}
          <div
            id="main-scroll"
            className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto pb-24 md:pb-8"
          >
            <div className="px-4 md:px-6 py-4 max-w-[1600px] mx-auto w-full">
              <Outlet />
            </div>
          </div>
        </main>
      </div>

      {/* Mobile bottom nav + drawer */}
      <MobileNav />

      {/* Overlays */}
      <GlobalSearch />
      <KeyboardHelp />

      {/* Greeting hidden region for screen readers on login */}
      {user && (
        <div aria-live="polite" className="sr-only">
          Signed in as {user.fullName}, {user.role}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

/* -------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * Offline banner
 * ------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
function OfflineBanner() {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const online = useSyncStoreOnline();

  if (online) return null;
  return (
    <Banner tone="warning" className="rounded-none border-x-0 border-t-0">
      {t("a11y.offlineBanner")}
    </Banner>
  );
}

function useSyncStoreOnline() {
  // Local import to avoid a circular dependency in the layout folder
  const { online } = require("@/stores/sync.store").useSyncStore.getState();
  // Simple subscription via a re-render on window events (Step 1 already wires the store)
  const [, force] = require("react").useReducer((n: number) => n + 1, 0);
  require("react").useEffect(() => {
    const on = () => force();
    window.addEventListener("online", on);
    window.addEventListener("offline", on);
    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener("online", on);
      window.removeEventListener("offline", on);
    };
  }, []);
  return online && navigator.onLine;
}
```

> **Note:** The `OfflineBanner` uses `require` inside to avoid an import cycle that would be introduced if we statically imported `sync.store` into `AppShell` while `sync.store` imports nothing from layout. In the actual codebase, just import `useSyncStore` normally at the top — this is only shown compactly to keep the file self-contained in this document.

Cleaner version for the real code:

```tsx
import { useSyncStore } from "@/stores/sync.store";

function OfflineBanner() {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const online = useSyncStore((s) => s.online);
  if (online) return null;
  return (
    <Banner tone="warning" className="rounded-none border-x-0 border-t-0">
      {t("a11y.offlineBanner")}
    </Banner>
  );
}
```

## 4.15 Router Update — `src/app/router.tsx`

Wrap all protected routes under `<AppShellRoute>`.

```tsx
import { Suspense, lazy } from "react";
import { Routes, Route, Navigate } from "react-router-dom";
import { RequireAuth, RequirePermission } from "@/features/auth/guards";
import { PERMISSIONS } from "@/features/auth/auth.types";
import { LoadingState } from "@/components/ui/LoadingState";

const LoginPage = lazy(() => import("@/features/auth/LoginPage"));
const AppShellRoute = lazy(() => import("@/pages/AppShellRoute"));
const DashboardPage = lazy(() => import("@/pages/DashboardPage"));
const NotFoundPage = lazy(() => import("@/pages/NotFoundPage"));
/* ...all other lazy imports identical to Step 3... */

export function AppRouter() {
  return (
    <Suspense fallback={<LoadingState message="Loading…" />}>
      <Routes>
        {/* Public */}
        <Route path="/login" element={<LoginPage />} />

        {/* Protected — everything below lives inside AppShell */}
        <Route element={<RequireAuth />}>
          <Route element={<AppShellRoute />}>
            <Route path="/" element={<Navigate to="/dashboard" replace />} />
            <Route path="/dashboard" element={<DashboardPage />} />

            {/* Projects */}
            <Route
              element={<RequirePermission perm={PERMISSIONS.projectRead} />}
            >
              <Route path="/projects" element={<ProjectListPage />} />
              <Route
                path="/projects/new"
                element={
                  <RequirePermission
                    perm={PERMISSIONS.projectWrite}
                    fallback={<Navigate to="/projects" replace />}
                  />
                }
              />
              <Route
                path="/projects/:projectId"
                element={<ProjectDetailPage />}
              />
              <Route path="/pipeline" element={<PipelinePage />} />
            </Route>

            {/* ...all other module routes unchanged from Step 3, now nested under the shell... */}

            {import.meta.env.DEV && (
              <Route path="/design-system" element={<DesignSystemPage />} />
            )}
          </Route>
        </Route>

        <Route path="*" element={<NotFoundPage />} />
      </Routes>
    </Suspense>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import { describe, it, expect, vi } from "vitest";
import { renderHook } from "@testing-library/react";
import userEvent from "@testing-library/user-event";
import { useKeyboardShortcuts } from "../useKeyboardShortcut";

describe("useKeyboardShortcuts", () => {
  it("fires single-key shortcut", async () => {
    const handler = vi.fn();
    renderHook(() =>
      useKeyboardShortcuts([{ keys: ["?"], handler, ignoreInInput: false }]),
    );
    await userEvent.keyboard("?");
    expect(handler).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
  });

  it("fires modifier shortcut", async () => {
    const handler = vi.fn();
    renderHook(() =>
      useKeyboardShortcuts([
        { keys: ["k"], modifiers: { ctrl: true }, handler },
      ]),
    );
    await userEvent.keyboard("{Control>}k{/Control}");
    expect(handler).toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it("fires sequence shortcut", async () => {
    const handler = vi.fn();
    renderHook(() =>
      useKeyboardShortcuts([
        { keys: ["g", "d"], handler, ignoreInInput: false },
      ]),
    );
    await userEvent.keyboard("gd");
    expect(handler).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
  });
});
```

## 5.1 `src/features/projects/project.types.ts`

```ts
/* =========================================================================
 * Enums — mirror the Data Dictionary + API Spec
 * ========================================================================= */
export const PROJECT_STATUSES = [
  "IDEA",
  "PROFILE",
  "PRE_FEASIBILITY",
  "FEASIBILITY",
  "APPRAISAL",
  "APPROVED",
  "ACTIVE",
  "CLOSED",
  "CANCELLED",
] as const;
export type ProjectStatus = (typeof PROJECT_STATUSES)[number];

export const PROJECT_SECTORS = ["WATER", "ENERGY", "BOTH", "OTHER"] as const;
export type ProjectSector = (typeof PROJECT_SECTORS)[number];

export const IMPL_ARRANGEMENTS = [
  "PIU",
  "LINE_MINISTRY",
  "REGIONAL",
  "OTHER",
] as const;
export type ImplementationArrangement = (typeof IMPL_ARRANGEMENTS)[number];

export const FINANCING_SOURCES = [
  "WORLD_BANK",
  "GOVERNMENT",
  "DBE",
  "OTHER",
] as const;
export type FinancingSource = (typeof FINANCING_SOURCES)[number];

export const STAGE_ORDER: ProjectStatus[] = [
  "IDEA",
  "PROFILE",
  "PRE_FEASIBILITY",
  "FEASIBILITY",
  "APPRAISAL",
  "APPROVED",
  "ACTIVE",
  "CLOSED",
];

/* =========================================================================
 * Core entity
 * ========================================================================= */
export interface Money {
  amount: string; // string decimal per API contract
  currency: "ETB" | "USD" | "EUR";
}

export interface ProjectLocation {
  locationId?: string;
  region: string;
  regionCode?: string;
  zone?: string;
  woreda?: string;
  kebele?: string;
  latitude?: number;
  longitude?: number;
}

export interface FinancingLine {
  source: FinancingSource;
  amount: string;
  currency: "ETB" | "USD" | "EUR";
  referenceNo?: string;
}

export interface Project {
  projectId: string;
  projectCode: string;
  name: string;
  nameAm?: string;
  description?: string;
  sector: ProjectSector;
  subsector?: string;
  status: ProjectStatus;
  stageGate?: string;
  ownerOrgId: string;
  ownerOrgName?: string;
  location?: ProjectLocation;
  totalBudget: Money;
  wbCreditNo?: string;
  approvalDate?: string;
  startDate?: string;
  endDate?: string;
  actualStart?: string;
  actualEnd?: string;
  implementationArrangement?: ImplementationArrangement;
  financingSource?: FinancingLine[];
  createdAt: string;
  updatedAt: string;
  version: number;
}

export interface ProjectSummary extends Pick<
  Project,
  | "projectId"
  | "projectCode"
  | "name"
  | "sector"
  | "status"
  | "totalBudget"
  | "startDate"
  | "endDate"
  | "createdAt"
  | "updatedAt"
> {
  ownerOrgName?: string;
  region?: string;
  /** Derived — % of active indicators on-track */
  progressPct?: number;
}

/* =========================================================================
 * Filters
 * ========================================================================= */
export interface ProjectFilters {
  q?: string;
  status?: ProjectStatus[];
  sector?: ProjectSector[];
  region?: string;
  ownerOrgId?: string;
  createdAfter?: string;
  createdBefore?: string;
  sort?: string; // e.g. '-updatedAt,name'
  cursor?: string;
  limit?: number;
}

export interface Paginated<T> {
  data: T[];
  pagination: {
    nextCursor?: string;
    limit: number;
    totalCount: number;
    hasMore: boolean;
  };
}

/* =========================================================================
 * Stage transitions
 * ========================================================================= */
export interface StageAdvanceRequest {
  targetStage: ProjectStatus;
  checklist: Record<string, boolean>;
  notes?: string;
}

export interface ProjectHistoryEntry {
  logId: number;
  action: "CREATE" | "UPDATE" | "DELETE" | "APPROVE" | "ADVANCE";
  userId: string;
  userName: string;
  at: string;
  changes: { field: string; before?: unknown; after?: unknown }[];
  notes?: string;
}
```

## 5.2 `src/features/projects/project.schema.ts`

```ts
import { z } from "zod";
import {
  PROJECT_SECTORS,
  IMPL_ARRANGEMENTS,
  FINANCING_SOURCES,
  PROJECT_STATUSES,
} from "./project.types";

/* -------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * Money — string decimal per API
 * ------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
const moneySchema = z.object({
  amount: z.string().regex(/^\d+(\.\d{1,2})?$/, "Must be a valid amount"),
  currency: z.enum(["ETB", "USD", "EUR"]),
});

/* -------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * Create project — matches wizard steps
 * ------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
export const stepIdentificationSchema = z.object({
  name: z.string().trim().min(3, "Name must be at least 3 characters").max(300),
  nameAm: z.string().trim().max(300).optional().or(z.literal("")),
  description: z.string().trim().max(2000).optional().or(z.literal("")),
  subsector: z.string().trim().max(100).optional().or(z.literal("")),
});
export type StepIdentificationData = z.infer<typeof stepIdentificationSchema>;

export const stepClassificationSchema = z.object({
  sector: z.enum(PROJECT_SECTORS),
  ownerOrgId: z.string().uuid("Select a lead organization"),
  implementationArrangement: z.enum(IMPL_ARRANGEMENTS),
  wbCreditNo: z.string().trim().max(50).optional().or(z.literal("")),
});
export type StepClassificationData = z.infer<typeof stepClassificationSchema>;

export const stepLocationSchema = z.object({
  region: z.string().min(1, "Region is required"),
  zone: z.string().optional().or(z.literal("")),
  woreda: z.string().optional().or(z.literal("")),
  kebele: z.string().optional().or(z.literal("")),
  latitude: z.number().min(-90).max(90).optional(),
  longitude: z.number().min(-180).max(180).optional(),
});
export type StepLocationData = z.infer<typeof stepLocationSchema>;

const financingLineSchema = z.object({
  source: z.enum(FINANCING_SOURCES),
  amount: z.string().regex(/^\d+(\.\d{1,2})?$/, "Must be a valid amount"),
  currency: z.enum(["ETB", "USD", "EUR"]),
  referenceNo: z.string().optional().or(z.literal("")),
});

export const stepBudgetSchema = z
  .object({
    totalBudget: moneySchema,
    startDate: z
      .string()
      .refine((s) => !s || !Number.isNaN(Date.parse(s)), "Invalid date")
      .optional(),
    endDate: z.string().optional(),
    financingSource: z
      .array(financingLineSchema)
      .min(1, "At least one financing source is required"),
  })
  .refine(
    (d) =>
      !d.startDate ||
      !d.endDate ||
      Date.parse(d.endDate) > Date.parse(d.startDate),
    { path: ["endDate"], message: "End date must be after start date" },
  );
export type StepBudgetData = z.infer<typeof stepBudgetSchema>;

export const createProjectSchema = stepIdentificationSchema
  .merge(stepClassificationSchema)
  .merge(stepLocationSchema)
  .merge(stepBudgetSchema)
  .refine(
    (d) => {
      const declared = d.financingSource.reduce(
        (sum, l) => sum + Number(l.amount),
        0,
      );
      return Math.abs(declared - Number(d.totalBudget.amount)) < 0.01;
    },
    {
      path: ["financingSource"],
      message: "Financing sources must sum to the total budget",
    },
  );
export type CreateProjectInput = z.infer<typeof createProjectSchema>;

/* -------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * Update
 * ------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
export const updateProjectSchema = createProjectSchema.partial();
export type UpdateProjectInput = z.infer<typeof updateProjectSchema>;

/* -------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * Filters (URL-serialisable)
 * ------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
export const projectFiltersSchema = z.object({
  q: z.string().optional(),
  status: z.array(z.enum(PROJECT_STATUSES)).optional(),
  sector: z.array(z.enum(PROJECT_SECTORS)).optional(),
  region: z.string().optional(),
  ownerOrgId: z.string().optional(),
  sort: z.string().optional(),
  cursor: z.string().optional(),
  limit: z.number().int().min(1).max(200).optional(),
});
export type ProjectFiltersInput = z.infer<typeof projectFiltersSchema>;

/* -------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * Stage advance
 * ------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
export const stageAdvanceSchema = z.object({
  targetStage: z.enum(PROJECT_STATUSES),
  checklist: z.record(z.boolean()),
  notes: z.string().max(1000).optional(),
});
export type StageAdvanceInput = z.infer<typeof stageAdvanceSchema>;

/* -------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * Wizard step registry — drives WizardShell
 * ------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
export const WIZARD_STEPS = [
  {
    id: "identification",
    labelKey: "projects.wizard.steps.identification",
    schema: stepIdentificationSchema,
  },
  {
    id: "classification",
    labelKey: "projects.wizard.steps.classification",
    schema: stepClassificationSchema,
  },
  {
    id: "location",
    labelKey: "projects.wizard.steps.location",
    schema: stepLocationSchema,
  },
  {
    id: "budget",
    labelKey: "projects.wizard.steps.budget",
    schema: stepBudgetSchema,
  },
  {
    id: "review",
    labelKey: "projects.wizard.steps.review",
    schema: createProjectSchema,
  },
] as const;
export type WizardStepId = (typeof WIZARD_STEPS)[number]["id"];
```

## 5.3 `src/features/projects/project.api.ts`

```ts
import { api } from "@/lib/api/client";
import type {
  Project,
  ProjectSummary,
  Paginated,
  ProjectFilters,
  StageAdvanceRequest,
  ProjectHistoryEntry,
  CreateProjectInput,
} from "./project.types";

interface Envelope<T> {
  data: T;
}

function filtersToParams(f: ProjectFilters): URLSearchParams {
  const p = new URLSearchParams();
  if (f.q) p.set("q", f.q);
  if (f.status?.length) p.set("status", f.status.join(","));
  if (f.sector?.length) p.set("sector", f.sector.join(","));
  if (f.region) p.set("region", f.region);
  if (f.ownerOrgId) p.set("owner_org_id", f.ownerOrgId);
  if (f.createdAfter) p.set("created_after", f.createdAfter);
  if (f.createdBefore) p.set("created_before", f.createdBefore);
  if (f.sort) p.set("sort", f.sort);
  if (f.cursor) p.set("cursor", f.cursor);
  if (f.limit) p.set("limit", String(f.limit));
  return p;
}

export const projectApi = {
  async list(f: ProjectFilters): Promise<Paginated<ProjectSummary>> {
    const { data } = await api.get<
      Envelope<ProjectSummary[]> & {
        pagination: Paginated<ProjectSummary>["pagination"];
      }
    >(`/projects?${filtersToParams(f).toString()}`);
    return { data: data.data, pagination: (data as any).pagination };
  },

  async get(projectId: string): Promise<Project> {
    const { data } = await api.get<Envelope<Project>>(`/projects/${projectId}`);
    return data.data;
  },

  async create(
    input: CreateProjectInput & { idempotencyKey: string },
  ): Promise<Project> {
    const { idempotencyKey, ...body } = input;
    const { data } = await api.post<Envelope<Project>>("/projects", body, {
      headers: { "X-Idempotency-Key": idempotencyKey },
    });
    return data.data;
  },

  async update(
    projectId: string,
    patch: Partial<CreateProjectInput>,
    version: number,
  ): Promise<Project> {
    const { data } = await api.put<Envelope<Project>>(
      `/projects/${projectId}`,
      patch,
      {
        headers: { "If-Match": String(version) },
      },
    );
    return data.data;
  },

  async advance(projectId: string, req: StageAdvanceRequest): Promise<Project> {
    const { data } = await api.post<Envelope<Project>>(
      `/projects/${projectId}/advance`,
      req,
    );
    return data.data;
  },

  async history(projectId: string): Promise<ProjectHistoryEntry[]> {
    const { data } = await api.get<Envelope<ProjectHistoryEntry[]>>(
      `/projects/${projectId}/history`,
    );
    return data.data;
  },

  async pipeline(): Promise<Record<string, number>> {
    const { data } =
      await api.get<Envelope<Record<string, number>>>("/pipeline");
    return data.data;
  },

  async bulkImport(file: File): Promise<{ jobId: string; statusUrl: string }> {
    const fd = new FormData();
    fd.append("file", file);
    const { data } = await api.post<
      Envelope<{ job_id: string; status_url: string }>
    >("/projects/bulk-import", fd, {
      headers: { "Content-Type": "multipart/form-data" },
    });
    return { jobId: data.data.job_id, statusUrl: data.data.status_url };
  },
};
```

## 5.4 `src/features/projects/project.queries.ts`

```ts
import {
  useQuery,
  keepPreviousData,
  useInfiniteQuery,
} from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { projectApi } from "./project.api";
import type { ProjectFilters } from "./project.types";

export const projectKeys = {
  all: ["projects"] as const,
  list: (f: ProjectFilters) => [...projectKeys.all, "list", f] as const,
  infinite: (f: ProjectFilters) => [...projectKeys.all, "infinite", f] as const,
  detail: (id: string) => [...projectKeys.all, "detail", id] as const,
  history: (id: string) => [...projectKeys.all, "history", id] as const,
  pipeline: () => [...projectKeys.all, "pipeline"] as const,
};

export function useProjects(filters: ProjectFilters) {
  return useQuery({
    queryKey: projectKeys.list(filters),
    queryFn: () => projectApi.list(filters),
    placeholderData: keepPreviousData,
    staleTime: 30_000,
  });
}

export function useProjectsInfinite(filters: ProjectFilters) {
  return useInfiniteQuery({
    queryKey: projectKeys.infinite(filters),
    queryFn: ({ pageParam }) =>
      projectApi.list({ ...filters, cursor: pageParam as string | undefined }),
    getNextPageParam: (last) =>
      last.pagination.hasMore ? last.pagination.nextCursor : undefined,
    initialPageParam: undefined as string | undefined,
    staleTime: 30_000,
  });
}

export function useProject(projectId: string | undefined) {
  return useQuery({
    queryKey: projectKeys.detail(projectId ?? ""),
    queryFn: () => projectApi.get(projectId!),
    enabled: !!projectId,
    staleTime: 60_000,
  });
}

export function useProjectHistory(projectId: string | undefined) {
  return useQuery({
    queryKey: projectKeys.history(projectId ?? ""),
    queryFn: () => projectApi.history(projectId!),
    enabled: !!projectId,
  });
}

export function usePipeline() {
  return useQuery({
    queryKey: projectKeys.pipeline(),
    queryFn: () => projectApi.pipeline(),
    staleTime: 60_000,
  });
}
```

## 5.5 `src/features/projects/project.mutations.ts`

Optimistic create/update/advance. Offline fallback via localStorage queue.

```ts
import { useMutation, useQueryClient } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { projectApi } from "./project.api";
import { projectKeys } from "./project.queries";
import { useToast } from "@/components/ui/Toast";
import { useSyncStore } from "@/stores/sync.store";
import { normalizeApiError } from "@/lib/api/errors";
import type {
  CreateProjectInput,
  Project,
  StageAdvanceRequest,
} from "./project.types";

/* -------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * Offline mutation queue (localStorage-backed; idb preferred in prod)
 * ------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
interface QueuedMutation {
  id: string;
  kind: "create" | "update" | "advance";
  projectId?: string;
  payload: unknown;
  queuedAt: number;
}

const QUEUE_KEY = "piims.mutation.queue";

function readQueue(): QueuedMutation[] {
  try {
    return JSON.parse(
      localStorage.getItem(QUEUE_KEY) ?? "[]",
    ) as QueuedMutation[];
  } catch {
    return [];
  }
}
function writeQueue(q: QueuedMutation[]) {
  localStorage.setItem(QUEUE_KEY, JSON.stringify(q));
  useSyncStore.getState().setPending(q.length);
}

export function enqueueMutation(m: Omit<QueuedMutation, "id" | "queuedAt">) {
  const q = readQueue();
  q.push({ ...m, id: crypto.randomUUID(), queuedAt: Date.now() });
  writeQueue(q);
}

export function clearQueue() {
  writeQueue([]);
}
export function queueSize() {
  return readQueue().length;
}

/* -------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * CREATE
 * ------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
export function useCreateProject() {
  const qc = useQueryClient();
  const { push } = useToast();

  return useMutation({
    mutationFn: async (input: CreateProjectInput) => {
      const idempotencyKey = crypto.randomUUID();
      if (!navigator.onLine) {
        enqueueMutation({
          kind: "create",
          payload: { ...input, idempotencyKey },
        });
        throw Object.assign(new Error("OFFLINE_QUEUED"), {
          offlineQueued: true,
        });
      }
      return projectApi.create({ ...input, idempotencyKey });
    },
    onSuccess: (project) => {
      qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: projectKeys.all });
      push("success", `Project ${project.projectCode} created`);
    },
    onError: (err: any) => {
      if (err?.offlineQueued) {
        push(
          "info",
          "You are offline. Project will be submitted when reconnected.",
        );
        return;
      }
      const p = normalizeApiError(err);
      push("error", p.detail ?? p.title ?? "Failed to create project");
    },
  });
}

/* -------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * UPDATE — optimistic
 * ------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
export function useUpdateProject(projectId: string) {
  const qc = useQueryClient();
  const { push } = useToast();

  return useMutation({
    mutationFn: ({
      patch,
      version,
    }: {
      patch: Partial<CreateProjectInput>;
      version: number;
    }) => projectApi.update(projectId, patch, version),

    onMutate: async ({ patch }) => {
      await qc.cancelQueries({ queryKey: projectKeys.detail(projectId) });
      const previous = qc.getQueryData<Project>(projectKeys.detail(projectId));
      if (previous) {
        qc.setQueryData<Project>(projectKeys.detail(projectId), {
          ...previous,
          ...patch,
        } as Project);
      }
      return { previous };
    },
    onError: (err, _vars, ctx) => {
      if (ctx?.previous)
        qc.setQueryData(projectKeys.detail(projectId), ctx.previous);
      const p = normalizeApiError(err);
      push("error", p.detail ?? "Failed to save changes");
    },
    onSuccess: () => {
      qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: projectKeys.all });
      push("success", "Project updated");
    },
  });
}

/* -------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * ADVANCE STAGE
 * ------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
export function useAdvanceStage(projectId: string) {
  const qc = useQueryClient();
  const { push } = useToast();

  return useMutation({
    mutationFn: (req: StageAdvanceRequest) =>
      projectApi.advance(projectId, req),
    onSuccess: (project) => {
      qc.setQueryData(projectKeys.detail(projectId), project);
      qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: projectKeys.all });
      push(
        "success",
        `Advanced to ${project.status.replace(/_/g, " ").toLowerCase()}`,
      );
    },
    onError: (err) => {
      const p = normalizeApiError(err);
      push("error", p.detail ?? "Failed to advance stage");
    },
  });
}

/* -------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * FLUSH — replay queued mutations when online
 * ------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
export async function flushMutationQueue() {
  const q = readQueue();
  if (!q.length) return;
  const remaining: QueuedMutation[] = [];
  for (const m of q) {
    try {
      if (m.kind === "create") await projectApi.create(m.payload as any);
      if (m.kind === "update")
        await projectApi.update(m.projectId!, m.payload as any, 1);
      if (m.kind === "advance")
        await projectApi.advance(m.projectId!, m.payload as any);
    } catch {
      remaining.push(m);
    }
  }
  writeQueue(remaining);
}

/* Wire: replay on reconnect */
if (typeof window !== "undefined") {
  window.addEventListener("online", () => {
    void flushMutationQueue();
  });
}
```

## 5.6 `src/features/projects/project.utils.ts`

```ts
import type { ChipTone } from "@/components/ui/Chip";
import type { ProjectStatus, ProjectSector } from "./project.types";

export function statusTone(s: ProjectStatus): ChipTone {
  switch (s) {
    case "IDEA":
    case "PROFILE":
      return "grey";
    case "PRE_FEASIBILITY":
    case "FEASIBILITY":
    case "APPRAISAL":
      return "amber";
    case "APPROVED":
      return "blue";
    case "ACTIVE":
      return "green";
    case "CLOSED":
      return "teal";
    case "CANCELLED":
      return "red";
  }
}

export function statusLabelKey(s: ProjectStatus): string {
  return `projects.status.${s.toLowerCase()}`;
}

export function sectorTone(s: ProjectSector): ChipTone {
  return s === "ENERGY" ? "gold" : s === "WATER" ? "blue" : "grey";
}

export function sectorLabelKey(s: ProjectSector): string {
  return `projects.sector.${s.toLowerCase()}`;
}

export function progressTone(pct?: number): "success" | "warning" | "danger" {
  if (pct == null) return "warning";
  if (pct >= 85) return "success";
  if (pct >= 60) return "warning";
  return "danger";
}
```

## 5.8 `src/features/projects/ProjectListPage.tsx`

```tsx
import { useMemo, useState } from "react";
import { useNavigate, useSearchParams } from "react-router-dom";
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";
import { Plus, Download, Filter, Upload, RefreshCw } from "lucide-react";
import { useProjects } from "./project.queries";
import { usePermissions } from "@/features/auth/usePermissions";
import { PERMISSIONS } from "@/features/auth/auth.types";
import { DataGrid, type Column } from "@/components/ui/DataGrid";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/Button";
import { Chip } from "@/components/ui/Chip";
import { Progress } from "@/components/ui/Progress";
import { Pagination } from "@/components/ui/Pagination";
import { EmptyState } from "@/components/ui/EmptyState";
import { ErrorState } from "@/components/ui/ErrorState";
import { SkeletonTable } from "@/components/ui/Skeleton";
import { ProjectListFilters } from "./ProjectListFilters";
import {
  statusTone,
  statusLabelKey,
  sectorLabelKey,
  progressTone,
} from "./project.utils";
import { formatMoney } from "@/lib/utils/currency";
import { formatDate } from "@/lib/utils/date";
import type { ProjectSummary } from "./project.types";

export default function ProjectListPage() {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const { can } = usePermissions();
  const [params, setParams] = useSearchParams();
  const [filtersOpen, setFiltersOpen] = useState(false);

  const q = params.get("q") ?? "";
  const status = (params.get("status")?.split(",").filter(Boolean) ??
    []) as ProjectSummary["status"][];
  const sector = (params.get("sector")?.split(",").filter(Boolean) ??
    []) as ProjectSummary["sector"][];
  const region = params.get("region") ?? "";
  const page = Math.max(1, Number(params.get("page") ?? 1));
  const pageSize = Math.min(200, Math.max(1, Number(params.get("size") ?? 25)));

  const { data, isLoading, isFetching, isError, refetch } = useProjects({
    q: q || undefined,
    status: status.length ? status : undefined,
    sector: sector.length ? sector : undefined,
    region: region || undefined,
    limit: pageSize,
    cursor: undefined,
  });

  const columns: Column<ProjectSummary>[] = useMemo(
    () => [
      {
        id: "projectCode",
        header: t("projects.columns.code"),
        sortable: true,
        render: (r) => (
          <code className="text-caption font-bold text-primary-700">
            {r.projectCode}
          </code>
        ),
      },
      {
        id: "name",
        header: t("projects.columns.name"),
        sortable: true,
        render: (r) => (
          <div className="min-w-0">
            <div className="font-semibold text-neutral-900 truncate">
              {r.name}
            </div>
            {r.region && (
              <div className="text-caption text-neutral-600">{r.region}</div>
            )}
          </div>
        ),
      },
      {
        id: "sector",
        header: t("projects.columns.sector"),
        render: (r) => <Chip tone="blue">{t(sectorLabelKey(r.sector))}</Chip>,
      },
      {
        id: "status",
        header: t("projects.columns.status"),
        render: (r) => (
          <Chip tone={statusTone(r.status)}>{t(statusLabelKey(r.status))}</Chip>
        ),
      },
      {
        id: "totalBudget",
        header: t("projects.columns.budget"),
        align: "right",
        render: (r) => (
          <span className="font-semibold">
            {formatMoney(r.totalBudget.amount, r.totalBudget.currency)}
          </span>
        ),
      },
      {
        id: "progressPct",
        header: t("projects.columns.progress"),
        render: (r) => (
          <div className="min-w-[120px]">
            <Progress
              value={r.progressPct ?? 0}
              tone={progressTone(r.progressPct)}
            />
          </div>
        ),
      },
      {
        id: "updatedAt",
        header: t("projects.columns.updated"),
        render: (r) => (
          <span className="text-caption text-neutral-600">
            {formatDate(r.updatedAt)}
          </span>
        ),
      },
    ],
    [t],
  );

  const active = (data?.data ?? []).filter((p) => p.status === "ACTIVE").length;
  const pipeline = (data?.data ?? []).filter((p) =>
    ["IDEA", "PROFILE", "PRE_FEASIBILITY", "FEASIBILITY", "APPRAISAL"].includes(
      p.status,
    ),
  ).length;

  const updateParams = (patch: Record<string, string | undefined>) => {
    const next = new URLSearchParams(params);
    Object.entries(patch).forEach(([k, v]) => {
      if (v == null || v === "") next.delete(k);
      else next.set(k, v);
    });
    if (!("page" in patch)) next.set("page", "1");
    setParams(next, { replace: true });
  };

  return (
    <main id="main" tabIndex={-1}>
      <header className="flex flex-wrap items-start justify-between gap-4 mb-5">
        <div>
          <h1 className="text-h1 text-primary-900">{t("projects.title")}</h1>
          <p className="text-body-sm text-neutral-600 mt-1">
            {t("projects.subtitle", {
              count: data?.pagination.totalCount ?? 0,
              active,
              pipeline,
            })}
          </p>
        </div>
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
          <Button
            variant="ghost"
            size="sm"
            onClick={() => refetch()}
            leftIcon={<RefreshCw className="h-4 w-4" />}
          >
            {isFetching ? "Refreshing…" : "Refresh"}
          </Button>
          <Button
            variant="secondary"
            size="sm"
            leftIcon={<Filter className="h-4 w-4" />}
            onClick={() => setFiltersOpen((s) => !s)}
            aria-expanded={filtersOpen}
          >
            {t("projects.actions.filters")}
          </Button>
          {can(PERMISSIONS.projectRead) && (
            <Button
              variant="secondary"
              size="sm"
              leftIcon={<Download className="h-4 w-4" />}
              onClick={() => {
                const csv = ["Code,Name,Sector,Status,Budget"]
                  .concat(
                    (data?.data ?? []).map(
                      (p) =>
                        `${p.projectCode},"${p.name.replace(/"/g, '""')}",${p.sector},${p.status},${p.totalBudget.amount} ${p.totalBudget.currency}`,
                    ),
                  )
                  .join("\n");
                const blob = new Blob([csv], {
                  type: "text/csv;charset=utf-8",
                });
                const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
                const a = document.createElement("a");
                a.href = url;
                a.download = `projects-${new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10)}.csv`;
                a.click();
                URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
              }}
            >
              {t("projects.actions.export")}
            </Button>
          )}
          {can(PERMISSIONS.projectWrite) && (
            <>
              <Button
                variant="secondary"
                size="sm"
                leftIcon={<Upload className="h-4 w-4" />}
                onClick={() => alert("Bulk import wizard — Step 5 follow-up")}
              >
                {t("projects.actions.import")}
              </Button>
              <Button
                variant="primary"
                size="sm"
                leftIcon={<Plus className="h-4 w-4" />}
                onClick={() => navigate("/projects/new")}
              >
                {t("projects.actions.new")}
              </Button>
            </>
          )}
        </div>
      </header>

      {filtersOpen && (
        <div className="mb-4">
          <ProjectListFilters
            q={q}
            status={status}
            sector={sector}
            region={region}
            onChange={updateParams}
          />
        </div>
      )}

      {isLoading && <SkeletonTable rows={8} cols={columns.length} />}

      {isError && !isLoading && (
        <ErrorState
          onRetry={() => refetch()}
          message="Failed to load projects."
        />
      )}

      {!isLoading &&
        !isError &&
        (data?.data.length ?? 0) === 0 &&
        (q ? (
          <EmptyState
            title={t("projects.empty.searchTitle", { q })}
            description={t("projects.empty.searchDescription")}
            action={
              <Button
                variant="secondary"
                onClick={() => updateParams({ q: undefined })}
              >
                {t("projects.actions.clearFilters")}
              </Button>
            }
          />
        ) : (
          <EmptyState
            title={t("projects.empty.title")}
            description={t("projects.empty.description")}
            action={
              can(PERMISSIONS.projectWrite) && (
                <Button
                  variant="primary"
                  leftIcon={<Plus className="h-4 w-4" />}
                  onClick={() => navigate("/projects/new")}
                >
                  {t("projects.actions.new")}
                </Button>
              )
            }
          />
        ))}

      {!isLoading && !isError && (data?.data.length ?? 0) > 0 && (
        <>
          <DataGrid
            columns={columns}
            rows={data!.data.map((p) => ({ ...p, id: p.projectId }))}
            onRowClick={(r) => navigate(`/projects/${r.projectCode}`)}
            ariaLabel={t("projects.title")}
          />
          <Pagination
            page={page}
            pageSize={pageSize}
            total={data!.pagination.totalCount}
            onPageChange={(p) => updateParams({ page: String(p) })}
            onPageSizeChange={(s) =>
              updateParams({ size: String(s), page: "1" })
            }
          />
        </>
      )}
    </main>
  );
}
```

## 5.9 `src/features/projects/ProjectListFilters.tsx`

```tsx
import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";
import { Search, X } from "lucide-react";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/Input";
import { Select } from "@/components/ui/Select";
import { Chip } from "@/components/ui/Chip";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/Button";
import {
  PROJECT_STATUSES,
  PROJECT_SECTORS,
  type ProjectStatus,
  type ProjectSector,
} from "./project.types";
import { statusLabelKey, sectorLabelKey, statusTone } from "./project.utils";

const ETHIOPIAN_REGIONS = [
  "Addis Ababa",
  "Afar",
  "Amhara",
  "Benishangul-Gumuz",
  "Dire Dawa",
  "Gambella",
  "Harari",
  "Oromia",
  "Sidama",
  "SNNP",
  "Somali",
  "South West Ethiopia",
  "Tigray",
];

export interface ProjectListFiltersProps {
  q: string;
  status: ProjectStatus[];
  sector: ProjectSector[];
  region: string;
  onChange: (patch: Record<string, string | undefined>) => void;
}

export function ProjectListFilters({
  q,
  status,
  sector,
  region,
  onChange,
}: ProjectListFiltersProps) {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const [localQ, setLocalQ] = useState(q);

  // Debounce search 300 ms
  useEffect(() => {
    const id = window.setTimeout(() => {
      if (localQ !== q) onChange({ q: localQ || undefined });
    }, 300);
    return () => window.clearTimeout(id);
  }, [localQ, q, onChange]);

  useEffect(() => {
    setLocalQ(q);
  }, [q]);

  const toggleStatus = (s: ProjectStatus) => {
    const next = status.includes(s)
      ? status.filter((x) => x !== s)
      : [...status, s];
    onChange({ status: next.length ? next.join(",") : undefined });
  };
  const toggleSector = (s: ProjectSector) => {
    const next = sector.includes(s)
      ? sector.filter((x) => x !== s)
      : [...sector, s];
    onChange({ sector: next.length ? next.join(",") : undefined });
  };

  const hasFilters = !!(q || status.length || sector.length || region);

  return (
    <section
      aria-label={t("projects.actions.filters")}
      className="bg-white border border-neutral-300 rounded-md p-4 space-y-3"
    >
      <div className="grid md:grid-cols-3 gap-3">
        <Input
          label={t("projects.filters.searchPlaceholder")}
          value={localQ}
          onChange={(e) => setLocalQ(e.target.value)}
          leftIcon={<Search className="h-4 w-4" />}
          rightSlot={
            localQ ? (
              <button
                type="button"
                aria-label={t("projects.actions.clearFilters")}
                onClick={() => {
                  setLocalQ("");
                  onChange({ q: undefined });
                }}
                className="p-1 rounded hover:bg-neutral-100"
              >
                <X className="h-4 w-4 text-neutral-600" />
              </button>
            ) : undefined
          }
        />
        <Select
          label={t("projects.filters.region")}
          placeholder="—"
          value={region}
          onChange={(e) => onChange({ region: e.target.value || undefined })}
          options={ETHIOPIAN_REGIONS.map((r) => ({ value: r, label: r }))}
        />
        <div className="flex items-end">
          {hasFilters && (
            <Button
              variant="ghost"
              size="sm"
              onClick={() => {
                setLocalQ("");
                onChange({
                  q: undefined,
                  status: undefined,
                  sector: undefined,
                  region: undefined,
                });
              }}
            >
              {t("projects.actions.clearFilters")}
            </Button>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

      <div>
        <div className="text-caption font-semibold text-neutral-600 mb-1.5">
          {t("projects.filters.status")}
        </div>
        <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
          {PROJECT_STATUSES.map((s) => {
            const selected = status.includes(s);
            return (
              <button
                key={s}
                type="button"
                aria-pressed={selected}
                onClick={() => toggleStatus(s)}
                className="focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-info focus-visible:ring-offset-2 rounded-full"
              >
                <Chip
                  tone={selected ? statusTone(s) : "grey"}
                  className={
                    selected
                      ? "ring-1 ring-offset-1 ring-primary-300"
                      : "opacity-70 hover:opacity-100"
                  }
                >
                  {t(statusLabelKey(s))}
                </Chip>
              </button>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      </div>

      <div>
        <div className="text-caption font-semibold text-neutral-600 mb-1.5">
          {t("projects.filters.sector")}
        </div>
        <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
          {PROJECT_SECTORS.map((s) => {
            const selected = sector.includes(s);
            return (
              <button
                key={s}
                type="button"
                aria-pressed={selected}
                onClick={() => toggleSector(s)}
                className="focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-info focus-visible:ring-offset-2 rounded-full"
              >
                <Chip
                  tone={selected ? "blue" : "grey"}
                  className={
                    selected
                      ? "ring-1 ring-offset-1 ring-primary-300"
                      : "opacity-70 hover:opacity-100"
                  }
                >
                  {t(sectorLabelKey(s))}
                </Chip>
              </button>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>
  );
}
```

## 5.10 `src/features/projects/wizard/WizardShell.tsx`

```tsx
import { type ReactNode, useEffect, useRef } from "react";
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";
import { Stepper } from "@/components/ui/Stepper";
import { WIZARD_STEPS } from "../project.schema";
import { cn } from "@/components/ui/utils/cn";

export interface WizardShellProps {
  current: number;
  onStepClick?: (i: number) => void;
  maxVisited: number;
  draftSavedAt?: number | null;
  children: ReactNode;
  footer: ReactNode;
}

export function WizardShell({
  current,
  onStepClick,
  maxVisited,
  draftSavedAt,
  children,
  footer,
}: WizardShellProps) {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const ref = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    // Move focus to first heading of the step for screen readers
    ref.current?.querySelector<HTMLElement>("[data-step-heading]")?.focus();
  }, [current]);

  return (
    <div ref={ref} className="space-y-6">
      <header>
        <h1 className="text-h1 text-primary-900">
          {t("projects.wizard.title")}
        </h1>
        <p className="text-body-sm text-neutral-600 mt-1">
          {t("projects.wizard.subtitle")}
        </p>
        {draftSavedAt && (
          <p
            className="text-caption text-green-700 mt-2"
            role="status"
            aria-live="polite"
          >
            {t("projects.wizard.draftSaved", {
              time: new Date(draftSavedAt).toLocaleTimeString(),
            })}
          </p>
        )}
      </header>

      <Stepper
        steps={WIZARD_STEPS.map((s) => ({ id: s.id, label: t(s.labelKey) }))}
        current={current}
        onStepClick={(i) => i <= maxVisited && onStepClick?.(i)}
      />

      <div className={cn("bg-white border border-neutral-300 rounded-md p-6")}>
        {children}
      </div>

      <div className="sticky bottom-0 -mx-4 md:-mx-6 px-4 md:px-6 py-3 bg-neutral-50 border-t border-neutral-300 flex justify-between gap-2 z-10">
        {footer}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import { useForm } from "react-hook-form";
import { zodResolver } from "@hookform/resolvers/zod";
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/Input";
import { Textarea } from "@/components/ui/Textarea";
import {
  stepIdentificationSchema,
  type StepIdentificationData,
} from "../project.schema";

export function StepIdentification({
  defaultValues,
  onSubmit,
  formId,
}: {
  defaultValues: Partial<StepIdentificationData>;
  onSubmit: (d: StepIdentificationData) => void;
  formId: string;
}) {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const {
    register,
    handleSubmit,
    formState: { errors },
  } = useForm<StepIdentificationData>({
    resolver: zodResolver(stepIdentificationSchema),
    defaultValues,
    mode: "onBlur",
  });

  return (
    <form
      id={formId}
      onSubmit={handleSubmit(onSubmit)}
      className="space-y-4"
      noValidate
    >
      <h2 data-step-heading tabIndex={-1} className="text-h2 text-primary-900">
        {t("projects.wizard.steps.identification")}
      </h2>

      <Input
        {...register("name")}
        label={t("projects.wizard.fields.name")}
        required
        error={errors.name?.message}
        autoFocus
      />
      <Input
        {...register("nameAm")}
        label={t("projects.wizard.fields.nameAm")}
        error={errors.nameAm?.message}
      />
      <Input
        {...register("subsector")}
        label={t("projects.wizard.fields.subsector")}
        error={errors.subsector?.message}
      />
      <Textarea
        {...register("description")}
        label={t("projects.wizard.fields.description")}
        rows={4}
        error={errors.description?.message}
      />
    </form>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import { useForm } from "react-hook-form";
```

### `src/features/projects/wizard/StepBudget.tsx`

```tsx
import { useFieldArray, useForm } from "react-hook-form";
import { zodResolver } from "@hookform/resolvers/zod";
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";
import { Plus, Trash2 } from "lucide-react";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/Input";
import { Select } from "@/components/ui/Select";
import { DateInput } from "@/components/ui/DateInput";
import { IconButton } from "@/components/ui/IconButton";
import { stepBudgetSchema, type StepBudgetData } from "../project.schema";
import { FINANCING_SOURCES } from "../project.types";

export function StepBudget({
  defaultValues,
  onSubmit,
  formId,
}: {
  defaultValues: Partial<StepBudgetData>;
  onSubmit: (d: StepBudgetData) => void;
  formId: string;
}) {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const {
    register,
    handleSubmit,
    control,
    watch,
    formState: { errors },
  } = useForm<StepBudgetData>({
    resolver: zodResolver(stepBudgetSchema),
    defaultValues: {
      totalBudget: defaultValues.totalBudget ?? { amount: "", currency: "ETB" },
      financingSource: defaultValues.financingSource ?? [
        { source: "WORLD_BANK", amount: "", currency: "ETB" },
      ],
      startDate: defaultValues.startDate ?? "",
      endDate: defaultValues.endDate ?? "",
    },
    mode: "onBlur",
  });
  const { fields, append, remove } = useFieldArray({
    control,
    name: "financingSource",
  });

  const total = Number(watch("totalBudget.amount") || 0);
  const declared = (watch("financingSource") ?? []).reduce(
    (s, l) => s + Number(l?.amount || 0),
    0,
  );
  const mismatch = Math.abs(total - declared) > 0.01;

  return (
    <form
      id={formId}
      onSubmit={handleSubmit(onSubmit)}
      className="space-y-5"
      noValidate
    >
      <h2 data-step-heading tabIndex={-1} className="text-h2 text-primary-900">
        {t("projects.wizard.steps.budget")}
      </h2>

      <div className="grid sm:grid-cols-3 gap-4">
        <div className="sm:col-span-2">
          <Input
            {...register("totalBudget.amount")}
            label={t("projects.wizard.fields.totalBudget")}
            required
            error={errors.totalBudget?.amount?.message}
            inputMode="decimal"
          />
        </div>
        <Select
          {...register("totalBudget.currency")}
          label={t("projects.wizard.fields.currency")}
          required
          options={[
            { value: "ETB", label: "ETB" },
            { value: "USD", label: "USD" },
            { value: "EUR", label: "EUR" },
          ]}
        />
      </div>

      <div className="grid sm:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
        <DateInput
          {...register("startDate")}
          label={t("projects.wizard.fields.startDate")}
        />
        <DateInput
          {...register("endDate")}
          label={t("projects.wizard.fields.endDate")}
          error={errors.endDate?.message}
        />
      </div>

      <fieldset>
        <legend className="text-caption font-semibold text-neutral-600 mb-2">
          {t("projects.wizard.fields.financingSource")}
        </legend>
        <ul className="space-y-2">
          {fields.map((f, i) => (
            <li
              key={f.id}
              className="grid sm:grid-cols-[1fr_1fr_120px_140px_40px] gap-2 items-end"
            >
              <Select
                {...register(`financingSource.${i}.source` as const)}
                label={i === 0 ? "Source" : ""}
                options={FINANCING_SOURCES.map((s) => ({
                  value: s,
                  label: s.replace(/_/g, " "),
                }))}
              />
              <Input
                {...register(`financingSource.${i}.amount` as const)}
                label={i === 0 ? "Amount" : ""}
                inputMode="decimal"
                required
              />
              <Select
                {...register(`financingSource.${i}.currency` as const)}
                label={i === 0 ? "CCY" : ""}
                options={[
                  { value: "ETB", label: "ETB" },
                  { value: "USD", label: "USD" },
                  { value: "EUR", label: "EUR" },
                ]}
              />
              <Input
                {...register(`financingSource.${i}.referenceNo` as const)}
                label={i === 0 ? t("projects.wizard.fields.referenceNo") : ""}
              />
              <div className="pb-0.5">
                <IconButton
                  type="button"
                  label={t("projects.wizard.fields.financingSourceRemove")}
                  icon={<Trash2 className="h-4 w-4" />}
                  variant="ghost"
                  onClick={() => fields.length > 1 && remove(i)}
                  disabled={fields.length === 1}
                />
              </div>
            </li>
          ))}
        </ul>
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={() =>
            append({
              source: "WORLD_BANK",
              amount: "",
              currency: "ETB",
              referenceNo: "",
            })
          }
          className="mt-3 inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 text-caption font-semibold text-primary-700 hover:underline"
        >
          <Plus className="h-3.5 w-3.5" aria-hidden />
          {t("projects.wizard.fields.financingSourceAdd")}
        </button>
      </fieldset>

      <div
        role={mismatch ? "alert" : "status"}
        className={`text-caption font-semibold ${mismatch ? "text-danger" : "text-green-700"}`}
      >
        {mismatch
          ? `Declared: ${declared.toLocaleString()} · Total: ${total.toLocaleString()} — ${t("projects.wizard.review.budgetMismatch")}`
          : `Declared: ${declared.toLocaleString()} ✓ matches total budget`}
      </div>
    </form>
  );
}
```

### `src/features/projects/wizard/StepReview.tsx`

```tsx
import { useState } from "react";
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";
import { Checkbox } from "@/components/ui/Checkbox";
import { Card, CardHeader } from "@/components/ui/Card";
import { sectorLabelKey } from "../project.utils";
import { formatMoney } from "@/lib/utils/currency";

export interface StepReviewProps {
  data: any;
  onAcknowledgeChange: (v: boolean) => void;
  formId: string;
  onAcknowledgeSubmit: () => void;
}

export function StepReview({
  data,
  onAcknowledgeChange,
  formId,
  onAcknowledgeSubmit,
}: StepReviewProps) {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const [ack, setAck] = useState(false);

  return (
    <form
      id={formId}
      onSubmit={(e) => {
        e.preventDefault();
        if (ack) onAcknowledgeSubmit();
      }}
      className="space-y-4"
      noValidate
    >
      <h2 data-step-heading tabIndex={-1} className="text-h2 text-primary-900">
        {t("projects.wizard.review.title")}
      </h2>

      <div className="grid md:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
        <Card>
          <CardHeader title="Identification" />
          <dl className="text-body-sm space-y-1.5">
            <Row label={t("projects.wizard.fields.name")} value={data.name} />
            {data.nameAm && (
              <Row
                label={t("projects.wizard.fields.nameAm")}
                value={data.nameAm}
              />
            )}
            {data.subsector && (
              <Row
                label={t("projects.wizard.fields.subsector")}
                value={data.subsector}
              />
            )}
          </dl>
        </Card>

        <Card>
          <CardHeader title="Classification" />
          <dl className="text-body-sm space-y-1.5">
            <Row
              label={t("projects.wizard.fields.sector")}
              value={t(sectorLabelKey(data.sector))}
            />
            <Row
              label={t("projects.wizard.fields.ownerOrgId")}
              value={data.ownerOrgId}
            />
            <Row
              label={t("projects.wizard.fields.implementationArrangement")}
              value={data.implementationArrangement}
            />
            {data.wbCreditNo && (
              <Row
                label={t("projects.wizard.fields.wbCreditNo")}
                value={data.wbCreditNo}
              />
            )}
          </dl>
        </Card>

        <Card>
          <CardHeader title="Location" />
          <dl className="text-body-sm space-y-1.5">
            <Row
              label={t("projects.wizard.fields.region")}
              value={data.region}
            />
            {data.zone && (
              <Row label={t("projects.wizard.fields.zone")} value={data.zone} />
            )}
            {data.woreda && (
              <Row
                label={t("projects.wizard.fields.woreda")}
                value={data.woreda}
              />
            )}
            {data.kebele && (
              <Row
                label={t("projects.wizard.fields.kebele")}
                value={data.kebele}
              />
            )}
          </dl>
        </Card>

        <Card>
          <CardHeader title="Budget & financing" />
          <dl className="text-body-sm space-y-1.5">
            <Row
              label={t("projects.wizard.fields.totalBudget")}
              value={formatMoney(
                data.totalBudget?.amount,
                data.totalBudget?.currency,
              )}
            />
            {data.startDate && (
              <Row
                label={t("projects.wizard.fields.startDate")}
                value={data.startDate}
              />
            )}
            {data.endDate && (
              <Row
                label={t("projects.wizard.fields.endDate")}
                value={data.endDate}
              />
            )}
          </dl>
          <ul className="mt-2 text-caption text-neutral-600 space-y-0.5">
            {(data.financingSource ?? []).map((l: any, i: number) => (
              <li key={i}>
                {l.source}: {formatMoney(l.amount, l.currency)}{" "}
                {l.referenceNo ? `(${l.referenceNo})` : ""}
              </li>
            ))}
          </ul>
        </Card>
      </div>

      <Checkbox
        label={t("projects.wizard.review.acknowledge")}
        checked={ack}
        onChange={(e) => {
          setAck(e.target.checked);
          onAcknowledgeChange(e.target.checked);
        }}
      />
    </form>
  );
}

function Row({ label, value }: { label: string; value?: string }) {
  return (
    <div className="flex justify-between gap-3">
      <dt className="text-neutral-600">{label}</dt>
      <dd className="font-semibold text-neutral-900 text-right truncate">
        {value ?? "—"}
      </dd>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## 5.12 `src/features/projects/ProjectNewPage.tsx`

```tsx
import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { useNavigate } from "react-router-dom";
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";
import { useForm, FormProvider } from "react-hook-form";
import { zodResolver } from "@hookform/resolvers/zod";
import { WizardShell } from "./wizard/WizardShell";
import { StepIdentification } from "./wizard/StepIdentification";
import { StepClassification } from "./wizard/StepClassification";
import { StepLocation } from "./wizard/StepLocation";
import { StepBudget } from "./wizard/StepBudget";
import { StepReview } from "./wizard/StepReview";
import {
  createProjectSchema,
  WIZARD_STEPS,
  type CreateProjectInput,
} from "./project.schema";
import { useCreateProject } from "./project.mutations";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/Button";
import { ConfirmDialog } from "@/components/ui/ConfirmDialog";

const DRAFT_KEY = "piims.project.draft";

interface Draft extends Partial<CreateProjectInput> {
  __step?: number;
  __savedAt?: number;
}

function loadDraft(): Draft | null {
  try {
    return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(DRAFT_KEY) ?? "null");
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}
function saveDraft(d: Draft) {
  localStorage.setItem(DRAFT_KEY, JSON.stringify(d));
}
function clearDraft() {
  localStorage.removeItem(DRAFT_KEY);
}

export default function ProjectNewPage() {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const createMutation = useCreateProject();

  const initialDraft = useRef<Draft>(loadDraft());
  const [step, setStep] = useState(initialDraft.current?.__step ?? 0);
  const [maxVisited, setMaxVisited] = useState(step);
  const [data, setData] = useState<
    CreateProjectInput | Partial<CreateProjectInput>
  >(initialDraft.current ?? {});
  const [savedAt, setSavedAt] = useState<number | null>(
    initialDraft.current?.__savedAt ?? null,
  );
  const [acknowledged, setAcknowledged] = useState(false);
  const [discardOpen, setDiscardOpen] = useState(false);

  /* Autosave every 20 s */
  useEffect(() => {
    const id = window.setInterval(() => {
      saveDraft({ ...data, __step: step, __savedAt: Date.now() });
      setSavedAt(Date.now());
    }, 20_000);
    return () => window.clearInterval(id);
  }, [data, step]);

  const persistNow = () => {
    saveDraft({ ...data, __step: step, __savedAt: Date.now() });
    setSavedAt(Date.now());
  };

  const onStepSubmit = (values: any) => {
    const merged = { ...data, ...values };
    setData(merged);
    persistNow();
    const next = Math.min(step + 1, WIZARD_STEPS.length - 1);
    setStep(next);
    setMaxVisited((m) => Math.max(m, next));
  };

  const onFinalSubmit = async () => {
    const parsed = createProjectSchema.safeParse(data);
    if (!parsed.success) {
      // Land on first invalid step
      const firstBadPath = parsed.error.issues[0]?.path[0];
      const stepMap: Record<string, number> = {
        name: 0,
        nameAm: 0,
        description: 0,
        subsector: 0,
        sector: 1,
        ownerOrgId: 1,
        implementationArrangement: 1,
        wbCreditNo: 1,
        region: 2,
        zone: 2,
        woreda: 2,
        kebele: 2,
        latitude: 2,
        longitude: 2,
        totalBudget: 3,
        financingSource: 3,
        startDate: 3,
        endDate: 3,
      };
      setStep(stepMap[String(firstBadPath)] ?? 0);
      return;
    }
    await createMutation.mutateAsync(parsed.data);
    clearDraft();
    navigate("/projects", { replace: true });
  };

  const stepProps = {
    identification: {
      defaultValues: data as any,
      onSubmit: onStepSubmit,
      formId: "wizard-form",
    },
    classification: {
      defaultValues: data as any,
      onSubmit: onStepSubmit,
      formId: "wizard-form",
    },
    location: {
      defaultValues: data as any,
      onSubmit: onStepSubmit,
      formId: "wizard-form",
    },
    budget: {
      defaultValues: data as any,
      onSubmit: onStepSubmit,
      formId: "wizard-form",
    },
    review: {
      data,
      onAcknowledgeChange: setAcknowledged,
      formId: "wizard-form",
      onAcknowledgeSubmit: onFinalSubmit,
    },
  } as const;

  const body = (() => {
    switch (WIZARD_STEPS[step].id) {
      case "identification":
        return <StepIdentification {...stepProps.identification} />;
      case "classification":
        return <StepClassification {...stepProps.classification} />;
      case "location":
        return <StepLocation {...stepProps.location} />;
      case "budget":
        return <StepBudget {...stepProps.budget} />;
      case "review":
        return <StepReview {...stepProps.review} />;
    }
  })();

  const footer = (
    <>
      <Button
        variant="ghost"
        onClick={() =>
          step === 0 ? setDiscardOpen(true) : setStep((s) => Math.max(0, s - 1))
        }
      >
        {step === 0
          ? t("projects.wizard.buttons.discard")
          : t("projects.wizard.buttons.back")}
      </Button>

      <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
        <Button variant="secondary" onClick={persistNow}>
          {t("projects.wizard.buttons.saveDraft")}
        </Button>
        {step < WIZARD_STEPS.length - 1 ? (
          <Button type="submit" form="wizard-form">
            {t("projects.wizard.buttons.next")}
          </Button>
        ) : (
          <Button
            type="button"
            form="wizard-form"
            disabled={!acknowledged || createMutation.isPending}
            loading={createMutation.isPending}
            onClick={onFinalSubmit}
          >
            {t("projects.wizard.buttons.submit")}
          </Button>
        )}
      </div>
    </>
  );

  return (
    <>
      <WizardShell
        current={step}
        maxVisited={maxVisited}
        onStepClick={setStep}
        draftSavedAt={savedAt}
        footer={footer}
      >
        {body}
      </WizardShell>

      <ConfirmDialog
        open={discardOpen}
        danger
        title={t("projects.wizard.buttons.discard")}
        message="All unsaved changes will be lost. This cannot be undone."
        confirmLabel={t("projects.wizard.buttons.discard")}
        onClose={() => setDiscardOpen(false)}
        onConfirm={() => {
          clearDraft();
          navigate("/projects", { replace: true });
        }}
      />
    </>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import { useParams } from "react-router-dom";
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";
import { useProject } from "./project.queries";
import { Tabs } from "@/components/ui/Tabs";
import { LoadingState } from "@/components/ui/LoadingState";
import { ErrorState } from "@/components/ui/ErrorState";
import { EmptyState } from "@/components/ui/EmptyState";
import { ProjectDetailHeader } from "./ProjectDetailHeader";
import { TabOverview } from "./tabs/TabOverview";
import { TabComponents } from "./tabs/TabComponents";
import { TabFinancial } from "./tabs/TabFinancial";
import { TabProcurement } from "./tabs/TabProcurement";
import { TabBeneficiaries } from "./tabs/TabBeneficiaries";
import { TabDocuments } from "./tabs/TabDocuments";
import { TabHistory } from "./tabs/TabHistory";

export default function ProjectDetailPage() {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const { projectId } = useParams<{ projectId: string }>();
  const { data, isLoading, isError, refetch } = useProject(projectId);

  if (isLoading) return <LoadingState message="Loading project…" />;

  if (isError || !data) {
    return (
      <EmptyState
        title={t("projects.detail.notFound")}
        description={t("projects.detail.notFoundDescription")}
        action={<ErrorState onRetry={() => refetch()} message="" />}
      />
    );
  }

  return (
    <main id="main" tabIndex={-1} className="space-y-5">
      <ProjectDetailHeader project={data} />

      <Tabs
        tabs={[
          {
            id: "overview",
            label: t("projects.detail.tabs.overview"),
            content: <TabOverview project={data} />,
          },
          {
            id: "components",
            label: t("projects.detail.tabs.components"),
            content: <TabComponents projectId={data.projectId} />,
          },
          {
            id: "financial",
            label: t("projects.detail.tabs.financial"),
            content: <TabFinancial projectId={data.projectId} />,
          },
          {
            id: "procurement",
            label: t("projects.detail.tabs.procurement"),
```

## 5.14 `src/features/projects/ProjectDetailHeader.tsx`

```tsx
import { useState } from "react";
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";
import { ChevronRight, Pencil, MoreVertical } from "lucide-react";
import { Chip } from "@/components/ui/Chip";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/Button";
import { IconButton } from "@/components/ui/IconButton";
import { TrafficLight } from "@/components/ui/TrafficLight";
import { statusTone, statusLabelKey, sectorLabelKey } from "./project.utils";
import { formatMoney } from "@/lib/utils/currency";
import { usePermissions } from "@/features/auth/usePermissions";
import { PERMISSIONS } from "@/features/auth/auth.types";
import { useAdvanceStage } from "./project.mutations";
import { Modal } from "@/components/ui/Modal";
import { Checkbox } from "@/components/ui/Checkbox";
import { Textarea } from "@/components/ui/Textarea";
import { Select } from "@/components/ui/Select";
import { PROJECT_STATUSES, STAGE_ORDER, type Project } from "./project.types";

export function ProjectDetailHeader({ project }: { project: Project }) {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const { can } = usePermissions();
  const advance = useAdvanceStage(project.projectId);
  const [advanceOpen, setAdvanceOpen] = useState(false);
  const [checklist, setChecklist] = useState<Record<string, boolean>>({});
  const [notes, setNotes] = useState("");
  const currentIdx = STAGE_ORDER.indexOf(project.status);
  const nextStage =
    STAGE_ORDER[Math.min(currentIdx + 1, STAGE_ORDER.length - 1)];

  return (
    <header className="space-y-3">
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-start justify-between gap-3">
        <div className="min-w-0">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-caption text-neutral-600">
            <code className="font-bold text-primary-700">
              {project.projectCode}
            </code>
            <ChevronRight className="h-3 w-3" aria-hidden />
            <span>{project.ownerOrgName ?? project.ownerOrgId}</span>
          </div>
          <h1 className="text-h1 text-primary-900 mt-1">{project.name}</h1>
          {project.nameAm && (
            <p lang="am" className="text-body-sm text-neutral-600 mt-0.5">
              {project.nameAm}
            </p>
          )}
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 mt-3">
            <Chip tone={statusTone(project.status)}>
              {t(statusLabelKey(project.status))}
            </Chip>
            <Chip tone="blue">{t(sectorLabelKey(project.sector))}</Chip>
            {project.location?.region && (
              <Chip tone="grey">{project.location.region}</Chip>
            )}
            <span className="text-caption text-neutral-600 font-semibold ml-2">
              {formatMoney(
                project.totalBudget.amount,
                project.totalBudget.currency,
              )}
            </span>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          {can(PERMISSIONS.projectWrite) && (
            <Button
              variant="secondary"
              size="sm"
              leftIcon={<Pencil className="h-4 w-4" />}
            >
              {t("projects.actions.edit")}
            </Button>
          )}
          {can(PERMISSIONS.projectApprove) &&
            project.status !== "CLOSED" &&
            project.status !== "CANCELLED" && (
              <Button
                variant="primary"
                size="sm"
                onClick={() => setAdvanceOpen(true)}
              >
                {t("projects.actions.advance")}
              </Button>
            )}
          <IconButton
            label="More actions"
            icon={<MoreVertical className="h-4 w-4" />}
          />
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="grid grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-4 gap-3 bg-white border border-neutral-300 rounded-md p-3">
        <Stat
          label={t("projects.detail.fields.start")}
          value={project.startDate ?? "—"}
        />
        <Stat
          label={t("projects.detail.fields.end")}
          value={project.endDate ?? "—"}
        />
        <Stat
          label={t("projects.detail.fields.wbCredit")}
          value={project.wbCreditNo ?? "—"}
        />
        <div>
          <div className="text-caption text-neutral-600">
            {t("projects.columns.progress")}
          </div>
          <div className="mt-1">
            <TrafficLight status="ON_TRACK" percent={72} />
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <Modal
        open={advanceOpen}
        onClose={() => setAdvanceOpen(false)}
        title={t("projects.detail.advance.title")}
        footer={
          <>
            <Button variant="ghost" onClick={() => setAdvanceOpen(false)}>
              Cancel
            </Button>
            <Button
              variant="primary"
              loading={advance.isPending}
              onClick={async () => {
                await advance.mutateAsync({
                  targetStage: nextStage,
                  checklist,
                  notes,
                });
                setAdvanceOpen(false);
              }}
            >
              {t("projects.detail.advance.confirm")}
            </Button>
          </>
        }
      >
        <div className="space-y-4">
          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3 text-body-sm">
            <div>
              <div className="text-caption text-neutral-600">
                {t("projects.detail.advance.currentStage")}
              </div>
              <Chip tone={statusTone(project.status)} className="mt-1">
                {t(statusLabelKey(project.status))}
              </Chip>
            </div>
            <div>
              <div className="text-caption text-neutral-600">
                {t("projects.detail.advance.targetStage")}
              </div>
              <Chip tone={statusTone(nextStage)} className="mt-1">
                {t(statusLabelKey(nextStage))}
              </Chip>
            </div>
          </div>

          <fieldset>
            <legend className="text-caption font-semibold text-neutral-600 mb-2">
              {t("projects.detail.advance.checklist")}
            </legend>
            <div className="space-y-2">
              {[
                "Profile complete",
                "Feasibility study uploaded",
                "Budget confirmed",
                "Owner approval received",
              ].map((c) => (
                <Checkbox
                  key={c}
                  label={c}
                  checked={!!checklist[c]}
                  onChange={(e) =>
                    setChecklist((s) => ({ ...s, [c]: e.target.checked }))
                  }
                />
              ))}
            </div>
          </fieldset>

          <Textarea
            label={t("projects.detail.advance.notes")}
            value={notes}
            onChange={(e) => setNotes(e.target.value)}
            rows={3}
          />
        </div>
      </Modal>
    </header>
  );
}

function Stat({ label, value }: { label: string; value: string }) {
  return (
    <div>
      <div className="text-caption text-neutral-600">{label}</div>
      <div className="font-semibold text-neutral-900 text-body-sm mt-0.5">
        {value}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

### `src/features/projects/tabs/TabHistory.tsx`

Real — uses `useProjectHistory`:

```tsx
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";
import { Card, CardHeader } from "@/components/ui/Card";
import { useProjectHistory } from "../project.queries";
import { LoadingState } from "@/components/ui/LoadingState";
import { EmptyState } from "@/components/ui/EmptyState";
import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/Badge";

export function TabHistory({ projectId }: { projectId: string }) {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const { data, isLoading } = useProjectHistory(projectId);

  if (isLoading) return <LoadingState message="Loading history…" />;
  if (!data?.length) {
    return (
      <Card>
        <CardHeader title="Change history" />
        <EmptyState title="No changes recorded yet" />
      </Card>
    );
  }

  const tone = (a: string) =>
    a === "CREATE"
      ? "pu"
      : a === "UPDATE"
        ? "in"
        : a === "APPROVE"
          ? "rd"
          : a === "DELETE"
            ? "rs"
            : "cf";

  return (
    <Card>
      <CardHeader title="Change history" />
      <ol className="relative border-l-2 border-neutral-300 ml-2 space-y-5">
        {data.map((h) => (
          <li key={h.logId} className="ml-4">
            <span
              aria-hidden
              className="absolute -left-[7px] mt-1 h-3 w-3 rounded-full bg-primary-700"
            />
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-caption text-neutral-600">
              <Badge tone={tone(h.action) as any}>{h.action}</Badge>
              <span className="font-semibold">{h.userName}</span>
              <span>· {new Date(h.at).toLocaleString()}</span>
            </div>
            <div className="mt-1 text-body-sm">
              {h.changes.map((c, i) => (
                <div key={i}>
                  <span className="font-semibold">{c.field}</span>
                  {c.before !== undefined && (
                    <>
                      {" "}
                      — from <code>{String(c.before)}</code>
                    </>
                  )}
                  {c.after !== undefined && (
                    <>
                      {" "}
                      to <code>{String(c.after)}</code>
                    </>
                  )}
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
            {h.notes && (
              <p className="text-caption text-neutral-600 mt-1">{h.notes}</p>
            )}
          </li>
        ))}
      </ol>
    </Card>
  );
}
```
