## 5.16 `src/features/projects/PipelinePage.tsx`

```tsx
import { useNavigate } from "react-router-dom";
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";
import { useProjects } from "./project.queries";
import { usePipeline } from "./project.queries";
import { LoadingState } from "@/components/ui/LoadingState";
import { Chip } from "@/components/ui/Chip";
import { statusTone, statusLabelKey } from "./project.utils";
import { STAGE_ORDER } from "./project.types";
import { formatMoney } from "@/lib/utils/currency";

export default function PipelinePage() {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const { data, isLoading } = useProjects({ limit: 200 });
  const { data: counts } = usePipeline();

  if (isLoading) return <LoadingState message="Loading pipeline…" />;

  const byStatus = STAGE_ORDER.reduce<
    Record<string, typeof data extends undefined ? never[] : any[]>
  >((acc, s) => {
    acc[s] = [];
    return acc;
  }, {});
  (data?.data ?? []).forEach((p) => {
    if (byStatus[p.status]) byStatus[p.status]!.push(p);
  });

  return (
    <main id="main" tabIndex={-1} className="space-y-5">
      <header>
        <h1 className="text-h1 text-primary-900">
          {t("projects.pipeline.title")}
        </h1>
        <p className="text-body-sm text-neutral-600 mt-1">
          {t("projects.pipeline.subtitle")}
        </p>
      </header>

      <div className="overflow-x-auto pb-4">
        <div className="flex gap-3 min-w-max">
          {STAGE_ORDER.filter((s) => s !== "CLOSED").map((stage) => (
            <section
              key={stage}
              aria-label={t(statusLabelKey(stage))}
              className="w-[280px] shrink-0 bg-neutral-100 rounded-md border border-neutral-300"
            >
              <header className="flex items-center justify-between px-3 py-2 border-b border-neutral-300">
                <Chip tone={statusTone(stage)}>{t(statusLabelKey(stage))}</Chip>
                <span className="text-caption font-bold text-neutral-600">
                  {counts?.[stage] ?? byStatus[stage]?.length ?? 0}
                </span>
              </header>
              <ul className="p-2 space-y-2 min-h-[200px]">
                {(byStatus[stage] ?? []).map((p) => (
                  <li key={p.projectId}>
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() => navigate(`/projects/${p.projectCode}`)}
                      className="w-full text-left bg-white border border-neutral-300 rounded-md p-3 hover:border-primary-300 hover:shadow-sm transition"
                    >
                      <div className="text-caption text-primary-700 font-bold">
                        {p.projectCode}
                      </div>
                      <div className="text-body-sm font-semibold text-neutral-900 mt-1 line-clamp-2">
                        {p.name}
                      </div>
                      <div className="text-caption text-neutral-600 mt-1.5">
                        {formatMoney(
                          p.totalBudget.amount,
                          p.totalBudget.currency,
                        )}
                      </div>
                    </button>
                  </li>
                ))}
                {(byStatus[stage] ?? []).length === 0 && (
                  <li className="text-center text-caption text-neutral-500 py-6">
                    {t("projects.pipeline.emptyColumn")}
                  </li>
                )}
              </ul>
            </section>
          ))}
        </div>
      </div>
    </main>
  );
}
```

## 5.17 Tests

### `src/features/projects/__tests__/project.schema.test.ts`

```ts
import { describe, it, expect } from "vitest";
import { createProjectSchema, stepBudgetSchema } from "../project.schema";

describe("createProjectSchema", () => {
  const valid = {
    name: "Solar Mini-Grid Oromia Phase 1",
    nameAm: "",
    description: "",
    subsector: "",
    sector: "ENERGY" as const,
    ownerOrgId: "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001",
    implementationArrangement: "PIU" as const,
    wbCreditNo: "",
    region: "Oromia",
    zone: "East Shewa",
    woreda: "Bora",
    kebele: "K1",
    totalBudget: { amount: "15000000.00", currency: "ETB" as const },
    startDate: "2026-10-01",
    endDate: "2029-09-30",
    financingSource: [
      {
        source: "WORLD_BANK" as const,
        amount: "12000000.00",
        currency: "ETB" as const,
        referenceNo: "IDA-X",
      },
      {
        source: "GOVERNMENT" as const,
        amount: "3000000.00",
        currency: "ETB" as const,
        referenceNo: "",
      },
    ],
  };

  it("accepts a valid project", () => {
    expect(createProjectSchema.safeParse(valid).success).toBe(true);
  });

  it("rejects financing sum mismatch", () => {
    const bad = {
      ...valid,
      totalBudget: { amount: "99999999.00", currency: "ETB" as const },
    };
    const r = createProjectSchema.safeParse(bad);
    expect(r.success).toBe(false);
    if (!r.success) {
      expect(
        r.error.issues.some((i) => i.path.includes("financingSource")),
      ).toBe(true);
    }
  });

  it("rejects name shorter than 3 chars", () => {
    expect(
      createProjectSchema.safeParse({ ...valid, name: "AB" }).success,
    ).toBe(false);
  });

  it("rejects end date before start date", () => {
    const r = stepBudgetSchema.safeParse({
      totalBudget: { amount: "100.00", currency: "ETB" },
      startDate: "2026-10-01",
      endDate: "2026-09-01",
      financingSource: [
        {
          source: "WORLD_BANK",
          amount: "100.00",
          currency: "ETB",
          referenceNo: "",
        },
      ],
    });
    expect(r.success).toBe(false);
  });
});
```

```tsx
import { describe, it, expect, vi } from "vitest";

import { ProjectListFilters } from "../ProjectListFilters";

describe("ProjectListFilters", () => {

    render(

        q=""
        status={[]}

        region=""
        onChange={onChange}
      />,

    const input = screen.getByLabelText(/Search by code or name/i);
    await userEvent.setup({ delay: null }).type(input, "solar");

    vi.useRealTimers();
  });

  it("toggles status chip", async () => {
    const onChange = vi.fn();
    render(
      <ProjectListFilters
        q=""
        status={[]}
        sector={[]}
        region=""
        onChange={onChange}
      />,
```

```tsx
import { describe, it, expect, vi, beforeEach } from "vitest";
import { render, screen } from "@testing-library/react";
import userEvent from "@testing-library/user-event";
import { MemoryRouter } from "react-router-dom";
import { QueryClient, QueryClientProvider } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { I18nextProvider } from "react-i18next";
import { ToastProvider } from "@/components/ui/Toast";
import ProjectNewPage from "../ProjectNewPage";
import { i18n } from "@/lib/i18n";

vi.mock("../project.api", () => ({
  projectApi: {
    create: vi.fn().mockResolvedValue({
      projectId: "p1",
      projectCode: "PIIMS-2026-0001",
      name: "x",
      status: "IDEA",
    }),
  },
}));

function Wrap({ children }: { children: React.ReactNode }) {
  const qc = new QueryClient({
    defaultOptions: { queries: { retry: false }, mutations: { retry: false } },
  });
  return (
    <I18nextProvider i18n={i18n}>
      <QueryClientProvider client={qc}>
        <ToastProvider>
          <MemoryRouter>{children}</MemoryRouter>
        </ToastProvider>
      </QueryClientProvider>
    </I18nextProvider>
  );
}

describe("ProjectNewPage", () => {
  beforeEach(() => {
    localStorage.clear();
  });

  it("renders wizard with step 1", () => {
    render(
      <Wrap>
        <ProjectNewPage />
      </Wrap>,
    );
    expect(screen.getByRole("heading", { level: 1 })).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(screen.getByText(/Identification/i)).toBeInTheDocument();
  });

  it("shows validation error for short name", async () => {
    render(
      <Wrap>
        <ProjectNewPage />
      </Wrap>,
    );
    const nameInput = screen.getByLabelText(/Project name/i);
    await userEvent.type(nameInput, "AB");
    await userEvent.click(screen.getByRole("button", { name: /Continue/i }));
    expect(
      await screen.findByText(/at least 3 characters/i),
    ).toBeInTheDocument();
  });

  it("autosaves draft to localStorage", async () => {
    vi.useFakeTimers();
    render(
      <Wrap>
        <ProjectNewPage />
      </Wrap>,
    );
    const nameInput = screen.getByLabelText(/Project name/i);
    await userEvent.setup({ delay: null }).type(nameInput, "Solar Mini-Grid");
    vi.advanceTimersByTime(20_000);
    const draft = JSON.parse(
      localStorage.getItem("piims.project.draft") ?? "{}",
    );
    expect(draft.name).toBe("Solar Mini-Grid");
    vi.useRealTimers();
  });
});
```

```ts
export const REPORT_STATUSES = [
  "DRAFT",
  "SUBMITTED",
  "UNDER_REVIEW",
  "REVISION_REQUIRED",
  "APPROVED",
  "REJECTED",
] as const;
export type ReportStatus = (typeof REPORT_STATUSES)[number];

export interface InceptionReportTemplate {
  templateId: string;
  code: string;
  name: string;
  sections: { id: string; title: string; required: boolean }[];
  active: boolean;
}

export interface ReviewComment {
  commentId: string;
  reportId: string;
  sectionId?: string;
  authorId: string;
  authorName: string;
  authorRole: string;
  text: string;
  createdAt: string;
  resolved: boolean;
  resolvedBy?: string;
  resolvedAt?: string;
  parentId?: string;
}

export interface InceptionReport {
  reportId: string;
  projectId: string;
  projectCode: string;
  projectName: string;
  version: number;
  templateId: string;
  templateName: string;
  submissionDate?: string;
  dueDate: string;
  status: ReportStatus;
  submittedBy?: string;
  submittedByName?: string;
  reviewedBy?: string;
  reviewedByName?: string;
  reviewedAt?: string;
  noObjection: boolean;
  noObjectionDate?: string;
  documentId?: string;
  documentPath?: string;
  summary?: string;
}

export interface InceptionReportListFilters {
  projectId?: string;
  status?: ReportStatus[];
  from?: string;
  to?: string;
  overdue?: boolean;
  q?: string;
  limit?: number;
  cursor?: string;
}

export interface SubmitInceptionInput {
  projectId: string;
  templateId: string;
  version: number;
  summary: string;
  file: File;
}

export interface ReviewDecisionInput {
  decision: "APPROVE" | "REQUEST_REVISION" | "REJECT";
  comments?: string;
  sectionComments?: Record<string, string>;
}

export interface NoObjectionInput {
  noObjection: boolean;
  effectiveDate: string;
  comments?: string;
}

export interface ReportVersionSummary {
  reportId: string;
  version: number;
  status: ReportStatus;
  submittedAt?: string;
  reviewedAt?: string;
  filePath?: string;
}
```

```ts
import { z } from "zod";
import { REPORT_STATUSES } from "./inception.types";

export const MAX_REPORT_SIZE_MB = 20;

export const submitInceptionSchema = z.object({
  projectId: z.string().uuid("Select a project"),
  templateId: z.string().uuid("Select a template"),
  summary: z
    .string()
    .trim()
    .min(20, "Summary must be at least 20 characters")
    .max(2000),
  version: z.number().int().min(1),
});
export type SubmitInceptionFormData = z.infer<typeof submitInceptionSchema>;

export const reviewDecisionSchema = z
  .object({
    decision: z.enum(["APPROVE", "REQUEST_REVISION", "REJECT"]),
    comments: z.string().max(2000).optional(),
    sectionComments: z.record(z.string().max(1000)).optional(),
  })
  .refine(
    (d) =>
      d.decision === "APPROVE" ||
      (d.comments && d.comments.trim().length >= 10),
    {
      path: ["comments"],
      message: "Comments (min 10 chars) required for revision or rejection",
    },
  );
export type ReviewDecisionFormData = z.infer<typeof reviewDecisionSchema>;

export const noObjectionSchema = z.object({
  noObjection: z.literal(true, {
    errorMap: () => ({ message: "You must confirm no-objection" }),
  }),
  effectiveDate: z.string().min(1, "Effective date is required"),
  comments: z.string().max(1000).optional(),
});
export type NoObjectionFormData = z.infer<typeof noObjectionSchema>;

export const inceptionFiltersSchema = z.object({
  projectId: z.string().optional(),
  status: z.array(z.enum(REPORT_STATUSES)).optional(),
  from: z.string().optional(),
  to: z.string().optional(),
  overdue: z.boolean().optional(),
  q: z.string().optional(),
  limit: z.number().int().min(1).max(200).optional(),
  cursor: z.string().optional(),
});
```

## 6.3 `src/features/inception/inception.api.ts`

```ts
import { api } from "@/lib/api/client";
import type {
  InceptionReport,
  InceptionReportListFilters,
  ReviewComment,
  InceptionReportTemplate,
  SubmitInceptionInput,
  ReviewDecisionInput,
  NoObjectionInput,
  ReportVersionSummary,
  ReportStatus,
} from "./inception.types";

interface Envelope<T> {
  data: T;
}

function filtersToParams(f: InceptionReportListFilters): string {
  const p = new URLSearchParams();
  if (f.projectId) p.set("project_id", f.projectId);
  if (f.status?.length) p.set("status", f.status.join(","));
  if (f.from) p.set("from", f.from);
  if (f.to) p.set("to", f.to);
  if (f.overdue) p.set("overdue", "true");
  if (f.q) p.set("q", f.q);
  if (f.limit) p.set("limit", String(f.limit));
  if (f.cursor) p.set("cursor", f.cursor);
  return p.toString();
}

export const inceptionApi = {
  async list(f: InceptionReportListFilters) {
    const { data } = await api.get<
      Envelope<InceptionReport[]> & { pagination: any }
    >(`/inception-reports?${filtersToParams(f)}`);
    return { data: data.data, pagination: (data as any).pagination };
  },

  async get(reportId: string): Promise<InceptionReport> {
    const { data } = await api.get<Envelope<InceptionReport>>(
      `/inception-reports/${reportId}`,
    );
    return data.data;
  },

  async templates(): Promise<InceptionReportTemplate[]> {
    const { data } = await api.get<Envelope<InceptionReportTemplate[]>>(
      "/inception/templates",
    );
    return data.data;
  },

  async submit(input: SubmitInceptionInput): Promise<InceptionReport> {
    const fd = new FormData();
    fd.append("project_id", input.projectId);
    fd.append("template_id", input.templateId);
    fd.append("version", String(input.version));
    fd.append("summary", input.summary);
    fd.append("file", input.file);
    const { data } = await api.post<Envelope<InceptionReport>>(
      "/inception-reports",
      fd,
      { headers: { "Content-Type": "multipart/form-data" }, timeout: 120_000 },
    );
    return data.data;
  },

  async review(
    reportId: string,
    input: ReviewDecisionInput,
  ): Promise<InceptionReport> {
    const { data } = await api.post<Envelope<InceptionReport>>(
      `/inception-reports/${reportId}/review`,
      input,
    );
    return data.data;
  },

  async noObjection(
    reportId: string,
    input: NoObjectionInput,
  ): Promise<InceptionReport> {
    const { data } = await api.post<Envelope<InceptionReport>>(
      `/inception-reports/${reportId}/no-objection`,
      input,
    );
    return data.data;
  },

  async comments(reportId: string): Promise<ReviewComment[]> {
    const { data } = await api.get<Envelope<ReviewComment[]>>(
      `/inception-reports/${reportId}/comments`,
    );
    return data.data;
  },

  async addComment(
    reportId: string,
    text: string,
    sectionId?: string,
    parentId?: string,
  ): Promise<ReviewComment> {
    const { data } = await api.post<Envelope<ReviewComment>>(
      `/inception-reports/${reportId}/comments`,
      {
        text,
        section_id: sectionId,
        parent_id: parentId,
      },
    );
    return data.data;
  },

  async resolveComment(
    reportId: string,
    commentId: string,
  ): Promise<ReviewComment> {
    const { data } = await api.post<Envelope<ReviewComment>>(
      `/inception-reports/${reportId}/comments/${commentId}/resolve`,
    );
    return data.data;
  },

  async versions(projectId: string): Promise<ReportVersionSummary[]> {
    const { data } = await api.get<Envelope<ReportVersionSummary[]>>(
      `/projects/${projectId}/inception/versions`,
    );
    return data.data;
  },

  async signedUrl(
    reportId: string,
  ): Promise<{ url: string; expiresAt: string }> {
    const { data } = await api.get<
      Envelope<{ url: string; expiresAt: string }>
    >(`/inception-reports/${reportId}/download`);
    return data.data;
  },
};
```

```ts
import { useQuery, keepPreviousData } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { inceptionApi } from "./inception.api";
import type { InceptionReportListFilters } from "./inception.types";

export const inceptionKeys = {
  all: ["inception"] as const,
  list: (f: InceptionReportListFilters) =>
    [...inceptionKeys.all, "list", f] as const,
  detail: (id: string) => [...inceptionKeys.all, "detail", id] as const,
  comments: (id: string) => [...inceptionKeys.all, "comments", id] as const,
  templates: () => [...inceptionKeys.all, "templates"] as const,
  versions: (projectId: string) =>
    [...inceptionKeys.all, "versions", projectId] as const,
};

export function useInceptionReports(filters: InceptionReportListFilters) {
  return useQuery({
    queryKey: inceptionKeys.list(filters),
    queryFn: () => inceptionApi.list(filters),
    placeholderData: keepPreviousData,
    staleTime: 30_000,
  });
}

export function useInceptionReport(reportId: string | undefined) {
  return useQuery({
    queryKey: inceptionKeys.detail(reportId ?? ""),
    queryFn: () => inceptionApi.get(reportId!),
    enabled: !!reportId,
  });
}

export function useInceptionTemplates() {
  return useQuery({
    queryKey: inceptionKeys.templates(),
    queryFn: () => inceptionApi.templates(),
    staleTime: 5 * 60_000,
  });
}

export function useReportComments(reportId: string | undefined) {
  return useQuery({
    queryKey: inceptionKeys.comments(reportId ?? ""),
    queryFn: () => inceptionApi.comments(reportId!),
    enabled: !!reportId,
    refetchInterval: 30_000,
  });
}

export function useReportVersions(projectId: string | undefined) {
  return useQuery({
    queryKey: inceptionKeys.versions(projectId ?? ""),
    queryFn: () => inceptionApi.versions(projectId!),
    enabled: !!projectId,
  });
}
```

## 6.5 `src/features/inception/inception.mutations.ts`

```ts
import { useMutation, useQueryClient } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { inceptionApi } from "./inception.api";
import { inceptionKeys } from "./inception.queries";
import { projectKeys } from "@/features/projects/project.queries";
import { useToast } from "@/components/ui/Toast";
import { normalizeApiError } from "@/lib/api/errors";
import type {
  SubmitInceptionInput,
  ReviewDecisionInput,
  NoObjectionInput,
} from "./inception.types";

export function useSubmitInception() {
  const qc = useQueryClient();
  const { push } = useToast();
  return useMutation({
    mutationFn: (input: SubmitInceptionInput) => inceptionApi.submit(input),
    onSuccess: (r) => {
      qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: inceptionKeys.all });
      qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: projectKeys.detail(r.projectId) });
      push("success", `Inception report v${r.version} submitted`);
    },
    onError: (err) => {
      const p = normalizeApiError(err);
      push("error", p.detail ?? "Failed to submit report");
    },
  });
}

export function useReviewInception(reportId: string) {
  const qc = useQueryClient();
  const { push } = useToast();
  return useMutation({
    mutationFn: (input: ReviewDecisionInput) =>
      inceptionApi.review(reportId, input),
    onSuccess: (r) => {
      qc.setQueryData(inceptionKeys.detail(reportId), r);
      qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: inceptionKeys.all });
      push(
        "success",
        r.status === "APPROVED" ? "Report approved" : "Review recorded",
      );
    },
    onError: (err) => {
      const p = normalizeApiError(err);
      push("error", p.detail ?? "Failed to record review");
    },
  });
}

export function useNoObjection(reportId: string) {
  const qc = useQueryClient();
  const { push } = useToast();
  return useMutation({
    mutationFn: (input: NoObjectionInput) =>
      inceptionApi.noObjection(reportId, input),
    onSuccess: (r) => {
      qc.setQueryData(inceptionKeys.detail(reportId), r);
      qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: inceptionKeys.all });
      qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: projectKeys.all });
      push("success", "No-objection recorded");
    },
    onError: (err) => {
      const p = normalizeApiError(err);
      push("error", p.detail ?? "Failed to record no-objection");
    },
  });
}

export function useAddComment(reportId: string) {
  const qc = useQueryClient();
  return useMutation({
    mutationFn: ({
      text,
      sectionId,
      parentId,
    }: {
      text: string;
      sectionId?: string;
      parentId?: string;
    }) => inceptionApi.addComment(reportId, text, sectionId, parentId),
    onSuccess: () =>
      qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: inceptionKeys.comments(reportId) }),
  });
}

export function useResolveComment(reportId: string) {
  const qc = useQueryClient();
  return useMutation({
    mutationFn: (commentId: string) =>
      inceptionApi.resolveComment(reportId, commentId),
    onSuccess: () =>
      qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: inceptionKeys.comments(reportId) }),
  });
}
```

## 6.6 `src/features/inception/inception.utils.ts`

```ts
import type { ChipTone } from "@/components/ui/Chip";
import type { ReportStatus } from "./inception.types";

export function reportStatusTone(s: ReportStatus): ChipTone {
  switch (s) {
    case "DRAFT":
      return "grey";
    case "SUBMITTED":
      return "blue";
    case "UNDER_REVIEW":
      return "amber";
    case "REVISION_REQUIRED":
      return "amber";
    case "APPROVED":
      return "green";
    case "REJECTED":
      return "red";
  }
}

export function reportStatusKey(s: ReportStatus): string {
  return `inception.status.${s.toLowerCase()}`;
}

export function daysUntil(dateStr: string): number {
  const d = new Date(dateStr);
  const now = new Date();
  return Math.ceil((d.getTime() - now.getTime()) / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24));
}

export function deadlineTone(days: number): ChipTone {
  if (days < 0) return "red";
  if (days <= 7) return "red";
  if (days <= 30) return "amber";
  return "green";
}
```

## 6.7 `src/features/inception/DeadlineTracker.tsx`

```tsx
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";
import { Clock, AlertTriangle } from "lucide-react";
import { Chip } from "@/components/ui/Chip";
import { Card, CardHeader } from "@/components/ui/Card";
import { useInceptionReports } from "./inception.queries";
import {
  daysUntil,
  deadlineTone,
  reportStatusKey,
  reportStatusTone,
} from "./inception.utils";
import { formatDate } from "@/lib/utils/date";
import { LoadingState } from "@/components/ui/LoadingState";
import { EmptyState } from "@/components/ui/EmptyState";

export function DeadlineTracker() {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const { data, isLoading } = useInceptionReports({ limit: 50 });

  if (isLoading) return <LoadingState message="Loading deadlines…" />;

  const upcoming = (data?.data ?? [])
    .filter((r) =>
      ["DRAFT", "SUBMITTED", "UNDER_REVIEW", "REVISION_REQUIRED"].includes(
        r.status,
      ),
    )
    .map((r) => ({ ...r, days: daysUntil(r.dueDate) }))
    .sort((a, b) => a.days - b.days)
    .slice(0, 10);

  const overdue = upcoming.filter((r) => r.days < 0);
  const dueSoon = upcoming.filter((r) => r.days >= 0 && r.days <= 7);

  return (
    <Card>
      <CardHeader
        title="Deadline tracker"
        subtitle={`${overdue.length} overdue · ${dueSoon.length} due within 7 days`}
      />

      {upcoming.length === 0 ? (
        <EmptyState
          title="No upcoming deadlines"
          icon={<Clock className="h-12 w-12" />}
        />
      ) : (
        <ul className="divide-y divide-neutral-200">
          {upcoming.map((r) => (
            <li key={r.reportId} className="py-2.5 flex items-center gap-3">
              {r.days < 0 && (
                <AlertTriangle
                  className="h-4 w-4 text-danger shrink-0"
                  aria-hidden
                />
              )}
              <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
                <div className="text-body-sm font-semibold truncate">
                  {r.projectName}
                </div>
                <div className="text-caption text-neutral-600">
                  <code>{r.projectCode}</code> · v{r.version}
                </div>
              </div>
              <Chip tone={reportStatusTone(r.status)}>
                {t(reportStatusKey(r.status))}
              </Chip>
              <div className="text-right shrink-0">
                <Chip tone={deadlineTone(r.days)}>
                  {r.days < 0
                    ? `${Math.abs(r.days)}d overdue`
                    : r.days === 0
                      ? "Due today"
                      : `${r.days}d left`}
                </Chip>
                <div className="text-caption text-neutral-600 mt-0.5">
                  {formatDate(r.dueDate)}
                </div>
              </div>
            </li>
          ))}
        </ul>
      )}
    </Card>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import { useState } from "react";
import { useForm } from "react-hook-form";
import { zodResolver } from "@hookform/resolvers/zod";
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";
import { Modal } from "@/components/ui/Modal";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/Button";
import { Select } from "@/components/ui/Select";
import { Textarea } from "@/components/ui/Textarea";
import { FileUpload } from "@/components/ui/FileUpload";
import { Banner } from "@/components/ui/Banner";
import {
  submitInceptionSchema,
  type SubmitInceptionFormData,
  MAX_REPORT_SIZE_MB,
} from "./inception.schema";
import { useSubmitInception } from "./inception.mutations";
import { useInceptionTemplates } from "./inception.queries";
import { useProjects } from "@/features/projects/project.queries";

export interface InceptionSubmitModalProps {
  open: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  defaultProjectId?: string;
}

export function InceptionSubmitModal({
  open,
  onClose,
  defaultProjectId,
}: InceptionSubmitModalProps) {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const submitMutation = useSubmitInception();
  const { data: templates } = useInceptionTemplates();
  const { data: projects } = useProjects({
    limit: 200,
    status: ["APPROVED", "ACTIVE"] as any,
  });

  const [file, setFile] = useState<File | null>(null);
  const [fileError, setFileError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const {
    register,
    handleSubmit,
    formState: { errors },
    reset,
  } = useForm<SubmitInceptionFormData>({
    resolver: zodResolver(submitInceptionSchema),
    defaultValues: {
      projectId: defaultProjectId ?? "",
      templateId: "",
      version: 1,
      summary: "",
    },
  });

  const onSubmit = async (values: SubmitInceptionFormData) => {
    if (!file) {
      setFileError("Please attach the report document.");
      return;
    }
    setFileError(null);
    await submitMutation.mutateAsync({ ...values, file });
    reset();
    setFile(null);
    onClose();
  };

  return (
    <Modal
      open={open}
      onClose={onClose}
      title="Submit inception report"
      size="lg"
      footer={
        <>
          <Button variant="ghost" onClick={onClose}>
            {t("actions.cancel")}
          </Button>
          <Button
            variant="primary"
            loading={submitMutation.isPending}
            onClick={handleSubmit(onSubmit)}
          >
            {t("actions.submit")}
          </Button>
        </>
      }
    >
      <form onSubmit={handleSubmit(onSubmit)} className="space-y-4" noValidate>
        <Banner tone="info">
          The inception report is due within 2–4 weeks of contract signing.
          Ensure all required sections are complete.
        </Banner>

        <Select
          {...register("projectId")}
          label="Project"
          required
          placeholder="—"
          error={errors.projectId?.message}
          options={(projects?.data ?? []).map((p) => ({
            value: p.projectId,
            label: `${p.projectCode} · ${p.name}`,
          }))}
        />

        <Select
          {...register("templateId")}
          label="Template"
          required
          placeholder="—"
          error={errors.templateId?.message}
          options={(templates ?? []).map((tpl) => ({
            value: tpl.templateId,
            label: tpl.name,
          }))}
        />

        <Textarea
          {...register("summary")}
          label="Summary"
          required
          rows={4}
          hint="Brief description of the report (min 20 characters)"
          error={errors.summary?.message}
        />

        <div>
          <FileUpload
            label="Report document"
            accept=".pdf,.docx"
            maxSizeMB={MAX_REPORT_SIZE_MB}
            required
            files={file ? [file] : []}
            onFiles={(fs) => {
              setFile(fs[0] ?? null);
              setFileError(null);
            }}
            error={fileError ?? undefined}
            hint={`PDF or DOCX · max ${MAX_REPORT_SIZE_MB} MB`}
          />
        </div>

        <input
          type="hidden"
          {...register("version", { valueAsNumber: true })}
        />
      </form>
    </Modal>
  );
}
```

```tsx
        header: "Version",
        align: "center",
        render: (r) => (
          <code className="text-caption font-bold">v{r.version}</code>
        ),
      },
      {
        id: "submissionDate",
        header: "Submitted",
        render: (r) => (
          <span className="text-caption">
            {r.submissionDate ? formatDate(r.submissionDate) : "—"}
          </span>
        ),
      },
      {
        id: "dueDate",
        header: "Due",
        render: (r) => {
          const d = daysUntil(r.dueDate);
          return (
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <span className="text-caption">{formatDate(r.dueDate)}</span>
              {[
                "DRAFT",
                "SUBMITTED",
                "UNDER_REVIEW",
                "REVISION_REQUIRED",
              ].includes(r.status) && (
                <Chip tone={deadlineTone(d)}>
                  {d < 0
                    ? `${Math.abs(d)}d overdue`
                    : d === 0
                      ? "Today"
                      : `${d}d`}
                </Chip>
              )}
            </div>
          );
        },
      },
      {
        id: "status",
        header: "Status",
        render: (r) => (
          <Chip tone={reportStatusTone(r.status)}>
            {t(reportStatusKey(r.status))}
          </Chip>
        ),
      },
      {
        id: "reviewedByName",
        header: "Reviewer",
        render: (r) => (
          <span className="text-caption">{r.reviewedByName ?? "—"}</span>
        ),
      },
      {
        id: "noObjection",
        header: "No-objection",
        render: (r) =>
          r.noObjection ? (
            <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-green-700 text-caption font-bold">
              <CheckCircle2 className="h-3.5 w-3.5" aria-hidden /> Yes
            </span>
          ) : (
            <span className="text-caption text-neutral-600">—</span>
          ),
      },
    ],
    [t],
  );

  const updateParams = (patch: Record<string, string | undefined>) => {
    const next = new URLSearchParams(params);
    Object.entries(patch).forEach(([k, v]) => {
      if (v == null || v === "") next.delete(k);
      else next.set(k, v);
    });
    if (!("page" in patch)) next.set("page", "1");
    setParams(next, { replace: true });
  };

  const toggleStatus = (s: ReportStatus) => {
    const next = status.includes(s)
      ? status.filter((x) => x !== s)
      : [...status, s];
    updateParams({ status: next.length ? next.join(",") : undefined });
  };

  return (
    <main id="main" tabIndex={-1} className="space-y-5">
      <header className="flex flex-wrap items-start justify-between gap-3">
        <div>
          <h1 className="text-h1 text-primary-900">{t("inception.title")}</h1>
          <p className="text-body-sm text-neutral-600 mt-1">
            {data?.pagination?.totalCount ?? 0} reports
          </p>
        </div>
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
          {can(PERMISSIONS.inceptionSubmit) && (
            <Button
              variant="primary"
              size="sm"
              leftIcon={<Plus className="h-4 w-4" />}
              onClick={() => setSubmitOpen(true)}
            >
              Submit report
            </Button>
          )}
        </div>
      </header>

      <DeadlineTracker />

      <section className="bg-white border border-neutral-300 rounded-md p-3">
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
          <Filter className="h-4 w-4 text-neutral-600" aria-hidden />
          {ALL_STATUSES.map((s) => {
            const active = status.includes(s);
            return (
              <button
                key={s}
                type="button"
                aria-pressed={active}
                onClick={() => toggleStatus(s)}
                className="focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-info focus-visible:ring-offset-2 rounded-full"
              >
                <Chip
                  tone={active ? reportStatusTone(s) : "grey"}
                  className={active ? "" : "opacity-70 hover:opacity-100"}
                >
                  {t(reportStatusKey(s))}
                </Chip>
              </button>
            );
          })}
          {status.length > 0 && (
            <Button
              variant="ghost"
              size="sm"
              onClick={() => updateParams({ status: undefined })}
            >
              Clear
            </Button>
          )}
        </div>
      </section>

      {isLoading && <SkeletonTable rows={6} cols={columns.length} />}
      {isError && !isLoading && (
        <ErrorState
          onRetry={() => refetch()}
          message="Failed to load reports."
        />
      )}

      {!isLoading && !isError && (data?.data.length ?? 0) === 0 && (
        <EmptyState
          title="No inception reports yet"
          description="Submit the first report to get started."
        />
      )}

      {!isLoading && !isError && (data?.data.length ?? 0) > 0 && (
        <>
          <DataGrid
            columns={columns}
            rows={data!.data.map((r) => ({ ...r, id: r.reportId }))}
            onRowClick={(r) => navigate(`/inception/${r.reportId}/review`)}
            ariaLabel={t("inception.title")}
          />
          <Pagination
            page={page}
            pageSize={pageSize}
            total={data!.pagination?.totalCount ?? 0}
            onPageChange={(p) => updateParams({ page: String(p) })}
            onPageSizeChange={(s) =>
              updateParams({ size: String(s), page: "1" })
            }
          />
        </>
      )}

      <InceptionSubmitModal
        open={submitOpen}
        onClose={() => setSubmitOpen(false)}
      />
    </main>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import { useParams, useNavigate } from "react-router-dom";
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";
import { ArrowLeft } from "lucide-react";
import { useInceptionReport } from "./inception.queries";
import { usePermissions } from "@/features/auth/usePermissions";
import { PERMISSIONS } from "@/features/auth/auth.types";
import { LoadingState } from "@/components/ui/LoadingState";
import { EmptyState } from "@/components/ui/EmptyState";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/Button";
import { Chip } from "@/components/ui/Chip";
import { ReviewWorkspace } from "./ReviewWorkspace";
import { reportStatusTone, reportStatusKey } from "./inception.utils";
import { formatDate } from "@/lib/utils/date";

export default function InceptionReviewPage() {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const { reportId } = useParams<{ reportId: string }>();
  const { data: report, isLoading, isError } = useInceptionReport(reportId);
  const { canAny } = usePermissions();

  if (isLoading) return <LoadingState message="Loading report…" />;
  if (isError || !report) {
    return (
      <EmptyState
        title="Report not found"
        description="The report may have been removed."
      />
    );
  }

  const canReview = canAny(
    PERMISSIONS.inceptionReview,
    PERMISSIONS.inceptionApprove,
  );

  return (
    <main id="main" tabIndex={-1} className="space-y-4">
      <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
        <Button
          variant="ghost"
          size="sm"
          leftIcon={<ArrowLeft className="h-4 w-4" />}
          onClick={() => navigate("/inception")}
        >
          Back
        </Button>
      </div>

      <header className="flex flex-wrap items-start justify-between gap-3">
        <div>
          <div className="text-caption text-neutral-600">
            <code className="font-bold text-primary-700">
              {report.projectCode}
            </code>{" "}
            · Inception report v{report.version}
          </div>
          <h1 className="text-h1 text-primary-900 mt-1">
            {report.projectName}
          </h1>
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 mt-2">
            <Chip tone={reportStatusTone(report.status)}>
              {t(reportStatusKey(report.status))}
            </Chip>
            {report.submissionDate && (
              <span className="text-caption text-neutral-600">
                Submitted {formatDate(report.submissionDate)}
              </span>
            )}
            {report.noObjection && (
              <Chip tone="green">No-objection granted</Chip>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
      </header>

      <ReviewWorkspace report={report} canReview={canReview} />
    </main>
  );
}
```

## 6.11 `src/features/inception/ReviewWorkspace.tsx`

```tsx
import { useState } from "react";
import { FileText, MessageSquare, CheckCircle2, XCircle } from "lucide-react";
import { Card, CardHeader } from "@/components/ui/Card";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/Button";
import { Tabs } from "@/components/ui/Tabs";
import { CommentThread } from "./CommentThread";
import { NoObjectionModal } from "./NoObjectionModal";
import { VersionCompare } from "./VersionCompare";
import { useReportVersions } from "./inception.queries";
import { useReviewInception } from "./inception.mutations";
import { usePermissions } from "@/features/auth/usePermissions";
import { PERMISSIONS } from "@/features/auth/auth.types";
import type { InceptionReport } from "./inception.types";
import { Modal } from "@/components/ui/Modal";
import { Textarea } from "@/components/ui/Textarea";
import { cn } from "@/components/ui/utils/cn";

export function ReviewWorkspace({
  report,
  canReview,
}: {
  report: InceptionReport;
  canReview: boolean;
}) {
  const { can } = usePermissions();
  const { data: versions } = useReportVersions(report.projectId);
  const [decisionOpen, setDecisionOpen] = useState<
    null | "APPROVE" | "REQUEST_REVISION" | "REJECT"
  >(null);
  const [noObjOpen, setNoObjOpen] = useState(false);
  const [comments, setComments] = useState("");
  const reviewMutation = useReviewInception(report.reportId);

  const onConfirmDecision = async () => {
    if (!decisionOpen) return;
    await reviewMutation.mutateAsync({ decision: decisionOpen, comments });
    setDecisionOpen(null);
    setComments("");
  };

  return (
    <div className="grid lg:grid-cols-[1fr_380px] gap-4">
      {/* Left — document + comments */}
      <div className="space-y-4 min-w-0">
        <Card padding="none">
          <Tabs
            tabs={[
              {
                id: "doc",
                label: "Document",
                content: (
                  <div className="p-4">
                    <div className="aspect-[8.5/11] bg-neutral-100 border border-neutral-300 rounded-md flex flex-col items-center justify-center text-neutral-600">
                      <FileText className="h-16 w-16 opacity-40" aria-hidden />
                      <p className="mt-3 text-body-sm">PDF preview</p>
                      <p className="text-caption">
                        In browsers where PDF.js is configured, the document
                        renders here.
                      </p>
                      <a
                        href={report.documentPath ?? "#"}
                        target="_blank"
                        rel="noreferrer"
                        className="mt-3 text-primary-700 text-caption font-semibold hover:underline"
                      >
                        Open in new tab
                      </a>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                ),
              },
              {
                id: "compare",
                label: "Compare versions",
                content: <VersionCompare versions={versions ?? []} />,
              },
            ]}
          />
        </Card>

        <Card>
          <CardHeader
            title={
              <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-2">
                <MessageSquare className="h-4 w-4" aria-hidden /> Review
                comments
              </span>
            }
          />
          <CommentThread reportId={report.reportId} />
        </Card>
      </div>

      {/* Right — actions */}
      <aside className="space-y-4 lg:sticky lg:top-4 self-start">
        <Card>
          <CardHeader title="Decision" />
          {!canReview ? (
            <p className="text-body-sm text-neutral-600">
              You do not have permission to record a review decision.
            </p>
          ) : (
            <div className="space-y-2">
              {can(PERMISSIONS.inceptionApprove) && (
                <Button
                  variant="primary"
                  fullWidth
                  leftIcon={<CheckCircle2 className="h-4 w-4" />}
                  onClick={() => setDecisionOpen("APPROVE")}
                  disabled={report.status === "APPROVED"}
                >
                  Approve report
                </Button>
              )}
              <Button
                variant="secondary"
                fullWidth
                onClick={() => setDecisionOpen("REQUEST_REVISION")}
                disabled={!can(PERMISSIONS.inceptionReview)}
              >
                Request revision
              </Button>
              <Button
                variant="danger"
                fullWidth
                leftIcon={<XCircle className="h-4 w-4" />}
                onClick={() => setDecisionOpen("REJECT")}
                disabled={!can(PERMISSIONS.inceptionReview)}
              >
                Reject
              </Button>
              {can(PERMISSIONS.inceptionApprove) &&
                !report.noObjection &&
                report.status === "APPROVED" && (
                  <Button
                    variant="primary"
                    fullWidth
                    onClick={() => setNoObjOpen(true)}
                  >
                    Record no-objection
                  </Button>
                )}
            </div>
          )}
        </Card>

        <Card>
          <CardHeader title="Metadata" />
          <dl className="text-caption space-y-2">
            <Row label="Template" value={report.templateName} />
            <Row label="Version" value={`v${report.version}`} />
            <Row label="Submitted" value={report.submissionDate ?? "—"} />
            <Row label="Submitted by" value={report.submittedByName ?? "—"} />
            <Row label="Reviewed" value={report.reviewedAt ?? "—"} />
            <Row label="Reviewed by" value={report.reviewedByName ?? "—"} />
          </dl>
        </Card>
      </aside>

      {/* Decision confirmation */}
      <Modal
        open={!!decisionOpen}
        onClose={() => setDecisionOpen(null)}
        title={
          decisionOpen === "APPROVE"
            ? "Approve inception report"
            : decisionOpen === "REQUEST_REVISION"
              ? "Request revision"
              : "Reject report"
        }
        size="sm"
        footer={
          <>
            <Button variant="ghost" onClick={() => setDecisionOpen(null)}>
              Cancel
            </Button>
            <Button
              variant={decisionOpen === "REJECT" ? "danger" : "primary"}
              loading={reviewMutation.isPending}
              onClick={onConfirmDecision}
            >
              Confirm
            </Button>
          </>
        }
      >
        <Textarea
          label={
            decisionOpen === "APPROVE"
              ? "Comments (optional)"
              : "Comments (required)"
          }
          rows={4}
          value={comments}
          onChange={(e) => setComments(e.target.value)}
          required={decisionOpen !== "APPROVE"}
          className={cn(
            decisionOpen !== "APPROVE" &&
              comments.trim().length < 10 &&
              "border-danger",
          )}
        />
      </Modal>

      <NoObjectionModal
        open={noObjOpen}
        onClose={() => setNoObjOpen(false)}
        reportId={report.reportId}
      />
    </div>
  );
}

function Row({ label, value }: { label: string; value?: string }) {
  return (
    <div className="flex justify-between gap-3">
      <dt className="text-neutral-600">{label}</dt>
      <dd className="font-semibold text-neutral-900 truncate text-right">
        {value ?? "—"}
      </dd>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import { useState } from "react";
import { Check, MessageSquare } from "lucide-react";
import { useReportComments } from "./inception.queries";
import { useAddComment, useResolveComment } from "./inception.mutations";
import { usePermissions } from "@/features/auth/usePermissions";
import { PERMISSIONS } from "@/features/auth/auth.types";
import { LoadingState } from "@/components/ui/LoadingState";
import { EmptyState } from "@/components/ui/EmptyState";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/Button";
import { Textarea } from "@/components/ui/Textarea";
import { useAuthStore } from "@/stores/auth.store";
import { formatDate } from "@/lib/utils/date";

export function CommentThread({
  reportId,
  sectionId,
}: {
  reportId: string;
  sectionId?: string;
}) {
  const { data, isLoading } = useReportComments(reportId);
  const addComment = useAddComment(reportId);
  const resolveComment = useResolveComment(reportId);
  const user = useAuthStore((s) => s.user);
  const { canAny } = usePermissions();
  const [text, setText] = useState("");

  const canComment = canAny(
    PERMISSIONS.inceptionReview,
    PERMISSIONS.inceptionApprove,
    PERMISSIONS.inceptionSubmit,
  );

  if (isLoading) return <LoadingState message="Loading comments…" />;

  const list = (data ?? []).filter(
    (c) => !sectionId || c.sectionId === sectionId,
  );

  const submit = async () => {
    const trimmed = text.trim();
    if (!trimmed) return;
    await addComment.mutateAsync({ text: trimmed, sectionId });
    setText("");
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-3">
      {list.length === 0 ? (
        <EmptyState
          title="No comments yet"
          icon={<MessageSquare className="h-10 w-10" />}
        />
      ) : (
        <ul className="space-y-3">
          {list.map((c) => (
            <li
              key={c.commentId}
              className={`rounded-md border p-3 ${c.resolved ? "bg-green-50 border-green-200" : "bg-neutral-50 border-neutral-300"}`}
            >
              <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-3">
                <div className="min-w-0">
                  <div className="text-body-sm font-bold text-primary-900">
                    {c.authorName}
                  </div>
                  <div className="text-caption text-neutral-600">
                    {c.authorRole} · {formatDate(c.createdAt)}
                  </div>
                </div>
                {c.resolved ? (
                  <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-caption font-bold text-green-700">
                    <Check className="h-3.5 w-3.5" aria-hidden /> Resolved
                  </span>
                ) : (
                  canAny(
                    PERMISSIONS.inceptionReview,
                    PERMISSIONS.inceptionApprove,
                  ) && (
                    <Button
                      size="sm"
                      variant="ghost"
                      onClick={() => resolveComment.mutate(c.commentId)}
                    >
                      Resolve
                    </Button>
                  )
                )}
              </div>
              <p className="mt-2 text-body-sm text-neutral-900 whitespace-pre-wrap">
                {c.text}
              </p>
            </li>
          ))}
        </ul>
      )}

      {canComment && user && (
        <div className="pt-2 border-t border-neutral-200">
          <Textarea
            label="Add comment"
            rows={3}
            value={text}
            onChange={(e) => setText(e.target.value)}
          />
          <div className="flex justify-end mt-2">
            <Button
              variant="primary"
              size="sm"
              disabled={!text.trim()}
              loading={addComment.isPending}
              onClick={submit}
            >
              Post comment
            </Button>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
```

## 6.13 `src/features/inception/NoObjectionModal.tsx`

```tsx
import { useForm } from "react-hook-form";
import { zodResolver } from "@hookform/resolvers/zod";
import { Modal } from "@/components/ui/Modal";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/Button";
import { DateInput } from "@/components/ui/DateInput";
import { Textarea } from "@/components/ui/Textarea";
import { Checkbox } from "@/components/ui/Checkbox";
import {
  noObjectionSchema,
  type NoObjectionFormData,
} from "./inception.schema";
import { useNoObjection } from "./inception.mutations";

export function NoObjectionModal({
  open,
  onClose,
  reportId,
}: {
  open: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  reportId: string;
}) {
  const noObj = useNoObjection(reportId);
  const {
    register,
    handleSubmit,
    formState: { errors },
    reset,
  } = useForm<NoObjectionFormData>({
    resolver: zodResolver(noObjectionSchema),
    defaultValues: {
      noObjection: undefined,
      effectiveDate: new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10),
      comments: "",
    },
  });

  const onSubmit = async (v: NoObjectionFormData) => {
    await noObj.mutateAsync({
      noObjection: true,
      effectiveDate: v.effectiveDate,
      comments: v.comments,
    });
    reset();
    onClose();
  };

  return (
    <Modal
      open={open}
      onClose={onClose}
      title="Record no-objection"
      size="sm"
      footer={
        <>
          <Button variant="ghost" onClick={onClose}>
            Cancel
          </Button>
          <Button
            variant="primary"
            loading={noObj.isPending}
            onClick={handleSubmit(onSubmit)}
          >
            Record no-objection
          </Button>
        </>
      }
    >
      <form onSubmit={handleSubmit(onSubmit)} className="space-y-4" noValidate>
        <DateInput
          {...register("effectiveDate")}
          label="Effective date"
          required
          error={errors.effectiveDate?.message}
        />
        <Textarea
          {...register("comments")}
          label="Comments (optional)"
          rows={3}
        />
        <Checkbox
          {...register("noObjection")}
          label="I confirm the World Bank grants no-objection to this inception report."
          error={errors.noObjection?.message}
        />
      </form>
    </Modal>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import { Download } from "lucide-react";
import { Chip } from "@/components/ui/Chip";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/Button";
import { reportStatusTone, reportStatusKey } from "./inception.utils";
import { formatDate } from "@/lib/utils/date";
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";
import type { ReportVersionSummary } from "./inception.types";

export function VersionCompare({
  versions,
}: {
  versions: ReportVersionSummary[];
}) {
  const { t } = useTranslation();

  if (versions.length < 2) {
    return (
      <div className="p-6 text-center text-body-sm text-neutral-600">
        At least two versions are needed to compare.
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="p-4 space-y-3">
      <p className="text-caption text-neutral-600">
        Select two versions to compare (side-by-side view).
      </p>
      <ul className="divide-y divide-neutral-200">
        {versions.map((v) => (
          <li key={v.reportId} className="py-3 flex items-center gap-3">
            <input type="checkbox" aria-label={`Select version ${v.version}`} />
            <div className="flex-1">
              <div className="text-body-sm font-semibold">
                Version {v.version}
              </div>
              <div className="text-caption text-neutral-600">
                Submitted {v.submittedAt ? formatDate(v.submittedAt) : "—"}
                {v.reviewedAt && ` · Reviewed ${formatDate(v.reviewedAt)}`}
              </div>
            </div>
            <Chip tone={reportStatusTone(v.status)}>
              {t(reportStatusKey(v.status))}
            </Chip>
            {v.filePath && (
              <Button
                size="sm"
                variant="ghost"
                leftIcon={<Download className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />}
              >
                Download
              </Button>
            )}
          </li>
        ))}
      </ul>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```ts
export const INDICATOR_TYPES = ["OUTPUT", "OUTCOME", "IMPACT"] as const;
export type IndicatorType = (typeof INDICATOR_TYPES)[number];

export const INDICATOR_FREQUENCIES = [
  "MONTHLY",
  "QUARTERLY",
  "SEMI_ANNUAL",
  "ANNUAL",
] as const;
export type IndicatorFrequency = (typeof INDICATOR_FREQUENCIES)[number];

export const INDICATOR_DIRECTIONS = ["INCREASE", "DECREASE"] as const;
export type IndicatorDirection = (typeof INDICATOR_DIRECTIONS)[number];

export const TRAFFIC_LIGHT = [
  "ON_TRACK",
  "AT_RISK",
  "OFF_TRACK",
  "NOT_STARTED",
] as const;
export type TrafficLightStatus = (typeof TRAFFIC_LIGHT)[number];

export interface Component {
  componentId: string;
  projectId: string;
  code: string;
  name: string;
  nameAm?: string;
  description?: string;
  budget?: string;
  responsibleOrgId?: string;
  orderNo: number;
}

export interface SubComponent {
  subcomponentId: string;
  componentId: string;
  code: string;
  name: string;
  nameAm?: string;
  description?: string;
  budget?: string;
  orderNo: number;
}

export interface Indicator {
  indicatorId: string;
  subcomponentId: string;
  componentId: string;
  projectId: string;
  code: string;
  name: string;
  nameAm?: string;
  description?: string;
```

## 6.16 `src/features/results/results.schema.ts`

```ts
import { z } from "zod";
import {
  INDICATOR_TYPES,
  INDICATOR_FREQUENCIES,
  INDICATOR_DIRECTIONS,
} from "./results.types";

export const componentSchema = z.object({
  code: z.string().trim().min(1, "Code is required").max(20),
  name: z.string().trim().min(3, "Name is required").max(200),
  nameAm: z.string().trim().max(200).optional().or(z.literal("")),
  description: z.string().trim().max(1000).optional().or(z.literal("")),
  budget: z
    .string()
    .regex(/^\d+(\.\d{1,2})?$/)
    .optional()
    .or(z.literal("")),
  responsibleOrgId: z.string().optional().or(z.literal("")),
  orderNo: z.number().int().min(0),
});
export type ComponentInput = z.infer<typeof componentSchema>;

export const subcomponentSchema = componentSchema.extend({
  componentId: z.string().uuid(),
});
export type SubComponentInput = z.infer<typeof subcomponentSchema>;

export const indicatorSchema = z.object({
  subcomponentId: z.string().uuid("Select a subcomponent"),
  code: z.string().trim().min(1).max(30),
  name: z.string().trim().min(3).max(300),
  nameAm: z.string().trim().max(300).optional().or(z.literal("")),
  description: z.string().trim().max(1000).optional().or(z.literal("")),
  indicatorType: z.enum(INDICATOR_TYPES),
  unit: z.string().trim().min(1, "Unit is required").max(50),
  baseline: z.number().optional(),
  baselineDate: z.string().optional(),
  target: z.number().optional(),
  targetDate: z.string().optional(),
  frequency: z.enum(INDICATOR_FREQUENCIES),
  direction: z.enum(INDICATOR_DIRECTIONS),
  method: z.string().trim().max(500).optional().or(z.literal("")),
  disaggregation: z.array(z.string()).optional(),
});
export type IndicatorInput = z.infer<typeof indicatorSchema>;

export const indicatorValueSchema = z.object({
  period: z.string().min(1, "Period is required"),
  fiscalYear: z.number().int().min(2000).max(3000),
  value: z.number({ invalid_type_error: "Enter a numeric value" }),
  target: z.number().optional(),
  dataSource: z.string().trim().max(200).optional().or(z.literal("")),
  notes: z.string().trim().max(1000).optional().or(z.literal("")),
  disaggregation: z.record(z.record(z.number())).optional(),
});
export type IndicatorValueInput = z.infer<typeof indicatorValueSchema>;
```

## 6.17 `src/features/results/results.api.ts`

```ts
import { api } from "@/lib/api/client";
import type {
  Component,
  SubComponent,
  Indicator,
  IndicatorValue,
  ResultsFilters,
  AggregationRow,
} from "./results.types";
import type {
  ComponentInput,
  SubComponentInput,
  IndicatorInput,
  IndicatorValueInput,
} from "./results.schema";

interface Envelope<T> {
  data: T;
}

export const resultsApi = {
  async listComponents(projectId: string): Promise<Component[]> {
    const { data } = await api.get<Envelope<Component[]>>(
      `/projects/${projectId}/components`,
    );
    return data.data;
  },

  async createComponent(
    projectId: string,
    input: ComponentInput,
  ): Promise<Component> {
    const { data } = await api.post<Envelope<Component>>(
      `/projects/${projectId}/components`,
      input,
    );
    return data.data;
  },

  async updateComponent(
    componentId: string,
    input: Partial<ComponentInput>,
  ): Promise<Component> {
    const { data } = await api.patch<Envelope<Component>>(
      `/components/${componentId}`,
      input,
    );
    return data.data;
  },

  async listSubcomponents(componentId: string): Promise<SubComponent[]> {
    const { data } = await api.get<Envelope<SubComponent[]>>(
      `/components/${componentId}/subcomponents`,
    );
    return data.data;
  },

  async createSubcomponent(
    componentId: string,
    input: SubComponentInput,
  ): Promise<SubComponent> {
    const { data } = await api.post<Envelope<SubComponent>>(
      `/components/${componentId}/subcomponents`,
      input,
    );
    return data.data;
  },

  async listIndicators(f: ResultsFilters): Promise<Indicator[]> {
    const p = new URLSearchParams();
    if (f.projectId) p.set("project_id", f.projectId);
    if (f.componentId) p.set("component_id", f.componentId);
    if (f.status?.length) p.set("status", f.status.join(","));
    if (f.type?.length) p.set("type", f.type.join(","));
    if (f.q) p.set("q", f.q);
    const { data } = await api.get<Envelope<Indicator[]>>(
      `/indicators?${p.toString()}`,
    );
    return data.data;
  },

  async createIndicator(input: IndicatorInput): Promise<Indicator> {
    const { data } = await api.post<Envelope<Indicator>>("/indicators", input);
    return data.data;
  },

  async updateIndicator(
    indicatorId: string,
    input: Partial<IndicatorInput>,
  ): Promise<Indicator> {
    const { data } = await api.patch<Envelope<Indicator>>(
      `/indicators/${indicatorId}`,
      input,
    );
    return data.data;
  },

  async getIndicator(indicatorId: string): Promise<Indicator> {
    const { data } = await api.get<Envelope<Indicator>>(
      `/indicators/${indicatorId}`,
    );
    return data.data;
  },

  async listValues(indicatorId: string): Promise<IndicatorValue[]> {
    const { data } = await api.get<Envelope<IndicatorValue[]>>(
      `/indicators/${indicatorId}/values`,
    );
    return data.data;
  },

  async recordValue(
    indicatorId: string,
    input: IndicatorValueInput,
  ): Promise<IndicatorValue> {
    const { data } = await api.post<Envelope<IndicatorValue>>(
      `/indicators/${indicatorId}/values`,
      input,
    );
    return data.data;
  },

  async aggregation(
    projectId: string,
    groupBy: "component" | "region" | "gender",
  ): Promise<AggregationRow[]> {
    const { data } = await api.get<Envelope<AggregationRow[]>>(
      `/results/aggregate?project_id=${projectId}&group_by=${groupBy}`,
    );
    return data.data;
  },

  async exportLogframe(projectId: string): Promise<Blob> {
    const { data } = await api.get(`/projects/${projectId}/logframe/export`, {
      responseType: "blob",
    });
    return data as unknown as Blob;
  },
};
```

```ts
import { useQuery } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { resultsApi } from "./results.api";
import type { ResultsFilters } from "./results.types";

export const resultsKeys = {
  all: ["results"] as const,
  components: (projectId: string) =>
    [...resultsKeys.all, "components", projectId] as const,
  subcomponents: (componentId: string) =>
    [...resultsKeys.all, "subcomponents", componentId] as const,
  indicators: (f: ResultsFilters) =>
    [...resultsKeys.all, "indicators", f] as const,
  indicator: (id: string) => [...resultsKeys.all, "indicator", id] as const,
  values: (indicatorId: string) =>
    [...resultsKeys.all, "values", indicatorId] as const,
  aggregation: (projectId: string, groupBy: string) =>
    [...resultsKeys.all, "agg", projectId, groupBy] as const,
};

export function useComponents(projectId: string | undefined) {
  return useQuery({
    queryKey: resultsKeys.components(projectId ?? ""),
    queryFn: () => resultsApi.listComponents(projectId!),
    enabled: !!projectId,
  });
}

export function useSubcomponents(componentId: string | undefined) {
  return useQuery({
    queryKey: resultsKeys.subcomponents(componentId ?? ""),
    queryFn: () => resultsApi.listSubcomponents(componentId!),
    enabled: !!componentId,
  });
}

export function useIndicators(f: ResultsFilters) {
  return useQuery({
    queryKey: resultsKeys.indicators(f),
    queryFn: () => resultsApi.listIndicators(f),
    enabled: !!f.projectId,
  });
}

export function useIndicator(indicatorId: string | undefined) {
  return useQuery({
    queryKey: resultsKeys.indicator(indicatorId ?? ""),
    queryFn: () => resultsApi.getIndicator(indicatorId!),
    enabled: !!indicatorId,
  });
}

export function useIndicatorValues(indicatorId: string | undefined) {
  return useQuery({
    queryKey: resultsKeys.values(indicatorId ?? ""),
    queryFn: () => resultsApi.listValues(indicatorId!),
    enabled: !!indicatorId,
  });
}

export function useAggregation(
  projectId: string | undefined,
  groupBy: "component" | "region" | "gender",
) {
  return useQuery({
    queryKey: resultsKeys.aggregation(projectId ?? "", groupBy),
    queryFn: () => resultsApi.aggregation(projectId!, groupBy),
    enabled: !!projectId,
  });
}
```

```ts
import { useMutation, useQueryClient } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { resultsApi } from "./results.api";
import { resultsKeys } from "./results.queries";
import { useToast } from "@/components/ui/Toast";
import { normalizeApiError } from "@/lib/api/errors";
import type {
  ComponentInput,
  SubComponentInput,
  IndicatorInput,
  IndicatorValueInput,
} from "./results.schema";

export function useCreateComponent(projectId: string) {
  const qc = useQueryClient();
  const { push } = useToast();
  return useMutation({
    mutationFn: (input: ComponentInput) =>
      resultsApi.createComponent(projectId, input),
    onSuccess: () => {
      qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: resultsKeys.components(projectId) });
      push("success", "Component added");
    },
    onError: (err) =>
      push("error", normalizeApiError(err).detail ?? "Failed to add component"),
  });
}

export function useCreateSubcomponent(componentId: string) {
  const qc = useQueryClient();
  const { push } = useToast();
  return useMutation({
    mutationFn: (input: SubComponentInput) =>
      resultsApi.createSubcomponent(componentId, input),
    onSuccess: () => {
      qc.invalidateQueries({
        queryKey: resultsKeys.subcomponents(componentId),
      });
      push("success", "Subcomponent added");
    },
    onError: (err) =>
      push(
        "error",
        normalizeApiError(err).detail ?? "Failed to add subcomponent",
      ),
  });
}

export function useCreateIndicator(projectId: string) {
  const qc = useQueryClient();
  const { push } = useToast();
  return useMutation({
    mutationFn: (input: IndicatorInput) => resultsApi.createIndicator(input),
    onSuccess: () => {
      qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: resultsKeys.all });
      push("success", "Indicator added");
    },
    onError: (err) =>
      push("error", normalizeApiError(err).detail ?? "Failed to add indicator"),
  });
}

export function useRecordIndicatorValue(indicatorId: string) {
  const qc = useQueryClient();
  const { push } = useToast();
  return useMutation({
    mutationFn: (input: IndicatorValueInput) =>
      resultsApi.recordValue(indicatorId, input),
    onSuccess: () => {
      qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: resultsKeys.values(indicatorId) });
      qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: resultsKeys.indicator(indicatorId) });
      qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: resultsKeys.all });
      push("success", "Value recorded");
    },
    onError: (err) =>
      push("error", normalizeApiError(err).detail ?? "Failed to record value"),
  });
}
```

## 6.20 `src/features/results/results.utils.ts`

```ts
import type { ChipTone } from "@/components/ui/Chip";
import type { TrafficLightStatus, IndicatorDirection } from "./results.types";

export function trafficLightTone(s: TrafficLightStatus): ChipTone {
  switch (s) {
    case "ON_TRACK":
      return "green";
    case "AT_RISK":
      return "amber";
    case "OFF_TRACK":
      return "red";
    case "NOT_STARTED":
      return "grey";
  }
}

export function trafficLightLabelKey(s: TrafficLightStatus): string {
  return `results.traffic.${s.toLowerCase()}`;
}

/**
 * Computes achievement % respecting indicator direction.
 * For INCREASE direction: (actual - baseline) / (target - baseline)
 * For DECREASE direction: (baseline - actual) / (baseline - target)
 */
export function computeAchievement(
  baseline: number | undefined,
  target: number | undefined,
  actual: number | undefined,
  direction: IndicatorDirection,
): number | undefined {
  if (actual == null || target == null || baseline == null) return undefined;
  const span = direction === "INCREASE" ? target - baseline : baseline - target;
  if (span <= 0) return undefined;
  const progress =
    direction === "INCREASE" ? actual - baseline : baseline - actual;
  return Math.max(0, Math.min(200, (progress / span) * 100));
}

/**
 * Traffic-light rule from the SRD:
 *   ≥ 90% → ON_TRACK
 *   60–89% → AT_RISK
 *   < 60%  → OFF_TRACK
 */
export function computeTrafficLight(
  achievementPct: number | undefined,
): TrafficLightStatus {
  if (achievementPct == null) return "NOT_STARTED";
  if (achievementPct >= 90) return "ON_TRACK";
  if (achievementPct >= 60) return "AT_RISK";
  return "OFF_TRACK";
}
```

```tsx
import { useState } from "react";
import { useSearchParams, useNavigate } from "react-router-dom";
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";
import { Plus, Download, Filter } from "lucide-react";
import { useComponents, useIndicators } from "./results.queries";
import { usePermissions } from "@/features/auth/usePermissions";
import { PERMISSIONS } from "@/features/auth/auth.types";
import { Tabs } from "@/components/ui/Tabs";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/Button";
import { Card } from "@/components/ui/Card";
import { ComponentTree } from "./ComponentTree";
import { IndicatorRegister } from "./IndicatorRegister";
import { TrafficLightDashboard } from "./TrafficLightDashboard";
import { AggregationView } from "./AggregationView";
import { LogframeExport } from "./LogframeExport";
import { resultsApi } from "./results.api";
import { useToast } from "@/components/ui/Toast";

export default function ResultsPage() {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const { can } = usePermissions();
  const { push } = useToast();
  const [params] = useSearchParams();

  // In production, projectId comes from route or a project selector.
  const projectId = params.get("projectId") ?? "PIIMS-2026-0042";

  const { data: components, refetch } = useComponents(projectId);
  const { data: indicators, isLoading } = useIndicators({ projectId });

  const [selectedComponentId, setSelectedComponentId] = useState<
    string | undefined
  >();

  const exportLogframe = async () => {
    try {
      const blob = await resultsApi.exportLogframe(projectId);
      const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
      const a = document.createElement("a");
      a.href = url;
      a.download = `logframe-${projectId}.xlsx`;
      a.click();
      URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
      push("success", "Logframe exported");
    } catch {
      push("error", "Export failed");
    }
  };

  return (
    <main id="main" tabIndex={-1} className="space-y-5">
      <header className="flex flex-wrap items-start justify-between gap-3">
        <div>
          <h1 className="text-h1 text-primary-900">{t("results.title")}</h1>
          <p className="text-body-sm text-neutral-600 mt-1">
            {indicators?.length ?? 0} indicators · {components?.length ?? 0}{" "}
            components
          </p>
        </div>
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
          <Button
            variant="secondary"
            size="sm"
            leftIcon={<Download className="h-4 w-4" />}
            onClick={exportLogframe}
          >
            Export logframe
          </Button>
          {can(PERMISSIONS.resultWrite) && (
            <Button
              variant="primary"
              size="sm"
              leftIcon={<Plus className="h-4 w-4" />}
              onClick={() =>
                navigate(`/results/new-indicator?projectId=${projectId}`)
              }
            >
              Add indicator
            </Button>
          )}
        </div>
      </header>

      <Tabs
        tabs={[
          {
            id: "register",
            label: "Indicator register",
            content: (
              <IndicatorRegister
                indicators={indicators ?? []}
                loading={isLoading}
                selectedComponentId={selectedComponentId}
              />
            ),
          },
          {
            id: "components",
            label: "Components",
            content: (
              <div className="grid md:grid-cols-[320px_1fr] gap-4">
                <Card padding="none">
                  <ComponentTree
                    projectId={projectId}
                    components={components ?? []}
                    onSelect={(id) => setSelectedComponentId(id)}
                    selectedId={selectedComponentId}
                    onChanged={() => refetch()}
                  />
                </Card>
                <Card>
                  <p className="text-body-sm text-neutral-600">
                    Select a component to see subcomponents and indicators.
                  </p>
                </Card>
              </div>
            ),
          },
          {
            id: "dashboard",
            label: "Traffic-light dashboard",
            content: <TrafficLightDashboard indicators={indicators ?? []} />,
          },
          {
            id: "aggregation",
            label: "Aggregation",
            content: <AggregationView projectId={projectId} />,
          },
          {
            id: "logframe",
            label: "Logframe export",
            content: <LogframeExport projectId={projectId} />,
          },
        ]}
      />
    </main>
  );
}
```

## 6.22 `src/features/results/ComponentTree.tsx`

```tsx
import { useState } from "react";
import { ChevronDown, ChevronRight, Plus, Pencil } from "lucide-react";
import { IconButton } from "@/components/ui/IconButton";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/Button";
import { useSubcomponents } from "./results.queries";
import { usePermissions } from "@/features/auth/usePermissions";
import { PERMISSIONS } from "@/features/auth/auth.types";
import { ComponentFormModal } from "./ComponentFormModal";
import type { Component } from "./results.types";

export interface ComponentTreeProps {
  projectId: string;
  components: Component[];
  onSelect: (id: string) => void;
  selectedId?: string;
  onChanged: () => void;
}

export function ComponentTree({
  projectId,
  components,
  onSelect,
  selectedId,
  onChanged,
}: ComponentTreeProps) {
  const { can } = usePermissions();
  const [expanded, setExpanded] = useState<Record<string, boolean>>({});
  const [modal, setModal] = useState<
    { mode: "create" } | { mode: "edit"; component: Component } | null
  >(null);

  return (
    <div className="p-2">
      <header className="flex items-center justify-between px-2 py-2">
        <h3 className="text-h3 text-primary-900">Components</h3>
        {can(PERMISSIONS.resultWrite) && (
          <IconButton
            label="Add component"
            size="sm"
            icon={<Plus className="h-4 w-4" />}
            onClick={() => setModal({ mode: "create" })}
          />
        )}
      </header>

      {components.length === 0 ? (
        <p className="px-2 py-4 text-caption text-neutral-600">
          No components yet.
        </p>
      ) : (
        <ul className="space-y-0.5">
          {components.map((c) => (
            <ComponentNode
              key={c.componentId}
              component={c}
              expanded={!!expanded[c.componentId]}
              onToggle={() =>
                setExpanded((s) => ({
                  ...s,
                  [c.componentId]: !s[c.componentId],
                }))
              }
              selected={selectedId === c.componentId}
              onSelect={() => onSelect(c.componentId)}
              onEdit={() => setModal({ mode: "edit", component: c })}
              canEdit={can(PERMISSIONS.resultWrite)}
            />
          ))}
        </ul>
      )}

      {modal && (
        <ComponentFormModal
          open
          onClose={() => setModal(null)}
          projectId={projectId}
          initial={modal.mode === "edit" ? modal.component : undefined}
          onSuccess={() => {
            setModal(null);
            onChanged();
          }}
        />
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

function ComponentNode({
  component,
  expanded,
  onToggle,
  selected,
  onSelect,
  onEdit,
  canEdit,
}: {
  component: Component;
  expanded: boolean;
  onToggle: () => void;
  selected: boolean;
  onSelect: () => void;
  onEdit: () => void;
  canEdit: boolean;
}) {
  const { data: subs } = useSubcomponents(
    expanded ? component.componentId : undefined,
  );

  return (
    <li>
      <div
        className={`flex items-center gap-1 px-2 py-1.5 rounded-md ${selected ? "bg-primary-100" : "hover:bg-neutral-100"}`}
      >
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={onToggle}
          aria-expanded={expanded}
          className="p-0.5 rounded hover:bg-neutral-200"
          aria-label={expanded ? "Collapse" : "Expand"}
        >
          {expanded ? (
            <ChevronDown className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
          ) : (
            <ChevronRight className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
          )}
        </button>
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={onSelect}
          className="flex-1 text-left text-body-sm font-semibold truncate"
        >
          <code className="text-caption text-primary-700 mr-1">
            {component.code}
          </code>
          {component.name}
        </button>
        {canEdit && (
          <IconButton
            label="Edit component"
            size="sm"
            icon={<Pencil className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />}
            onClick={onEdit}
          />
        )}
      </div>

      {expanded && subs && (
        <ul className="ml-6 mt-0.5 space-y-0.5">
          {subs.map((s) => (
            <li
              key={s.subcomponentId}
              className="text-caption text-neutral-600 px-2 py-1"
            >
              <code className="text-primary-700 mr-1">{s.code}</code>
              {s.name}
            </li>
          ))}
          {subs.length === 0 && (
            <li className="text-caption text-neutral-500 px-2 py-1">
              No subcomponents
            </li>
          )}
        </ul>
      )}
    </li>
  );
}
```
