```tsx
import { useForm } from "react-hook-form";
import { zodResolver } from "@hookform/resolvers/zod";
import { Modal } from "@/components/ui/Modal";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/Button";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/Input";
import { Textarea } from "@/components/ui/Textarea";
import { componentSchema, type ComponentInput } from "./results.schema";
import { useCreateComponent } from "./results.mutations";
import type { Component } from "./results.types";

export interface ComponentFormModalProps {
  open: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  projectId: string;
  initial?: Component;
  onSuccess?: () => void;
}

export function ComponentFormModal({
  open,
  onClose,
  projectId,
  initial,
  onSuccess,
}: ComponentFormModalProps) {
  const create = useCreateComponent(projectId);

  const {
    register,
    handleSubmit,
    formState: { errors },
    reset,
  } = useForm<ComponentInput>({
    resolver: zodResolver(componentSchema),
    defaultValues: initial
      ? {
          code: initial.code,
          name: initial.name,
          nameAm: initial.nameAm ?? "",
          description: initial.description ?? "",
          budget: initial.budget ?? "",
          responsibleOrgId: initial.responsibleOrgId ?? "",
          orderNo: initial.orderNo,
        }
      : {
          code: "",
          name: "",
          nameAm: "",
          description: "",
          budget: "",
          responsibleOrgId: "",
          orderNo: 0,
        },
  });

  const onSubmit = async (v: ComponentInput) => {
    await create.mutateAsync(v);
    reset();
    onSuccess?.();
  };

  return (
    <Modal
      open={open}
      onClose={onClose}
      title={initial ? "Edit component" : "Add component"}
      size="md"
      footer={
        <>
          <Button variant="ghost" onClick={onClose}>
            Cancel
          </Button>
          <Button
            variant="primary"
            loading={create.isPending}
            onClick={handleSubmit(onSubmit)}
          >
            {initial ? "Save changes" : "Add component"}
          </Button>
        </>
      }
    >
      <form onSubmit={handleSubmit(onSubmit)} className="space-y-4" noValidate>
        <Input
          {...register("code")}
          label="Code"
          required
          error={errors.code?.message}
        />
        <Input
          {...register("name")}
          label="Name"
          required
          error={errors.name?.message}
        />
        <Input {...register("nameAm")} label="Name (Amharic)" />
        <Textarea {...register("description")} label="Description" rows={3} />
        <Input
          {...register("budget")}
          label="Budget"
          inputMode="decimal"
          error={errors.budget?.message}
        />
        <input
          type="hidden"
          {...register("orderNo", { valueAsNumber: true })}
        />
      </form>
    </Modal>
  );
}
```

## 6.24 `src/features/results/IndicatorRegister.tsx`

```tsx
import { useMemo, useState } from "react";
import { useNavigate } from "react-router-dom";
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";
import { DataGrid, type Column } from "@/components/ui/DataGrid";
import { Chip } from "@/components/ui/Chip";
import { TrafficLight } from "@/components/ui/TrafficLight";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/Button";
import { LoadingState } from "@/components/ui/LoadingState";
import { EmptyState } from "@/components/ui/EmptyState";
import { trafficLightLabelKey, trafficLightTone } from "./results.utils";
import type { Indicator, TrafficLightStatus } from "./results.types";

const ALL_STATUSES: TrafficLightStatus[] = [
  "ON_TRACK",
  "AT_RISK",
  "OFF_TRACK",
  "NOT_STARTED",
];

export function IndicatorRegister({
  indicators,
  loading,
  selectedComponentId,
}: {
  indicators: Indicator[];
  loading: boolean;
  selectedComponentId?: string;
}) {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const [statusFilter, setStatusFilter] = useState<TrafficLightStatus | "ALL">(
    "ALL",
  );

  const filtered = useMemo(() => {
    let arr = indicators;
    if (selectedComponentId)
      arr = arr.filter((i) => i.componentId === selectedComponentId);
    if (statusFilter !== "ALL")
      arr = arr.filter((i) => i.status === statusFilter);
    return arr;
  }, [indicators, selectedComponentId, statusFilter]);

  const columns: Column<Indicator & { id: string }>[] = [
    {
      id: "code",
      header: "Code",
      width: "120px",
      render: (r) => (
        <code className="text-caption font-bold text-primary-700">
          {r.code}
        </code>
      ),
    },
    {
      id: "name",
      header: "Indicator",
      render: (r) => (
        <div className="min-w-0">
          <div className="font-semibold truncate">{r.name}</div>
          <div className="text-caption text-neutral-600">
            {r.indicatorType} · {r.unit}
          </div>
        </div>
      ),
    },
    {
      id: "baseline",
      header: "Baseline",
      align: "right",
      render: (r) => <span className="text-caption">{r.baseline ?? "—"}</span>,
    },
    {
      id: "target",
      header: "Target",
      align: "right",
      render: (r) => <span className="text-caption">{r.target ?? "—"}</span>,
    },
    {
      id: "actual",
      header: "Actual",
      align: "right",
      render: (r) => <span className="font-semibold">{r.actual ?? "—"}</span>,
    },
    {
      id: "status",
      header: "Status",
      render: (r) => (
        <TrafficLight
          status={r.status}
          percent={r.achievementPct ? Math.round(r.achievementPct) : undefined}
        />
      ),
    },
  ];

  if (loading) return <LoadingState message="Loading indicators…" />;

  return (
    <div className="space-y-3">
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={() => setStatusFilter("ALL")}
          aria-pressed={statusFilter === "ALL"}
          className="focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-info focus-visible:ring-offset-2 rounded-full"
        >
          <Chip tone={statusFilter === "ALL" ? "blue" : "grey"}>
            All ({indicators.length})
          </Chip>
        </button>
        {ALL_STATUSES.map((s) => {
          const count = indicators.filter((i) => i.status === s).length;
          return (
            <button
              key={s}
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setStatusFilter(s)}
              aria-pressed={statusFilter === s}
              className="focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-info focus-visible:ring-offset-2 rounded-full"
            >
              <Chip tone={statusFilter === s ? trafficLightTone(s) : "grey"}>
                {t(trafficLightLabelKey(s))} ({count})
              </Chip>
            </button>
          );
        })}
      </div>

      {filtered.length === 0 ? (
        <EmptyState
          title="No indicators"
          description="Add indicators to this component to get started."
        />
      ) : (
        <DataGrid
          columns={columns}
          rows={filtered.map((i) => ({ ...i, id: i.indicatorId }))}
          onRowClick={(r) => navigate(`/results/${r.indicatorId}/entry`)}
          ariaLabel="Indicators"
        />
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import { useState } from "react";
import { useParams, useNavigate } from "react-router-dom";
import { useForm } from "react-hook-form";
import { zodResolver } from "@hookform/resolvers/zod";
import { ArrowLeft, Save } from "lucide-react";
import { useIndicator, useIndicatorValues } from "./results.queries";
import { useRecordIndicatorValue } from "./results.mutations";
import {
  indicatorValueSchema,
  type IndicatorValueInput,
} from "./results.schema";
import { LoadingState } from "@/components/ui/LoadingState";
import { EmptyState } from "@/components/ui/EmptyState";
import { Card, CardHeader } from "@/components/ui/Card";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/Button";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/Input";
import { Select } from "@/components/ui/Select";
import { Textarea } from "@/components/ui/Textarea";
import { TrafficLight } from "@/components/ui/TrafficLight";
import { Progress } from "@/components/ui/Progress";
import { formatDate } from "@/lib/utils/date";
import { computeAchievement, computeTrafficLight } from "./results.utils";

const DISAGG_OPTIONS = ["Male", "Female", "Urban", "Rural"];

export default function IndicatorEntryPage() {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const { indicatorId } = useParams<{ indicatorId: string }>();
  const { data: indicator, isLoading } = useIndicator(indicatorId);
  const { data: values } = useIndicatorValues(indicatorId);
  const recordMutation = useRecordIndicatorValue(indicatorId ?? "");

  const [disagg, setDisagg] = useState<Record<string, string>>({});

  const {
    register,
    handleSubmit,
    watch,
    formState: { errors },
  } = useForm<IndicatorValueInput>({
    resolver: zodResolver(indicatorValueSchema),
    defaultValues: {
      period: `Q${Math.ceil((new Date().getMonth() + 1) / 3)}-${new Date().getFullYear()}`,
      fiscalYear: new Date().getFullYear(),
      value: 0,
      target: indicator?.target ?? 0,
      dataSource: "",
      notes: "",
    },
  });

  const value = Number(watch("value") || 0);
  const target = Number(watch("target") || indicator?.target || 0);
  const achievement = computeAchievement(
    indicator?.baseline ?? 0,
    target,
    value,
    indicator?.direction ?? "INCREASE",
  );
  const status = computeTrafficLight(achievement);

  if (isLoading) return <LoadingState message="Loading indicator…" />;
  if (!indicator) return <EmptyState title="Indicator not found" />;

  const onSubmit = async (v: IndicatorValueInput) => {
    const disaggregation = Object.keys(disagg).length
      ? Object.fromEntries(
          Object.entries(disagg).map(([k, val]) => [k, { value: Number(val) }]),
        )
      : undefined;
    await recordMutation.mutateAsync({ ...v, disaggregation });
  };

  return (
    <main id="main" tabIndex={-1} className="space-y-5">
      <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
        <Button
          variant="ghost"
          size="sm"
          leftIcon={<ArrowLeft className="h-4 w-4" />}
          onClick={() => navigate("/results")}
        >
          Back
        </Button>
      </div>

      <header>
        <code className="text-caption font-bold text-primary-700">
          {indicator.code}
        </code>
        <h1 className="text-h1 text-primary-900 mt-1">{indicator.name}</h1>
        {indicator.nameAm && (
          <p lang="am" className="text-body-sm text-neutral-600 mt-0.5">
            {indicator.nameAm}
          </p>
        )}
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3 mt-3">
          <TrafficLight
            status={status}
            percent={achievement ? Math.round(achievement) : undefined}
          />
          <span className="text-caption text-neutral-600">
            Unit: <strong>{indicator.unit}</strong> · Frequency:{" "}
            {indicator.frequency}
          </span>
        </div>
      </header>

      <div className="grid md:grid-cols-3 gap-4">
        <Card className="md:col-span-2">
          <CardHeader title="Record value" />
          <form
            onSubmit={handleSubmit(onSubmit)}
            className="space-y-4"
            noValidate
          >
            <div className="grid sm:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
              <Input
                {...register("period")}
                label="Reporting period"
                required
                error={errors.period?.message}
                placeholder="e.g. Q3-2026"
              />
              <Input
                {...register("fiscalYear", { valueAsNumber: true })}
                type="number"
                label="Fiscal year (EFY)"
                required
                error={errors.fiscalYear?.message}
              />
            </div>

            <div className="grid sm:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
              <Input
                {...register("value", { valueAsNumber: true })}
                type="number"
                step="any"
                label="Actual value"
                required
                error={errors.value?.message}
              />
              <Input
                {...register("target", { valueAsNumber: true })}
                type="number"
                step="any"
                label="Target for period"
                error={errors.target?.message}
              />
            </div>

            <fieldset className="border border-neutral-300 rounded-md p-3">
              <legend className="text-caption font-semibold text-neutral-600 px-1">
                Disaggregation (optional)
              </legend>
              <div className="grid sm:grid-cols-2 gap-3">
                {DISAGG_OPTIONS.map((d) => (
                  <Input
                    key={d}
                    type="number"
                    label={d}
                    value={disagg[d] ?? ""}
                    onChange={(e) =>
                      setDisagg((s) => ({ ...s, [d]: e.target.value }))
                    }
                    inputMode="numeric"
                  />
                ))}
              </div>
            </fieldset>

            <Input
              {...register("dataSource")}
              label="Data source"
              placeholder="e.g. Field verification + supplier records"
            />

            <Textarea {...register("notes")} label="Notes" rows={2} />

            <div className="flex justify-end gap-2">
              <Button
                type="button"
                variant="ghost"
                onClick={() => navigate("/results")}
              >
                Cancel
              </Button>
              <Button
                type="submit"
                variant="primary"
                loading={recordMutation.isPending}
                leftIcon={<Save className="h-4 w-4" />}
              >
                Save value
              </Button>
            </div>
          </form>
        </Card>

        <div className="space-y-4">
          <Card>
            <CardHeader title="Achievement" />
            <div className="space-y-3">
              <Progress
                value={achievement ?? 0}
                tone={
                  status === "ON_TRACK"
                    ? "success"
                    : status === "AT_RISK"
                      ? "warning"
                      : "danger"
                }
              />
              <div className="text-body-sm">
                <div className="flex justify-between">
                  <span className="text-neutral-600">Baseline</span>
                  <span className="font-semibold">
                    {indicator.baseline ?? "—"}
                  </span>
                </div>
                <div className="flex justify-between">
                  <span className="text-neutral-600">Target</span>
                  <span className="font-semibold">{target}</span>
                </div>
                <div className="flex justify-between">
                  <span className="text-neutral-600">Actual</span>
                  <span className="font-semibold">{value}</span>
                </div>
                <div className="flex justify-between pt-2 border-t border-neutral-200 mt-2">
                  <span className="text-neutral-600">Achievement</span>
                  <span className="font-bold">
                    {achievement != null ? `${achievement.toFixed(1)}%` : "—"}
                  </span>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          </Card>

          <Card>
            <CardHeader title="History" />
            {!values || values.length === 0 ? (
              <p className="text-caption text-neutral-600">
                No values recorded yet.
              </p>
            ) : (
              <ul className="text-caption space-y-2 max-h-64 overflow-y-auto">
                {values.map((v) => (
                  <li
                    key={v.valueId}
                    className="flex justify-between border-b border-neutral-200 pb-1.5 last:border-0"
                  >
                    <span className="text-neutral-600">{v.period}</span>
                    <span className="font-semibold">
                      {v.value} {indicator.unit}
                    </span>
                  </li>
                ))}
              </ul>
            )}
          </Card>

          <Card>
            <CardHeader title="Definition" />
            <dl className="text-caption space-y-1.5">
              <Row label="Type" value={indicator.indicatorType} />
              <Row label="Direction" value={indicator.direction} />
              <Row
                label="Baseline date"
                value={indicator.baselineDate ?? "—"}
              />
              <Row label="Target date" value={indicator.targetDate ?? "—"} />
              {indicator.method && (
                <Row label="Method" value={indicator.method} />
              )}
            </dl>
          </Card>
        </div>
      </div>
    </main>
  );
}

function Row({ label, value }: { label: string; value?: string }) {
  return (
    <div className="flex justify-between gap-3">
      <dt className="text-neutral-600">{label}</dt>
      <dd className="font-semibold text-neutral-900 text-right truncate">
        {value ?? "—"}
      </dd>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## 6.26 `src/features/results/TrafficLightDashboard.tsx`

```tsx
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";
import { Card, CardHeader } from "@/components/ui/Card";
import { TrafficLight } from "@/components/ui/TrafficLight";
import type { Indicator, TrafficLightStatus } from "./results.types";
import { trafficLightLabelKey } from "./results.utils";

export function TrafficLightDashboard({
  indicators,
}: {
  indicators: Indicator[];
}) {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const counts: Record<TrafficLightStatus, number> = {
    ON_TRACK: 0,
    AT_RISK: 0,
    OFF_TRACK: 0,
    NOT_STARTED: 0,
  };
  indicators.forEach((i) => {
    counts[i.status]++;
  });
  const total = indicators.length || 1;

  const byComponent = new Map<string, Indicator[]>();
  indicators.forEach((i) => {
    const arr = byComponent.get(i.componentId) ?? [];
    arr.push(i);
    byComponent.set(i.componentId, arr);
  });

  return (
    <div className="grid md:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
      <Card>
        <CardHeader
          title="Portfolio status"
          subtitle={`${indicators.length} indicators`}
        />
        <ul className="space-y-3">
          {(
            [
              "ON_TRACK",
              "AT_RISK",
              "OFF_TRACK",
              "NOT_STARTED",
            ] as TrafficLightStatus[]
          ).map((s) => {
            const pct = (counts[s] / total) * 100;
            return (
              <li key={s} className="space-y-1.5">
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-body-sm">
                  <TrafficLight status={s} />
                  <span className="font-bold">
                    {counts[s]}{" "}
                    <span className="text-neutral-600 font-normal">
                      ({pct.toFixed(0)}%)
                    </span>
                  </span>
                </div>
                <div
                  className="h-2 bg-neutral-200 rounded overflow-hidden"
                  aria-hidden
                >
                  <div
                    className={
                      s === "ON_TRACK"
                        ? "h-full bg-green-500"
                        : s === "AT_RISK"
                          ? "h-full bg-amber-500"
                          : s === "OFF_TRACK"
                            ? "h-full bg-red-500"
                            : "h-full bg-slate-400"
                    }
                    style={{ width: `${pct}%` }}
                  />
                </div>
              </li>
            );
          })}
        </ul>
      </Card>

      <Card>
        <CardHeader title="By component" />
        {byComponent.size === 0 ? (
          <p className="text-caption text-neutral-600">No components yet.</p>
        ) : (
          <ul className="space-y-3">
            {Array.from(byComponent.entries()).map(([componentId, items]) => {
              const on = items.filter((i) => i.status === "ON_TRACK").length;
              const at = items.filter((i) => i.status === "AT_RISK").length;
              const off = items.filter((i) => i.status === "OFF_TRACK").length;
              return (
                <li
                  key={componentId}
                  className="flex items-center justify-between text-body-sm"
                >
                  <span className="text-neutral-900 font-semibold truncate">
                    {componentId.slice(0, 8)}…
                  </span>
                  <div className="flex gap-3 text-caption">
                    <span className="text-green-700 font-bold">{on}</span>
                    <span className="text-amber-700 font-bold">{at}</span>
                    <span className="text-red-700 font-bold">{off}</span>
                  </div>
                </li>
              );
            })}
          </ul>
        )}
      </Card>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## 6.27 `src/features/results/AggregationView.tsx`

```tsx
import { useState } from "react";
import { useAggregation } from "./results.queries";
import { Card, CardHeader } from "@/components/ui/Card";
import { LoadingState } from "@/components/ui/LoadingState";
import { DataGrid, type Column } from "@/components/ui/DataGrid";
import { Progress } from "@/components/ui/Progress";
import { Tabs } from "@/components/ui/Tabs";
import type { AggregationRow } from "./results.types";

export function AggregationView({ projectId }: { projectId: string }) {
  const [groupBy, setGroupBy] = useState<"component" | "region" | "gender">(
    "component",
  );

  return (
    <Tabs
      tabs={[
        {
          id: "component",
          label: "By component",
          content: <AggTable projectId={projectId} groupBy="component" />,
        },
        {
          id: "region",
          label: "By region",
          content: <AggTable projectId={projectId} groupBy="region" />,
        },
        {
          id: "gender",
          label: "By gender",
          content: <AggTable projectId={projectId} groupBy="gender" />,
        },
      ]}
      onChange={(id) => setGroupBy(id as any)}
      defaultTab={groupBy}
    />
  );
}

function AggTable({
  projectId,
  groupBy,
}: {
  projectId: string;
  groupBy: "component" | "region" | "gender";
}) {
  const { data, isLoading } = useAggregation(projectId, groupBy);
  if (isLoading) return <LoadingState />;

  const columns: Column<AggregationRow & { id: string }>[] = [
    {
      id: "label",
      header: "Group",
      render: (r) => <span className="font-semibold">{r.label}</span>,
    },
    { id: "indicatorCount", header: "Indicators", align: "right" },
    {
      id: "onTrack",
      header: "On-track",
      align: "right",
      render: (r) => (
        <span className="text-green-700 font-bold">{r.onTrack}</span>
      ),
    },
    {
      id: "atRisk",
      header: "At-risk",
      align: "right",
      render: (r) => (
        <span className="text-amber-700 font-bold">{r.atRisk}</span>
      ),
    },
    {
      id: "offTrack",
      header: "Off-track",
      align: "right",
      render: (r) => (
        <span className="text-red-700 font-bold">{r.offTrack}</span>
      ),
    },
    {
      id: "avgAchievement",
      header: "Avg achievement",
      render: (r) => (
        <div className="min-w-[140px]">
          <Progress
            value={r.avgAchievement}
            tone={
              r.avgAchievement >= 85
                ? "success"
                : r.avgAchievement >= 60
                  ? "warning"
                  : "danger"
            }
          />
          <div className="text-caption text-neutral-600 mt-0.5">
            {r.avgAchievement.toFixed(1)}%
          </div>
        </div>
      ),
    },
  ];

  return (
    <Card>
      <CardHeader title={`Aggregated by ${groupBy}`} />
      <DataGrid
        columns={columns}
        rows={(data ?? []).map((r) => ({ ...r, id: r.key }))}
        ariaLabel="Aggregation"
      />
    </Card>
  );
}
```

## 6.28 `src/features/results/LogframeExport.tsx`

```tsx
import { Download, FileSpreadsheet } from "lucide-react";
import { Card, CardHeader } from "@/components/ui/Card";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/Button";
import { resultsApi } from "./results.api";
import { useToast } from "@/components/ui/Toast";

export function LogframeExport({ projectId }: { projectId: string }) {
  const { push } = useToast();

  const download = async () => {
    try {
      const blob = await resultsApi.exportLogframe(projectId);
      const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
      const a = document.createElement("a");
      a.href = url;
      a.download = `logframe-${projectId}-${new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10)}.xlsx`;
      a.click();
      URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
      push("success", "Logframe exported");
    } catch {
      push("error", "Export failed");
    }
  };

  return (
    <Card>
      <CardHeader
        title="Logframe export"
        subtitle="Excel file with components, subcomponents, indicators, values"
      />
      <div className="flex items-start gap-4">
        <FileSpreadsheet
          className="h-12 w-12 text-green-600 shrink-0"
          aria-hidden
        />
        <div className="flex-1">
          <p className="text-body-sm text-neutral-600">
            The logframe export contains the full results framework in a format
            compatible with World Bank reporting and audit requirements. It
            includes baseline, target, latest actual value, and disaggregation
            for each indicator.
          </p>
          <Button
            variant="primary"
            className="mt-4"
            leftIcon={<Download className="h-4 w-4" />}
            onClick={download}
          >
            Download Excel logframe
          </Button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </Card>
  );
}
```

### `src/features/inception/__tests__/inception.schema.test.ts`

```ts
import { describe, it, expect } from "vitest";
import {
  reviewDecisionSchema,
  submitInceptionSchema,
} from "../inception.schema";

describe("reviewDecisionSchema", () => {
  it("allows APPROVE without comments", () => {
    expect(
      reviewDecisionSchema.safeParse({ decision: "APPROVE" }).success,
    ).toBe(true);
  });

  it("requires ≥10-char comment for REQUEST_REVISION", () => {
    expect(
      reviewDecisionSchema.safeParse({
        decision: "REQUEST_REVISION",
        comments: "short",
      }).success,
    ).toBe(false);
    expect(
      reviewDecisionSchema.safeParse({
        decision: "REQUEST_REVISION",
        comments: "Please revise section 2.",
      }).success,
    ).toBe(true);
  });

  it("rejects REJECT without comments", () => {
    expect(reviewDecisionSchema.safeParse({ decision: "REJECT" }).success).toBe(
      false,
    );
  });
});

describe("submitInceptionSchema", () => {
  it("rejects summary shorter than 20 chars", () => {
    const r = submitInceptionSchema.safeParse({
      projectId: "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001",
      templateId: "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000002",
      version: 1,
      summary: "Too short",
    });
    expect(r.success).toBe(false);
  });
});
```

```ts
import { z } from "zod";
import { FINANCING_CATEGORIES, DISBURSEMENT_STATUSES } from "./financial.types";

export const budgetFormSchema = z.object({
  projectId: z.string().uuid(),
  componentId: z.string().uuid().optional().or(z.literal("")),
  fiscalYear: z.number().int().min(2000).max(3000),
  currency: z.enum(["ETB", "USD", "EUR"]),
  appropriation: z
    .string()
    .regex(/^\d+(\.\d{1,2})?$/, "Must be a valid amount"),
  notes: z.string().max(500).optional().or(z.literal("")),
});
export type BudgetFormData = z.infer<typeof budgetFormSchema>;

export const disbursementFormSchema = z.object({
  projectId: z.string().uuid("Select a project"),
  sourceOrgId: z.string().uuid("Select a source"),
  category: z.enum(FINANCING_CATEGORIES),
  amount: z.string().regex(/^\d+(\.\d{1,2})?$/, "Must be a valid amount"),
  currency: z.enum(["ETB", "USD", "EUR"]),
  valueDate: z.string().min(1, "Value date is required"),
  referenceNo: z.string().max(50).optional().or(z.literal("")),
  status: z.enum(DISBURSEMENT_STATUSES).default("APPROVED"),
});
export type DisbursementFormData = z.infer<typeof disbursementFormSchema>;

export const fmisTriggerSchema = z.object({
  kind: z.enum(["APPROPRIATION", "RELEASE", "EXPENDITURE"]),
  fiscalYear: z.number().int().optional(),
});

export const disbursementFiltersSchema = z.object({
  projectId: z.string().optional(),
  status: z.array(z.enum(DISBURSEMENT_STATUSES)).optional(),
  sourceOrgId: z.string().optional(),
  from: z.string().optional(),
  to: z.string().optional(),
  q: z.string().optional(),
  limit: z.number().int().min(1).max(200).optional(),
  cursor: z.string().optional(),
});
```

## 7.3 `src/features/financial/financial.api.ts`

```ts
import { api } from "@/lib/api/client";
import type {
  Budget,
  Disbursement,
  FinancialExecution,
  FmisSyncRun,
  CostPerOutputRow,
  FinancialException,
  BudgetFilters,
  DisbursementFilters,
} from "./financial.types";
import type { BudgetFormData, DisbursementFormData } from "./financial.schema";

interface Envelope<T> {
  data: T;
}

function dFiltersToParams(f: DisbursementFilters): string {
  const p = new URLSearchParams();
  if (f.projectId) p.set("project_id", f.projectId);
  if (f.status?.length) p.set("status", f.status.join(","));
  if (f.sourceOrgId) p.set("source_org_id", f.sourceOrgId);
  if (f.from) p.set("from", f.from);
  if (f.to) p.set("to", f.to);
  if (f.q) p.set("q", f.q);
  if (f.limit) p.set("limit", String(f.limit));
  if (f.cursor) p.set("cursor", f.cursor);
  return p.toString();
}

export const financialApi = {
  async listBudgets(f: BudgetFilters): Promise<Budget[]> {
    const p = new URLSearchParams();
    if (f.projectId) p.set("project_id", f.projectId);
    if (f.fiscalYear) p.set("fiscal_year", String(f.fiscalYear));
    if (f.componentId) p.set("component_id", f.componentId);
    const { data } = await api.get<Envelope<Budget[]>>(
      `/budgets?${p.toString()}`,
    );
    return data.data;
  },

  async createBudget(input: BudgetFormData): Promise<Budget> {
    const { data } = await api.post<Envelope<Budget>>("/budgets", input);
    return data.data;
  },

  async execution(
    projectId: string,
    fiscalYear?: number,
  ): Promise<FinancialExecution> {
    const p = new URLSearchParams({ project_id: projectId });
    if (fiscalYear) p.set("fiscal_year", String(fiscalYear));
    const { data } = await api.get<Envelope<FinancialExecution>>(
      `/finance/execution?${p.toString()}`,
    );
    return data.data;
  },

  async listDisbursements(f: DisbursementFilters) {
    const { data } = await api.get<
      Envelope<Disbursement[]> & { pagination: any }
    >(`/disbursements?${dFiltersToParams(f)}`);
    return { data: data.data, pagination: (data as any).pagination };
  },

  async createDisbursement(input: DisbursementFormData): Promise<Disbursement> {
    const { data } = await api.post<Envelope<Disbursement>>(
      "/disbursements",
      input,
    );
    return data.data;
  },

  async fmisRuns(): Promise<FmisSyncRun[]> {
    const { data } =
      await api.get<Envelope<FmisSyncRun[]>>("/finance/fmis/runs");
    return data.data;
  },

  async triggerFmisSync(
    kind: "APPROPRIATION" | "RELEASE" | "EXPENDITURE",
  ): Promise<{ jobId: string; statusUrl: string }> {
    const { data } = await api.post<
      Envelope<{ jobId: string; statusUrl: string }>
    >("/finance/sync-fmis", { kind });
    return data.data;
  },

  async costPerOutput(projectId: string): Promise<CostPerOutputRow[]> {
    const { data } = await api.get<Envelope<CostPerOutputRow[]>>(
      `/finance/cost-per-output?project_id=${projectId}`,
    );
    return data.data;
  },

  async exceptions(projectId?: string): Promise<FinancialException[]> {
    const p = projectId ? `?project_id=${projectId}` : "";
    const { data } = await api.get<Envelope<FinancialException[]>>(
      `/finance/exceptions${p}`,
    );
    return data.data;
  },
};
```

## 7.4 `src/features/financial/financial.queries.ts`

```ts
import { useQuery, keepPreviousData } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { financialApi } from "./financial.api";
import type { BudgetFilters, DisbursementFilters } from "./financial.types";

export const financialKeys = {
  all: ["financial"] as const,
  budgets: (f: BudgetFilters) => [...financialKeys.all, "budgets", f] as const,
  execution: (projectId: string, fy?: number) =>
    [...financialKeys.all, "execution", projectId, fy] as const,
  disbursements: (f: DisbursementFilters) =>
    [...financialKeys.all, "disbursements", f] as const,
  fmisRuns: () => [...financialKeys.all, "fmis-runs"] as const,
  costPerOutput: (projectId: string) =>
    [...financialKeys.all, "cost-per-output", projectId] as const,
  exceptions: (projectId?: string) =>
    [...financialKeys.all, "exceptions", projectId ?? "all"] as const,
};

export function useBudgets(f: BudgetFilters) {
  return useQuery({
    queryKey: financialKeys.budgets(f),
    queryFn: () => financialApi.listBudgets(f),
    enabled: !!f.projectId,
    staleTime: 60_000,
  });
}

export function useExecution(
  projectId: string | undefined,
  fiscalYear?: number,
) {
  return useQuery({
    queryKey: financialKeys.execution(projectId ?? "", fiscalYear),
    queryFn: () => financialApi.execution(projectId!, fiscalYear),
    enabled: !!projectId,
    staleTime: 60_000,
  });
}

export function useDisbursements(f: DisbursementFilters) {
  return useQuery({
    queryKey: financialKeys.disbursements(f),
    queryFn: () => financialApi.listDisbursements(f),
    placeholderData: keepPreviousData,
    staleTime: 30_000,
  });
}

export function useFmisRuns() {
  return useQuery({
    queryKey: financialKeys.fmisRuns(),
    queryFn: () => financialApi.fmisRuns(),
    refetchInterval: 15_000,
  });
}

export function useCostPerOutput(projectId: string | undefined) {
  return useQuery({
    queryKey: financialKeys.costPerOutput(projectId ?? ""),
    queryFn: () => financialApi.costPerOutput(projectId!),
    enabled: !!projectId,
  });
}

export function useFinancialExceptions(projectId?: string) {
  return useQuery({
    queryKey: financialKeys.exceptions(projectId),
    queryFn: () => financialApi.exceptions(projectId),
    refetchInterval: 60_000,
  });
}
```

## 7.5 `src/features/financial/financial.mutations.ts`

```ts
import { useMutation, useQueryClient } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { financialApi } from "./financial.api";
import { financialKeys } from "./financial.queries";
import { projectKeys } from "@/features/projects/project.queries";
import { useToast } from "@/components/ui/Toast";
import { normalizeApiError } from "@/lib/api/errors";
import type { BudgetFormData, DisbursementFormData } from "./financial.schema";

export function useCreateBudget() {
  const qc = useQueryClient();
  const { push } = useToast();
  return useMutation({
    mutationFn: (input: BudgetFormData) => financialApi.createBudget(input),
    onSuccess: (b) => {
      qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: financialKeys.all });
      qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: projectKeys.detail(b.projectId) });
      push("success", "Budget recorded");
    },
    onError: (err) =>
      push("error", normalizeApiError(err).detail ?? "Failed to record budget"),
  });
}

export function useCreateDisbursement() {
  const qc = useQueryClient();
  const { push } = useToast();
  return useMutation({
    mutationFn: (input: DisbursementFormData) =>
      financialApi.createDisbursement(input),
    onSuccess: (d) => {
      qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: financialKeys.all });
      qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: projectKeys.detail(d.projectId) });
      push(
        "success",
        `Disbursement recorded · ${d.currency} ${Number(d.amount).toLocaleString()}`,
      );
    },
    onError: (err) =>
      push(
        "error",
        normalizeApiError(err).detail ?? "Failed to record disbursement",
      ),
  });
}

export function useTriggerFmisSync() {
  const qc = useQueryClient();
  const { push } = useToast();
  return useMutation({
    mutationFn: (kind: "APPROPRIATION" | "RELEASE" | "EXPENDITURE") =>
      financialApi.triggerFmisSync(kind),
    onSuccess: () => {
      qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: financialKeys.fmisRuns() });
      push("info", "FMIS sync job queued");
    },
    onError: (err) =>
      push("error", normalizeApiError(err).detail ?? "Sync trigger failed"),
  });
}
```

## 7.6 `src/features/financial/financial.utils.ts`

```ts
import type { ChipTone } from "@/components/ui/Chip";
import type { DisbursementStatus } from "./financial.types";

export function disbursementStatusTone(s: DisbursementStatus): ChipTone {
  switch (s) {
    case "PLANNED":
      return "grey";
    case "REQUESTED":
      return "blue";
    case "APPROVED":
      return "blue";
    case "DISBURSED":
      return "green";
    case "RECONCILED":
      return "teal";
    case "REJECTED":
      return "red";
  }
}

export function disbursementStatusKey(s: DisbursementStatus): string {
  return `financial.disbursement.status.${s.toLowerCase()}`;
}

export function executionTone(pct: number): "success" | "warning" | "danger" {
  if (pct >= 85) return "success";
  if (pct >= 60) return "warning";
  return "danger";
}

export function exceptionTone(
  severity: "LOW" | "MEDIUM" | "HIGH" | "CRITICAL",
): ChipTone {
  return severity === "CRITICAL"
    ? "red"
    : severity === "HIGH"
      ? "red"
      : severity === "MEDIUM"
        ? "amber"
        : "grey";
}

/** Convert any currency amount to ETB using a fixed reporting rate for display. */
export function toEtb(amount: string, currency: string): string {
  const n = Number(amount);
  const rate = currency === "USD" ? 57 : currency === "EUR" ? 62 : 1;
  return (n * rate).toFixed(2);
}
```

```tsx
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";
import { Card, CardHeader } from "@/components/ui/Card";
import { formatMoney } from "@/lib/utils/currency";
import type { FinancialExecution } from "./financial.types";

/** Simple CSS-based bar chart — no external chart libs required at this step. */
export function BurnRateChart({
  execution,
}: {
  execution: FinancialExecution;
}) {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const total = Number(execution.totalAppropriation) || 1;

  const rows: { label: string; amount: string; color: string; key: string }[] =
    [
      {
        key: "released",
        label: t("financial.burn.released"),
        amount: execution.totalReleased,
        color: "bg-amber-500",
      },
      {
        key: "expended",
        label: t("financial.burn.expended"),
        amount: execution.totalExpended,
        color: "bg-green-500",
      },
      {
        key: "committed",
        label: t("financial.burn.committed"),
        amount: execution.totalCommitted,
        color: "bg-blue-500",
      },
    ];

  return (
    <Card>
      <CardHeader
        title={t("financial.burn.title")}
        subtitle={formatMoney(execution.totalAppropriation, execution.currency)}
      />
      <ul className="space-y-4">
        {rows.map((r) => {
          const pct = (Number(r.amount) / total) * 100;
          return (
            <li key={r.key}>
              <div className="flex justify-between text-body-sm mb-1.5">
                <span className="text-neutral-600">{r.label}</span>
                <span className="font-semibold">
                  {formatMoney(r.amount, execution.currency)}
                  <span className="text-caption text-neutral-600 ml-2">
                    ({pct.toFixed(1)}%)
                  </span>
                </span>
              </div>
              <div
                className="h-3 bg-neutral-200 rounded-full overflow-hidden"
                aria-hidden
              >
                <div
                  className={`h-full ${r.color} transition-all`}
                  style={{ width: `${Math.min(100, pct)}%` }}
                />
              </div>
            </li>
          );
        })}
      </ul>
    </Card>
  );
}
```

## 7.9 `src/features/financial/ExecutionGauge.tsx`

```tsx
import { Card, CardHeader } from "@/components/ui/Card";
import { executionTone } from "./financial.utils";
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";
import type { FinancialExecution } from "./financial.types";

export function ExecutionGauge({
  execution,
}: {
  execution: FinancialExecution;
}) {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const pct = execution.executionRate;
  const tone = executionTone(pct);

  const color =
    tone === "success" ? "#16A34A" : tone === "warning" ? "#D97706" : "#DC2626";
  const radius = 60;
  const circumference = 2 * Math.PI * radius;
  const dash = (pct / 100) * circumference;

  return (
    <Card>
      <CardHeader
        title={t("financial.execution.title")}
        subtitle={t("financial.execution.subtitle")}
      />
      <div className="flex flex-col items-center">
        <svg
          width="160"
          height="160"
          viewBox="0 0 160 160"
          role="img"
          aria-label={`Execution rate ${pct.toFixed(1)}%`}
        >
          <circle
            cx="80"
            cy="80"
            r={radius}
            fill="none"
            stroke="#E2E8F0"
            strokeWidth="14"
          />
          <circle
            cx="80"
            cy="80"
            r={radius}
            fill="none"
            stroke={color}
            strokeWidth="14"
            strokeLinecap="round"
            strokeDasharray={`${dash} ${circumference - dash}`}
            transform="rotate(-90 80 80)"
          />
          <text
            x="80"
            y="80"
            textAnchor="middle"
            dominantBaseline="middle"
            fontSize="28"
            fontWeight="800"
            fill="#0B1E3D"
          >
            {pct.toFixed(0)}%
          </text>
          <text x="80" y="108" textAnchor="middle" fontSize="11" fill="#475569">
            executed
          </text>
        </svg>
      </div>
    </Card>
  );
}
```

```tsx
          ))}
```

```tsx
import { useState } from "react";
import { useSearchParams, useNavigate } from "react-router-dom";
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";
import { Plus, Download } from "lucide-react";
import { useExecution, useBudgets } from "./financial.queries";
import { usePermissions } from "@/features/auth/usePermissions";
import { PERMISSIONS } from "@/features/auth/auth.types";
import { Tabs } from "@/components/ui/Tabs";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/Button";
import { Card, CardHeader } from "@/components/ui/Card";
import { LoadingState } from "@/components/ui/LoadingState";
import { FinancialKPIs } from "./FinancialKPIs";
import { BurnRateChart } from "./BurnRateChart";
import { ExecutionGauge } from "./ExecutionGauge";
import { ExceptionsPanel } from "./ExceptionsPanel";
import { BudgetRegister } from "./BudgetRegister";
import { BudgetFormModal } from "./BudgetFormModal";
import { CostPerOutputView } from "./CostPerOutputView";
import { formatMoney } from "@/lib/utils/currency";

export default function FinancialPage() {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const [params] = useSearchParams();
  const { can } = usePermissions();
  const [budgetOpen, setBudgetOpen] = useState(false);

  const projectId = params.get("projectId") ?? "PIIMS-2026-0042";
  const fiscalYear = Number(params.get("fy") ?? new Date().getFullYear());

  const { data: execution, isLoading } = useExecution(projectId, fiscalYear);
  const { data: budgets } = useBudgets({ projectId, fiscalYear });

  if (isLoading || !execution)
    return <LoadingState message="Loading financial data…" />;

  return (
    <main id="main" tabIndex={-1} className="space-y-5">
      <header className="flex flex-wrap items-start justify-between gap-3">
        <div>
          <h1 className="text-h1 text-primary-900">{t("financial.title")}</h1>
          <p className="text-body-sm text-neutral-600 mt-1">
            <code className="text-primary-700 font-bold">{projectId}</code> · FY{" "}
            {fiscalYear}
          </p>
        </div>
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
          <Button
            variant="ghost"
            size="sm"
            onClick={() => navigate("/financial/fmis")}
          >
            {t("financial.actions.viewFmis")}
          </Button>
          <Button
            variant="secondary"
            size="sm"
            leftIcon={<Download className="h-4 w-4" />}
            onClick={() => {
              const csv = [
                "Component,Appropriation,Released,Expended,Execution %",
              ]
                .concat(
                  execution.byComponent.map(
                    (c) =>
                      `${c.componentName},${c.appropriation},${c.released},${c.expended},${c.executionPct.toFixed(1)}`,
                  ),
                )
                .join("\n");
              const blob = new Blob([csv], { type: "text/csv" });
              const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
              const a = document.createElement("a");
              a.href = url;
              a.download = `financial-${projectId}-FY${fiscalYear}.csv`;
              a.click();
              URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
            }}
          >
            {t("financial.actions.export")}
          </Button>
          {can(PERMISSIONS.budgetWrite) && (
            <Button
              variant="primary"
              size="sm"
              leftIcon={<Plus className="h-4 w-4" />}

            >
              {t("financial.actions.addBudget")}

          )}
        </div>
      </header>

      <FinancialKPIs execution={execution} />

      <div className="grid md:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
        <BurnRateChart execution={execution} />
        <ExecutionGauge execution={execution} />
      </div>

      <Tabs
        tabs={[
          {
            id: "budget",
            label: t("financial.tabs.budget"),
            content: (
              <BudgetRegister
                budgets={budgets ?? []}
                currency={execution.currency}
              />
            ),
          },
          {
            id: "by-component",
            label: t("financial.tabs.byComponent"),
            content: (
              <Card>
                <CardHeader title={t("financial.byComponent.title")} />
                <table className="w-full text-body-sm">
                  <thead>
                    <tr className="border-b border-neutral-300 text-left">
                      <th className="py-2 text-caption font-bold uppercase tracking-wide text-neutral-600">
                        Component
                      </th>
                      <th className="py-2 text-right text-caption font-bold uppercase tracking-wide text-neutral-600">
                        Appropriation
                      </th>
                      <th className="py-2 text-right text-caption font-bold uppercase tracking-wide text-neutral-600">
                        Released
                      </th>
                      <th className="py-2 text-right text-caption font-bold uppercase tracking-wide text-neutral-600">
                        Expended
                      </th>
                      <th className="py-2 text-right text-caption font-bold uppercase tracking-wide text-neutral-600">
                        Exec %
                      </th>
                    </tr>
                  </thead>
                  <tbody>
                    {execution.byComponent.map((c) => (
                      <tr
                        key={c.componentId}
                        className="border-b border-neutral-100"
                      >
                        <td className="py-2 font-semibold">
                          {c.componentName}
                        </td>
                        <td className="py-2 text-right">
                          {formatMoney(c.appropriation, execution.currency)}
                        </td>
                        <td className="py-2 text-right">
                          {formatMoney(c.released, execution.currency)}
                        </td>
                        <td className="py-2 text-right">
                          {formatMoney(c.expended, execution.currency)}
                        </td>
                        <td className="py-2 text-right font-bold">
                          {c.executionPct.toFixed(1)}%
                        </td>
                      </tr>
                    ))}
                  </tbody>
                </table>
              </Card>
            ),
          },
          {
            id: "cost-per-output",
            label: t("financial.tabs.costPerOutput"),
            content: <CostPerOutputView projectId={projectId} />,
          },
          {
            id: "disbursements",
            label: t("financial.tabs.disbursements"),
            content: (
              <Card>
                <CardHeader
                  title={t("financial.disbursements.title")}
                  action={
                    <Button
                      size="sm"
                      variant="secondary"
                      onClick={() => navigate("/financial/disbursements")}
                    >
                      {t("financial.actions.viewAll")}
                    </Button>
                  }
                />
                <p className="text-body-sm text-neutral-600">
                  {t("financial.disbursements.hint")}
                </p>
              </Card>
            ),
          },
        ]}
      />

      <ExceptionsPanel />

      <BudgetFormModal
        open={budgetOpen}
        onClose={() => setBudgetOpen(false)}
        defaultProjectId={projectId}
      />
    </main>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import { useForm } from "react-hook-form";
import { zodResolver } from "@hookform/resolvers/zod";
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";
import { Modal } from "@/components/ui/Modal";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/Button";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/Input";
import { Select } from "@/components/ui/Select";
import { Textarea } from "@/components/ui/Textarea";
import { budgetFormSchema, type BudgetFormData } from "./financial.schema";
import { useCreateBudget } from "./financial.mutations";
import { useComponents } from "@/features/results/results.queries";

export function BudgetFormModal({
  open,
  onClose,
  defaultProjectId,
}: {
  open: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  defaultProjectId?: string;
}) {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const create = useCreateBudget();
  const { data: components } = useComponents(defaultProjectId);

  const {
    register,
    handleSubmit,
    formState: { errors },
    reset,
  } = useForm<BudgetFormData>({
    resolver: zodResolver(budgetFormSchema),
    defaultValues: {
      projectId: defaultProjectId ?? "",
      componentId: "",
      fiscalYear: new Date().getFullYear(),
      currency: "ETB",
      appropriation: "",
      notes: "",
    },
  });

  const onSubmit = async (v: BudgetFormData) => {
    await create.mutateAsync(v);
    reset();
    onClose();
  };

  return (
    <Modal
      open={open}
      onClose={onClose}
      title={t("financial.budget.form.title")}
      footer={
        <>
          <Button variant="ghost" onClick={onClose}>
            {t("actions.cancel")}
          </Button>
          <Button
            variant="primary"
            loading={create.isPending}
            onClick={handleSubmit(onSubmit)}
          >
            {t("actions.save")}
          </Button>
        </>
      }
    >
      <form onSubmit={handleSubmit(onSubmit)} className="space-y-4" noValidate>
        <input type="hidden" {...register("projectId")} />
        <Select
          {...register("componentId")}
          label={t("financial.budget.form.component")}
          placeholder={t("financial.budget.form.wholeProject")}
          options={(components ?? []).map((c) => ({
            value: c.componentId,
            label: `${c.code} · ${c.name}`,
          }))}
        />
        <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4">
          <Input
            {...register("fiscalYear", { valueAsNumber: true })}
            type="number"
            label={t("financial.budget.form.fiscalYear")}
            required
            error={errors.fiscalYear?.message}
          />
          <Select
            {...register("currency")}
            label={t("financial.budget.form.currency")}
            required
            options={[
              { value: "ETB", label: "ETB" },
              { value: "USD", label: "USD" },
              { value: "EUR", label: "EUR" },
            ]}
          />
        </div>
        <Input
          {...register("appropriation")}
          label={t("financial.budget.form.appropriation")}
          required
          inputMode="decimal"
          error={errors.appropriation?.message}
        />
        <Textarea
          {...register("notes")}
          label={t("financial.budget.form.notes")}
          rows={2}
        />
      </form>
    </Modal>
  );
}
```

```tsx
        ),
      },
    ],
    [t],
  );

  const updateParams = (patch: Record<string, string | undefined>) => {
    const next = new URLSearchParams(params);
    Object.entries(patch).forEach(([k, v]) => {
      if (v == null || v === "") next.delete(k);
      else next.set(k, v);
    });
    setParams(next, { replace: true });
  };

  const toggleStatus = (s: DisbursementStatus) => {
    const nxt = status.includes(s)
      ? status.filter((x) => x !== s)
      : [...status, s];
    updateParams({ status: nxt.length ? nxt.join(",") : undefined });
  };

  return (
    <main id="main" tabIndex={-1} className="space-y-5">
      <header className="flex flex-wrap items-start justify-between gap-3">
        <div>
          <h1 className="text-h1 text-primary-900">
            {t("financial.disbursements.title")}
          </h1>
          <p className="text-body-sm text-neutral-600 mt-1">
            {data?.pagination?.totalCount ?? 0} disbursements
          </p>
        </div>
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
          <Button
            variant="secondary"
            size="sm"
            leftIcon={<Download className="h-4 w-4" />}
            onClick={() => {
              const csv = [
                "Project,Source,Category,Amount,Currency,Value date,Status",
              ]
                .concat(
                  (data?.data ?? []).map(
                    (d) =>
                      `${d.projectCode},${d.sourceOrgName},${d.category},${d.amount},${d.currency},${d.valueDate},${d.status}`,
                  ),
                )
                .join("\n");
              const blob = new Blob([csv], { type: "text/csv" });
              const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
              const a = document.createElement("a");
              a.href = url;
              a.download = "disbursements.csv";
              a.click();
              URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
            }}
          >
            {t("financial.actions.export")}
          </Button>
          {can(PERMISSIONS.disbursementWrite) && (
            <Button
              variant="primary"
              size="sm"
              leftIcon={<Plus className="h-4 w-4" />}
              onClick={() => setFormOpen(true)}
            >
              {t("financial.disbursements.add")}
            </Button>
          )}
        </div>
      </header>

      <section className="bg-white border border-neutral-300 rounded-md p-3 flex flex-wrap gap-2 items-center">
        {ALL_STATUSES.map((s) => {
          const active = status.includes(s);
          return (
            <button
              key={s}
              type="button"
              aria-pressed={active}
              onClick={() => toggleStatus(s)}
              className="focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-info focus-visible:ring-offset-2 rounded-full"
            >
              <Chip tone={active ? disbursementStatusTone(s) : "grey"}>
                {t(disbursementStatusKey(s))}
              </Chip>
            </button>
          );
        })}
        {status.length > 0 && (
          <Button
            variant="ghost"
            size="sm"
            onClick={() => updateParams({ status: undefined })}
          >
            {t("financial.filters.clear")}
          </Button>
        )}
      </section>

      {isLoading && <SkeletonTable rows={6} cols={columns.length} />}
      {isError && !isLoading && <ErrorState onRetry={() => refetch()} />}
      {!isLoading && !isError && (data?.data.length ?? 0) === 0 && (
        <EmptyState
          title="No disbursements yet"
          description="Record a disbursement to begin tracking."
        />
      )}
      {!isLoading && !isError && (data?.data.length ?? 0) > 0 && (
        <>
          <DataGrid
            columns={columns}
            rows={data!.data.map((d) => ({ ...d, id: d.disbursementId }))}
            ariaLabel={t("financial.disbursements.title")}
          />
          <Pagination
            page={1}
            pageSize={pageSize}
            total={data!.pagination?.totalCount ?? 0}
            onPageChange={() => {
              /* cursor-based */
            }}
            onPageSizeChange={(s) => updateParams({ size: String(s) })}
          />
        </>
      )}

      <DisbursementFormModal
        open={formOpen}
        onClose={() => setFormOpen(false)}
      />
    </main>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import { useForm } from "react-hook-form";
import { zodResolver } from "@hookform/resolvers/zod";
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";
import { Modal } from "@/components/ui/Modal";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/Button";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/Input";
import { Select } from "@/components/ui/Select";
import { DateInput } from "@/components/ui/DateInput";
import { Banner } from "@/components/ui/Banner";
import {
  disbursementFormSchema,
  type DisbursementFormData,
} from "./financial.schema";
import { useCreateDisbursement } from "./financial.mutations";
import { useProjects } from "@/features/projects/project.queries";

const ORGS = [
  { value: "org-wb", label: "World Bank" },
  { value: "org-mof", label: "Ministry of Finance" },
  { value: "org-dbe", label: "Development Bank of Ethiopia" },
];

export function DisbursementFormModal({
  open,
  onClose,
}: {
  open: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
}) {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const create = useCreateDisbursement();
  const { data: projects } = useProjects({
    limit: 200,
    status: ["APPROVED", "ACTIVE"] as any,
  });

  const {
    register,
    handleSubmit,
    formState: { errors },
    reset,
  } = useForm<DisbursementFormData>({
    resolver: zodResolver(disbursementFormSchema),
    defaultValues: {
      projectId: "",
      sourceOrgId: "",
      category: "CATEGORY_1",
      amount: "",
      currency: "ETB",
      valueDate: new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10),
      referenceNo: "",
      status: "APPROVED",
    },
  });

  const onSubmit = async (v: DisbursementFormData) => {
    await create.mutateAsync(v);
    reset();
    onClose();
  };

  return (
    <Modal
      open={open}
      onClose={onClose}
      title={t("financial.disbursements.form.title")}
      size="md"
      footer={
        <>
          <Button variant="ghost" onClick={onClose}>
            {t("actions.cancel")}
          </Button>
          <Button
            variant="primary"
            loading={create.isPending}
            onClick={handleSubmit(onSubmit)}
          >
            {t("actions.save")}
          </Button>
        </>
      }
    >
      <form onSubmit={handleSubmit(onSubmit)} className="space-y-4" noValidate>
        <Banner tone="warning">
          {t("financial.disbursements.form.warning")}
        </Banner>

        <Select
          {...register("projectId")}
          label={t("financial.disbursements.form.project")}
          required
          placeholder="—"
          error={errors.projectId?.message}
          options={(projects?.data ?? []).map((p) => ({
            value: p.projectId,
            label: `${p.projectCode} · ${p.name}`,
          }))}
        />

        <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4">
          <Select
            {...register("sourceOrgId")}
            label={t("financial.disbursements.form.source")}
            required
            placeholder="—"
            error={errors.sourceOrgId?.message}
            options={ORGS}
          />
          <Select
            {...register("category")}
            label={t("financial.disbursements.form.category")}
            required
            options={[
              { value: "CATEGORY_1", label: "Category 1" },
              { value: "CATEGORY_2", label: "Category 2" },
              { value: "CATEGORY_3", label: "Category 3" },
              { value: "OTHER", label: "Other" },
            ]}
          />
        </div>

        <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-4">
          <div className="col-span-2">
            <Input
              {...register("amount")}
              label={t("financial.disbursements.form.amount")}
              required
              inputMode="decimal"
              error={errors.amount?.message}
            />
          </div>
          <Select
            {...register("currency")}
            label={t("financial.disbursements.form.currency")}
            required
            options={[
              { value: "ETB", label: "ETB" },
              { value: "USD", label: "USD" },
              { value: "EUR", label: "EUR" },
            ]}
          />
        </div>

        <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4">
          <DateInput
            {...register("valueDate")}
            label={t("financial.disbursements.form.valueDate")}
            required
            error={errors.valueDate?.message}
          />
          <Input
            {...register("referenceNo")}
            label={t("financial.disbursements.form.referenceNo")}
            placeholder="WB-DISB-2026-001234"
          />
        </div>

        <Select
          {...register("status")}
          label={t("financial.disbursements.form.status")}
          options={[
            { value: "PLANNED", label: "Planned" },
            { value: "REQUESTED", label: "Requested" },
            { value: "APPROVED", label: "Approved" },
```

```tsx
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";
import { RefreshCw, CheckCircle2, AlertTriangle, Clock } from "lucide-react";
import { useFmisRuns } from "./financial.queries";
import { useTriggerFmisSync } from "./financial.mutations";
import { Card, CardHeader } from "@/components/ui/Card";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/Button";

import { PERMISSIONS } from "@/features/auth/auth.types";

import type { FmisSyncRun } from "./financial.types";

export default function FmisSyncPage() {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const { can } = usePermissions();
  const { data, isLoading } = useFmisRuns();
  const trigger = useTriggerFmisSync();

  if (isLoading) return <LoadingState message="Loading FMIS sync status…" />;

  const latest = data?.[0];

  return (
    <main id="main" tabIndex={-1} className="space-y-5">
      <header className="flex flex-wrap items-start justify-between gap-3">

          <h1 className="text-h1 text-primary-900">

          </h1>

            {t("financial.fmis.subtitle")}
          </p>
        </div>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <Chip
            tone={
              healthy ? "green" : latest?.status === "FAILED" ? "red" : "amber"
            }
          >
            {healthy ? "🟢 Healthy" : (latest?.status ?? "Unknown")}
          </Chip>
          {can(PERMISSIONS.financeReconcile) && (
            <Button
              variant="primary"
              size="sm"

          <CardHeader title={t("financial.fmis.lastSync")} />

            <Row label="Kind" value={latest?.kind ?? "—"} />
            <Row
              label="Started"

            <Row

                  : "—"

            />
            <Row

              02:05
            </li>

              nightly 02:15
            </li>
          </ul>

        <Card>
          <CardHeader title={t("financial.fmis.actions")} />
          <div className="space-y-2">
            <Button
              variant="secondary"
              fullWidth
              size="sm"
              onClick={() => trigger.mutate("APPROPRIATION")}
            >
              Sync appropriations
            </Button>
            <Button
              variant="secondary"
              fullWidth
              size="sm"
              onClick={() => trigger.mutate("RELEASE")}
            >
              Sync releases
            </Button>
            <Button
              variant="secondary"
              fullWidth
              size="sm"
              onClick={() => trigger.mutate("EXPENDITURE")}
            >
              Sync expenditures
            </Button>
          </div>
        </Card>
      </div>

      <Card>
        <CardHeader title={t("financial.fmis.history")} />
        <table className="w-full text-body-sm">
          <thead>
            <tr className="border-b border-neutral-300 text-left">
              <th className="py-2 text-caption font-bold uppercase text-neutral-600">

              </th>
              <th className="py-2 text-caption font-bold uppercase text-neutral-600">
                Started
              </th>
              <th className="py-2 text-caption font-bold uppercase text-neutral-600">
                Duration
              </th>
              <th className="py-2 text-right text-caption font-bold uppercase text-neutral-600">
                Records
              </th>
              <th className="py-2 text-right text-caption font-bold uppercase text-neutral-600">
                Errors
              </th>
              <th className="py-2 text-caption font-bold uppercase text-neutral-600">
                Status
              </th>
            </tr>
          </thead>
          <tbody>
            {(data ?? []).map((r) => (
              <RunRow key={r.runId} run={r} />
            ))}
          </tbody>
        </table>
      </Card>
    </main>
  );
}

function Row({ label, value }: { label: string; value: string }) {
  return (
    <div className="flex justify-between gap-3">
      <span className="text-neutral-600">{label}</span>
      <span className="font-semibold">{value}</span>
    </div>
  );
}

function RunRow({ run }: { run: FmisSyncRun }) {
  const tone =
    run.status === "SUCCESS"
      ? "green"
      : run.status === "FAILED"
        ? "red"
        : run.status === "PARTIAL"
          ? "amber"
          : "blue";
  return (
    <tr className="border-b border-neutral-100">
      <td className="py-2 font-semibold">{run.kind}</td>
      <td className="py-2">{new Date(run.startedAt).toLocaleString()}</td>
      <td className="py-2">
        {run.durationMs ? `${(run.durationMs / 1000).toFixed(1)} s` : "—"}
      </td>
      <td className="py-2 text-right">{run.recordsProcessed}</td>
      <td className="py-2 text-right">{run.recordsFailed}</td>
      <td className="py-2">
        <Chip tone={tone}>
          {run.status === "SUCCESS" && (
            <CheckCircle2 className="h-3 w-3" aria-hidden />
          )}
          {run.status === "FAILED" && (
            <AlertTriangle className="h-3 w-3" aria-hidden />
          )}
          {run.status}
        </Chip>
      </td>
    </tr>
  );
}
```

## 7.19 `src/features/procurement/procurement.schema.ts`

```ts
import { z } from "zod";
import {
  PROCUREMENT_METHODS,
  PROCUREMENT_STATUSES,
  CONTRACT_STATUSES,
} from "./procurement.types";

export const procurementFormSchema = z.object({
  projectId: z.string().uuid("Select a project"),
  componentId: z.string().uuid().optional().or(z.literal("")),
  planRef: z.string().trim().min(1, "Plan reference is required").max(50),
  description: z.string().trim().min(5, "Description is required").max(500),
  method: z.enum(PROCUREMENT_METHODS),
  estimatedAmount: z
    .string()
    .regex(/^\d+(\.\d{1,2})?$/, "Must be a valid amount"),
  currency: z.enum(["ETB", "USD", "EUR"]),
  planDate: z.string().min(1, "Planned date is required"),
});
export type ProcurementFormData = z.infer<typeof procurementFormSchema>;

export const contractFormSchema = z
  .object({
    procurementId: z.string().uuid().optional().or(z.literal("")),
    projectId: z.string().uuid(),
    supplierId: z.string().uuid("Select a supplier"),
    contractNo: z.string().trim().min(1, "Contract number is required").max(50),
    title: z.string().trim().min(5, "Title is required").max(300),
    amount: z.string().regex(/^\d+(\.\d{1,2})?$/, "Must be a valid amount"),
    currency: z.enum(["ETB", "USD", "EUR"]),
    signedDate: z.string().optional(),
    startDate: z.string().optional(),
    endDate: z.string().optional(),
    status: z.enum(CONTRACT_STATUSES).default("DRAFT"),
  })
  .refine(
    (d) =>
      !d.startDate ||
      !d.endDate ||
      Date.parse(d.endDate) > Date.parse(d.startDate),
    { path: ["endDate"], message: "End date must be after start date" },
  );
export type ContractFormData = z.infer<typeof contractFormSchema>;
```

## 7.20 `src/features/procurement/procurement.api.ts`

```ts
import { api } from "@/lib/api/client";
import type {
  Procurement,
  Contract,
  SupplierPerformance,
  ProcurementDelay,
  ProcurementFilters,
  ContractFilters,
} from "./procurement.types";
import type {
  ProcurementFormData,
  ContractFormData,
} from "./procurement.schema";

interface Envelope<T> {
  data: T;
}

export const procurementApi = {
  async list(f: ProcurementFilters) {
    const p = new URLSearchParams();
    if (f.projectId) p.set("project_id", f.projectId);
    if (f.status?.length) p.set("status", f.status.join(","));
    if (f.method?.length) p.set("method", f.method.join(","));
    if (f.q) p.set("q", f.q);
    if (f.limit) p.set("limit", String(f.limit));
    if (f.cursor) p.set("cursor", f.cursor);
    const { data } = await api.get<
      Envelope<Procurement[]> & { pagination: any }
    >(`/procurement?${p.toString()}`);
    return { data: data.data, pagination: (data as any).pagination };
  },

  async create(input: ProcurementFormData): Promise<Procurement> {
    const { data } = await api.post<Envelope<Procurement>>(
      "/procurement",
      input,
    );
    return data.data;
  },

  async update(
    procurementId: string,
    patch: Partial<ProcurementFormData>,
  ): Promise<Procurement> {
    const { data } = await api.patch<Envelope<Procurement>>(
      `/procurement/${procurementId}`,
      patch,
    );
    return data.data;
  },

  async delays(projectId?: string): Promise<ProcurementDelay[]> {
    const p = projectId ? `?project_id=${projectId}` : "";
    const { data } = await api.get<Envelope<ProcurementDelay[]>>(
      `/procurement/delays${p}`,
    );
    return data.data;
  },

  async contracts(f: ContractFilters) {
    const p = new URLSearchParams();
    if (f.projectId) p.set("project_id", f.projectId);
    if (f.supplierId) p.set("supplier_id", f.supplierId);
    if (f.status?.length) p.set("status", f.status.join(","));
    if (f.q) p.set("q", f.q);
    if (f.limit) p.set("limit", String(f.limit));
    if (f.cursor) p.set("cursor", f.cursor);
    const { data } = await api.get<Envelope<Contract[]> & { pagination: any }>(
      `/contracts?${p.toString()}`,
    );
    return { data: data.data, pagination: (data as any).pagination };
  },

  async createContract(input: ContractFormData): Promise<Contract> {
    const { data } = await api.post<Envelope<Contract>>("/contracts", input);
    return data.data;
  },

  async updateContract(
    contractId: string,
    patch: Partial<ContractFormData>,
  ): Promise<Contract> {
    const { data } = await api.patch<Envelope<Contract>>(
      `/contracts/${contractId}`,
      patch,
    );
    return data.data;
  },

  async supplierPerformance(supplierId: string): Promise<SupplierPerformance> {
    const { data } = await api.get<Envelope<SupplierPerformance>>(
      `/suppliers/${supplierId}/performance`,
    );
    return data.data;
  },
};
```

## 7.21 `src/features/procurement/procurement.queries.ts`

```ts
import { useQuery, keepPreviousData } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { procurementApi } from "./procurement.api";
import type { ProcurementFilters, ContractFilters } from "./procurement.types";

export const procurementKeys = {
  all: ["procurement"] as const,
  list: (f: ProcurementFilters) => [...procurementKeys.all, "list", f] as const,
  delays: (projectId?: string) =>
    [...procurementKeys.all, "delays", projectId ?? "all"] as const,
  contracts: (f: ContractFilters) =>
    [...procurementKeys.all, "contracts", f] as const,
  supplierPerf: (id: string) =>
    [...procurementKeys.all, "supplier-perf", id] as const,
};

export function useProcurement(f: ProcurementFilters) {
  return useQuery({
    queryKey: procurementKeys.list(f),
    queryFn: () => procurementApi.list(f),
    placeholderData: keepPreviousData,
    staleTime: 30_000,
  });
}

export function useProcurementDelays(projectId?: string) {
  return useQuery({
    queryKey: procurementKeys.delays(projectId),
    queryFn: () => procurementApi.delays(projectId),
    refetchInterval: 60_000,
  });
}

export function useContracts(f: ContractFilters) {
  return useQuery({
    queryKey: procurementKeys.contracts(f),
    queryFn: () => procurementApi.contracts(f),
    placeholderData: keepPreviousData,
    staleTime: 30_000,
  });
}

export function useSupplierPerformance(supplierId: string | undefined) {
  return useQuery({
    queryKey: procurementKeys.supplierPerf(supplierId ?? ""),
    queryFn: () => procurementApi.supplierPerformance(supplierId!),
    enabled: !!supplierId,
  });
}
```

## 7.22 `src/features/procurement/procurement.mutations.ts`

```ts
import { useMutation, useQueryClient } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { procurementApi } from "./procurement.api";
import { procurementKeys } from "./procurement.queries";
import { useToast } from "@/components/ui/Toast";
import { normalizeApiError } from "@/lib/api/errors";
import type {
  ProcurementFormData,
  ContractFormData,
} from "./procurement.schema";

export function useCreateProcurement() {
  const qc = useQueryClient();
  const { push } = useToast();
  return useMutation({
    mutationFn: (input: ProcurementFormData) => procurementApi.create(input),
    onSuccess: () => {
      qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: procurementKeys.all });
      push("success", "Procurement line added");
    },
    onError: (err) =>
      push(
        "error",
        normalizeApiError(err).detail ?? "Failed to add procurement line",
      ),
  });
}

export function useCreateContract() {
  const qc = useQueryClient();
  const { push } = useToast();
  return useMutation({
    mutationFn: (input: ContractFormData) =>
      procurementApi.createContract(input),
    onSuccess: (c) => {
      qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: procurementKeys.all });
      push("success", `Contract ${c.contractNo} created`);
    },
    onError: (err) =>
      push(
        "error",
        normalizeApiError(err).detail ?? "Failed to create contract",
      ),
  });
}
```

## 7.23 `src/features/procurement/procurement.utils.ts`

```ts
import type { ChipTone } from "@/components/ui/Chip";
import type {
  ProcurementStatus,
  ContractStatus,
  ProcurementMethod,
} from "./procurement.types";

export function procurementStatusTone(s: ProcurementStatus): ChipTone {
  switch (s) {
    case "PLANNED":
      return "grey";
    case "ADVERTISED":
      return "blue";
    case "BID_OPEN":
      return "blue";
    case "EVALUATED":
      return "amber";
    case "AWARDED":
      return "green";
    case "CANCELLED":
      return "red";
  }
}

export function contractStatusTone(s: ContractStatus): ChipTone {
  switch (s) {
    case "DRAFT":
      return "grey";
    case "SIGNED":
      return "blue";
    case "ACTIVE":
      return "green";
    case "COMPLETED":
      return "teal";
    case "TERMINATED":
      return "red";
  }
}

export function methodTone(_m: ProcurementMethod): ChipTone {
  return "grey";
}

export function delaySeverityTone(
  s: "LOW" | "MEDIUM" | "HIGH" | "CRITICAL",
): ChipTone {
  return s === "CRITICAL" || s === "HIGH"
    ? "red"
    : s === "MEDIUM"
      ? "amber"
      : "grey";
}
```
