## 8.9 `src/features/beneficiaries/BeneficiaryFormModal.tsx`

```tsx
import { useState } from "react";
import { useForm } from "react-hook-form";
import { zodResolver } from "@hookform/resolvers/zod";
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";
import { MapPin } from "lucide-react";
import { Modal } from "@/components/ui/Modal";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/Button";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/Input";
import { Select } from "@/components/ui/Select";
import { DateInput } from "@/components/ui/DateInput";
import { Checkbox } from "@/components/ui/Checkbox";
import { Banner } from "@/components/ui/Banner";
import {
  beneficiaryWithConsentSchema,
  type BeneficiaryWithConsentFormData,
} from "./beneficiary.schema";
import { useCreateBeneficiary } from "./beneficiary.mutations";
import { beneficiaryApi } from "./beneficiary.api";
import { DuplicateWarningModal } from "./DuplicateWarningModal";
import { ETHIOPIAN_REGIONS } from "./beneficiary.utils";
import type { DuplicateCandidate } from "./beneficiary.types";

const CONSENT_VERSION = "v1.2";

export function BeneficiaryFormModal({
  open,
  onClose,
}: {
  open: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
}) {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const create = useCreateBeneficiary();
  const [gps, setGps] = useState<{ lat: number; lon: number } | null>(null);
  const [gpsError, setGpsError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [duplicates, setDuplicates] = useState<DuplicateCandidate[] | null>(
    null,
  );
  const [pendingSubmit, setPendingSubmit] =
    useState<BeneficiaryWithConsentFormData | null>(null);

  const {
    register,
    handleSubmit,
    formState: { errors },
    reset,
    setValue,
  } = useForm<BeneficiaryWithConsentFormData>({
    resolver: zodResolver(beneficiaryWithConsentSchema),
    defaultValues: {
      fullName: "",
      fullNameAm: "",
      gender: "FEMALE",
      phone: "",
      nationalId: "",
      householdSize: undefined,
      dateOfBirth: "",
      location: { region: "", zone: "", woreda: "", kebele: "" },
      registrationChannel: "WEB",
      consent: {
        participation: true as any,
        data_use: true as any,
        future_research: false,
        media: false,
        contact: false,
        consent_version: CONSENT_VERSION,
        language: "en",
      },
    },
  });

  const captureGps = () => {
    if (!navigator.geolocation) {
      setGpsError("Geolocation not supported");
      return;
    }
    navigator.geolocation.getCurrentPosition(
      (p) => {
        const coords = { lat: p.coords.latitude, lon: p.coords.longitude };
        setGps(coords);
        setValue("location.latitude", coords.lat);
        setValue("location.longitude", coords.lon);
        setGpsError(null);
      },
      (e) => setGpsError(e.message),
      { enableHighAccuracy: true, timeout: 10_000 },
    );
  };

  const onSubmit = async (v: BeneficiaryWithConsentFormData) => {
    // Pre-check duplicates
    const candidates = await beneficiaryApi.findDuplicates(v);
    const strong = candidates.filter((c) => c.dedupScore >= 0.7);
    if (strong.length > 0) {
      setDuplicates(strong);
      setPendingSubmit(v);
      return;
    }
    await create.mutateAsync(v);
    reset();
    setGps(null);
    onClose();
  };

  const confirmAnyway = async () => {
    if (!pendingSubmit) return;
    await create.mutateAsync(pendingSubmit);
    setDuplicates(null);
    setPendingSubmit(null);
    reset();
    setGps(null);
    onClose();
  };

  return (
    <>
      <Modal
        open={open}
        onClose={onClose}
        title={t("beneficiaries.form.title")}
        size="lg"
        footer={
          <>
            <Button variant="ghost" onClick={onClose}>
              {t("actions.cancel")}
            </Button>
            <Button
              variant="primary"
              loading={create.isPending}
              onClick={handleSubmit(onSubmit)}
            >
              {t("beneficiaries.form.register")}
            </Button>
          </>
        }
      >
        <form
          onSubmit={handleSubmit(onSubmit)}
          className="space-y-5"
          noValidate
        >
          {/* Identity */}
          <fieldset className="space-y-4">
            <legend className="text-h3 text-primary-900">
              {t("beneficiaries.form.section.identity")}
            </legend>
            <Input
              {...register("fullName")}
              label={t("beneficiaries.form.fullName")}
              required
              error={errors.fullName?.message}
              autoFocus
            />
            <Input
              {...register("fullNameAm")}
              label={t("beneficiaries.form.fullNameAm")}
            />
            <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-4">
              <Select
                {...register("gender")}
                label={t("beneficiaries.form.gender")}
                required
                error={errors.gender?.message}
                options={[
                  { value: "FEMALE", label: t("beneficiaries.gender.female") },
                  { value: "MALE", label: t("beneficiaries.gender.male") },
                  { value: "OTHER", label: t("beneficiaries.gender.other") },
                ]}
              />
              <DateInput
                {...register("dateOfBirth")}
                label={t("beneficiaries.form.dob")}
              />
              <Input
                {...register("householdSize", { valueAsNumber: true })}
                type="number"
                label={t("beneficiaries.form.householdSize")}
                error={errors.householdSize?.message}
              />
            </div>
            <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4">
              <Input
                {...register("phone")}
                label={t("beneficiaries.form.phone")}
                placeholder="+251911234567"
                error={errors.phone?.message}
              />
              <Input
                {...register("nationalId")}
                label={t("beneficiaries.form.nationalId")}
              />
            </div>
          </fieldset>

          {/* Location */}
          <fieldset className="space-y-4">
            <legend className="text-h3 text-primary-900">
              {t("beneficiaries.form.section.location")}
            </legend>
            <Select
              {...register("location.region")}
              label={t("beneficiaries.form.region")}
              required
              placeholder="—"
              error={errors.location?.region?.message}
              options={ETHIOPIAN_REGIONS.map((r) => ({ value: r, label: r }))}
            />
            <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-4">
              <Input
                {...register("location.zone")}
                label={t("beneficiaries.form.zone")}
              />
              <Input
                {...register("location.woreda")}
                label={t("beneficiaries.form.woreda")}
              />
              <Input
                {...register("location.kebele")}
                label={t("beneficiaries.form.kebele")}
              />
            </div>
            <div>
              <Button
                type="button"
                variant="secondary"
                size="sm"
                leftIcon={<MapPin className="h-4 w-4" />}
                onClick={captureGps}
              >
                {gps
                  ? t("beneficiaries.form.recapture")
                  : t("beneficiaries.form.captureGps")}
              </Button>
              {gps && (
                <span className="ml-3 text-caption text-green-700 font-semibold">
                  ✓ {gps.lat.toFixed(5)}, {gps.lon.toFixed(5)}
                </span>
              )}
              {gpsError && (
                <p role="alert" className="text-caption text-danger mt-1">
                  {gpsError}
                </p>
              )}
            </div>
          </fieldset>

          {/* Consent */}
          <fieldset className="space-y-3 border border-neutral-300 rounded-md p-4 bg-neutral-50">
            <legend className="text-h3 text-primary-900 px-2">
              {t("beneficiaries.form.section.consent")}
            </legend>
            <Banner tone="info">{t("beneficiaries.form.consentInfo")}</Banner>
            <Checkbox
              {...register("consent.participation")}
              label={t("beneficiaries.form.consent.participation")}
              error={errors.consent?.participation?.message}
            />
            <Checkbox
              {...register("consent.data_use")}
              label={t("beneficiaries.form.consent.dataUse")}
              error={errors.consent?.data_use?.message}
            />
            <Checkbox
              {...register("consent.future_research")}
              label={t("beneficiaries.form.consent.futureResearch")}
            />
            <Checkbox
              {...register("consent.media")}
              label={t("beneficiaries.form.consent.media")}
            />
            <Checkbox
              {...register("consent.contact")}
              label={t("beneficiaries.form.consent.contact")}
            />
          </fieldset>
        </form>
      </Modal>

      <DuplicateWarningModal
        open={!!duplicates}
        candidates={duplicates ?? []}
        onCancel={() => {
          setDuplicates(null);
          setPendingSubmit(null);
        }}
        onMerge={() => alert("Merge flow — coming in a follow-up")}
        onProceed={confirmAnyway}
        loading={create.isPending}
      />
    </>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import { AlertTriangle, Users } from "lucide-react";
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";
import { Modal } from "@/components/ui/Modal";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/Button";
import { Chip } from "@/components/ui/Chip";
import { dedupTone } from "./beneficiary.utils";
import type { DuplicateCandidate } from "./beneficiary.types";

export function DuplicateWarningModal({
  open,
  candidates,
  onCancel,
  onMerge,
  onProceed,
  loading,
}: {
  open: boolean;
  candidates: DuplicateCandidate[];
  onCancel: () => void;
  onMerge: (candidateId: string) => void;
  onProceed: () => void;
  loading?: boolean;
}) {
  const { t } = useTranslation();

  return (
    <Modal
      open={open}
      onClose={onCancel}
      title={t("beneficiaries.duplicate.title")}
      size="lg"
      footer={
        <>
          <Button variant="ghost" onClick={onCancel}>
            {t("actions.cancel")}
          </Button>
          <Button variant="secondary" loading={loading} onClick={onProceed}>
            {t("beneficiaries.duplicate.proceedAnyway")}
          </Button>
        </>
      }
    >
      <div className="space-y-4">
        <div className="flex gap-3 items-start">
          <AlertTriangle
            className="h-5 w-5 text-amber-600 mt-0.5 shrink-0"
            aria-hidden
          />
          <p className="text-body-sm text-neutral-600">
            {t("beneficiaries.duplicate.message", { count: candidates.length })}
          </p>
        </div>

        <ul className="space-y-2">
          {candidates.map((c) => (
            <li
              key={c.candidateId}
              className="border border-neutral-300 rounded-md p-3 flex items-start justify-between gap-3"
            >
              <div className="min-w-0">
                <div className="text-body-sm font-semibold truncate">
                  {c.fullName}
                </div>
                <div className="text-caption text-neutral-600">
                  <code>{c.uniqueId}</code> · {c.woreda}, {c.region}
                </div>
                <div className="text-caption text-neutral-500 mt-1">
                  {c.matchReasons.join(" · ")}
                </div>
              </div>
              <div className="text-right shrink-0">
                <Chip tone={dedupTone(c.dedupScore)}>
                  {(c.dedupScore * 100).toFixed(0)}% match
                </Chip>
                <Button
                  variant="ghost"
                  size="sm"
                  className="mt-1"
                  leftIcon={<Users className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />}
                  onClick={() => onMerge(c.candidateId)}
                >
                  {t("beneficiaries.duplicate.merge")}
                </Button>
              </div>
            </li>
          ))}
        </ul>
      </div>
    </Modal>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import { useParams, useNavigate } from "react-router-dom";
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";
import { ArrowLeft, MapPin, Phone, User } from "lucide-react";
import { useBeneficiary } from "./beneficiary.queries";
import { usePermissions } from "@/features/auth/usePermissions";
import { PERMISSIONS } from "@/features/auth/auth.types";
import { LoadingState } from "@/components/ui/LoadingState";
import { EmptyState } from "@/components/ui/EmptyState";
import { Card, CardHeader } from "@/components/ui/Card";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/Button";
import { Chip } from "@/components/ui/Chip";
import { Tabs } from "@/components/ui/Tabs";
import { VerificationPanel } from "./VerificationPanel";
import {
  beneficiaryStatusTone,
  beneficiaryStatusKey,
  maskPhone,
} from "./beneficiary.utils";
import { formatDate } from "@/lib/utils/date";

export default function BeneficiaryDetailPage() {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const { beneficiaryId } = useParams<{ beneficiaryId: string }>();
  const { data: b, isLoading, isError } = useBeneficiary(beneficiaryId);
  const { can } = usePermissions();

  if (isLoading) return <LoadingState message="Loading beneficiary…" />;
  if (isError || !b) {
    return <EmptyState title={t("beneficiaries.detail.notFound")} />;
  }

  return (
    <main id="main" tabIndex={-1} className="space-y-5">
      <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
        <Button
          variant="ghost"
          size="sm"
          leftIcon={<ArrowLeft className="h-4 w-4" />}
          onClick={() => navigate("/beneficiaries")}
        >
          {t("beneficiaries.detail.back")}
        </Button>
      </div>

      <header className="flex flex-wrap items-start justify-between gap-3">
        <div>
          <div className="text-caption text-neutral-600">
            <code className="font-bold text-primary-700">{b.uniqueId}</code>
          </div>
          <h1 className="text-h1 text-primary-900 mt-1">{b.fullName}</h1>
          {b.fullNameAm && (
            <p lang="am" className="text-body-sm text-neutral-600 mt-0.5">
              {b.fullNameAm}
            </p>
          )}
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 mt-3">
            <Chip tone={beneficiaryStatusTone(b.status)}>
              {t(beneficiaryStatusKey(b.status))}
            </Chip>
            <Chip tone="grey">{b.gender.toLowerCase()}</Chip>
            {b.ageYears && <Chip tone="grey">{b.ageYears} y</Chip>}
            <Chip tone="grey">{b.registrationChannel}</Chip>
          </div>
        </div>
      </header>

      <div className="grid lg:grid-cols-[1fr_360px] gap-4">
        <div className="min-w-0">
          <Tabs
            tabs={[
              {
                id: "profile",
                label: t("beneficiaries.detail.tabs.profile"),
                content: (
                  <Card>
                    <CardHeader title={t("beneficiaries.detail.profile")} />
                    <dl className="text-body-sm grid sm:grid-cols-2 gap-3">
                      <Row
                        icon={<User className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />}
                        label="Phone"
                        value={maskPhone(b.phone)}
                      />
                      <Row
                        icon={<MapPin className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />}
                        label="Region"
                        value={b.location.region}
                      />
                      <Row label="Zone" value={b.location.zone ?? "—"} />
                      <Row label="Woreda" value={b.location.woreda ?? "—"} />
                      <Row label="Kebele" value={b.location.kebele ?? "—"} />
                      <Row
                        label="Household size"
                        value={String(b.householdSize ?? "—")}
                      />
                      <Row
                        label="Registered"
                        value={formatDate(b.registrationDate)}
                      />
                      <Row
                        label="Verified"
                        value={b.verifiedAt ? formatDate(b.verifiedAt) : "—"}
                      />
                    </dl>
                  </Card>
                ),
              },
              {
                id: "deliveries",
                label: t("beneficiaries.detail.tabs.deliveries"),
                content: (
                  <Card>
                    <CardHeader
                      title={t("beneficiaries.detail.deliveries")}
                      subtitle={t("beneficiaries.detail.deliveriesHint")}
                    />
                    <p className="text-body-sm text-neutral-600">
                      {t("beneficiaries.detail.deliveriesEmpty")}
                    </p>
                  </Card>
                ),
              },
              {
                id: "grievances",
                label: t("beneficiaries.detail.tabs.grievances"),
                content: (
                  <Card>
                    <CardHeader title={t("beneficiaries.detail.grievances")} />
                    <p className="text-body-sm text-neutral-600">
                      {t("beneficiaries.detail.grievancesEmpty")}
                    </p>
                  </Card>
                ),
              },
            ]}
          />
        </div>

        <aside>
          {can(PERMISSIONS.beneficiaryVerify) && (
            <VerificationPanel beneficiary={b} />
          )}
        </aside>
      </div>
    </main>
  );
}

function Row({
  icon,
  label,
  value,
}: {
  icon?: React.ReactNode;
  label: string;
  value: string;
}) {
  return (
    <div>
      <dt className="text-caption text-neutral-600 inline-flex items-center gap-1">
        {icon}
        {label}
      </dt>
      <dd className="font-semibold text-neutral-900 mt-0.5">{value}</dd>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## 8.12 `src/features/beneficiaries/VerificationPanel.tsx`

```tsx
import { useState } from "react";
import { CheckCircle2, XCircle } from "lucide-react";
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";
import { Card, CardHeader } from "@/components/ui/Card";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/Button";
import { Textarea } from "@/components/ui/Textarea";
import { useVerifyBeneficiary } from "./beneficiary.mutations";
import type { Beneficiary } from "./beneficiary.types";

export function VerificationPanel({
  beneficiary,
}: {
  beneficiary: Beneficiary;
}) {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const verify = useVerifyBeneficiary();
  const [notes, setNotes] = useState("");

  const isVerified = beneficiary.status === "VERIFIED";

  return (
    <Card>
      <CardHeader
        title={t("beneficiaries.verify.title")}
        subtitle={t("beneficiaries.verify.subtitle")}
      />
      <div className="space-y-3">
        <Textarea
          label={t("beneficiaries.verify.notes")}
          rows={3}
          value={notes}
          onChange={(e) => setNotes(e.target.value)}
          placeholder={t("beneficiaries.verify.notesPlaceholder")}
        />
        <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2">
          <Button
            variant="primary"
            leftIcon={<CheckCircle2 className="h-4 w-4" />}
            disabled={isVerified}
            loading={verify.isPending}
            onClick={() =>
              verify.mutate({
                id: beneficiary.beneficiaryId,
                verified: true,
                notes,
              })
            }
          >
            {isVerified
              ? t("beneficiaries.verify.verified")
              : t("beneficiaries.verify.verify")}
          </Button>
          <Button
            variant="danger"
            leftIcon={<XCircle className="h-4 w-4" />}
            disabled={beneficiary.status === "INACTIVE"}
            loading={verify.isPending}
            onClick={() =>
              verify.mutate({
                id: beneficiary.beneficiaryId,
                verified: false,
                notes,
              })
            }
          >
            {t("beneficiaries.verify.reject")}
          </Button>
        </div>
        {isVerified && beneficiary.verifiedByName && (
          <p className="text-caption text-green-700 font-semibold">
            ✓{" "}
            {t("beneficiaries.verify.verifiedBy", {
              name: beneficiary.verifiedByName,
              date: beneficiary.verifiedAt
                ? beneficiary.verifiedAt.slice(0, 10)
                : "",
            })}
          </p>
        )}
      </div>
    </Card>
  );
}
```

```tsx
      {
        id: "serialNo",

        header: "Install date",

      {

            {data?.pagination?.totalCount ?? 0}{" "}
            {t("beneficiaries.deliveries.recorded")}
          </p>
        </div>
        {can(PERMISSIONS.serviceDeliveryWrite) && (
          <Button
            variant="primary"
            size="sm"
            leftIcon={<Plus className="h-4 w-4" />}
            onClick={() => setFormOpen(true)}
          >
            {t("beneficiaries.deliveries.add")}
          </Button>
        )}
      </header>

      {isLoading && <SkeletonTable rows={6} cols={columns.length} />}
      {!isLoading && (data?.data.length ?? 0) === 0 && (
        <EmptyState
          title={t("beneficiaries.deliveries.empty")}
          description={t("beneficiaries.deliveries.emptyHint")}
        />
      )}
      {!isLoading && (data?.data.length ?? 0) > 0 && (
        <DataGrid
          columns={columns}
          rows={data!.data.map((d) => ({ ...d, id: d.deliveryId }))}
          ariaLabel={t("beneficiaries.deliveries.title")}
        />
      )}

      <Modal
        open={formOpen}
        onClose={() => setFormOpen(false)}
        title={t("beneficiaries.deliveries.formTitle")}
        size="md"
      >
        <ServiceDeliveryForm onSuccess={() => setFormOpen(false)} />
      </Modal>
    </main>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import { useState } from "react";
import { useForm } from "react-hook-form";
import { zodResolver } from "@hookform/resolvers/zod";
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";
import { MapPin } from "lucide-react";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/Input";
import { Select } from "@/components/ui/Select";
import { DateInput } from "@/components/ui/DateInput";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/Button";
import { FileUpload } from "@/components/ui/FileUpload";
import {
  serviceDeliverySchema,
  type ServiceDeliveryFormData,
} from "./beneficiary.schema";
import { useCreateServiceDelivery } from "./beneficiary.mutations";
import { useBeneficiaries } from "./beneficiary.queries";
import { useProjects } from "@/features/projects/project.queries";

export function ServiceDeliveryForm({ onSuccess }: { onSuccess?: () => void }) {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const submit = useCreateServiceDelivery();
  const { data: beneficiaries } = useBeneficiaries({ limit: 200 });
  const { data: projects } = useProjects({
    limit: 200,
    status: ["APPROVED", "ACTIVE"] as any,
  });
  const [gps, setGps] = useState<{ lat: number; lon: number } | null>(null);
  const [photo, setPhoto] = useState<File | null>(null);

  const {
    register,
    handleSubmit,
    formState: { errors },
    reset,
    setValue,
  } = useForm<ServiceDeliveryFormData>({
    resolver: zodResolver(serviceDeliverySchema),
    defaultValues: {
      beneficiaryId: "",
      projectId: "",
      supplierId: "",
      productId: "",
      productName: "",
      serialNo: "",
      quantity: 1,
      installDate: new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10),
      warrantyStart: "",
      warrantyEnd: "",
    },
  });

  const captureGps = () => {
    if (!navigator.geolocation) return;
    navigator.geolocation.getCurrentPosition((p) => {
      const coords = { lat: p.coords.latitude, lon: p.coords.longitude };
      setGps(coords);
      setValue("installGps", coords);
    });
  };

  const onSubmit = async (v: ServiceDeliveryFormData) => {
    await submit.mutateAsync({ input: v, photo: photo ?? undefined });
    reset();
    setGps(null);
    setPhoto(null);
    onSuccess?.();
  };

  return (
    <form onSubmit={handleSubmit(onSubmit)} className="space-y-4" noValidate>
      <Select
        {...register("beneficiaryId")}
        label={t("beneficiaries.deliveries.form.beneficiary")}
        required
        placeholder="—"
        error={errors.beneficiaryId?.message}
        options={(beneficiaries?.data ?? []).map((b) => ({
          value: b.beneficiaryId,
          label: `${b.uniqueId} · ${b.fullName}`,
        }))}
      />
      <Select
        {...register("projectId")}
        label={t("beneficiaries.deliveries.form.project")}
        required
        placeholder="—"
        error={errors.projectId?.message}
        options={(projects?.data ?? []).map((p) => ({
          value: p.projectId,
          label: `${p.projectCode} · ${p.name}`,
        }))}
      />
      <Input
        {...register("productName")}
        label={t("beneficiaries.deliveries.form.product")}
        required
        error={errors.productName?.message}
        placeholder="Solar Home System 100W"
      />
      <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4">
        <Input
          {...register("serialNo")}
          label={t("beneficiaries.deliveries.form.serial")}
        />
        <Input
          {...register("quantity", { valueAsNumber: true })}
          type="number"
          label={t("beneficiaries.deliveries.form.quantity")}
          error={errors.quantity?.message}
        />
      </div>
      <DateInput
        {...register("installDate")}
        label={t("beneficiaries.deliveries.form.installDate")}
      />
      <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4">
        <DateInput
          {...register("warrantyStart")}
          label={t("beneficiaries.deliveries.form.warrantyStart")}
        />
        <DateInput
          {...register("warrantyEnd")}
          label={t("beneficiaries.deliveries.form.warrantyEnd")}
          error={errors.warrantyEnd?.message}
        />
      </div>
      <div>
        <Button
          type="button"
          variant="secondary"
          size="sm"
          leftIcon={<MapPin className="h-4 w-4" />}
          onClick={captureGps}
        >
          {gps
            ? t("beneficiaries.deliveries.form.recaptureGps")
            : t("beneficiaries.deliveries.form.captureGps")}
        </Button>
        {gps && (
          <span className="ml-3 text-caption text-green-700 font-semibold">
            ✓ {gps.lat.toFixed(5)}, {gps.lon.toFixed(5)}
          </span>
        )}
      </div>
      <FileUpload
        label={t("beneficiaries.deliveries.form.photo")}
        accept="image/*"
        maxSizeMB={5}
        files={photo ? [photo] : []}
        onFiles={(fs) => setPhoto(fs[0] ?? null)}
      />
      <div className="flex justify-end gap-2">
        <Button variant="ghost" type="button" onClick={onSuccess}>
          {t("actions.cancel")}
        </Button>
        <Button variant="primary" type="submit" loading={submit.isPending}>
          {t("actions.save")}
        </Button>
      </div>
    </form>
  );
}
```

## 8.17 `src/features/geo/geo.api.ts`

```ts
import { api } from "@/lib/api/client";
import type {
  BeneficiaryMarker,
  InterventionMarker,
  GeoFilters,
  GeoVerifyRequest,
  GeoVerifyResponse,
  GeoPoint,
} from "./geo.types";

interface Envelope<T> {
  data: T;
}

export const geoApi = {
  async beneficiaries(f: GeoFilters): Promise<BeneficiaryMarker[]> {
    const p = new URLSearchParams();
    if (f.bounds) {
      p.set(
        "bbox",
        `${f.bounds.west},${f.bounds.south},${f.bounds.east},${f.bounds.north}`,
      );
    }
    if (f.region) p.set("region", f.region);
    if (f.woreda) p.set("woreda", f.woreda);
    if (f.status?.length) p.set("status", f.status.join(","));
    const { data } = await api.get<Envelope<BeneficiaryMarker[]>>(
      `/geo/beneficiaries?${p.toString()}`,
    );
    return data.data;
  },

  async interventions(f: GeoFilters): Promise<InterventionMarker[]> {
    const p = new URLSearchParams();
    if (f.bounds) {
      p.set(
        "bbox",
        `${f.bounds.west},${f.bounds.south},${f.bounds.east},${f.bounds.north}`,
      );
    }
    if (f.projectId) p.set("project_id", f.projectId);
    const { data } = await api.get<Envelope<InterventionMarker[]>>(
      `/geo/interventions?${p.toString()}`,
    );
    return data.data;
  },

  async verify(req: GeoVerifyRequest): Promise<GeoVerifyResponse> {
    const { data } = await api.post<Envelope<GeoVerifyResponse>>(
      "/geo/verify",
      req,
    );
    return data.data;
  },

  async geocode(query: string): Promise<GeoPoint | null> {
    const { data } = await api.get<Envelope<GeoPoint | null>>(
      `/geo/geocode?q=${encodeURIComponent(query)}`,
    );
    return data.data;
  },
};
```

## 8.18 `src/features/geo/geo.queries.ts`

```ts
import { useQuery, keepPreviousData } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { geoApi } from "./geo.api";
import type { GeoFilters } from "./geo.types";

export const geoKeys = {
  all: ["geo"] as const,
  beneficiaries: (f: GeoFilters) =>
    [...geoKeys.all, "beneficiaries", f] as const,
  interventions: (f: GeoFilters) =>
    [...geoKeys.all, "interventions", f] as const,
};

export function useGeoBeneficiaries(f: GeoFilters) {
  return useQuery({
    queryKey: geoKeys.beneficiaries(f),
    queryFn: () => geoApi.beneficiaries(f),
    placeholderData: keepPreviousData,
    staleTime: 60_000,
    enabled: f.layer === "beneficiaries" || f.layer === "heatmap",
  });
}

export function useGeoInterventions(f: GeoFilters) {
  return useQuery({
    queryKey: geoKeys.interventions(f),
    queryFn: () => geoApi.interventions(f),
    placeholderData: keepPreviousData,
    staleTime: 60_000,
    enabled: f.layer === "interventions",
  });
}
```

## 8.19 `src/features/geo/MapPage.tsx`

Uses **react-leaflet**. Add CSS import for Leaflet marker icons at the top of the file.

```tsx
import { useCallback, useMemo, useState } from "react";
import {
  MapContainer,
  TileLayer,
  Marker,
  Popup,
  CircleMarker,
  LayersControl,
  useMapEvents,
} from "react-leaflet";
import L from "leaflet";
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";
import "leaflet/dist/leaflet.css";
import { useGeoBeneficiaries, useGeoInterventions } from "./geo.queries";
import { MapControls } from "./MapControls";
import { Card, CardHeader } from "@/components/ui/Card";
import { Chip } from "@/components/ui/Chip";
import { formatDate } from "@/lib/utils/date";
import type { GeoFilters, MapBounds } from "./geo.types";

/* Fix Leaflet default marker icons under Vite */
delete (L.Icon.Default.prototype as any)._getIconUrl;
L.Icon.Default.mergeOptions({
  iconRetinaUrl:
    "https://unpkg.com/leaflet@1.9.4/dist/images/marker-icon-2x.png",
  iconUrl: "https://unpkg.com/leaflet@1.9.4/dist/images/marker-icon.png",
  shadowUrl: "https://unpkg.com/leaflet@1.9.4/dist/images/marker-shadow.png",
});

/* Ethiopia bbox */
const DEFAULT_CENTER: [number, number] = [9.145, 40.489];
const DEFAULT_ZOOM = 6;

export default function MapPage() {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const [layer, setLayer] = useState<GeoFilters["layer"]>("beneficiaries");
  const [bounds, setBounds] = useState<MapBounds | undefined>(undefined);

  const filters: GeoFilters = useMemo(
    () => ({ layer, bounds }),
    [layer, bounds],
  );

  const { data: beneficiaries } = useGeoBeneficiaries(filters);
  const { data: interventions } = useGeoInterventions(filters);

  const onBoundsChange = useCallback((b: MapBounds) => setBounds(b), []);

  return (
    <main id="main" tabIndex={-1} className="space-y-4">
      <header className="flex flex-wrap items-start justify-between gap-3">
        <div>
          <h1 className="text-h1 text-primary-900">{t("geo.title")}</h1>
          <p className="text-body-sm text-neutral-600 mt-1">
            {t("geo.subtitle")}
          </p>
        </div>
      </header>

      <MapControls layer={layer} onLayerChange={setLayer} />

      <div className="grid lg:grid-cols-[1fr_320px] gap-4">
        <div
          className="rounded-md border border-neutral-300 overflow-hidden"
          style={{ height: 620 }}
        >
          <MapContainer
            center={DEFAULT_CENTER}
            zoom={DEFAULT_ZOOM}
            style={{ height: "100%", width: "100%" }}
            scrollWheelZoom
          >
            <TileLayer
              url="https://{s}.tile.openstreetmap.org/{z}/{x}/{y}.png"
              attribution="&copy; OpenStreetMap contributors"
            />

            <BoundsWatcher onBoundsChange={onBoundsChange} />

            <LayersControl position="topright">
              <LayersControl.Overlay
                checked
                name={t("geo.layers.beneficiaries")}
              >
                <MarkersLayer
                  markers={(beneficiaries ?? []).map((b) => ({
                    id: b.beneficiaryId,
                    lat: b.lat,
                    lon: b.lon,
                    title: b.fullName,
                    subtitle: `${b.uniqueId} · ${b.woreda ?? ""}`,
                  }))}
                />
              </LayersControl.Overlay>
              <LayersControl.Overlay name={t("geo.layers.interventions")}>
                <MarkersLayer
                  markers={(interventions ?? []).map((m) => ({
                    id: m.deliveryId,
                    lat: m.lat,
                    lon: m.lon,
                    title: m.productName,
                    subtitle: `${m.serialNo ?? ""} · ${m.projectCode ?? ""}`,
                  }))}
                  color="blue"
                />
              </LayersControl.Overlay>
            </LayersControl>
          </MapContainer>
        </div>

        <aside className="space-y-4">
          <Card>
            <CardHeader title={t("geo.stats.title")} />
            <ul className="text-body-sm space-y-1.5">
              <Row
                label={t("geo.stats.beneficiaries")}
                value={String(beneficiaries?.length ?? 0)}
              />
              <Row
                label={t("geo.stats.interventions")}
                value={String(interventions?.length ?? 0)}
              />
              {bounds && (
                <Row
                  label={t("geo.stats.view")}
                  value={`${bounds.south.toFixed(2)}°S · ${bounds.north.toFixed(2)}°N`}
                />
              )}
            </ul>
          </Card>

          <Card>
            <CardHeader title={t("geo.legend.title")} />
            <ul className="text-caption space-y-1.5">
              <li>
                <span
                  aria-hidden
                  className="inline-block h-2.5 w-2.5 rounded-full bg-primary-700 mr-2"
                />
                {t("geo.legend.registered")}
              </li>
              <li>
                <span
                  aria-hidden
                  className="inline-block h-2.5 w-2.5 rounded-full bg-green-500 mr-2"
                />
                {t("geo.legend.verified")}
              </li>
              <li>
                <span
                  aria-hidden
                  className="inline-block h-2.5 w-2.5 rounded-full bg-blue-500 mr-2"
                />
                {t("geo.legend.intervention")}
              </li>
            </ul>
          </Card>
        </aside>
      </div>
    </main>
  );
}

/* ---- Sub-components ---- */

function BoundsWatcher({
  onBoundsChange,
}: {
  onBoundsChange: (b: MapBounds) => void;
}) {
  useMapEvents({
    moveend: (e) => {
      const b = e.target.getBounds();
      onBoundsChange({
        north: b.getNorth(),
        south: b.getSouth(),
        east: b.getEast(),
        west: b.getWest(),
      });
    },
  });
  return null;
}

function MarkersLayer({
  markers,
  color = "default",
}: {
  markers: {
    id: string;
    lat: number;
    lon: number;
    title: string;
    subtitle: string;
  }[];
  color?: "default" | "blue";
}) {
  return (
    <>
      {markers.map((m) => {
        if (color === "blue") {
          return (
            <CircleMarker
              key={m.id}
              center={[m.lat, m.lon]}
              radius={5}
              pathOptions={{
                color: "#1E4976",
                fillColor: "#2563EB",
                fillOpacity: 0.8,
              }}
            >
              <Popup>
                <div className="text-caption">
                  <div className="font-bold">{m.title}</div>
                  <div className="text-neutral-600">{m.subtitle}</div>
                </div>
              </Popup>
            </CircleMarker>
          );
        }
        return (
          <Marker key={m.id} position={[m.lat, m.lon]}>
            <Popup>
              <div className="text-caption">
                <div className="font-bold">{m.title}</div>
                <div className="text-neutral-600">{m.subtitle}</div>
              </div>
            </Popup>
          </Marker>
        );
      })}
    </>
  );
}

function Row({ label, value }: { label: string; value: string }) {
  return (
    <li className="flex justify-between gap-3">
      <span className="text-neutral-600">{label}</span>
      <span className="font-semibold">{value}</span>
    </li>
  );
}
```

```tsx
  value?: { lat: number; lon: number };
  onChange: (v: { lat: number; lon: number }) => void;
}

export function LocationPicker({ value, onChange }: LocationPickerProps) {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const [marker, setMarker] = useState<
    { lat: number; lon: number } | undefined
  >(value);
  const [gpsError, setGpsError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const set = (lat: number, lon: number) => {
    setMarker({ lat, lon });
    onChange({ lat, lon });
  };

  const useCurrentGps = () => {
    if (!navigator.geolocation) {
      setGpsError("Geolocation unsupported");
      return;
    }
    navigator.geolocation.getCurrentPosition(
      (p) => set(p.coords.latitude, p.coords.longitude),
      (e) => setGpsError(e.message),
      { enableHighAccuracy: true },
    );
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-3">
      <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
        <Input
          label="Latitude"
          type="number"
          step="0.0000001"
          value={marker?.lat ?? ""}
          onChange={(e) => set(Number(e.target.value), marker?.lon ?? 0)}
        />
        <Input
          label="Longitude"
          type="number"
          step="0.0000001"
          value={marker?.lon ?? ""}
          onChange={(e) => set(marker?.lat ?? 0, Number(e.target.value))}
        />
      </div>

      <Button
        type="button"
        variant="secondary"
        size="sm"
        leftIcon={<MapPin className="h-4 w-4" />}
        onClick={useCurrentGps}
      >
        {t("geo.picker.useGps")}
      </Button>
      {gpsError && (
        <p role="alert" className="text-caption text-danger">
          {gpsError}
        </p>
      )}

      <div
        className="rounded-md overflow-hidden border border-neutral-300"
        style={{ height: 260 }}
      >
        <MapContainer
          center={marker ? [marker.lat, marker.lon] : [9.145, 40.489]}
          zoom={marker ? 12 : 6}
          style={{ height: "100%", width: "100%" }}
        >
          <TileLayer
            url="https://{s}.tile.openstreetmap.org/{z}/{x}/{y}.png"
            attribution="&copy; OSM"
          />
          <ClickCatcher onClick={set} />
          {marker && <Marker position={[marker.lat, marker.lon]} />}
        </MapContainer>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

function ClickCatcher({
  onClick,
}: {
  onClick: (lat: number, lon: number) => void;
}) {
  useMapEvents({
    click: (e) => onClick(e.latlng.lat, e.latlng.lng),
  });
  return null;
}
```

```tsx
import { useState } from "react";
import { MapPin, CheckCircle2, XCircle } from "lucide-react";
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";
import { Card, CardHeader } from "@/components/ui/Card";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/Button";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/Input";
import { geoApi } from "./geo.api";
import { useToast } from "@/components/ui/Toast";

export function GeoVerifyPanel({
  entityType,
  entityId,
  claimed,
}: {
  entityType: "BENEFICIARY" | "SERVICE_DELIVERY";
  entityId: string;
  claimed: { lat: number; lon: number };
}) {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const { push } = useToast();
  const [tolerance, setTolerance] = useState(500);
  const [result, setResult] = useState<{
    match: boolean;
    distanceMeters: number;
  } | null>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);

  const verify = async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const r = await geoApi.verify({
        entityType,
        entityId,
        claimedLocation: claimed,
        toleranceMeters: tolerance,
      });
      setResult(r);
      push(
        r.match ? "success" : "warning",
        r.match ? "Location verified" : "Location outside tolerance",
      );
    } catch {
      push("error", "Verification failed");
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <Card>
      <CardHeader
        title={t("geo.verify.title")}
        subtitle={t("geo.verify.subtitle")}
      />
      <div className="space-y-3">
        <Input
          label={t("geo.verify.tolerance")}
          type="number"
          value={tolerance}
          onChange={(e) => setTolerance(Number(e.target.value))}
          hint="Meters"
        />
        <Button
          variant="primary"
          leftIcon={<MapPin className="h-4 w-4" />}
          loading={loading}
          onClick={verify}
        >
          {t("geo.verify.run")}
        </Button>

        {result && (
          <div
            role="status"
            className={`flex items-center gap-2 text-body-sm font-semibold ${result.match ? "text-green-700" : "text-red-700"}`}
          >
            {result.match ? (
              <CheckCircle2 className="h-4 w-4" aria-hidden />
            ) : (
              <XCircle className="h-4 w-4" aria-hidden />
            )}
            {result.match
              ? t("geo.verify.match", {
                  distance: result.distanceMeters.toFixed(0),
                })
              : t("geo.verify.mismatch", {
                  distance: result.distanceMeters.toFixed(0),
                })}
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </Card>
  );
}
```

## 8.24 `src/features/documents/document.schema.ts`

```ts
import { z } from "zod";
import { DOC_TYPES, ACCESS_LEVELS } from "./document.types";

export const MAX_FILE_SIZE_MB = 25;
const ACCEPTED_MIMES = [
  "application/pdf",
  "application/msword",
  "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document",
  "application/vnd.ms-excel",
  "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet",
  "image/png",
  "image/jpeg",
  "application/zip",
];

export const documentUploadSchema = z.object({
  projectId: z.string().uuid().optional().or(z.literal("")),
  docType: z.enum(DOC_TYPES),
  title: z.string().trim().min(3, "Title is required").max(300),
  description: z.string().trim().max(1000).optional().or(z.literal("")),
  accessLevel: z.enum(ACCESS_LEVELS).default("INTERNAL"),
  tags: z.array(z.string()).optional(),
});
export type DocumentUploadFormData = z.infer<typeof documentUploadSchema>;

export function validateFile(file: File): string | null {
  if (file.size / 1024 / 1024 > MAX_FILE_SIZE_MB)
    return `File exceeds ${MAX_FILE_SIZE_MB} MB`;
  if (!ACCEPTED_MIMES.includes(file.type))
    return `Unsupported file type: ${file.type || "unknown"}`;
  return null;
}
```

## 8.25 `src/features/documents/document.api.ts`

```ts
import { api } from "@/lib/api/client";
import type {
  DocumentMeta,
  DocumentFilters,
  DocumentVersion,
} from "./document.types";
import type { DocumentUploadFormData } from "./document.schema";

interface Envelope<T> {
  data: T;
}

function filtersToParams(f: DocumentFilters): string {
  const p = new URLSearchParams();
  if (f.projectId) p.set("project_id", f.projectId);
  if (f.docType?.length) p.set("doc_type", f.docType.join(","));
  if (f.q) p.set("q", f.q);
  if (f.from) p.set("from", f.from);
  if (f.to) p.set("to", f.to);
  if (f.limit) p.set("limit", String(f.limit));
  if (f.cursor) p.set("cursor", f.cursor);
  return p.toString();
}

export const documentApi = {
  async list(f: DocumentFilters) {
    const { data } = await api.get<
      Envelope<DocumentMeta[]> & { pagination: any }
    >(`/documents?${filtersToParams(f)}`);
    return { data: data.data, pagination: (data as any).pagination };
  },

  async get(docId: string): Promise<DocumentMeta> {
    const { data } = await api.get<Envelope<DocumentMeta>>(
      `/documents/${docId}`,
    );
    return data.data;
  },

  async upload(
    input: DocumentUploadFormData,
    file: File,
  ): Promise<DocumentMeta> {
    const fd = new FormData();
    Object.entries(input).forEach(([k, v]) => {
      if (v == null || v === "") return;
      fd.append(k, Array.isArray(v) ? v.join(",") : String(v));
    });
    fd.append("file", file);
    const { data } = await api.post<Envelope<DocumentMeta>>("/documents", fd, {
      headers: { "Content-Type": "multipart/form-data" },
      timeout: 120_000,
    });
    return data.data;
  },

  async versions(docId: string): Promise<DocumentVersion[]> {
    const { data } = await api.get<Envelope<DocumentVersion[]>>(
      `/documents/${docId}/versions`,
    );
    return data.data;
  },

  async signedUrl(docId: string): Promise<{ url: string; expiresAt: string }> {
    const { data } = await api.get<
      Envelope<{ url: string; expiresAt: string }>
    >(`/documents/${docId}/download`);
    return data.data;
  },

  async restoreVersion(
    docId: string,
    versionId: string,
  ): Promise<DocumentMeta> {
    const { data } = await api.post<Envelope<DocumentMeta>>(
      `/documents/${docId}/restore`,
      { version_id: versionId },
    );
    return data.data;
  },
};
```

```ts
import { useQuery, keepPreviousData } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { documentApi } from "./document.api";
import type { DocumentFilters } from "./document.types";

export const documentKeys = {
  all: ["documents"] as const,
  list: (f: DocumentFilters) => [...documentKeys.all, "list", f] as const,
  detail: (id: string) => [...documentKeys.all, "detail", id] as const,
  versions: (id: string) => [...documentKeys.all, "versions", id] as const,
};

export function useDocuments(f: DocumentFilters) {
  return useQuery({
    queryKey: documentKeys.list(f),
    queryFn: () => documentApi.list(f),
    placeholderData: keepPreviousData,
    staleTime: 30_000,
  });
}

export function useDocument(docId: string | undefined) {
  return useQuery({
    queryKey: documentKeys.detail(docId ?? ""),
    queryFn: () => documentApi.get(docId!),
    enabled: !!docId,
  });
}

export function useDocumentVersions(docId: string | undefined) {
  return useQuery({
    queryKey: documentKeys.versions(docId ?? ""),
    queryFn: () => documentApi.versions(docId!),
    enabled: !!docId,
  });
}
```

## 8.27 `src/features/documents/document.mutations.ts`

```ts
import { useMutation, useQueryClient } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { documentApi } from "./document.api";
import { documentKeys } from "./document.queries";
import { useToast } from "@/components/ui/Toast";
import { normalizeApiError } from "@/lib/api/errors";
import type { DocumentUploadFormData } from "./document.schema";

export function useUploadDocument() {
  const qc = useQueryClient();
  const { push } = useToast();
  return useMutation({
    mutationFn: ({
      input,
      file,
    }: {
      input: DocumentUploadFormData;
      file: File;
    }) => documentApi.upload(input, file),
    onSuccess: (d) => {
      qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: documentKeys.all });
      push("success", `Document "${d.title}" uploaded`);
    },
    onError: (err) =>
      push("error", normalizeApiError(err).detail ?? "Upload failed"),
  });
}

export function useRestoreVersion(docId: string) {
  const qc = useQueryClient();
  const { push } = useToast();
  return useMutation({
    mutationFn: (versionId: string) =>
      documentApi.restoreVersion(docId, versionId),
    onSuccess: () => {
      qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: documentKeys.all });
      push("success", "Version restored");
    },
  });
}
```

```tsx
import { useMemo, useState } from "react";
import { useSearchParams } from "react-router-dom";
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";
import {
  Plus,
  FileText,
  FileSpreadsheet,
  FileImage,
  FileArchive,
  Download,
} from "lucide-react";
import { useDocuments } from "./document.queries";
import { usePermissions } from "@/features/auth/usePermissions";
import { PERMISSIONS } from "@/features/auth/auth.types";
import { DataGrid, type Column } from "@/components/ui/DataGrid";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/Button";
import { Chip } from "@/components/ui/Chip";
import { Pagination } from "@/components/ui/Pagination";
import { EmptyState } from "@/components/ui/EmptyState";
import { SkeletonTable } from "@/components/ui/Skeleton";
import { Drawer } from "@/components/ui/Drawer";
import { DocumentUploadModal } from "./DocumentUploadModal";
import { DocumentPreviewPanel } from "./DocumentPreviewPanel";
import { DOC_TYPES, type DocumentMeta, type DocType } from "./document.types";
import { formatDate } from "@/lib/utils/date";

function fileIcon(mime: string) {
  if (mime.includes("pdf")) return FileText;
  if (mime.includes("sheet") || mime.includes("excel")) return FileSpreadsheet;
  if (mime.includes("image")) return FileImage;
  if (mime.includes("zip")) return FileArchive;
  return FileText;
}

function fileSize(bytes: number): string {
  if (bytes < 1024) return `${bytes} B`;
  if (bytes < 1024 * 1024) return `${(bytes / 1024).toFixed(0)} KB`;
  return `${(bytes / 1024 / 1024).toFixed(1)} MB`;
}

export default function DocumentsPage() {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const [params, setParams] = useSearchParams();
  const { can } = usePermissions();
  const [uploadOpen, setUploadOpen] = useState(false);
  const [selected, setSelected] = useState<DocumentMeta | null>(null);

  const q = params.get("q") ?? "";
  const docType = (params.get("docType")?.split(",").filter(Boolean) ??
    []) as DocType[];
  const projectId = params.get("projectId") ?? undefined;
  const pageSize = Math.min(200, Math.max(1, Number(params.get("size") ?? 25)));

  const { data, isLoading } = useDocuments({
    q: q || undefined,
    docType: docType.length ? docType : undefined,
    projectId,
    limit: pageSize,
  });

  const columns: Column<DocumentMeta & { id: string }>[] = useMemo(
    () => [
      {
        id: "title",
        header: t("documents.columns.title"),
        render: (r) => {
          const Icon = fileIcon(r.mimeType);
          return (
            <div className="flex items-start gap-2 min-w-0">
              <Icon
                className="h-4 w-4 text-primary-700 mt-0.5 shrink-0"
                aria-hidden
              />
              <div className="min-w-0">
                <div className="font-semibold truncate">{r.title}</div>
                {r.projectCode && (
                  <div className="text-caption text-neutral-600">
                    <code>{r.projectCode}</code>
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>
            </div>
          );
        },
      },
      {
        id: "docType",
        header: t("documents.columns.type"),
        render: (r) => <Chip tone="blue">{r.docType}</Chip>,
      },
      {
        id: "version",
        header: t("documents.columns.version"),
        align: "center",
        render: (r) => (
          <code className="text-caption font-bold">v{r.version}</code>
        ),
      },
      {
        id: "fileSize",
        header: t("documents.columns.size"),
        align: "right",
        render: (r) => (
          <span className="text-caption">{fileSize(r.fileSize)}</span>
        ),
      },
      {
        id: "uploadedAt",
        header: t("documents.columns.uploaded"),
        render: (r) => (
          <span className="text-caption">{formatDate(r.uploadedAt)}</span>
        ),
      },
      {
        id: "uploadedByName",
        header: t("documents.columns.uploader"),
        render: (r) => <span className="text-caption">{r.uploadedByName}</span>,
      },
      {
        id: "accessLevel",
        header: t("documents.columns.access"),
        render: (r) => (
          <Chip
            tone={
              r.accessLevel === "PUBLIC"
                ? "green"
                : r.accessLevel === "RESTRICTED"
                  ? "red"
                  : "grey"
            }
          >
            {r.accessLevel}
          </Chip>
        ),
      },
    ],
    [t],
  );

  const updateParams = (patch: Record<string, string | undefined>) => {
    const next = new URLSearchParams(params);
    Object.entries(patch).forEach(([k, v]) => {
      if (v == null || v === "") next.delete(k);
      else next.set(k, v);
    });
    setParams(next, { replace: true });
  };

  const toggleType = (dt: DocType) => {
    const next = docType.includes(dt)
      ? docType.filter((x) => x !== dt)
      : [...docType, dt];
    updateParams({ docType: next.length ? next.join(",") : undefined });
  };

  return (
    <main id="main" tabIndex={-1} className="space-y-5">
      <header className="flex flex-wrap items-start justify-between gap-3">
        <div>
          <h1 className="text-h1 text-primary-900">{t("documents.title")}</h1>
          <p className="text-body-sm text-neutral-600 mt-1">
            {data?.pagination?.totalCount ?? 0} {t("documents.files")}
          </p>
        </div>
        {can(PERMISSIONS.docWrite) && (
          <Button
            variant="primary"
            size="sm"
            leftIcon={<Plus className="h-4 w-4" />}
            onClick={() => setUploadOpen(true)}
          >
            {t("documents.upload")}
          </Button>
        )}
      </header>

      <section className="bg-white border border-neutral-300 rounded-md p-3 flex flex-wrap gap-2 items-center">
        {DOC_TYPES.map((dt) => {
          const active = docType.includes(dt);
          return (
            <button
              key={dt}
              type="button"
              aria-pressed={active}
              onClick={() => toggleType(dt)}
              className="focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-info focus-visible:ring-offset-2 rounded-full"
            >
              <Chip tone={active ? "blue" : "grey"}>{dt}</Chip>
            </button>
          );
        })}
        {docType.length > 0 && (
          <Button
            variant="ghost"
            size="sm"
            onClick={() => updateParams({ docType: undefined })}
          >
            {t("documents.clear")}
          </Button>
        )}
      </section>

      {isLoading && <SkeletonTable rows={6} cols={columns.length} />}
      {!isLoading && (data?.data.length ?? 0) === 0 && (
        <EmptyState
          title={t("documents.empty")}
          description={t("documents.emptyHint")}
        />
      )}
      {!isLoading && (data?.data.length ?? 0) > 0 && (
        <>
          <DataGrid
            columns={columns}
            rows={data!.data.map((d) => ({ ...d, id: d.docId }))}
            onRowClick={setSelected}
            ariaLabel={t("documents.title")}
          />
          <Pagination
            page={1}
            pageSize={pageSize}
            total={data!.pagination?.totalCount ?? 0}
            onPageChange={() => {
              /* cursor-based */
            }}
            onPageSizeChange={(s) => updateParams({ size: String(s) })}
          />
        </>
      )}

      <DocumentUploadModal
        open={uploadOpen}
        onClose={() => setUploadOpen(false)}
        defaultProjectId={projectId}
      />

      <Drawer
        open={!!selected}
        onClose={() => setSelected(null)}
        title={selected?.title ?? ""}
        width="max-w-xl"
      >
        {selected && <DocumentPreviewPanel document={selected} />}
      </Drawer>
    </main>
  );
}
```

## 8.29 `src/features/documents/DocumentUploadModal.tsx`

```tsx
import { useState } from "react";
import { useForm } from "react-hook-form";
import { zodResolver } from "@hookform/resolvers/zod";
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";
import { Modal } from "@/components/ui/Modal";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/Button";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/Input";
import { Select } from "@/components/ui/Select";
import { Textarea } from "@/components/ui/Textarea";
import { FileUpload } from "@/components/ui/FileUpload";
import {
  documentUploadSchema,
  validateFile,
  MAX_FILE_SIZE_MB,
  type DocumentUploadFormData,
} from "./document.schema";
import { useUploadDocument } from "./document.mutations";
import { DOC_TYPES, ACCESS_LEVELS } from "./document.types";
import { useProjects } from "@/features/projects/project.queries";

export function DocumentUploadModal({
  open,
  onClose,
  defaultProjectId,
}: {
  open: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  defaultProjectId?: string;
}) {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const upload = useUploadDocument();
  const { data: projects } = useProjects({ limit: 200 });
  const [file, setFile] = useState<File | null>(null);
  const [fileError, setFileError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const {
    register,
    handleSubmit,
    formState: { errors },
    reset,
  } = useForm<DocumentUploadFormData>({
    resolver: zodResolver(documentUploadSchema),
    defaultValues: {
      projectId: defaultProjectId ?? "",
      docType: "REPORT",
      title: "",
      description: "",
      accessLevel: "INTERNAL",
    },
  });

  const onSubmit = async (v: DocumentUploadFormData) => {
    if (!file) {
      setFileError("Please select a file.");
      return;
    }
    const err = validateFile(file);
    if (err) {
      setFileError(err);
      return;
    }
    setFileError(null);
    await upload.mutateAsync({ input: v, file });
    reset();
    setFile(null);
    onClose();
  };

  return (
    <Modal
      open={open}
      onClose={onClose}
      title={t("documents.uploadTitle")}
      size="md"
      footer={
        <>
          <Button variant="ghost" onClick={onClose}>
            {t("actions.cancel")}
          </Button>
          <Button
            variant="primary"
            loading={upload.isPending}
            onClick={handleSubmit(onSubmit)}
          >
            {t("documents.uploadButton")}
          </Button>
        </>
      }
    >
      <form onSubmit={handleSubmit(onSubmit)} className="space-y-4" noValidate>
        <Select
          {...register("projectId")}
          label={t("documents.form.project")}
          placeholder={t("documents.form.noProject")}
          options={(projects?.data ?? []).map((p) => ({
            value: p.projectId,
            label: `${p.projectCode} · ${p.name}`,
          }))}
        />
        <Select
          {...register("docType")}
          label={t("documents.form.type")}
          required
          options={DOC_TYPES.map((dt) => ({ value: dt, label: dt }))}
        />
        <Input
          {...register("title")}
          label={t("documents.form.title")}
          required
          error={errors.title?.message}
        />
        <Textarea
          {...register("description")}
          label={t("documents.form.description")}
          rows={3}
        />
        <Select
          {...register("accessLevel")}
          label={t("documents.form.access")}
          required
          options={ACCESS_LEVELS.map((a) => ({
            value: a,
            label:
              a === "PUBLIC"
                ? "Public"
                : a === "INTERNAL"
                  ? "Internal"
                  : "Restricted",
          }))}
        />
        <FileUpload
          label={t("documents.form.file")}
          accept=".pdf,.doc,.docx,.xls,.xlsx,.png,.jpg,.jpeg,.zip"
          maxSizeMB={MAX_FILE_SIZE_MB}
          required
          files={file ? [file] : []}
          onFiles={(fs) => {
            setFile(fs[0] ?? null);
            setFileError(null);
          }}
          error={fileError ?? undefined}
          hint={`PDF, Word, Excel, images, ZIP · max ${MAX_FILE_SIZE_MB} MB`}
        />
      </form>
    </Modal>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import { useState } from "react";
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";
import { Download, History, RotateCcw } from "lucide-react";
import { useDocumentVersions } from "./document.queries";
import { useRestoreVersion } from "./document.mutations";
import { documentApi } from "./document.api";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/Button";
import { Chip } from "@/components/ui/Chip";
import { Card, CardHeader } from "@/components/ui/Card";
import { formatDate } from "@/lib/utils/date";
import { useToast } from "@/components/ui/Toast";
import type { DocumentMeta } from "./document.types";

export function DocumentPreviewPanel({ document }: { document: DocumentMeta }) {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const { push } = useToast();
  const { data: versions } = useDocumentVersions(document.docId);
  const restore = useRestoreVersion(document.docId);

  const download = async () => {
    try {
      const { url } = await documentApi.signedUrl(document.docId);
      window.open(url, "_blank", "noopener");
    } catch {
      push("error", "Download link failed");
    }
  };

  const isImage = document.mimeType.startsWith("image/");
  const isPdf = document.mimeType === "application/pdf";

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      <div>
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 mb-2">
          <Chip tone="blue">{document.docType}</Chip>
          <Chip tone="grey">v{document.version}</Chip>
          <Chip
            tone={
              document.accessLevel === "RESTRICTED"
                ? "red"
                : document.accessLevel === "PUBLIC"
                  ? "green"
                  : "grey"
            }
          >
            {document.accessLevel}
          </Chip>
        </div>
        {document.description && (
          <p className="text-body-sm text-neutral-600">
            {document.description}
          </p>
        )}
      </div>

      <div className="rounded-md border border-neutral-300 bg-neutral-50 p-4">
        {isPdf ? (
          <iframe
            title={document.title}
            src={document.filePath}
            className="w-full h-[420px] rounded-md border border-neutral-200 bg-white"
          />
        ) : isImage ? (
          <img
            src={document.filePath}
            alt={document.title}
            className="max-h-[420px] mx-auto rounded-md"
          />
        ) : (
          <p className="text-center text-body-sm text-neutral-600 py-12">
            {t("documents.preview.unsupported")}
          </p>
        )}
      </div>

      <div className="flex gap-2">
        <Button
          variant="primary"
          size="sm"
          leftIcon={<Download className="h-4 w-4" />}
          onClick={download}
        >
          {t("documents.preview.download")}
        </Button>
      </div>

      <Card>
        <CardHeader
          title={
            <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-2">
              <History className="h-4 w-4" aria-hidden />
              {t("documents.versions.title")}
            </span>
          }
        />
        <ul className="divide-y divide-neutral-200">
          {(versions ?? []).map((v) => (
            <li
              key={v.versionId}
              className="py-2 flex items-center justify-between gap-3"
            >
              <div className="text-body-sm">
                <div className="font-semibold">v{v.version}</div>
                <div className="text-caption text-neutral-600">
                  {v.uploadedByName} · {formatDate(v.uploadedAt)}
                </div>
              </div>
              <Button
                size="sm"
                variant="ghost"
                leftIcon={<RotateCcw className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />}
                loading={restore.isPending}
                onClick={() => restore.mutate(v.versionId)}
                disabled={v.version === document.version}
              >
                {t("documents.versions.restore")}
              </Button>
            </li>
          ))}
        </ul>
      </Card>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## 8.33 `src/features/grievances/grievance.api.ts`

```ts
import { api } from "@/lib/api/client";
import type {
  Grievance,
  GrievanceFilters,
  GrievanceAction,
  GrievanceStats,
} from "./grievance.types";
import type {
  GrievanceIntakeFormData,
  GrievanceAssignFormData,
  GrievanceResolveFormData,
  GrievanceEscalateFormData,
} from "./grievance.schema";

interface Envelope<T> {
  data: T;
}

function filtersToParams(f: GrievanceFilters): string {
  const p = new URLSearchParams();
  if (f.projectId) p.set("project_id", f.projectId);
  if (f.category?.length) p.set("category", f.category.join(","));
  if (f.status?.length) p.set("status", f.status.join(","));
  if (f.severity?.length) p.set("severity", f.severity.join(","));
  if (f.assignedTo) p.set("assigned_to", f.assignedTo);
  if (f.overdueOnly) p.set("overdue", "true");
  if (f.q) p.set("q", f.q);
  if (f.from) p.set("from", f.from);
  if (f.to) p.set("to", f.to);
  if (f.limit) p.set("limit", String(f.limit));
  if (f.cursor) p.set("cursor", f.cursor);
  return p.toString();
}

export const grievanceApi = {
  async list(f: GrievanceFilters) {
    const { data } = await api.get<Envelope<Grievance[]> & { pagination: any }>(
      `/grievances?${filtersToParams(f)}`,
    );
    return { data: data.data, pagination: (data as any).pagination };
  },

  async get(grievanceId: string): Promise<Grievance> {
    const { data } = await api.get<Envelope<Grievance>>(
      `/grievances/${grievanceId}`,
    );
    return data.data;
  },

  async create(input: GrievanceIntakeFormData): Promise<Grievance> {
    const { data } = await api.post<Envelope<Grievance>>("/grievances", input);
    return data.data;
  },

  async assign(
    grievanceId: string,
    input: GrievanceAssignFormData,
  ): Promise<Grievance> {
    const { data } = await api.post<Envelope<Grievance>>(
      `/grievances/${grievanceId}/assign`,
      input,
    );
    return data.data;
  },

  async resolve(
    grievanceId: string,
    input: GrievanceResolveFormData,
  ): Promise<Grievance> {
    const { data } = await api.post<Envelope<Grievance>>(
      `/grievances/${grievanceId}/resolve`,
      input,
    );
    return data.data;
  },

  async escalate(
    grievanceId: string,
    input: GrievanceEscalateFormData,
  ): Promise<Grievance> {
    const { data } = await api.post<Envelope<Grievance>>(
      `/grievances/${grievanceId}/escalate`,
      input,
    );
    return data.data;
  },

  async actions(grievanceId: string): Promise<GrievanceAction[]> {
    const { data } = await api.get<Envelope<GrievanceAction[]>>(
      `/grievances/${grievanceId}/actions`,
    );
    return data.data;
  },

  async stats(projectId?: string): Promise<GrievanceStats> {
    const p = projectId ? `?project_id=${projectId}` : "";
    const { data } = await api.get<Envelope<GrievanceStats>>(
      `/grievances/stats${p}`,
    );
    return data.data;
  },
};
```

```ts
import { useQuery, keepPreviousData } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { grievanceApi } from "./grievance.api";
import type { GrievanceFilters } from "./grievance.types";

export const grievanceKeys = {
  all: ["grievances"] as const,
  list: (f: GrievanceFilters) => [...grievanceKeys.all, "list", f] as const,
  detail: (id: string) => [...grievanceKeys.all, "detail", id] as const,
  actions: (id: string) => [...grievanceKeys.all, "actions", id] as const,
  stats: (projectId?: string) =>
    [...grievanceKeys.all, "stats", projectId ?? "all"] as const,
};

export function useGrievances(f: GrievanceFilters) {
  return useQuery({
    queryKey: grievanceKeys.list(f),
    queryFn: () => grievanceApi.list(f),
    placeholderData: keepPreviousData,
    staleTime: 30_000,
  });
}

export function useGrievance(grievanceId: string | undefined) {
  return useQuery({
    queryKey: grievanceKeys.detail(grievanceId ?? ""),
    queryFn: () => grievanceApi.get(grievanceId!),
    enabled: !!grievanceId,
  });
}

export function useGrievanceActions(grievanceId: string | undefined) {
  return useQuery({
    queryKey: grievanceKeys.actions(grievanceId ?? ""),
    queryFn: () => grievanceApi.actions(grievanceId!),
    enabled: !!grievanceId,
  });
}

export function useGrievanceStats(projectId?: string) {
  return useQuery({
    queryKey: grievanceKeys.stats(projectId),
    queryFn: () => grievanceApi.stats(projectId),
    staleTime: 60_000,
  });
}
```

```ts
import { useMutation, useQueryClient } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { grievanceApi } from "./grievance.api";
import { grievanceKeys } from "./grievance.queries";
import { useToast } from "@/components/ui/Toast";
import { normalizeApiError } from "@/lib/api/errors";
import type {
  GrievanceIntakeFormData,
  GrievanceAssignFormData,
  GrievanceResolveFormData,
  GrievanceEscalateFormData,
} from "./grievance.schema";

export function useCreateGrievance() {
  const qc = useQueryClient();
  const { push } = useToast();
  return useMutation({
    mutationFn: (input: GrievanceIntakeFormData) => grievanceApi.create(input),
    onSuccess: (g) => {
      qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: grievanceKeys.all });
      push("success", `Grievance ${g.ticketNo} recorded`);
    },
    onError: (err) =>
      push(
        "error",
        normalizeApiError(err).detail ?? "Failed to record grievance",
      ),
  });
}

export function useAssignGrievance(grievanceId: string) {
  const qc = useQueryClient();
  const { push } = useToast();
  return useMutation({
    mutationFn: (input: GrievanceAssignFormData) =>
      grievanceApi.assign(grievanceId, input),
    onSuccess: () => {
      qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: grievanceKeys.all });
      push("success", "Grievance assigned");
    },
  });
}

export function useResolveGrievance(grievanceId: string) {
  const qc = useQueryClient();
  const { push } = useToast();
  return useMutation({
    mutationFn: (input: GrievanceResolveFormData) =>
      grievanceApi.resolve(grievanceId, input),
    onSuccess: () => {
      qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: grievanceKeys.all });
      push("success", "Grievance resolved");
    },
  });
}

export function useEscalateGrievance(grievanceId: string) {
  const qc = useQueryClient();
  const { push } = useToast();
  return useMutation({
    mutationFn: (input: GrievanceEscalateFormData) =>
      grievanceApi.escalate(grievanceId, input),
    onSuccess: () => {
      qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: grievanceKeys.all });
      push("success", "Grievance escalated");
    },
  });
}
```

## 8.36 `src/features/grievances/grievance.utils.ts`

```ts
import type { ChipTone } from "@/components/ui/Chip";
import type {
  GrievanceStatus,
  GrievanceCategory,
  Severity,
} from "./grievance.types";

export function statusTone(s: GrievanceStatus): ChipTone {
  switch (s) {
    case "OPEN":
      return "amber";
    case "IN_PROGRESS":
      return "blue";
    case "RESOLVED":
      return "green";
    case "CLOSED":
      return "teal";
    case "ESCALATED":
      return "red";
  }
}

export function statusKey(s: GrievanceStatus): string {
  return `grievance.status.${s.toLowerCase()}`;
}

export function categoryTone(c: GrievanceCategory): ChipTone {
  switch (c) {
    case "SAFEGUARDS":
      return "red";
    case "PAYMENT":
      return "amber";
    case "SERVICE_QUALITY":
      return "blue";
    case "DELAY":
      return "amber";
    case "CONDUCT":
      return "red";
    case "OTHER":
      return "grey";
  }
}

export function categoryKey(c: GrievanceCategory): string {
  return `grievance.category.${c.toLowerCase()}`;
}

export function severityTone(s: Severity): ChipTone {
  return s === "CRITICAL"
    ? "red"
    : s === "HIGH"
      ? "red"
      : s === "MEDIUM"
        ? "amber"
        : "grey";
}

export function slaDaysRemaining(slaDue: string): number {
  return Math.ceil((Date.parse(slaDue) - Date.now()) / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24));
}

export function slaTone(days: number): ChipTone {
  if (days < 0) return "red";
  if (days <= 1) return "red";
  if (days <= 3) return "amber";
  return "green";
}
```

```tsx
import { useMemo, useState } from "react";
import { useSearchParams } from "react-router-dom";
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";
import { Plus, LayoutGrid, List } from "lucide-react";
import { useGrievances } from "./grievance.queries";
import { usePermissions } from "@/features/auth/usePermissions";
import { PERMISSIONS } from "@/features/auth/auth.types";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/Button";
import { Chip } from "@/components/ui/Chip";
import { GrievanceKanban } from "./GrievanceKanban";
import { GrievanceList } from "./GrievanceList";
import { GrievanceIntakeModal } from "./GrievanceIntakeModal";
import { GrievanceDetailDrawer } from "./GrievanceDetailDrawer";
import { SlaTracker } from "./SlaTracker";
import { GrievanceAnalytics } from "./GrievanceAnalytics";
import {
  GRIEVANCE_STATUSES,
  type Grievance,
  type GrievanceStatus,
} from "./grievance.types";
import { statusTone, statusKey } from "./grievance.utils";
import { cn } from "@/components/ui/utils/cn";

export default function GrievancePage() {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const [params, setParams] = useSearchParams();
  const { can } = usePermissions();
  const [view, setView] = useState<"kanban" | "list">("kanban");
  const [intakeOpen, setIntakeOpen] = useState(false);
  const [selected, setSelected] = useState<Grievance | null>(null);

  const status = (params.get("status")?.split(",").filter(Boolean) ??
    []) as GrievanceStatus[];
  const projectId = params.get("projectId") ?? undefined;

  const { data, isLoading } = useGrievances({
    projectId,
    status: status.length ? status : undefined,
    limit: 200,
  });

  const list = data?.data ?? [];

  const updateParams = (patch: Record<string, string | undefined>) => {
    const next = new URLSearchParams(params);
    Object.entries(patch).forEach(([k, v]) => {
      if (v == null || v === "") next.delete(k);
      else next.set(k, v);
    });
    setParams(next, { replace: true });
  };

  const toggleStatus = (s: GrievanceStatus) => {
    const next = status.includes(s)
      ? status.filter((x) => x !== s)
      : [...status, s];
    updateParams({ status: next.length ? next.join(",") : undefined });
  };

  return (
    <main id="main" tabIndex={-1} className="space-y-5">
      <header className="flex flex-wrap items-start justify-between gap-3">
        <div>
          <h1 className="text-h1 text-primary-900">{t("grievance.title")}</h1>
          <p className="text-body-sm text-neutral-600 mt-1">
            {list.length} {t("grievance.records")}
          </p>
        </div>
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
          <div className="inline-flex rounded-md border border-neutral-300 overflow-hidden">
            <button
              type="button"
              aria-pressed={view === "kanban"}
              onClick={() => setView("kanban")}
              className={cn(
                "inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 text-caption font-semibold",
                view === "kanban"
                  ? "bg-primary-700 text-white"
                  : "bg-white text-neutral-600 hover:bg-neutral-100",
              )}
            >
              <LayoutGrid className="h-3.5 w-3.5" aria-hidden /> Kanban
            </button>
            <button
              type="button"
              aria-pressed={view === "list"}
              onClick={() => setView("list")}
              className={cn(
                "inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 text-caption font-semibold",
                view === "list"
                  ? "bg-primary-700 text-white"
                  : "bg-white text-neutral-600 hover:bg-neutral-100",
              )}
            >
              <List className="h-3.5 w-3.5" aria-hidden /> List
            </button>
          </div>
          {can(PERMISSIONS.grievanceWrite) && (
            <Button
              variant="primary"
              size="sm"
              leftIcon={<Plus className="h-4 w-4" />}
              onClick={() => setIntakeOpen(true)}
            >
              {t("grievance.intake")}
            </Button>
          )}
        </div>
      </header>

      <section className="bg-white border border-neutral-300 rounded-md p-3 flex flex-wrap gap-2 items-center">
        {GRIEVANCE_STATUSES.map((s) => {
          const active = status.includes(s);
          return (
            <button
              key={s}
              type="button"
              aria-pressed={active}
              onClick={() => toggleStatus(s)}
              className="focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-info focus-visible:ring-offset-2 rounded-full"
            >
              <Chip tone={active ? statusTone(s) : "grey"}>
                {t(statusKey(s))}
              </Chip>
            </button>
          );
        })}
        {status.length > 0 && (
          <Button
            variant="ghost"
            size="sm"
            onClick={() => updateParams({ status: undefined })}
          >
            {t("grievance.clear")}
          </Button>
        )}
      </section>

      <SlaTracker projectId={projectId} />

      {view === "kanban" ? (
        <GrievanceKanban
          grievances={list}
          loading={isLoading}
          onSelect={setSelected}
        />
      ) : (
        <GrievanceList
          grievances={list}
          loading={isLoading}
          onSelect={setSelected}
        />
      )}

      <GrievanceAnalytics projectId={projectId} />

      <GrievanceIntakeModal
        open={intakeOpen}
        onClose={() => setIntakeOpen(false)}
      />

      <GrievanceDetailDrawer
        grievance={selected}
        open={!!selected}
        onClose={() => setSelected(null)}
      />
    </main>
  );
}
```
