## 8.38 `src/features/grievances/GrievanceKanban.tsx`

```tsx
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";
import { Chip } from "@/components/ui/Chip";
import { LoadingState } from "@/components/ui/LoadingState";
import {
  statusTone,
  statusKey,
  categoryTone,
  categoryKey,
  severityTone,
  slaDaysRemaining,
  slaTone,
} from "./grievance.utils";
import {
  GRIEVANCE_STATUSES,
  type Grievance,
  type GrievanceStatus,
} from "./grievance.types";

export function GrievanceKanban({
  grievances,
  loading,
  onSelect,
}: {
  grievances: Grievance[];
  loading: boolean;
  onSelect: (g: Grievance) => void;
}) {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  if (loading) return <LoadingState />;

  const byStatus = GRIEVANCE_STATUSES.reduce<
    Record<GrievanceStatus, Grievance[]>
  >(
    (acc, s) => {
      acc[s] = [];
      return acc;
    },
    {} as Record<GrievanceStatus, Grievance[]>,
  );
  grievances.forEach((g) => byStatus[g.status]?.push(g));

  return (
    <div className="overflow-x-auto pb-4">
      <div className="flex gap-3 min-w-max">
        {GRIEVANCE_STATUSES.map((s) => (
          <section
            key={s}
            aria-label={t(statusKey(s))}
            className="w-[300px] shrink-0 bg-neutral-100 rounded-md border border-neutral-300"
          >
            <header className="flex items-center justify-between px-3 py-2 border-b border-neutral-300">
              <Chip tone={statusTone(s)}>{t(statusKey(s))}</Chip>
              <span className="text-caption font-bold text-neutral-600">
                {byStatus[s].length}
              </span>
            </header>
            <ul className="p-2 space-y-2 min-h-[200px]">
              {byStatus[s].map((g) => {
                const days = slaDaysRemaining(g.slaDue);
                return (
                  <li key={g.grievanceId}>
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() => onSelect(g)}
                      className="w-full text-left bg-white border border-neutral-300 rounded-md p-3 hover:border-primary-300 hover:shadow-sm transition"
                    >
                      <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 mb-1.5">
                        <code className="text-caption font-bold text-primary-700">
                          {g.ticketNo}
                        </code>
                        <Chip tone={severityTone(g.severity)}>
                          {g.severity}
                        </Chip>
                      </div>
                      <div className="text-body-sm font-semibold line-clamp-2">
                        {g.description}
                      </div>
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mt-2">
                        <Chip tone={categoryTone(g.category)}>
                          {t(categoryKey(g.category))}
                        </Chip>
                        <Chip tone={slaTone(days)}>
                          {days < 0
                            ? `${Math.abs(days)}d overdue`
                            : days === 0
                              ? "Today"
                              : `${days}d`}
                        </Chip>
                      </div>
                    </button>
                  </li>
                );
              })}
              {byStatus[s].length === 0 && (
                <li className="text-center text-caption text-neutral-500 py-6">
                  {t("grievance.empty")}
                </li>
              )}
            </ul>
          </section>
        ))}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";
import { DataGrid, type Column } from "@/components/ui/DataGrid";
import { Chip } from "@/components/ui/Chip";
import { EmptyState } from "@/components/ui/EmptyState";
import {
  statusTone,
  statusKey,
  categoryTone,
  categoryKey,
  severityTone,
  slaDaysRemaining,
  slaTone,
} from "./grievance.utils";
import { formatDate } from "@/lib/utils/date";
import type { Grievance } from "./grievance.types";

export function GrievanceList({
  grievances,
  loading,
  onSelect,
}: {
  grievances: Grievance[];
  loading: boolean;
  onSelect: (g: Grievance) => void;
}) {
  const { t } = useTranslation();

  const columns: Column<Grievance & { id: string }>[] = [
    {
      id: "ticketNo",
      header: "Ticket",
      render: (r) => (
        <code className="text-caption font-bold text-primary-700">
          {r.ticketNo}
        </code>
      ),
    },
    {
      id: "description",
      header: "Description",
      render: (r) => (
        <span className="text-body-sm truncate block max-w-md">
          {r.description}
        </span>
      ),
    },
    {
      id: "category",
      header: "Category",
      render: (r) => (
        <Chip tone={categoryTone(r.category)}>
          {t(categoryKey(r.category))}
        </Chip>
      ),
    },
    {
      id: "severity",
      header: "Severity",
      render: (r) => <Chip tone={severityTone(r.severity)}>{r.severity}</Chip>,
    },
    {
      id: "slaDue",
      header: "SLA",
      render: (r) => {
        const days = slaDaysRemaining(r.slaDue);
        return (
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <span className="text-caption">{formatDate(r.slaDue)}</span>
            <Chip tone={slaTone(days)}>
              {days < 0 ? `${Math.abs(days)}d overdue` : `${days}d`}
            </Chip>
          </div>
        );
      },
    },
    {
      id: "assignedToName",
      header: "Assigned",
      render: (r) => (
        <span className="text-caption">{r.assignedToName ?? "—"}</span>
      ),
    },
    {
      id: "status",
      header: "Status",
      render: (r) => (
        <Chip tone={statusTone(r.status)}>{t(statusKey(r.status))}</Chip>
      ),
    },
  ];

  if (!loading && grievances.length === 0) {
    return <EmptyState title={t("grievance.empty")} />;
  }

  return (
    <DataGrid
      columns={columns}
      rows={grievances.map((g) => ({ ...g, id: g.grievanceId }))}
      loading={loading}
      onRowClick={onSelect}
      ariaLabel={t("grievance.title")}
    />
  );
}
```

## 8.40 `src/features/grievances/GrievanceIntakeModal.tsx`

```tsx
import { useForm } from "react-hook-form";
import { zodResolver } from "@hookform/resolvers/zod";
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";
import { Modal } from "@/components/ui/Modal";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/Button";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/Input";
import { Select } from "@/components/ui/Select";
import { Textarea } from "@/components/ui/Textarea";
import { Checkbox } from "@/components/ui/Checkbox";
import {
  grievanceIntakeSchema,
  type GrievanceIntakeFormData,
} from "./grievance.schema";
import { useCreateGrievance } from "./grievance.mutations";
import {
  GRIEVANCE_CATEGORIES,
  GRIEVANCE_CHANNELS,
  SEVERITIES,
} from "./grievance.types";
import { useProjects } from "@/features/projects/project.queries";

export function GrievanceIntakeModal({
  open,
  onClose,
}: {
  open: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
}) {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const create = useCreateGrievance();
  const { data: projects } = useProjects({ limit: 200 });

  const {
    register,
    handleSubmit,
    formState: { errors },
    reset,
    watch,
  } = useForm<GrievanceIntakeFormData>({
    resolver: zodResolver(grievanceIntakeSchema),
    defaultValues: {
      projectId: "",
      beneficiaryId: "",
      category: "SERVICE_QUALITY",
      subcategory: "",
      description: "",
      channel: "IN_PERSON",
      severity: "MEDIUM",
      anonymous: false,
    },
  });

  const anonymous = watch("anonymous");

  const onSubmit = async (v: GrievanceIntakeFormData) => {
    await create.mutateAsync(v);
    reset();
    onClose();
  };

  return (
    <Modal
      open={open}
      onClose={onClose}
      title={t("grievance.form.title")}
      size="md"
      footer={
        <>
          <Button variant="ghost" onClick={onClose}>
            {t("actions.cancel")}
          </Button>
          <Button
            variant="primary"
            loading={create.isPending}
            onClick={handleSubmit(onSubmit)}
          >
            {t("grievance.form.submit")}
          </Button>
        </>
      }
    >
      <form onSubmit={handleSubmit(onSubmit)} className="space-y-4" noValidate>
        <Select
          {...register("projectId")}
          label={t("grievance.form.project")}
          placeholder={t("grievance.form.noProject")}
          options={(projects?.data ?? []).map((p) => ({
            value: p.projectId,
            label: `${p.projectCode} · ${p.name}`,
          }))}
        />
        <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4">
          <Select
            {...register("category")}
            label={t("grievance.form.category")}
            required
            options={GRIEVANCE_CATEGORIES.map((c) => ({
              value: c,
              label: t(`grievance.category.${c.toLowerCase()}`),
            }))}
          />
          <Select
            {...register("severity")}
            label={t("grievance.form.severity")}
            required
            options={SEVERITIES.map((s) => ({ value: s, label: s }))}
          />
        </div>
        <Input
          {...register("subcategory")}
          label={t("grievance.form.subcategory")}
        />
        <Textarea
          {...register("description")}
          label={t("grievance.form.description")}
          rows={4}
          required
          error={errors.description?.message}
        />
        <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4">
          <Select
            {...register("channel")}
            label={t("grievance.form.channel")}
            required
            options={GRIEVANCE_CHANNELS.map((c) => ({ value: c, label: c }))}
          />
          <div className="flex items-end pb-1.5">
            <Checkbox
              {...register("anonymous")}
              label={t("grievance.form.anonymous")}
            />
          </div>
        </div>
        {!anonymous && (
          <Input
            {...register("beneficiaryId")}
            label={t("grievance.form.beneficiaryId")}
            placeholder="Beneficiary UUID (optional)"
          />
        )}
      </form>
    </Modal>
  );
}
```

## 8.41 `src/features/grievances/GrievanceDetailDrawer.tsx`

```tsx
import { useState } from "react";
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";
import { Drawer } from "@/components/ui/Drawer";
import { Card, CardHeader } from "@/components/ui/Card";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/Button";
import { Chip } from "@/components/ui/Chip";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/Input";
import { Textarea } from "@/components/ui/Textarea";
import { usePermissions } from "@/features/auth/usePermissions";
import { PERMISSIONS } from "@/features/auth/auth.types";
import {
  useAssignGrievance,
  useResolveGrievance,
  useEscalateGrievance,
} from "./grievance.mutations";
import { useGrievanceActions } from "./grievance.queries";
import {
  statusTone,
  statusKey,
  categoryTone,
  categoryKey,
  severityTone,
  slaDaysRemaining,
  slaTone,
} from "./grievance.utils";
import { formatDate } from "@/lib/utils/date";
import type { Grievance } from "./grievance.types";

const OFFICERS = [
  { value: "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000101", label: "Meron Haile · QA" },
  {
    value: "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000102",
    label: "Selam Bekele · Woreda",
  },
  { value: "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000103", label: "Tigist Alemu · IE" },
];

export function GrievanceDetailDrawer({
  grievance,
  open,
  onClose,
}: {
  grievance: Grievance | null;
  open: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
}) {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const { can } = usePermissions();

  if (!grievance)
    return (
      <Drawer open={false} onClose={onClose} title="" width="max-w-xl">
        <span />
      </Drawer>
    );

  const canAssign =
    can(PERMISSIONS.grievanceWrite) && grievance.status === "OPEN";
  const canResolve =
    can(PERMISSIONS.grievanceResolve) &&
    ["OPEN", "IN_PROGRESS", "ESCALATED"].includes(grievance.status);
  const canEscalate =
    can(PERMISSIONS.grievanceEscalate) &&
    !["CLOSED", "RESOLVED"].includes(grievance.status);

  return (
    <Drawer
      open={open}
      onClose={onClose}
      title={`${grievance.ticketNo}`}
      width="max-w-xl"
    >
      <div className="space-y-4">
        <div>
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 mb-2">
            <Chip tone={statusTone(grievance.status)}>
              {t(statusKey(grievance.status))}
            </Chip>
            <Chip tone={categoryTone(grievance.category)}>
              {t(categoryKey(grievance.category))}
            </Chip>
            <Chip tone={severityTone(grievance.severity)}>
              {grievance.severity}
            </Chip>
            <Chip tone={slaTone(slaDaysRemaining(grievance.slaDue))}>
              SLA {formatDate(grievance.slaDue)}
            </Chip>
          </div>
          <p className="text-body-sm text-neutral-900 whitespace-pre-wrap mt-2">
            {grievance.description}
          </p>
          <div className="text-caption text-neutral-600 mt-3 grid grid-cols-2 gap-1">
            <span>Submitted: {formatDate(grievance.submittedAt)}</span>
            <span>Channel: {grievance.channel}</span>
            {grievance.assignedToName && (
              <span>Assigned to: {grievance.assignedToName}</span>
            )}
            {grievance.escalatedToName && (
              <span>Escalated to: {grievance.escalatedToName}</span>
            )}
            {grievance.location?.region && (
              <span>Region: {grievance.location.region}</span>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>

        {canAssign && <AssignPanel grievanceId={grievance.grievanceId} />}
        {canResolve && <ResolvePanel grievanceId={grievance.grievanceId} />}
        {canEscalate && <EscalatePanel grievanceId={grievance.grievanceId} />}

        <HistoryPanel grievanceId={grievance.grievanceId} />
      </div>
    </Drawer>
  );
}

function AssignPanel({ grievanceId }: { grievanceId: string }) {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const assign = useAssignGrievance(grievanceId);
  const [assignedTo, setAssignedTo] = useState(OFFICERS[0]!.value);
  const [notes, setNotes] = useState("");

  return (
    <Card>
      <CardHeader title={t("grievance.actions.assign")} />
      <div className="space-y-2">
        <div className="text-caption text-neutral-600">Assign to</div>
        <select
          className="w-full h-9 rounded-md border border-neutral-300 px-2 text-body-sm"
          value={assignedTo}
          onChange={(e) => setAssignedTo(e.target.value)}
        >
          {OFFICERS.map((o) => (
            <option key={o.value} value={o.value}>
              {o.label}
            </option>
          ))}
        </select>
        <Textarea
          label="Notes"
          rows={2}
          value={notes}
          onChange={(e) => setNotes(e.target.value)}
        />
        <Button
          variant="primary"
          size="sm"
          loading={assign.isPending}
          onClick={() => assign.mutate({ assignedTo, notes })}
        >
          {t("grievance.actions.assignCta")}
        </Button>
      </div>
    </Card>
  );
}

function ResolvePanel({ grievanceId }: { grievanceId: string }) {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const resolve = useResolveGrievance(grievanceId);
  const [resolution, setResolution] = useState("");

  return (
    <Card>
      <CardHeader title={t("grievance.actions.resolve")} />
      <div className="space-y-2">
        <Textarea
          label={t("grievance.actions.resolution")}
          rows={3}
          value={resolution}
          onChange={(e) => setResolution(e.target.value)}
          required
        />
        <Button
          variant="primary"
          size="sm"
          loading={resolve.isPending}
          disabled={resolution.trim().length < 20}
          onClick={() => resolve.mutate({ resolution })}
        >
          {t("grievance.actions.resolveCta")}
        </Button>
      </div>
    </Card>
  );
}

function EscalatePanel({ grievanceId }: { grievanceId: string }) {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const escalate = useEscalateGrievance(grievanceId);
  const [escalatedTo, setEscalatedTo] = useState(OFFICERS[0]!.value);
  const [reason, setReason] = useState("");

  return (
    <Card>
      <CardHeader title={t("grievance.actions.escalate")} />
      <div className="space-y-2">
        <select
          className="w-full h-9 rounded-md border border-neutral-300 px-2 text-body-sm"
          value={escalatedTo}
          onChange={(e) => setEscalatedTo(e.target.value)}
        >
          {OFFICERS.map((o) => (
            <option key={o.value} value={o.value}>
              {o.label}
            </option>
          ))}
        </select>
        <Textarea
          label="Reason"
          rows={2}
          value={reason}
          onChange={(e) => setReason(e.target.value)}
          required
        />
        <Button
          variant="danger"
          size="sm"
          loading={escalate.isPending}
          disabled={reason.trim().length < 10}
          onClick={() => escalate.mutate({ escalatedTo, reason })}
        >
          {t("grievance.actions.escalateCta")}
        </Button>
      </div>
    </Card>
  );
}

function HistoryPanel({ grievanceId }: { grievanceId: string }) {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const { data } = useGrievanceActions(grievanceId);
  return (
    <Card>
      <CardHeader title={t("grievance.actions.history")} />
      {!data?.length ? (
        <p className="text-caption text-neutral-600">
          {t("grievance.actions.noHistory")}
        </p>
      ) : (
        <ol className="space-y-3 relative border-l-2 border-neutral-200 ml-2">
          {data.map((a) => (
            <li key={a.actionId} className="ml-4">
              <span
                aria-hidden
                className="absolute -left-[7px] mt-1 h-3 w-3 rounded-full bg-primary-700"
              />
              <div className="text-caption text-neutral-600">
                <strong>{a.actorName}</strong> · {a.actionType} ·{" "}
                {formatDate(a.createdAt)}
              </div>
              {a.notes && <p className="text-body-sm mt-1">{a.notes}</p>}
            </li>
          ))}
        </ol>
      )}
    </Card>
  );
}
```

## 8.42 `src/features/grievances/SlaTracker.tsx`

```tsx
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";
import { AlertTriangle } from "lucide-react";
import { Card, CardHeader } from "@/components/ui/Card";
import { useGrievances } from "./grievance.queries";
import { slaDaysRemaining, slaTone } from "./grievance.utils";
import { Chip } from "@/components/ui/Chip";
import { formatDate } from "@/lib/utils/date";

export function SlaTracker({ projectId }: { projectId?: string }) {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const { data } = useGrievances({
    projectId,
    status: ["OPEN", "IN_PROGRESS", "ESCALATED"] as any,
    limit: 100,
  });

  const atRisk = (data?.data ?? [])
    .map((g) => ({ g, days: slaDaysRemaining(g.slaDue) }))
    .filter(({ days }) => days <= 3)
    .sort((a, b) => a.days - b.days);

  if (atRisk.length === 0) return null;

  return (
    <Card>
      <CardHeader
        title={t("grievance.sla.title")}
        subtitle={t("grievance.sla.subtitle", { count: atRisk.length })}
      />
      <ul className="divide-y divide-neutral-200">
        {atRisk.map(({ g, days }) => (
          <li key={g.grievanceId} className="py-2 flex items-center gap-3">
            <AlertTriangle
              className={`h-4 w-4 ${days < 0 ? "text-danger" : "text-amber-600"} shrink-0`}
              aria-hidden
            />
            <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
              <div className="text-body-sm font-semibold">
                <code className="text-primary-700 mr-1">{g.ticketNo}</code>
                {g.description.slice(0, 80)}
                {g.description.length > 80 ? "…" : ""}
              </div>
              <div className="text-caption text-neutral-600">
                SLA due {formatDate(g.slaDue)}
              </div>
            </div>
            <Chip tone={slaTone(days)}>
              {days < 0
                ? `${Math.abs(days)}d overdue`
                : days === 0
                  ? "Today"
                  : `${days}d`}
            </Chip>
          </li>
        ))}
      </ul>
    </Card>
  );
}
```

## 8.43 `src/features/grievances/GrievanceAnalytics.tsx`

```tsx
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";
import { Card, CardHeader } from "@/components/ui/Card";
import { LoadingState } from "@/components/ui/LoadingState";
import { KPITile } from "@/components/ui/KPITile";
import { useGrievanceStats } from "./grievance.queries";
import { categoryKey } from "./grievance.utils";

export function GrievanceAnalytics({ projectId }: { projectId?: string }) {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const { data, isLoading } = useGrievanceStats(projectId);
  if (isLoading || !data) return <LoadingState />;

  const maxCat = Math.max(1, ...data.byCategory.map((c) => c.count));

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      <div className="grid grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-4 gap-3">
        <KPITile
          label={t("grievance.analytics.total")}
          value={String(data.total)}
        />
        <KPITile
          label={t("grievance.analytics.open")}
          value={String(data.open)}
          tone="warning"
        />
        <KPITile
          label={t("grievance.analytics.overdue")}
          value={String(data.overdue)}
          tone="danger"
        />
        <KPITile
          label={t("grievance.analytics.avgDays")}
          value={`${data.avgResolutionDays.toFixed(1)} d`}
          tone="success"
        />
      </div>

      <Card>
        <CardHeader title={t("grievance.analytics.byCategory")} />
        <ul className="space-y-2">
          {data.byCategory.map((c) => (
            <li key={c.category}>
              <div className="flex justify-between text-body-sm mb-1">
                <span className="text-neutral-600">
                  {t(categoryKey(c.category))}
                </span>
                <span className="font-bold">{c.count}</span>
              </div>
              <div className="h-2 bg-neutral-200 rounded-full overflow-hidden">
                <div
                  className="h-full bg-primary-700"
                  style={{ width: `${(c.count / maxCat) * 100}%` }}
                />
              </div>
            </li>
          ))}
        </ul>
      </Card>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## 8.45 Tests

### `src/features/beneficiaries/__tests__/beneficiary.schema.test.ts`

```ts
import { describe, it, expect } from "vitest";
import {
  beneficiaryWithConsentSchema,
  beneficiarySchema,
} from "../beneficiary.schema";

const base = {
  fullName: "Aster Bekele",
  gender: "FEMALE" as const,
  location: { region: "Oromia", woreda: "Bora", kebele: "K1" },
  registrationChannel: "WEB" as const,
};

describe("beneficiarySchema", () => {
  it("accepts valid input", () => {
    expect(beneficiarySchema.safeParse(base).success).toBe(true);
  });

  it("rejects invalid phone", () => {
    const r = beneficiarySchema.safeParse({ ...base, phone: "12345" });
    expect(r.success).toBe(false);
  });

  it("accepts valid Ethiopian phone", () => {
    const r = beneficiarySchema.safeParse({ ...base, phone: "+251911234567" });
    expect(r.success).toBe(true);
    const r2 = beneficiarySchema.safeParse({ ...base, phone: "0911234567" });
    expect(r2.success).toBe(true);
  });

  it("requires region", () => {
    const r = beneficiarySchema.safeParse({
      ...base,
      location: { region: "" },
    });
    expect(r.success).toBe(false);
  });
});

describe("beneficiaryWithConsentSchema", () => {
  it("requires participation + data_use consent", () => {
    const r = beneficiaryWithConsentSchema.safeParse({
      ...base,
      consent: {
        participation: true,
        data_use: true,
        consent_version: "v1.2",
        language: "en",
      },
    });
    expect(r.success).toBe(true);
  });

  it("rejects missing data_use", () => {
    const r = beneficiaryWithConsentSchema.safeParse({
      ...base,
      consent: {
        participation: true,
        data_use: false,
        consent_version: "v1.2",
        language: "en",
      },
    });
    expect(r.success).toBe(false);
  });
});
```

```tsx
import { describe, it, expect, vi } from "vitest";
import { render, screen } from "@testing-library/react";
import userEvent from "@testing-library/user-event";
import { DuplicateWarningModal } from "../DuplicateWarningModal";
import "@/lib/i18n";

const candidates = [
  {
    candidateId: "1",
    fullName: "Aster Bekele",
    uniqueId: "BEN-001",
    region: "Oromia",
    woreda: "Bora",
    dedupScore: 0.92,
    matchReasons: ["name", "phone"],
  },
];

describe("DuplicateWarningModal", () => {
  it("renders candidates and fires callbacks", async () => {
    const onProceed = vi.fn();
    const onCancel = vi.fn();
    const onMerge = vi.fn();
    render(
      <DuplicateWarningModal
        open
        candidates={candidates}
        onCancel={onCancel}
        onMerge={onMerge}
        onProceed={onProceed}
      />,
    );
    expect(screen.getByText("Aster Bekele")).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(screen.getByText("92% match")).toBeInTheDocument();
    await userEvent.click(screen.getByText("Proceed anyway"));
    expect(onProceed).toHaveBeenCalled();
  });
});
```

```ts
import { describe, it, expect } from "vitest";
import { documentUploadSchema, validateFile } from "../document.schema";

describe("documentUploadSchema", () => {

      docType: "REPORT",
      title: "Q3",
      accessLevel: "INTERNAL",

});

describe("validateFile", () => {
  it("rejects file over 25 MB", () => {
    const f = new File([new Uint8Array(26 * 1024 * 1024)], "big.pdf", {
      type: "application/pdf",
    });
    expect(validateFile(f)).toMatch(/exceeds/);
  });

  it("rejects unknown MIME", () => {
    const f = new File([new Uint8Array(100)], "x.bin", {
      type: "application/octet-stream",
    });
    expect(validateFile(f)).toMatch(/Unsupported/);
  });

  it("accepts valid PDF", () => {
    const f = new File([new Uint8Array(100)], "x.pdf", {
      type: "application/pdf",
    });
    expect(validateFile(f)).toBeNull();
  });
});
```

# PART A — M18 · IMPACT INDICATORS

## 9.1 `src/features/impact-indicators/impactIndicator.types.ts`

```ts
export const IMPACT_DOMAINS = [
  "INCOME",
  "ENERGY",
  "WATER",
  "HEALTH",
  "EDUCATION",
  "GENDER",
  "ENVIRONMENT",
  "RESILIENCE",
  "SATISFACTION",
] as const;
export type ImpactDomain = (typeof IMPACT_DOMAINS)[number];

export const INDICATOR_DIRECTION = ["INCREASE", "DECREASE"] as const;
export type IndicatorDirection = (typeof INDICATOR_DIRECTION)[number];

export interface ImpactIndicator {
  indicatorId: string;
  domain: ImpactDomain;
  code: string;
  name: string;
  nameAm?: string;
  description?: string;
  unit: string;
  direction: IndicatorDirection;
  method?: string;
  disaggregation: string[];
  isComposite: boolean;
  compositeFormula?: CompositeFormula;
  standardRef?: string;
  version: number;
  effectiveFrom: string;
  effectiveTo?: string;
  status: "ACTIVE" | "DEPRECATED";
}

export interface CompositeFormula {
  components: { indicatorId: string; weight: number }[];
  normalization: "MIN_MAX" | "Z_SCORE" | "NONE";
  aggregation: "WEIGHTED_SUM" | "WEIGHTED_AVG";
}

export interface IndicatorWaveAssignment {
  indicatorWaveId: string;
  indicatorId: string;
  waveId: string;
  targetValue?: number;
  collectionWindowStart?: string;
  collectionWindowEnd?: string;
  required: boolean;
}

export interface TheoryOfChange {
  tocId: string;
  projectId: string;
  name: string;
  description?: string;
  diagramUrl?: string;
  links: ToCLink[];
}

export interface ToCLink {
  fromType: "OUTPUT" | "OUTCOME" | "IMPACT";
  fromId: string;
  fromLabel: string;
  toType: "OUTPUT" | "OUTCOME" | "IMPACT";
  toId: string;
  toLabel: string;
  assumption?: string;
}

export interface ImpactIndicatorFilters {
  domain?: ImpactDomain[];
  q?: string;
  status?: "ACTIVE" | "DEPRECATED";
}
```

---

## 9.2 `src/features/impact-indicators/impactIndicator.schema.ts`

```ts
import { z } from "zod";
import { IMPACT_DOMAINS, INDICATOR_DIRECTION } from "./impactIndicator.types";

export const impactIndicatorSchema = z.object({
  domain: z.enum(IMPACT_DOMAINS),
  code: z.string().trim().min(1).max(30),
  name: z.string().trim().min(3, "Name is required").max(300),
  nameAm: z.string().trim().max(300).optional().or(z.literal("")),
  description: z.string().trim().max(1000).optional().or(z.literal("")),
  unit: z.string().trim().min(1, "Unit is required").max(50),
  direction: z.enum(INDICATOR_DIRECTION),
  method: z.string().trim().max(500).optional().or(z.literal("")),
  disaggregation: z.array(z.string()).default([]),
  standardRef: z.string().trim().max(100).optional().or(z.literal("")),
  effectiveFrom: z.string().min(1, "Effective date is required"),
});
export type ImpactIndicatorFormData = z.infer<typeof impactIndicatorSchema>;

export const waveAssignmentSchema = z.object({
  indicatorId: z.string().uuid(),
  waveId: z.string().uuid(),
  targetValue: z.number().optional(),
  collectionWindowStart: z.string().optional().or(z.literal("")),
  collectionWindowEnd: z.string().optional().or(z.literal("")),
  required: z.boolean().default(true),
});
export type WaveAssignmentFormData = z.infer<typeof waveAssignmentSchema>;

export const compositeSchema = z
  .object({
    name: z.string().trim().min(3).max(200),
    components: z
      .array(
        z.object({
          indicatorId: z.string().uuid(),
          weight: z.number().min(0).max(100),
        }),
      )
      .min(2, "At least two components required"),
    normalization: z.enum(["MIN_MAX", "Z_SCORE", "NONE"]).default("MIN_MAX"),
    aggregation: z
      .enum(["WEIGHTED_SUM", "WEIGHTED_AVG"])
      .default("WEIGHTED_AVG"),
  })
  .refine(
    (d) => {
      const sum = d.components.reduce((s, c) => s + c.weight, 0);
      return Math.abs(sum - 100) < 0.01;
    },
    { path: ["components"], message: "Weights must sum to 100" },
  );
export type CompositeFormData = z.infer<typeof compositeSchema>;
```

## 9.3 `src/features/impact-indicators/impactIndicator.api.ts`

```ts
import { api } from "@/lib/api/client";
import type {
  ImpactIndicator,
  ImpactIndicatorFilters,
  CompositeFormula,
  TheoryOfChange,
} from "./impactIndicator.types";
import type {
  ImpactIndicatorFormData,
  CompositeFormData,
  WaveAssignmentFormData,
} from "./impactIndicator.schema";

interface Envelope<T> {
  data: T;
}

export const impactIndicatorApi = {
  async list(f: ImpactIndicatorFilters): Promise<ImpactIndicator[]> {
    const p = new URLSearchParams();
    if (f.domain?.length) p.set("domain", f.domain.join(","));
    if (f.q) p.set("q", f.q);
    if (f.status) p.set("status", f.status);
    const { data } = await api.get<Envelope<ImpactIndicator[]>>(
      `/impact-indicators?${p.toString()}`,
    );
    return data.data;
  },

  async get(id: string): Promise<ImpactIndicator> {
    const { data } = await api.get<Envelope<ImpactIndicator>>(
      `/impact-indicators/${id}`,
    );
    return data.data;
  },

  async create(input: ImpactIndicatorFormData): Promise<ImpactIndicator> {
    const { data } = await api.post<Envelope<ImpactIndicator>>(
      "/impact-indicators",
      input,
    );
    return data.data;
  },

  async update(
    id: string,
    patch: Partial<ImpactIndicatorFormData>,
  ): Promise<ImpactIndicator> {
    const { data } = await api.patch<Envelope<ImpactIndicator>>(
      `/impact-indicators/${id}`,
      patch,
    );
    return data.data;
  },

  async assignWave(
    input: WaveAssignmentFormData,
  ): Promise<{ assignmentId: string }> {
    const { data } = await api.post<Envelope<{ assignmentId: string }>>(
      `/impact-indicators/${input.indicatorId}/waves`,
      input,
    );
    return data.data;
  },

  async createComposite(input: CompositeFormData): Promise<ImpactIndicator> {
    const { data } = await api.post<Envelope<ImpactIndicator>>(
      "/impact-indicators/composite",
      input,
    );
    return data.data;
  },

  async theoryOfChange(projectId: string): Promise<TheoryOfChange | null> {
    const { data } = await api.get<Envelope<TheoryOfChange | null>>(
      `/projects/${projectId}/toc`,
    );
    return data.data;
  },

  async standardLibrary(): Promise<
    { code: string; name: string; domain: ImpactDomain; unit: string }[]
  > {
    const { data } = await api.get<
      Envelope<
        { code: string; name: string; domain: ImpactDomain; unit: string }[]
      >
    >("/impact-indicators/standard-library");
    return data.data;
  },
};

// Type-only re-export for use in the API surface
type ImpactDomain = ImpactIndicator["domain"];
```

## 9.4 `src/features/impact-indicators/impactIndicator.queries.ts`

```ts
import { useQuery } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { impactIndicatorApi } from "./impactIndicator.api";
import type { ImpactIndicatorFilters } from "./impactIndicator.types";

export const impactIndicatorKeys = {
  all: ["impact-indicators"] as const,
  list: (f: ImpactIndicatorFilters) =>
    [...impactIndicatorKeys.all, "list", f] as const,
  detail: (id: string) => [...impactIndicatorKeys.all, "detail", id] as const,
  toc: (projectId: string) =>
    [...impactIndicatorKeys.all, "toc", projectId] as const,
  library: () => [...impactIndicatorKeys.all, "library"] as const,
};

export function useImpactIndicators(f: ImpactIndicatorFilters) {
  return useQuery({
    queryKey: impactIndicatorKeys.list(f),
    queryFn: () => impactIndicatorApi.list(f),
    staleTime: 60_000,
  });
}

export function useImpactIndicator(id: string | undefined) {
  return useQuery({
    queryKey: impactIndicatorKeys.detail(id ?? ""),
    queryFn: () => impactIndicatorApi.get(id!),
    enabled: !!id,
  });
}

export function useTheoryOfChange(projectId: string | undefined) {
  return useQuery({
    queryKey: impactIndicatorKeys.toc(projectId ?? ""),
    queryFn: () => impactIndicatorApi.theoryOfChange(projectId!),
    enabled: !!projectId,
  });
}

export function useStandardLibrary() {
  return useQuery({
    queryKey: impactIndicatorKeys.library(),
    queryFn: () => impactIndicatorApi.standardLibrary(),
    staleTime: 5 * 60_000,
  });
}
```

## 9.5 `src/features/impact-indicators/impactIndicator.mutations.ts`

```ts
import { useMutation, useQueryClient } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { impactIndicatorApi } from "./impactIndicator.api";
import { impactIndicatorKeys } from "./impactIndicator.queries";
import { useToast } from "@/components/ui/Toast";
import { normalizeApiError } from "@/lib/api/errors";
import type {
  ImpactIndicatorFormData,
  CompositeFormData,
  WaveAssignmentFormData,
} from "./impactIndicator.schema";

export function useCreateImpactIndicator() {
  const qc = useQueryClient();
  const { push } = useToast();
  return useMutation({
    mutationFn: (input: ImpactIndicatorFormData) =>
      impactIndicatorApi.create(input),
    onSuccess: (i) => {
      qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: impactIndicatorKeys.all });
      push("success", `Indicator ${i.code} created`);
    },
    onError: (err) =>
      push(
        "error",
        normalizeApiError(err).detail ?? "Failed to create indicator",
      ),
  });
}

export function useAssignIndicatorWave() {
  const qc = useQueryClient();
  const { push } = useToast();
  return useMutation({
    mutationFn: (input: WaveAssignmentFormData) =>
      impactIndicatorApi.assignWave(input),
    onSuccess: () => {
      qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: impactIndicatorKeys.all });
      push("success", "Indicator assigned to wave");
    },
  });
}

export function useCreateComposite() {
  const qc = useQueryClient();
  const { push } = useToast();
  return useMutation({
    mutationFn: (input: CompositeFormData) =>
      impactIndicatorApi.createComposite(input),
    onSuccess: (i) => {
      qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: impactIndicatorKeys.all });
      push("success", `Composite index ${i.code} created`);
    },
  });
}
```

```tsx
import { useState } from "react";
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";
import { Plus, Layers } from "lucide-react";
import { useImpactIndicators } from "./impactIndicator.queries";
import { usePermissions } from "@/features/auth/usePermissions";
import { PERMISSIONS } from "@/features/auth/auth.types";
import { DataGrid, type Column } from "@/components/ui/DataGrid";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/Button";
import { Chip } from "@/components/ui/Chip";
import { Card, CardHeader } from "@/components/ui/Card";
import { EmptyState } from "@/components/ui/EmptyState";
import { SkeletonTable } from "@/components/ui/Skeleton";
import { Modal } from "@/components/ui/Modal";
import { ImpactIndicatorForm } from "./ImpactIndicatorForm";
import { CompositeIndexBuilder } from "./CompositeIndexBuilder";
import { WaveAssignmentModal } from "./WaveAssignmentModal";
import {
  IMPACT_DOMAINS,
  type ImpactIndicator,
  type ImpactDomain,
} from "./impactIndicator.types";
import { useUIStore } from "@/stores/ui.store";

const DOMAIN_TONE: Record<ImpactDomain, any> = {
  INCOME: "green",
  ENERGY: "gold",
  WATER: "blue",
  HEALTH: "red",
  EDUCATION: "purple",
  GENDER: "teal",
  ENVIRONMENT: "green",
  RESILIENCE: "amber",
  SATISFACTION: "grey",
};

export default function ImpactIndicatorsPage() {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const { can } = usePermissions();
  const { locale } = useUIStore();
  const [domainFilter, setDomainFilter] = useState<ImpactDomain | "ALL">("ALL");
  const [createOpen, setCreateOpen] = useState(false);
  const [compositeOpen, setCompositeOpen] = useState(false);
  const [assigning, setAssigning] = useState<ImpactIndicator | null>(null);

  const { data, isLoading } = useImpactIndicators({
    domain: domainFilter === "ALL" ? undefined : [domainFilter],
  });

  const columns: Column<ImpactIndicator & { id: string }>[] = [
    {
      id: "code",
      header: "Code",
      render: (r) => (
        <code className="text-caption font-bold text-primary-700">
          {r.code}
        </code>
      ),
    },
    {
      id: "name",
      header: "Indicator",
      render: (r) => (
        <div className="min-w-0">
          <div className="font-semibold truncate">
            {locale === "am" && r.nameAm ? r.nameAm : r.name}
          </div>
          <div className="text-caption text-neutral-600">
            {r.unit} · {r.direction.toLowerCase()}
          </div>
        </div>
      ),
    },
    {
      id: "domain",
      header: "Domain",
      render: (r) => <Chip tone={DOMAIN_TONE[r.domain]}>{r.domain}</Chip>,
    },
    {
      id: "isComposite",
      header: "Type",
      render: (r) =>
        r.isComposite ? (
          <Chip tone="teal">
            <Layers className="h-3 w-3" aria-hidden /> Composite
          </Chip>
        ) : (
          <span className="text-caption text-neutral-600">Base</span>
        ),
    },
    {
      id: "disaggregation",
      header: "Disagg.",
      render: (r) => (
        <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1">
          {r.disaggregation.length === 0 ? (
            <span className="text-caption text-neutral-500">—</span>
          ) : (
            r.disaggregation.slice(0, 3).map((d) => (
              <span
                key={d}
                className="text-[10px] bg-neutral-100 px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded font-mono"
              >
                {d}
              </span>
            ))
          )}
        </div>
      ),
    },
    {
      id: "status",
      header: "Status",
      render: (r) => (
        <Chip tone={r.status === "ACTIVE" ? "green" : "grey"}>{r.status}</Chip>
      ),
    },
    {
      id: "actions",
      header: "",
      render: (r) => (
        <Button
          size="sm"
          variant="ghost"
          onClick={(e) => {
            e.stopPropagation();
            setAssigning(r);
          }}
        >
          Assign to wave
        </Button>
      ),
    },
  ];

  return (
    <main id="main" tabIndex={-1} className="space-y-5">
      <header className="flex flex-wrap items-start justify-between gap-3">
        <div>
          <h1 className="text-h1 text-primary-900">
            {t("impactIndicators.title")}
          </h1>
          <p className="text-body-sm text-neutral-600 mt-1">
            {data?.length ?? 0} {t("impactIndicators.indicators")}
          </p>
        </div>
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
          {can(PERMISSIONS.impactDesign) && (
            <>
              <Button
                variant="secondary"
                size="sm"
                leftIcon={<Layers className="h-4 w-4" />}
                onClick={() => setCompositeOpen(true)}
              >
                {t("impactIndicators.composite")}
              </Button>
              <Button
                variant="primary"
                size="sm"
                leftIcon={<Plus className="h-4 w-4" />}
                onClick={() => setCreateOpen(true)}
              >
                {t("impactIndicators.new")}
              </Button>
            </>
          )}
        </div>
      </header>

      <Card>
        <CardHeader title={t("impactIndicators.filterByDomain")} />
        <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => setDomainFilter("ALL")}
            aria-pressed={domainFilter === "ALL"}
          >
            <Chip tone={domainFilter === "ALL" ? "blue" : "grey"}>
              All domains
            </Chip>
          </button>
          {IMPACT_DOMAINS.map((d) => (
            <button
              key={d}
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setDomainFilter(d)}
              aria-pressed={domainFilter === d}
            >
              <Chip tone={domainFilter === d ? DOMAIN_TONE[d] : "grey"}>
                {d}
              </Chip>
            </button>
          ))}
        </div>
      </Card>

      {isLoading && <SkeletonTable rows={6} cols={columns.length} />}
      {!isLoading && (data?.length ?? 0) === 0 && (
        <EmptyState
          title={t("impactIndicators.empty")}
          description={t("impactIndicators.emptyHint")}
        />
      )}
      {!isLoading && (data?.length ?? 0) > 0 && (
        <DataGrid
          columns={columns}
          rows={data!.map((i) => ({ ...i, id: i.indicatorId }))}
          ariaLabel={t("impactIndicators.title")}
        />
      )}

      <Modal
        open={createOpen}
        onClose={() => setCreateOpen(false)}
        title={t("impactIndicators.new")}
        size="md"
      >
        <ImpactIndicatorForm onSuccess={() => setCreateOpen(false)} />
      </Modal>

      <Modal
        open={compositeOpen}
        onClose={() => setCompositeOpen(false)}
        title={t("impactIndicators.composite")}
        size="md"
      >
        <CompositeIndexBuilder
          indicators={data ?? []}
          onSuccess={() => setCompositeOpen(false)}
        />
      </Modal>

      {assigning && (
        <WaveAssignmentModal
          open
          indicator={assigning}
          onClose={() => setAssigning(null)}
        />
      )}
    </main>
  );
}
```

## 9.8 `src/features/impact-indicators/CompositeIndexBuilder.tsx`

```tsx
import { useState } from "react";
import { useForm, useFieldArray } from "react-hook-form";
import { zodResolver } from "@hookform/resolvers/zod";
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";
import { Plus, Trash2 } from "lucide-react";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/Input";
import { Select } from "@/components/ui/Select";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/Button";
import { IconButton } from "@/components/ui/IconButton";
import {
  compositeSchema,
  type CompositeFormData,
} from "./impactIndicator.schema";
import { useCreateComposite } from "./impactIndicator.mutations";
import type { ImpactIndicator } from "./impactIndicator.types";

export function CompositeIndexBuilder({
  indicators,
  onSuccess,
}: {
  indicators: ImpactIndicator[];
  onSuccess?: () => void;
}) {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const create = useCreateComposite();
  const baseIndicators = indicators.filter((i) => !i.isComposite);

  const {
    register,
    handleSubmit,
    control,
    watch,
    formState: { errors },
  } = useForm<CompositeFormData>({
    resolver: zodResolver(compositeSchema),
    defaultValues: {
      name: "",
      components: [
        { indicatorId: baseIndicators[0]?.indicatorId ?? "", weight: 50 },
        { indicatorId: baseIndicators[1]?.indicatorId ?? "", weight: 50 },
      ],
      normalization: "MIN_MAX",
      aggregation: "WEIGHTED_AVG",
    },
  });
  const { fields, append, remove } = useFieldArray({
    control,
    name: "components",
  });

  const components = watch("components");
  const totalWeight = (components ?? []).reduce(
    (s, c) => s + (Number(c.weight) || 0),
    0,
  );
  const valid = Math.abs(totalWeight - 100) < 0.01;

  const onSubmit = async (v: CompositeFormData) => {
    await create.mutateAsync(v);
    onSuccess?.();
  };

  return (
    <form onSubmit={handleSubmit(onSubmit)} className="space-y-4" noValidate>
      <Input
        {...register("name")}
        label={t("impactIndicators.compositeForm.name")}
        required
        error={errors.name?.message}
        placeholder="Women's Empowerment Index"
      />

      <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4">
        <Select
          {...register("normalization")}
          label={t("impactIndicators.compositeForm.normalization")}
          options={[
            { value: "MIN_MAX", label: "Min-Max (0-1)" },
            { value: "Z_SCORE", label: "Z-score" },
            { value: "NONE", label: "None" },
          ]}
        />
        <Select
          {...register("aggregation")}
          label={t("impactIndicators.compositeForm.aggregation")}
          options={[
            { value: "WEIGHTED_SUM", label: "Weighted sum" },
            { value: "WEIGHTED_AVG", label: "Weighted average" },
          ]}
        />
      </div>

      <div>
        <div className="text-caption font-semibold text-primary-900 mb-2">
          {t("impactIndicators.compositeForm.components")}
        </div>
        <ul className="space-y-2">
          {fields.map((f, i) => (
            <li
              key={f.id}
              className="grid grid-cols-[1fr_120px_40px] gap-2 items-end"
            >
              <Select
                {...register(`components.${i}.indicatorId` as const)}
                label={i === 0 ? "Indicator" : ""}
                options={baseIndicators.map((ind) => ({
                  value: ind.indicatorId,
                  label: `${ind.code} · ${ind.name}`,
                }))}
              />
              <Input
                {...register(`components.${i}.weight` as const, {
                  valueAsNumber: true,
                })}
                label={i === 0 ? "Weight %" : ""}
                type="number"
                inputMode="numeric"
              />
              <div className="pb-0.5">
                <IconButton
                  type="button"
                  label="Remove"
                  icon={<Trash2 className="h-4 w-4" />}
                  onClick={() => fields.length > 2 && remove(i)}
                  disabled={fields.length <= 2}
                />
              </div>
            </li>
          ))}
        </ul>
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={() => append({ indicatorId: "", weight: 0 })}
          className="mt-2 inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-caption font-semibold text-primary-700 hover:underline"
        >
          <Plus className="h-3.5 w-3.5" aria-hidden /> Add component
        </button>
      </div>

      <div
        role={valid ? "status" : "alert"}
        className={`text-caption font-semibold ${valid ? "text-green-700" : "text-danger"}`}
      >
        Total weight: {totalWeight}% {valid ? "✓" : "— must equal 100%"}
      </div>

      <div className="flex justify-end">
        <Button
          type="submit"
          variant="primary"
          loading={create.isPending}
          disabled={!valid}
        >
          {t("impactIndicators.compositeForm.create")}
        </Button>
      </div>
    </form>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import { useForm } from "react-hook-form";
import { zodResolver } from "@hookform/resolvers/zod";
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";
import { Modal } from "@/components/ui/Modal";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/Button";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/Input";
import { Select } from "@/components/ui/Select";
import { DateInput } from "@/components/ui/DateInput";
import { Checkbox } from "@/components/ui/Checkbox";
import {
  waveAssignmentSchema,
  type WaveAssignmentFormData,
} from "./impactIndicator.schema";
import { useAssignIndicatorWave } from "./impactIndicator.mutations";
import type { ImpactIndicator } from "./impactIndicator.types";

const WAVES = [
  { value: "wave-w0", label: "W0 · Baseline" },
  { value: "wave-w1", label: "W1 · Midline" },
  { value: "wave-w2", label: "W2 · Endline" },
  { value: "wave-w3", label: "W3 · Ex-post" },
];

export function WaveAssignmentModal({
  open,
  indicator,
  onClose,
}: {
  open: boolean;
  indicator: ImpactIndicator;
  onClose: () => void;
}) {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const assign = useAssignIndicatorWave();

  const {
    register,
    handleSubmit,
    formState: { errors },
    reset,
  } = useForm<WaveAssignmentFormData>({
    resolver: zodResolver(waveAssignmentSchema),
    defaultValues: {
      indicatorId: indicator.indicatorId,
      waveId: "",
      targetValue: undefined,
      required: true,
      collectionWindowStart: "",
      collectionWindowEnd: "",
    },
  });

  const onSubmit = async (v: WaveAssignmentFormData) => {
    await assign.mutateAsync(v);
    reset();
    onClose();
  };

  return (
    <Modal
      open={open}
      onClose={onClose}
      title={t("impactIndicators.waveForm.title")}
      size="sm"
      footer={
        <>
          <Button variant="ghost" onClick={onClose}>
            {t("actions.cancel")}
          </Button>
          <Button
            variant="primary"
            loading={assign.isPending}
            onClick={handleSubmit(onSubmit)}
          >
            {t("actions.save")}
          </Button>
        </>
      }
    >
      <form onSubmit={handleSubmit(onSubmit)} className="space-y-4" noValidate>
        <div className="text-caption text-neutral-600 mb-2">
          <code className="text-primary-700 font-bold">{indicator.code}</code> ·{" "}
          {indicator.name}
        </div>
        <input type="hidden" {...register("indicatorId")} />
        <Select
          {...register("waveId")}
          label={t("impactIndicators.waveForm.wave")}
          required
          placeholder="—"
          error={errors.waveId?.message}
          options={WAVES}
        />
        <Input
          {...register("targetValue", { valueAsNumber: true })}
          type="number"
          label={t("impactIndicators.waveForm.target")}
          error={errors.targetValue?.message}
        />
        <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
          <DateInput
            {...register("collectionWindowStart")}
            label="Window start"
          />
          <DateInput {...register("collectionWindowEnd")} label="Window end" />
        </div>
        <Checkbox
          {...register("required")}
          label={t("impactIndicators.waveForm.required")}
        />
      </form>
    </Modal>
  );
}
```

## 9.12 `src/features/survey/skipLogic.ts` — Safe Expression Evaluator

**Critical piece.** Evaluates XLSForm-style conditions without `eval()`. Supports `${field}` references, comparison operators, `and`/`or`/`not`, parentheses, and `selected()` / `count-selected()`.

```ts
/**
 * Safe expression evaluator for XLSForm-style relevance / skip-logic conditions.
 *
 * Grammar supported:
 *   expr    := orExpr
 *   orExpr  := andExpr ('or' andExpr)*
 *   andExpr := notExpr ('and' notExpr)*
 *   notExpr := 'not' notExpr | primary
 *   primary := '(' expr ')' | comparison | function | field | literal
 *   comparison := operand (op operand)?    where op in =, !=, >, <, >=, <=
 *   operand := field | literal | function
 *   field   := '${' IDENT '}'
 *   function := 'selected' '(' field ',' literal ')' | 'count-selected' '(' field ')'
 *
 * Values in the context are the raw answer values (string | number | string[] | null).
 * Comparison is type-aware: if both are numeric → numeric compare, else string compare.
 */

type Token =
  | { type: "IDENT"; value: string } // and, or, not, selected, count-selected
  | { type: "FIELD"; value: string } // ${name}
  | { type: "NUMBER"; value: number }
  | { type: "STRING"; value: string }
  | { type: "OP"; value: "=" | "!=" | ">" | "<" | ">=" | "<=" }
  | { type: "LPAREN" }
  | { type: "RPAREN" }
  | { type: "COMMA" };

export class SkipLogicError extends Error {
  constructor(message: string) {
    super(message);
    this.name = "SkipLogicError";
  }
}

function tokenize(input: string): Token[] {
  const tokens: Token[] = [];
  let i = 0;
  while (i < input.length) {
    const c = input[i]!;

    if (/\s/.test(c)) {
      i++;
      continue;
    }

    if (c === "(") {
      tokens.push({ type: "LPAREN" });
      i++;
      continue;
    }
    if (c === ")") {
      tokens.push({ type: "RPAREN" });
      i++;
      continue;
    }
    if (c === ",") {
      tokens.push({ type: "COMMA" });
      i++;
      continue;
    }

    // ${field}
    if (c === "$" && input[i + 1] === "{") {
      const end = input.indexOf("}", i + 2);
      if (end === -1)
        throw new SkipLogicError(`Unclosed field reference at position ${i}`);
      tokens.push({ type: "FIELD", value: input.slice(i + 2, end).trim() });
      i = end + 1;
      continue;
    }

    // quoted string
    if (c === '"' || c === "'") {
      const quote = c;
      let j = i + 1;
      let val = "";
      while (j < input.length && input[j] !== quote) {
        if (input[j] === "\\" && j + 1 < input.length) {
          val += input[j + 1];
          j += 2;
        } else {
          val += input[j];
          j++;
        }
      }
      if (j >= input.length)
        throw new SkipLogicError("Unterminated string literal");
      tokens.push({ type: "STRING", value: val });
      i = j + 1;
      continue;
    }

    // number
    if (/[0-9]/.test(c) || (c === "-" && /[0-9]/.test(input[i + 1] ?? ""))) {
      let j = i;
      if (input[j] === "-") j++;
      while (j < input.length && /[0-9.]/.test(input[j]!)) j++;
      tokens.push({ type: "NUMBER", value: Number(input.slice(i, j)) });
      i = j;
      continue;
    }

    // operators
    if (c === "!") {
      if (input[i + 1] === "=") {
        tokens.push({ type: "OP", value: "!=" });
        i += 2;
        continue;
      }
      throw new SkipLogicError(`Unexpected '!' at ${i}`);
    }
    if (c === "=") {
      tokens.push({ type: "OP", value: "=" });
      i++;
      continue;
    }
    if (c === ">") {
      if (input[i + 1] === "=") {
        tokens.push({ type: "OP", value: ">=" });
        i += 2;
        continue;
      }
      tokens.push({ type: "OP", value: ">" });
      i++;
      continue;
    }
    if (c === "<") {
      if (input[i + 1] === "=") {
        tokens.push({ type: "OP", value: "<=" });
        i += 2;
        continue;
      }
      tokens.push({ type: "OP", value: "<" });
      i++;
      continue;
    }

    // identifier (and, or, not, selected, count-selected)
    if (/[a-zA-Z_-]/.test(c)) {
      let j = i;
      while (j < input.length && /[a-zA-Z0-9_-]/.test(input[j]!)) j++;
      tokens.push({ type: "IDENT", value: input.slice(i, j) });
      i = j;
      continue;
    }

    throw new SkipLogicError(`Unexpected character '${c}' at ${i}`);
  }
  return tokens;
}

/* ---------- Parse tree (simple AST) ---------- */
type Node =
  | { kind: "AND" | "OR"; left: Node; right: Node }
  | { kind: "NOT"; child: Node }
  | {
      kind: "CMP";
      op: "=" | "!=" | ">" | "<" | ">=" | "<=";
      left: Operand;
      right: Operand;
    }
  | { kind: "OPERAND"; operand: Operand };

type Operand =
  | { kind: "FIELD"; name: string }
  | { kind: "STRING"; value: string }
  | { kind: "NUMBER"; value: number }
  | { kind: "SELECTED"; field: string; value: string }
  | { kind: "COUNT_SELECTED"; field: string };

class Parser {
  private pos = 0;
  constructor(private tokens: Token[]) {}

  parse(): Node {
    const n = this.parseOr();
    if (this.pos < this.tokens.length) {
      throw new SkipLogicError(
        `Unexpected token: ${this.tokens[this.pos]!.type}`,
      );
    }
    return n;
  }

  private parseOr(): Node {
    let left = this.parseAnd();
    while (this.matchIdent("or")) {
      const right = this.parseAnd();
      left = { kind: "OR", left, right };
    }
    return left;
  }

  private parseAnd(): Node {
    let left = this.parseNot();
    while (this.matchIdent("and")) {
      const right = this.parseNot();
      left = { kind: "AND", left, right };
    }
    return left;
  }

  private parseNot(): Node {
    if (this.matchIdent("not")) {
      return { kind: "NOT", child: this.parseNot() };
    }
    return this.parsePrimary();
  }

  private parsePrimary(): Node {
    if (this.peek()?.type === "LPAREN") {
      this.consume("LPAREN");
      const n = this.parseOr();
      this.consume("RPAREN");
      return n;
    }
    const left = this.parseOperand();
    if (this.peek()?.type === "OP") {
      const op = (this.consume("OP") as { type: "OP"; value: any }).value;
      const right = this.parseOperand();
      return { kind: "CMP", op, left, right };
    }
    return { kind: "OPERAND", operand: left };
  }

  private parseOperand(): Operand {
    const t = this.next();
    if (!t) throw new SkipLogicError("Unexpected end of expression");
    if (t.type === "FIELD") return { kind: "FIELD", name: t.value };
    if (t.type === "STRING") return { kind: "STRING", value: t.value };
    if (t.type === "NUMBER") return { kind: "NUMBER", value: t.value };
    if (t.type === "IDENT") {
      if (t.value === "selected") {
        this.consume("LPAREN");
        const f = this.next();
        if (!f || f.type !== "FIELD")
          throw new SkipLogicError("selected() expects a field reference");
        this.consume("COMMA");
        const v = this.next();
        if (!v || (v.type !== "STRING" && v.type !== "NUMBER")) {
          throw new SkipLogicError("selected() expects a value after comma");
        }
        this.consume("RPAREN");
        return { kind: "SELECTED", field: f.value, value: String(v.value) };
      }
      if (t.value === "count-selected") {
        this.consume("LPAREN");
        const f = this.next();
        if (!f || f.type !== "FIELD")
          throw new SkipLogicError(
            "count-selected() expects a field reference",
          );
        this.consume("RPAREN");
        return { kind: "COUNT_SELECTED", field: f.value };
      }
      // bare identifiers we don't recognize → treat as error
      throw new SkipLogicError(`Unknown identifier: ${t.value}`);
    }
    throw new SkipLogicError(`Unexpected token: ${t.type}`);
  }

  private peek(): Token | undefined {
    return this.tokens[this.pos];
  }
  private next(): Token | undefined {
    return this.tokens[this.pos++];
  }

  private consume(kind: Token["type"]) {
    const t = this.next();
    if (!t || t.type !== kind) throw new SkipLogicError(`Expected ${kind}`);
    return t;
  }

  private matchIdent(name: string): boolean {
    const t = this.peek();
    if (t?.type === "IDENT" && t.value === name) {
      this.pos++;
      return true;
    }
    return false;
  }
}

/* ---------- Evaluation ---------- */

export type AnswerMap = Record<
  string,
  string | number | string[] | null | undefined
>;

function evalOperand(
  op: Operand,
  ctx: AnswerMap,
): string | number | string[] | null {
  switch (op.kind) {
    case "FIELD":
      return ctx[op.name] ?? null;
    case "STRING":
      return op.value;
    case "NUMBER":
      return op.value;
    case "SELECTED": {
      const v = ctx[op.field];
      return Array.isArray(v)
        ? v.includes(op.value)
          ? 1
          : 0
        : v === op.value
          ? 1
          : 0;
    }
    case "COUNT_SELECTED": {
      const v = ctx[op.field];
      return Array.isArray(v) ? v.length : v == null ? 0 : 1;
    }
  }
}

function compare(
  a: string | number | string[] | null,
  b: string | number | string[] | null,
  op: string,
): boolean {
  const na = typeof a === "number" ? a : a == null ? null : Number(a);
  const nb = typeof b === "number" ? b : b == null ? null : Number(b);
  const bothNumeric =
    na != null && nb != null && !Number.isNaN(na) && !Number.isNaN(nb);

  if (bothNumeric) {
    switch (op) {
      case "=":
        return na === nb;
      case "!=":
        return na !== nb;
      case ">":
        return na > nb;
      case "<":
        return na < nb;
      case ">=":
        return na >= nb;
      case "<=":
        return na <= nb;
    }
  }

  const sa = a == null ? "" : String(a);
  const sb = b == null ? "" : String(b);
  switch (op) {
    case "=":
      return sa === sb;
    case "!=":
      return sa !== sb;
    // For strings, alphabetical comparison
    case ">":
      return sa > sb;
    case "<":
      return sa < sb;
    case ">=":
      return sa >= sb;
    case "<=":
      return sa <= sb;
  }
  return false;
}

function evalNode(n: Node, ctx: AnswerMap): boolean {
  switch (n.kind) {
    case "AND":
      return evalNode(n.left, ctx) && evalNode(n.right, ctx);
    case "OR":
      return evalNode(n.left, ctx) || evalNode(n.right, ctx);
    case "NOT":
      return !evalNode(n.child, ctx);
    case "CMP":
      return compare(evalOperand(n.left, ctx), evalOperand(n.right, ctx), n.op);
    case "OPERAND": {
      const v = evalOperand(n.operand, ctx);
      if (typeof v === "number") return v !== 0;
      if (Array.isArray(v)) return v.length > 0;
      if (v == null || v === "") return false;
      return String(v).toLowerCase() !== "false";
    }
  }
}

/**
 * Evaluate a skip-logic condition.
 * Returns `true` if the condition is satisfied (e.g. the question should be shown).
 */
export function evaluateCondition(condition: string, ctx: AnswerMap): boolean {
  if (!condition.trim()) return true;
  try {
    const tokens = tokenize(condition);
    const ast = new Parser(tokens).parse();
    return evalNode(ast, ctx);
  } catch (err) {
    // Fail safe: if the condition is malformed, default to SHOW (so users don't lose data)
    // eslint-disable-next-line no-console
    console.warn(
      "Skip logic evaluation failed:",
      (err as Error).message,
      condition,
    );
    return true;
  }
}

/**
 * Compute which questions should be visible given the current answers,
 * applying SKIP / SHOW / HIDE / REQUIRE actions.
 */
export function computeVisibility(
  questions: {
    questionId: string;
    skipLogic?: {
      condition: string;
      action: string;
      targetQuestionId?: string;
    }[];
  }[],
  ctx: AnswerMap,
): { visible: Set<string>; required: Set<string> } {
  const visible = new Set(questions.map((q) => q.questionId));
  const required = new Set<string>();

  for (const q of questions) {
    if (!q.skipLogic) continue;
    for (const rule of q.skipLogic) {
      const ok = evaluateCondition(rule.condition, ctx);
      if (rule.action === "SKIP" || rule.action === "HIDE") {
        if (ok && rule.targetQuestionId) visible.delete(rule.targetQuestionId);
      } else if (rule.action === "SHOW") {
        if (ok && rule.targetQuestionId) visible.add(rule.targetQuestionId);
      } else if (rule.action === "REQUIRE") {
        if (ok) required.add(q.questionId);
      }
    }
  }

  return { visible, required };
}
```

## 9.13 `src/features/survey/xlsform.ts`

```ts
/**
 * Minimal XLSForm import/export.
 *
 * XLSForm structure (simplified):
 *   survey sheet: type | name | label | label::Amharic | required | relevant | constraint | appearance
 *   choices sheet: list_name | name | label | label::Amharic
 *
 * We map:
 *   - `select_one list` → SINGLE with options
 *   - `select_multiple list` → MULTI
 *   - `integer` / `decimal` → NUMERIC / DECIMAL
 *   - `text` → TEXT
 *   - `date` → DATE
 *   - `geopoint` → GPS
 *   - `image` → PHOTO
 *   - `audio` → AUDIO
 *   - `barcode` → BARCODE
 *   - `begin_repeat` / `end_repeat` → repeatable section
 */

import type {
  Question,
  QuestionType,
  Section,
  QuestionOption,
} from "./survey.types";

export interface XlsFormRow {
  type: string;
  name: string;
  label?: string;
  labelAm?: string;
  required?: string;
  relevant?: string;
  constraint?: string;
  appearance?: string;
  calculation?: string;
}

export interface XlsFormChoiceRow {
  list_name: string;
  name: string;
  label?: string;
  labelAm?: string;
}

interface XlsForm {
  survey: XlsFormRow[];
  choices: XlsFormChoiceRow[];
}

/* -------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * Import
 * ------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

export function parseXlsForm(xls: XlsForm): Section[] {
  const sections: Section[] = [];
  const questionsByGroup: Record<string, Question[]> = {};
  const choicesByList: Record<string, QuestionOption[]> = {};

  // Pre-index choices
  for (const c of xls.choices) {
    if (!choicesByList[c.list_name]) choicesByList[c.list_name] = [];
    choicesByList[c.list_name]!.push({
      code: c.name,
      label: c.label ?? c.name,
      labelAm: c.labelAm,
      value: c.name,
      orderNo: choicesByList[c.list_name]!.length,
    });
  }

  // Walk the survey rows
  let currentSection: Section | null = null;
  let order = 0;

  for (const row of xls.survey) {
    const type = row.type.trim();
    if (type === "begin_group" || type === "begin_repeat") {
      const sectionId = crypto.randomUUID();
      currentSection = {
        sectionId,
        versionId: "",
        code: row.name,
        title: row.label ?? row.name,
        titleAm: row.labelAm,
        orderNo: sections.length,
        repeatable: type === "begin_repeat",
        questions: [],
      };
      sections.push(currentSection);
      order = 0;
      continue;
    }
    if (type === "end_group" || type === "end_repeat") {
      currentSection = null;
      continue;
    }

    // Choose target section
    const target =
      currentSection ??
      (() => {
        const s: Section = {
          sectionId: crypto.randomUUID(),
          versionId: "",
          code: "default",
          title: "Default",
          orderNo: sections.length,
          repeatable: false,
          questions: [],
        };
        sections.push(s);
        return s;
      })();

    const parsed = parseQuestionRow(
      row,
      target.sectionId,
      order++,
      choicesByList,
    );
    if (parsed) target.questions.push(parsed);
  }

  return sections;
}

function parseQuestionRow(
  row: XlsFormRow,
  sectionId: string,
  order: number,
  choices: Record<string, QuestionOption[]>,
): Question | null {
  const type = row.type.trim();

  let questionType: QuestionType | null = null;
  let optionsListName: string | null = null;

  if (type === "integer") questionType = "NUMERIC";
  else if (type === "decimal") questionType = "DECIMAL";
  else if (type === "text") questionType = "TEXT";
  else if (type === "date") questionType = "DATE";
  else if (type === "geopoint") questionType = "GPS";
  else if (type === "image") questionType = "PHOTO";
  else if (type === "audio") questionType = "AUDIO";
  else if (type === "barcode") questionType = "BARCODE";
  else if (type === "calculate") questionType = "CALCULATED";
  else if (type.startsWith("select_one ")) {
    questionType = "SINGLE";
    optionsListName = type.slice(11).trim();
  } else if (type.startsWith("select_multiple ")) {
    questionType = "MULTI";
    optionsListName = type.slice(16).trim();
  } else if (type.startsWith("select_one")) {
    questionType = "SINGLE";
  } else if (type.startsWith("select_multiple")) {
    questionType = "MULTI";
  }

  if (!questionType) return null;

  const q: Question = {
    questionId: crypto.randomUUID(),
    sectionId,
    code: row.name,
    type: questionType,
    text: row.label ?? row.name,
    textAm: row.labelAm,
    hint: row.constraint,
    required: row.required === "yes" || row.required === "true",
    orderNo: order,
    calculation: row.calculation,
    options: optionsListName ? (choices[optionsListName] ?? []) : undefined,
    skipLogic: row.relevant
      ? [
          {
            logicId: crypto.randomUUID(),
            questionId: "",
            condition: row.relevant,
            action: "SHOW",
          },
        ]
      : undefined,
  };
  return q;
}

/* -------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * Export
 * ------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

export function toXlsForm(sections: Section[]): XlsForm {
  const survey: XlsFormRow[] = [];
  const choices: XlsFormChoiceRow[] = [];
  let listIndex = 0;

  for (const section of sections) {
    survey.push({
      type: section.repeatable ? "begin_repeat" : "begin_group",
      name: section.code,
      label: section.title,
      labelAm: section.titleAm,
    });
    for (const q of section.questions) {
      const type = toXlsType(q.type);
      let xlsType = type;
      if ((q.type === "SINGLE" || q.type === "MULTI") && q.options) {
        const listName = `list_${listIndex++}`;
        xlsType = `${type} ${listName}`;
        for (const opt of q.options) {
          choices.push({
            list_name: listName,
            name: opt.code,
            label: opt.label,
            labelAm: opt.labelAm,
          });
        }
      }
      survey.push({
        type: xlsType,
        name: q.code,
        label: q.text,
        labelAm: q.textAm,
        required: q.required ? "yes" : "",
        relevant: q.skipLogic?.[0]?.condition,
        constraint: q.hint,
        calculation: q.calculation,
      });
    }
    survey.push({
      type: section.repeatable ? "end_repeat" : "end_group",
      name: "",
    });
  }

  return { survey, choices };
}

function toXlsType(t: QuestionType): string {
  switch (t) {
    case "SINGLE":
      return "select_one";
    case "MULTI":
      return "select_multiple";
    case "NUMERIC":
      return "integer";
    case "DECIMAL":
      return "decimal";
    case "DATE":
      return "date";
    case "TEXT":
      return "text";
    case "GPS":
      return "geopoint";
    case "PHOTO":
      return "image";
    case "AUDIO":
      return "audio";
    case "BARCODE":
      return "barcode";
    case "CALCULATED":
      return "calculate";
    case "MATRIX":
    case "RANKING":
      return "text";
  }
}
```

## 9.14 `src/features/survey/survey.api.ts`

```ts
import { api } from "@/lib/api/client";
import type { Survey, SurveyFilters, SurveyVersion } from "./survey.types";
import type {
  SurveyFormData,
  SectionFormData,
  QuestionFormData,
  SkipLogicFormData,
} from "./survey.schema";

interface Envelope<T> {
  data: T;
}

export const surveyApi = {
  async list(f: SurveyFilters): Promise<Survey[]> {
    const p = new URLSearchParams();
    if (f.q) p.set("q", f.q);
    if (f.status) p.set("status", f.status);
    const { data } = await api.get<Envelope<Survey[]>>(
      `/surveys?${p.toString()}`,
    );
    return data.data;
  },

  async get(id: string): Promise<Survey> {
    const { data } = await api.get<Envelope<Survey>>(`/surveys/${id}`);
    return data.data;
  },

  async create(input: SurveyFormData): Promise<Survey> {
    const { data } = await api.post<Envelope<Survey>>("/surveys", input);
    return data.data;
  },

  async createVersion(
    surveyId: string,
    sections: SectionFormData[],
  ): Promise<SurveyVersion> {
    const { data } = await api.post<Envelope<SurveyVersion>>(
      `/surveys/${surveyId}/versions`,
      { sections },
    );
    return data.data;
  },

  async publish(surveyId: string): Promise<SurveyVersion> {
    const { data } = await api.post<Envelope<SurveyVersion>>(
      `/surveys/${surveyId}/publish`,
    );
    return data.data;
  },

  async lockVersion(
    surveyId: string,
    versionId: string,
  ): Promise<SurveyVersion> {
    const { data } = await api.post<Envelope<SurveyVersion>>(
      `/surveys/${surveyId}/versions/${versionId}/lock`,
    );
    return data.data;
  },

  async createQuestion(
    versionId: string,
    input: QuestionFormData,
  ): Promise<{ questionId: string }> {
    const { data } = await api.post<Envelope<{ questionId: string }>>(
      `/surveys/versions/${versionId}/questions`,
      input,
    );
    return data.data;
  },

  async createSkipLogic(
    versionId: string,
    input: SkipLogicFormData,
  ): Promise<{ logicId: string }> {
    const { data } = await api.post<Envelope<{ logicId: string }>>(
      `/surveys/versions/${versionId}/skip-logic`,
      input,
    );
    return data.data;
  },

  async exportXlsForm(surveyId: string): Promise<Blob> {
    const { data } = await api.get(`/surveys/${surveyId}/export-xlsform`, {
      responseType: "blob",
    });
    return data as unknown as Blob;
  },

  async importXlsForm(file: File, projectId?: string): Promise<Survey> {
    const fd = new FormData();
    fd.append("file", file);
    if (projectId) fd.append("project_id", projectId);
    const { data } = await api.post<Envelope<Survey>>(
      "/surveys/import-xlsform",
      fd,
      {
        headers: { "Content-Type": "multipart/form-data" },
      },
    );
    return data.data;
  },
};
```

```ts
// survey.queries.ts
import { useQuery } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { surveyApi } from "./survey.api";
import type { SurveyFilters } from "./survey.types";

export const surveyKeys = {
  all: ["surveys"] as const,
  list: (f: SurveyFilters) => [...surveyKeys.all, "list", f] as const,
  detail: (id: string) => [...surveyKeys.all, "detail", id] as const,
};

export function useSurveys(f: SurveyFilters) {
  return useQuery({
    queryKey: surveyKeys.list(f),
    queryFn: () => surveyApi.list(f),
    staleTime: 60_000,
  });
}

export function useSurvey(id: string | undefined) {
  return useQuery({
    queryKey: surveyKeys.detail(id ?? ""),
    queryFn: () => surveyApi.get(id!),
    enabled: !!id,
  });
}
```

```ts
// survey.mutations.ts
import { useMutation, useQueryClient } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { surveyApi } from "./survey.api";
import { surveyKeys } from "./survey.queries";
import { useToast } from "@/components/ui/Toast";
import { normalizeApiError } from "@/lib/api/errors";
import type {
  SurveyFormData,
  QuestionFormData,
  SectionFormData,
  SkipLogicFormData,
} from "./survey.schema";

export function useCreateSurvey() {
  const qc = useQueryClient();
  const { push } = useToast();
  return useMutation({
    mutationFn: (input: SurveyFormData) => surveyApi.create(input),
    onSuccess: (s) => {
      qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: surveyKeys.all });
      push("success", `Survey ${s.code} created`);
    },
    onError: (err) =>
      push("error", normalizeApiError(err).detail ?? "Failed to create survey"),
  });
}

export function usePublishSurvey(surveyId: string) {
  const qc = useQueryClient();
  const { push } = useToast();
  return useMutation({
    mutationFn: () => surveyApi.publish(surveyId),
    onSuccess: () => {
      qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: surveyKeys.all });
      push("success", "Survey published");
    },
  });
}

export function useAddQuestion(versionId: string) {
  const qc = useQueryClient();
  const { push } = useToast();
  return useMutation({
    mutationFn: (input: QuestionFormData) =>
      surveyApi.createQuestion(versionId, input),
    onSuccess: () => {
      qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: surveyKeys.all });
      push("success", "Question added");
    },
  });
}

export function useAddSkipLogic(versionId: string) {
  const qc = useQueryClient();
  const { push } = useToast();
  return useMutation({
    mutationFn: (input: SkipLogicFormData) =>
      surveyApi.createSkipLogic(versionId, input),
    onSuccess: () => {
      qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: surveyKeys.all });
      push("success", "Skip logic added");
    },
  });
}
```
