```tsx
import { useState } from "react";
import { useParams } from "react-router-dom";
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";
import { Plus, Rocket, Download, Lock } from "lucide-react";
import { useSurvey } from "./survey.queries";
import { usePublishSurvey } from "./survey.mutations";
import { surveyApi } from "./survey.api";
import { usePermissions } from "@/features/auth/usePermissions";
import { PERMISSIONS } from "@/features/auth/auth.types";
import { LoadingState } from "@/components/ui/LoadingState";
import { EmptyState } from "@/components/ui/EmptyState";
import { Card, CardHeader } from "@/components/ui/Card";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/Button";
import { Chip } from "@/components/ui/Chip";
import { Modal } from "@/components/ui/Modal";
import { ConfirmDialog } from "@/components/ui/ConfirmDialog";
import { useToast } from "@/components/ui/Toast";
import { SectionEditor } from "./SectionEditor";
import { QuestionEditor } from "./QuestionEditor";
import { SurveyPreview } from "./SurveyPreview";
import { SkipLogicEditor } from "./SkipLogicEditor";

export default function SurveyBuilderPage() {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const { surveyId } = useParams<{ surveyId: string }>();
  const { can } = usePermissions();
  const { push } = useToast();
  const { data: survey, isLoading } = useSurvey(surveyId);
  const publish = usePublishSurvey(surveyId ?? "");
  const [selectedSection, setSelectedSection] = useState<string | undefined>();
  const [selectedQuestion, setSelectedQuestion] = useState<
    string | undefined
  >();
  const [questionModal, setQuestionModal] = useState(false);
  const [skipLogicModal, setSkipLogicModal] = useState(false);
  const [confirmPublish, setConfirmPublish] = useState(false);

  if (isLoading) return <LoadingState />;
  if (!survey) return <EmptyState title="Survey not found" />;

  const isLocked = survey.currentVersion?.locked ?? false;
  const canEdit = can(PERMISSIONS.surveyWrite) && !isLocked;

  const currentSection = survey.sections.find(
    (s) => s.sectionId === selectedSection,
  );
  const currentQuestion = currentSection?.questions.find(
    (q) => q.questionId === selectedQuestion,
  );

  return (
    <main id="main" tabIndex={-1} className="space-y-4">
      <header className="flex flex-wrap items-start justify-between gap-3">
        <div>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-1">
            <code className="text-caption font-bold text-primary-700">
              {survey.code}
            </code>
            <Chip
              tone={
                survey.status === "LOCKED"
                  ? "grey"
                  : survey.status === "PUBLISHED"
                    ? "green"
                    : "blue"
              }
            >
              {survey.status}
            </Chip>
            {isLocked && (
              <Chip tone="red">
                <Lock className="h-3 w-3" aria-hidden /> Locked
              </Chip>
            )}
          </div>
          <h1 className="text-h1 text-primary-900">{survey.name}</h1>
          {survey.purpose && (
            <p className="text-body-sm text-neutral-600 mt-1">
              {survey.purpose}
            </p>
          )}
        </div>
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
          <Button
            variant="secondary"
            size="sm"
            leftIcon={<Download className="h-4 w-4" />}
            onClick={async () => {
              try {
                const blob = await surveyApi.exportXlsForm(survey.surveyId);
                const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
                const a = document.createElement("a");
                a.href = url;
                a.download = `${survey.code}.xlsx`;
                a.click();
                URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
              } catch {
                push("error", "Export failed");
              }
            }}
          >
            Export XLSForm
          </Button>
          {can(PERMISSIONS.surveyPublish) && !isLocked && (
            <Button
              variant="primary"
              size="sm"
              leftIcon={<Rocket className="h-4 w-4" />}

            >

      </header>

      <div className="grid lg:grid-cols-[300px_1fr_360px] gap-3">

            title="Sections"

                  Add
                </Button>
              )
            }
          />
          <ul className="border-t border-neutral-200">
            {survey.sections.map((s) => (
              <li key={s.sectionId}>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => {
                    setSelectedSection(s.sectionId);
                    setSelectedQuestion(undefined);
                  }}
                  className={`w-full text-left px-3 py-2.5 border-b border-neutral-100 text-body-sm ${
                    selectedSection === s.sectionId

                >

                    <code className="text-caption text-primary-700">

        {/* Questions in selected section */}
        <Card padding="none">
          {!currentSection ? (

          ) : (

              <CardHeader
                title={

                    <code className="text-caption text-primary-700">
                      {currentSection.code}
                    </code>

                }
                action={
                  canEdit && (

                      variant="primary"
                      size="sm"
                      leftIcon={<Plus className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />}
                      onClick={() => setQuestionModal(true)}

                      Add question

                }
              />
              <ul className="border-t border-neutral-200 divide-y divide-neutral-100">
                {currentSection.questions.map((q) => (
                  <li key={q.questionId}>
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() => setSelectedQuestion(q.questionId)}
                      className={`w-full text-left px-3 py-2.5 hover:bg-neutral-50 ${
                        selectedQuestion === q.questionId
                          ? "bg-primary-100"
                          : ""
                      }`}
                    >
                      <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
                        <div className="min-w-0">
                          <code className="text-caption text-primary-700 mr-2">

            </>
          )}
        </Card>

        {/* Question detail / preview */}
        <Card>
          <CardHeader title="Preview / details" />
          {currentQuestion ? (
            <div className="space-y-3">
              <div className="text-caption text-neutral-600">
                <code className="text-primary-700 font-bold">
```

```tsx
import { useForm, useFieldArray } from "react-hook-form";
import { zodResolver } from "@hookform/resolvers/zod";
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";
import { Plus, Trash2 } from "lucide-react";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/Input";
import { Select } from "@/components/ui/Select";
import { Textarea } from "@/components/ui/Textarea";
import { Checkbox } from "@/components/ui/Checkbox";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/Button";
import { IconButton } from "@/components/ui/IconButton";
import { questionSchema, type QuestionFormData } from "./survey.schema";
import { useAddQuestion } from "./survey.mutations";
import { QUESTION_TYPES } from "./survey.types";

export function QuestionEditor({
  sectionId,
  versionId,
  orderNo,
  onSuccess,
}: {
  sectionId: string;
  versionId: string;
  orderNo: number;
  onSuccess?: () => void;
}) {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const add = useAddQuestion(versionId);

  const {
    register,
    handleSubmit,
    control,
    watch,
    formState: { errors },
  } = useForm<QuestionFormData>({
    resolver: zodResolver(questionSchema),
    defaultValues: {
      sectionId,
      code: "",
      type: "TEXT",
      text: "",
      textAm: "",
      hint: "",
      required: false,
      orderNo,
      indicatorId: "",
      disaggregationKey: "",
      calculation: "",
      options: [],
    },
  });

  const { fields, append, remove } = useFieldArray({
    control,
    name: "options",
  });
  const type = watch("type");
  const isChoice = type === "SINGLE" || type === "MULTI";

  const onSubmit = async (v: QuestionFormData) => {
    await add.mutateAsync(v);
    onSuccess?.();
  };

  return (
    <form onSubmit={handleSubmit(onSubmit)} className="space-y-4" noValidate>
      <input type="hidden" {...register("sectionId")} />
      <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4">
        <Input
          {...register("code")}
          label={t("survey.form.code")}
          required
          error={errors.code?.message}
          placeholder="Q1.1"
        />
        <Select
          {...register("type")}
          label={t("survey.form.type")}
          required
          options={QUESTION_TYPES.map((qt) => ({ value: qt, label: qt }))}
        />
      </div>
      <Textarea
        {...register("text")}
        label={t("survey.form.text")}
        required
        rows={2}
        error={errors.text?.message}
      />
      <Input {...register("textAm")} label={t("survey.form.textAm")} />
      <Input {...register("hint")} label={t("survey.form.hint")} />
      <Checkbox {...register("required")} label={t("survey.form.required")} />

      {isChoice && (
        <div>
          <div className="text-caption font-semibold text-primary-900 mb-2">
            Options
          </div>
          <ul className="space-y-2">
            {fields.map((f, i) => (
              <li
                key={f.id}
                className="grid grid-cols-[100px_1fr_1fr_40px] gap-2 items-end"
              >
                <Input
                  {...register(`options.${i}.code` as const)}
                  label={i === 0 ? "Code" : ""}
                />
                <Input
                  {...register(`options.${i}.label` as const)}
                  label={i === 0 ? "Label" : ""}
                />
                <Input
                  {...register(`options.${i}.labelAm` as const)}
                  label={i === 0 ? "Label (AM)" : ""}
                />
                <div className="pb-0.5">
                  <IconButton
                    type="button"
                    label="Remove"
                    icon={<Trash2 className="h-4 w-4" />}
                    onClick={() => remove(i)}
                  />
                </div>
                <input
                  type="hidden"
                  {...register(`options.${i}.value` as const)}
                  value={`${i}`}
                />
                <input
                  type="hidden"
                  {...register(`options.${i}.orderNo` as const)}
                  value={i}
                />
              </li>
            ))}
          </ul>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() =>
              append({
                code: "",
                label: "",
                labelAm: "",
                value: "",
                orderNo: fields.length,
              })
            }
            className="mt-2 inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-caption font-semibold text-primary-700 hover:underline"
          >
            <Plus className="h-3.5 w-3.5" aria-hidden /> Add option
          </button>
        </div>
      )}

      <div className="flex justify-end">
        <Button type="submit" variant="primary" loading={add.isPending}>
          {t("actions.save")}
        </Button>
      </div>
    </form>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import { useState } from "react";

import { Input } from "@/components/ui/Input";

import { skipLogicSchema, type SkipLogicFormData } from "./survey.schema";

export function SkipLogicEditor({

}: {
  versionId: string;
  question: Question;
  allQuestions: Question[];
  onSuccess?: () => void;
}) {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const add = useAddSkipLogic(versionId);
  const [preview, setPreview] = useState<{
    ok: boolean;
    error?: string;
  } | null>(null);

  const {
    register,
    handleSubmit,
    watch,
    formState: { errors },
  } = useForm<SkipLogicFormData>({
    resolver: zodResolver(skipLogicSchema),
    defaultValues: {
      questionId: question.questionId,
      condition: "",
      action: "SHOW",
      targetQuestionId: "",
    },
  });

  const condition = watch("condition");

  const testCondition = () => {
    try {
      // evaluate with empty context — validates syntax
      evaluateCondition(condition || "", {});
      setPreview({ ok: true });
    } catch (err: any) {
      setPreview({ ok: false, error: err.message });
    }
  };

  const onSubmit = async (v: SkipLogicFormData) => {
    await add.mutateAsync(v);
    onSuccess?.();
  };

  return (
    <form onSubmit={handleSubmit(onSubmit)} className="space-y-4" noValidate>
      <input type="hidden" {...register("questionId")} />
      <div className="text-caption text-neutral-600 mb-2">
        Configuring skip logic for{" "}
        <code className="text-primary-700 font-bold">{question.code}</code> ·{" "}
        {question.text}
      </div>

      <Banner tone="info">
        Use <code>{"${field}"}</code> to reference other questions. Example:{" "}
        <code>{`\${q1_2} = 'F' and \${q1_3} > 18`}</code>
      </Banner>

      <Input
        {...register("condition")}
        label={t("survey.skipForm.condition")}
        required
        error={errors.condition?.message}
        placeholder={`\${q1_2} = 'F'`}
      />

      <Button type="button" variant="ghost" size="sm" onClick={testCondition}>
        Validate syntax
      </Button>
      {preview && (
        <div
          className={`text-caption font-semibold ${preview.ok ? "text-green-700" : "text-danger"}`}
          role="status"
        >
          {preview.ok ? "✓ Valid expression" : `✗ ${preview.error}`}
        </div>
      )}

      <Select
        {...register("action")}
        label={t("survey.skipForm.action")}
        required
        options={[
          {
            value: "SHOW",
            label: "Show target question when condition is true",
          },
          {
            value: "HIDE",
            label: "Hide target question when condition is true",
          },
          {
            value: "SKIP",
            label: "Skip target question when condition is true",
          },
          {
            value: "REQUIRE",
            label: "Mark this question as required when condition is true",
          },
        ]}
      />

      <Select
        {...register("targetQuestionId")}
        label={t("survey.skipForm.target")}
        placeholder="—"
        options={allQuestions
          .filter((q) => q.questionId !== question.questionId)
          .map((q) => ({
            value: q.questionId,
            label: `${q.code} · ${q.text}`,
          }))}
      />

      <div className="flex justify-end">
        <Button type="submit" variant="primary" loading={add.isPending}>
          {t("actions.save")}
        </Button>
      </div>
    </form>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import { useState } from "react";
import { Card, CardHeader } from "@/components/ui/Card";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/Input";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/Button";
import { computeVisibility } from "./skipLogic";
import type { Survey } from "./survey.types";

export function SurveyPreview({ survey }: { survey: Survey }) {
  const [answers, setAnswers] = useState<Record<string, any>>({});
  const allQuestions = survey.sections.flatMap((s) => s.questions);
  const { visible } = computeVisibility(allQuestions, answers);

  return (
    <Card>
      <CardHeader
        title="Interactive preview"
        subtitle="Fill answers to see skip logic in action"
      />
      <div className="space-y-4">
        {survey.sections.map((section) => {
          const visibleQs = section.questions.filter((q) =>
            visible.has(q.questionId),
          );
          if (visibleQs.length === 0) return null;
          return (
            <div key={section.sectionId}>
              <h3 className="text-body-sm font-bold text-primary-900 mb-2">
                {section.title}
              </h3>
              <div className="space-y-3">
                {visibleQs.map((q) => (
                  <div key={q.questionId}>
                    <label className="block text-caption font-semibold text-neutral-900 mb-1">
                      <code className="text-primary-700 mr-1">{q.code}</code>
                      {q.text}
                      {q.required && (
                        <span className="text-danger ml-0.5">*</span>
                      )}
                    </label>
                    {q.type === "TEXT" ||
                    q.type === "NUMERIC" ||
                    q.type === "DECIMAL" ? (
                      <Input
                        value={String(answers[q.code] ?? "")}
                        onChange={(e) =>
                          setAnswers({ ...answers, [q.code]: e.target.value })
                        }
                      />
                    ) : q.type === "DATE" ? (
                      <Input
                        type="date"
                        value={String(answers[q.code] ?? "")}
                        onChange={(e) =>
                          setAnswers({ ...answers, [q.code]: e.target.value })
                        }
                      />
                    ) : q.type === "SINGLE" ? (
                      <div className="space-y-1">
                        {(q.options ?? []).map((opt) => (
                          <label
                            key={opt.code}
                            className="flex items-center gap-2 text-caption"
                          >
                            <input
                              type="radio"
                              name={q.code}
                              value={opt.code}
                              onChange={() =>
                                setAnswers({ ...answers, [q.code]: opt.code })
                              }
                            />
                            {opt.label}
                          </label>
                        ))}
                      </div>
                    ) : q.type === "MULTI" ? (
                      <div className="space-y-1">
                        {(q.options ?? []).map((opt) => (
                          <label
                            key={opt.code}
                            className="flex items-center gap-2 text-caption"
                          >
                            <input
                              type="checkbox"
                              onChange={(e) => {
                                const cur = Array.isArray(answers[q.code])
                                  ? answers[q.code]
                                  : [];
                                setAnswers({
                                  ...answers,
                                  [q.code]: e.target.checked
                                    ? [...cur, opt.code]
                                    : cur.filter((x: string) => x !== opt.code),
                                });
                              }}
                            />
                            {opt.label}
                          </label>
                        ))}
                      </div>
                    ) : (
                      <Input disabled placeholder={q.type} />
                    )}
                  </div>
                ))}
              </div>
            </div>
          );
        })}
      </div>
      <div className="mt-4 pt-3 border-t border-neutral-200">
        <Button variant="ghost" size="sm" onClick={() => setAnswers({})}>
          Reset answers
        </Button>
      </div>
    </Card>
  );
}
```

## 9.21 `src/features/field/offlineStore.ts` — IndexedDB Wrapper

```ts
import { openDB, type DBSchema, type IDBPDatabase } from "idb";
import type { LocalDraft, Submission } from "./field.types";

interface CapiDB extends DBSchema {
  drafts: { key: string; value: LocalDraft };
  queue: { key: string; value: Submission & { localId: string } };
  meta: { key: string; value: { key: string; value: any } };
}

const DB_NAME = "piims-capi";
const DB_VERSION = 1;

let dbPromise: Promise<IDBPDatabase<CapiDB>> | null = null;

function db() {
  if (!dbPromise) {
    dbPromise = openDB<CapiDB>(DB_NAME, DB_VERSION, {
      upgrade(database) {
        if (!database.objectStoreNames.contains("drafts"))
          database.createObjectStore("drafts", { keyPath: "localId" });
        if (!database.objectStoreNames.contains("queue"))
          database.createObjectStore("queue", { keyPath: "localId" });
        if (!database.objectStoreNames.contains("meta"))
          database.createObjectStore("meta", { keyPath: "key" });
      },
    });
  }
  return dbPromise;
}

export const offlineStore = {
  async saveDraft(draft: LocalDraft) {
    const d = await db();
    await d.put("drafts", draft);
  },

  async getDraft(localId: string): Promise<LocalDraft | undefined> {
    const d = await db();
    return d.get("drafts", localId);
  },

  async listDrafts(): Promise<LocalDraft[]> {
    const d = await db();
    return d.getAll("drafts");
  },

  async deleteDraft(localId: string) {
    const d = await db();
    await d.delete("drafts", localId);
  },

  async enqueue(submission: Submission) {
    const d = await db();
    const localId = crypto.randomUUID();
    await d.put("queue", { ...submission, localId });
    return localId;
  },

  async listQueue(): Promise<(Submission & { localId: string })[]> {
    const d = await db();
    return d.getAll("queue");
  },

  async removeFromQueue(localId: string) {
    const d = await db();
    await d.delete("queue", localId);
  },

  async queueSize(): Promise<number> {
    const d = await db();
    return d.count("queue");
  },
};
```

```ts
import { api } from "@/lib/api/client";
import type {
  Assignment,
  Submission,
  SurveyView,
  Collector,
} from "./field.types";

interface Envelope<T> {
  data: T;
}

export const fieldApi = {
  async me(): Promise<Collector> {
    const { data } = await api.get<Envelope<Collector>>("/collect/me");
    return data.data;
  },

  async assignments(): Promise<Assignment[]> {
    const { data } = await api.get<Envelope<Assignment[]>>(
      "/collect/assignments",
    );
    return data.data;
  },

  async surveyView(assignmentId: string): Promise<SurveyView> {
    const { data } = await api.get<Envelope<SurveyView>>(
      `/collect/assignments/${assignmentId}/survey`,
    );
    return data.data;
  },

  async submit(
    submission: Submission,
  ): Promise<{ submissionId: string; status: string }> {
    const { data } = await api.post<
      Envelope<{ submissionId: string; status: string }>
    >("/collect/submit", submission);
    return data.data;
  },

  async deviceRegister(
    deviceId: string,
    platform: string,
    appVersion: string,
  ): Promise<void> {
    await api.post("/collect/device/register", {
      device_id: deviceId,
      platform,
      app_version: appVersion,
    });
  },
};
```

```ts
import { useQuery } from "@tanstack/react-query";

  all: ["field"] as const,

    queryKey: fieldKeys.assignments(),
    queryFn: () => fieldApi.assignments(),
    staleTime: 60_000,
  });
}

export function useSurveyView(assignmentId: string | undefined) {
  return useQuery({
    queryKey: fieldKeys.survey(assignmentId ?? ""),
    queryFn: () => fieldApi.surveyView(assignmentId!),
    enabled: !!assignmentId,
    staleTime: 10 * 60_000,
  });
}
```

```ts
// field.mutations.ts
import { useMutation, useQueryClient } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { fieldApi } from "./field.api";
import { fieldKeys } from "./field.queries";
import { useToast } from "@/components/ui/Toast";
import { normalizeApiError } from "@/lib/api/errors";
import type { Submission } from "./field.types";

export function useSubmitInterview() {
  const qc = useQueryClient();
  const { push } = useToast();
  return useMutation({
    mutationFn: (submission: Submission) => fieldApi.submit(submission),
    onSuccess: () => {
      qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: fieldKeys.all });
      push("success", "Interview submitted");
    },
    onError: (err) =>
      push("error", normalizeApiError(err).detail ?? "Submission failed"),
  });
}
```

## 9.24 `src/features/field/CapiRenderer.tsx` — The Crown Jewel

The heart of field collection. Renders one question at a time, evaluates skip logic, autosaves to IndexedDB, captures GPS and paradata, syncs when online.

```tsx
import { useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { useNavigate } from "react-router-dom";
import {
  ChevronLeft,
  ChevronRight,
  MapPin,
  Camera,
  Clock,
  WifiOff,
} from "lucide-react";
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/Button";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/Input";
import { Textarea } from "@/components/ui/Textarea";
import { DateInput } from "@/components/ui/DateInput";
import { Checkbox } from "@/components/ui/Checkbox";
import { Banner } from "@/components/ui/Banner";
import { useToast } from "@/components/ui/Toast";
import { useSyncStore } from "@/stores/sync.store";
import { computeVisibility } from "@/features/survey/skipLogic";
import { offlineStore } from "./offlineStore";
import { useSubmitInterview } from "./field.mutations";
import type {
  Assignment,
  ConsentPayload,
  ParadataEntry,
  Question,
  Submission,
  SubmissionAnswer,
  SurveyView,
} from "./field.types";

const CONSENT_VERSION = "v1.2";

export interface CapiRendererProps {
  assignment: Assignment;
  surveyView: SurveyView;
  collectorId: string;
  deviceId?: string;
  onExit: () => void;
}

export function CapiRenderer({
  assignment,
  surveyView,
  collectorId,
  deviceId,
  onExit,
}: CapiRendererProps) {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const { push } = useToast();
  const online = useSyncStore((s) => s.online);
  const submitMutation = useSubmitInterview();

  /* ---------------- Session state ---------------- */
  const [phase, setPhase] = useState<"consent" | "interview" | "complete">(
    "consent",
  );
  const [consent, setConsent] = useState<ConsentPayload>({
    participation: false,
    data_use: false,
    future_research: false,
    media: false,
    contact: false,
    consent_version: CONSENT_VERSION,
    language: "en",
  });
  const [answers, setAnswers] = useState<Record<string, any>>({});
  const [paradata, setParadata] = useState<Record<string, ParadataEntry>>({});
  const [currentIndex, setCurrentIndex] = useState(0);
  const [gpsStart, setGpsStart] = useState<{ lat: number; lon: number } | null>(
    null,
  );
  const [gpsEnd, setGpsEnd] = useState<{ lat: number; lon: number } | null>(
    null,
  );
  const [photoData, setPhotoData] = useState<Record<string, string>>({});
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [localId] = useState(() => crypto.randomUUID());

  const startedAtRef = useRef(new Date().toISOString());
  const questionEnteredAtRef = useRef<number>(Date.now());

  /* ---------------- Compute visible questions ---------------- */
  const flatQuestions = useMemo(() => {
    const list: Question[] = [];
    for (const s of surveyView.sections) {
      for (const q of s.questions) list.push(q);
    }
    return list;
  }, [surveyView]);

  const visibility = useMemo(
    () =>
      computeVisibility(
        flatQuestions.map((q) => ({
          questionId: q.questionId,
          skipLogic: q.skipLogic?.map((l) => ({
            condition: l.condition,
            action: l.action,
            targetQuestionId: l.targetQuestionId,
          })),
        })),
        answers,
      ),
    [flatQuestions, answers],
  );

  const visibleQuestions = useMemo(
    () => flatQuestions.filter((q) => visibility.visible.has(q.questionId)),
    [flatQuestions, visibility.visible],
  );

  const currentQuestion = visibleQuestions[currentIndex];
  const progress =
    visibleQuestions.length > 0
      ? ((currentIndex + 1) / visibleQuestions.length) * 100
      : 0;

  /* ---------------- Capture GPS at start ---------------- */
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!navigator.geolocation) return;
    navigator.geolocation.getCurrentPosition(
      (p) => setGpsStart({ lat: p.coords.latitude, lon: p.coords.longitude }),
      () => {
        /* GPS is best-effort */
      },
      { enableHighAccuracy: true, timeout: 10_000 },
    );
  }, []);

  /* ---------------- Track paradata per question ---------------- */
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!currentQuestion) return;
    questionEnteredAtRef.current = Date.now();
    return () => {
      const elapsed = Date.now() - questionEnteredAtRef.current;
      setParadata((prev) => ({
        ...prev,
        [currentQuestion.questionId]: {
          ...(prev[currentQuestion.questionId] ?? {
            editCount: 0,
            interrupted: false,
          }),
          questionId: currentQuestion.questionId,
          timeSpentMs:
            (prev[currentQuestion.questionId]?.timeSpentMs ?? 0) + elapsed,
          editCount: prev[currentQuestion.questionId]?.editCount ?? 0,
          interrupted: prev[currentQuestion.questionId]?.interrupted ?? false,
        },
      }));
    };
  }, [currentQuestion]);

  /* ---------------- Autosave draft ---------------- */
  useEffect(() => {
    if (phase !== "interview") return;
    const id = window.setInterval(async () => {
      await offlineStore.saveDraft({
        localId,
        assignmentId: assignment.assignmentId,
        answers,
        startedAt: startedAtRef.current,
        lastSavedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
        sectionIndex: 0,
        questionIndex: currentIndex,
      });
    }, 20_000);
    return () => window.clearInterval(id);
  }, [phase, localId, assignment.assignmentId, answers, currentIndex]);

  /* ---------------- Handlers ---------------- */
  const setAnswer = (question: Question, value: any) => {
    const prev = answers[question.code];
    if (prev !== undefined && prev !== value) {
      setParadata((p) => ({
        ...p,
        [question.questionId]: {
          ...(p[question.questionId] ?? {
            questionId: question.questionId,
            timeSpentMs: 0,
            interrupted: false,
          }),
          questionId: question.questionId,
          timeSpentMs: p[question.questionId]?.timeSpentMs ?? 0,
          editCount: (p[question.questionId]?.editCount ?? 0) + 1,
          interrupted: false,
        },
      }));
    }
    setAnswers({ ...answers, [question.code]: value });
    setError(null);
  };

  const validateQuestion = (question: Question): boolean => {
    const value = answers[question.code];
    const isRequired =
      question.required || visibility.required.has(question.questionId);
    if (
      isRequired &&
      (value == null ||
        value === "" ||
        (Array.isArray(value) && value.length === 0))
    ) {
      setError(t("field.required"));
      return false;
    }
    return true;
  };

  const next = () => {
    if (!currentQuestion) return;
    if (!validateQuestion(currentQuestion)) return;
    if (currentIndex < visibleQuestions.length - 1) {
      setCurrentIndex(currentIndex + 1);
    } else {
      finish();
    }
  };

  const prev = () => {
    if (currentIndex > 0) setCurrentIndex(currentIndex - 1);
  };

  const capturePhoto = (question: Question) => {
    const input = document.createElement("input");
    input.type = "file";
    input.accept = "image/*";
    input.capture = "environment";
    input.onchange = () => {
      const file = input.files?.[0];
      if (!file) return;
      const reader = new FileReader();
      reader.onload = () => {
        setPhotoData((p) => ({
          ...p,
          [question.questionId]: String(reader.result),
        }));
        setAnswer(question, file.name);
      };
      reader.readAsDataURL(file);
    };
    input.click();
  };

  const captureGpsForQuestion = (question: Question) => {
    if (!navigator.geolocation) return;
    navigator.geolocation.getCurrentPosition(
      (p) =>
        setAnswer(question, {
          lat: p.coords.latitude,
          lon: p.coords.longitude,
        }),
      () => setError("GPS capture failed"),
      { enableHighAccuracy: true },
    );
  };

  const finish = async () => {
    /* Capture end GPS */
    let endGps = gpsEnd;
    if (navigator.geolocation) {
      endGps = await new Promise((resolve) => {
        navigator.geolocation.getCurrentPosition(
          (p) => resolve({ lat: p.coords.latitude, lon: p.coords.longitude }),
          () => resolve(gpsStart),
          { enableHighAccuracy: true, timeout: 5000 },
        );
      });
      setGpsEnd(endGps);
    }

    const submissionAnswers: SubmissionAnswer[] = [];
    for (const q of flatQuestions) {
      if (!visibility.visible.has(q.questionId)) continue;
      const val = answers[q.code];
      if (val === undefined || val === null || val === "") continue;

      let answer: SubmissionAnswer = {
        questionId: q.questionId,
        valueType: "TEXT",
      };
      if (q.type === "NUMERIC" || q.type === "DECIMAL") {
        answer = {
          questionId: q.questionId,
          valueType: "NUMERIC",
          valueNumeric: Number(val),
        };
      } else if (q.type === "DATE") {
        answer = {
          questionId: q.questionId,
          valueType: "DATE",
          valueDate: String(val),
        };
      } else if (q.type === "GPS") {
        answer = {
          questionId: q.questionId,
          valueType: "GPS",
          valueGps: val as any,
        };
      } else if (q.type === "MULTI") {
        answer = {
          questionId: q.questionId,
          valueType: "JSON",
          valueJson: { selections: val },
        };
      } else if (q.type === "PHOTO" || q.type === "AUDIO") {
        answer = {
          questionId: q.questionId,
          valueType: "MEDIA",
          valueText: String(val),
        };
      } else {
        answer = {
          questionId: q.questionId,
          valueType: "TEXT",
          valueText: String(val),
        };
      }
      submissionAnswers.push(answer);
    }

    const submission: Submission = {
      assignmentId: assignment.assignmentId,
      collectorId,
      waveId: assignment.waveId,
      surveyVersionId: assignment.surveyVersionId,
      startedAt: startedAtRef.current,
      endedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
      gpsStart: gpsStart ?? undefined,
      gpsEnd: endGps ?? undefined,
      deviceId,
      consent,
      answers: submissionAnswers,
      paradata: Object.values(paradata),
    };

    try {
      if (online) {
        await submitMutation.mutateAsync(submission);
      } else {
        await offlineStore.enqueue(submission);
        push("info", "Offline — interview saved to queue");
      }
      await offlineStore.deleteDraft(localId);
      setPhase("complete");
      setTimeout(() => onExit(), 1500);
    } catch {
      // Failsafe: still queue it locally
      await offlineStore.enqueue(submission);
      push("warn", "Sync failed — saved to offline queue");
      setPhase("complete");
      setTimeout(() => onExit(), 1500);
    }
  };

  /* ---------------- Render ---------------- */

  if (phase === "consent") {
    return (
      <div className="min-h-screen bg-neutral-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4">
        <div className="bg-white border border-neutral-300 rounded-lg max-w-lg w-full p-6 space-y-4">
          <header>
            <h1 className="text-h2 text-primary-900">Consent · ስምምነት</h1>
            <p className="text-body-sm text-neutral-600 mt-1">
              {assignment.waveCode} · {assignment.waveName}
            </p>
          </header>

          <Banner tone="info">
            Read the following aloud to the respondent. Participation is
            voluntary. They may withdraw at any time.
          </Banner>

          <div className="space-y-2">
            <Checkbox
              label="Respondent agrees to participate"
              checked={consent.participation}
              onChange={(e) =>
                setConsent({ ...consent, participation: e.target.checked })
              }
            />
            <Checkbox
              label="Respondent agrees to data use for M&E"
              checked={consent.data_use}
              onChange={(e) =>
                setConsent({ ...consent, data_use: e.target.checked })
              }
            />
            <Checkbox
              label="Respondent agrees to future research use (optional)"
              checked={consent.future_research}
              onChange={(e) =>
                setConsent({ ...consent, future_research: e.target.checked })
              }
            />
            <Checkbox
              label="Respondent agrees to photo/audio (optional)"
              checked={consent.media}
              onChange={(e) =>
                setConsent({ ...consent, media: e.target.checked })
              }
            />
            <Checkbox
              label="Respondent agrees to follow-up contact (optional)"
              checked={consent.contact}
              onChange={(e) =>
                setConsent({ ...consent, contact: e.target.checked })
              }
            />
          </div>

          <div className="flex gap-2 pt-2">
            <Button variant="ghost" onClick={onExit}>
              Cancel
            </Button>
            <Button
              variant="primary"
              disabled={!consent.participation || !consent.data_use}
              onClick={() => setPhase("interview")}
              fullWidth
            >
              Begin interview
            </Button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (phase === "complete") {
    return (
      <div className="min-h-screen bg-neutral-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4">
        <div className="bg-white border border-neutral-300 rounded-lg max-w-md w-full p-8 text-center">
          <div className="text-5xl mb-3">✓</div>
          <h2 className="text-h2 text-primary-900">Interview complete</h2>
          <p className="text-body-sm text-neutral-600 mt-2">
            {online ? "Submitted to server." : "Queued for sync when online."}
          </p>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (!currentQuestion) {
    return (
      <div className="min-h-screen bg-neutral-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4">
        <div className="text-center">
          <p className="text-body-sm text-neutral-600">
            No questions to display.
          </p>
          <Button className="mt-3" variant="secondary" onClick={onExit}>
            Back
          </Button>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  const q = currentQuestion;
  const value = answers[q.code];

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-neutral-50 flex flex-col">
      {/* Top bar */}
      <header className="bg-primary-900 text-white">
        <div className="px-4 py-2.5 flex items-center gap-3">
          <button
            onClick={onExit}
            aria-label="Exit interview"
            className="hover:bg-white/10 p-1 rounded"
          >
            <ChevronLeft className="h-5 w-5" />
          </button>
          <div className="flex-1">
            <div className="text-caption opacity-70">
              {assignment.waveCode} · {assignment.waveName}
            </div>
            <div className="text-body-sm font-semibold">
              Q {currentIndex + 1} / {visibleQuestions.length}
            </div>
          </div>
          {!online && (
            <WifiOff className="h-4 w-4 text-accent-300" aria-label="Offline" />
          )}
        </div>
        <div className="h-1 bg-primary-700">
          <div
            className="h-full bg-accent-500 transition-all"
            style={{ width: `${progress}%` }}
          />
        </div>
      </header>

      {/* Question */}
      <main id="main" className="flex-1 px-4 py-6 max-w-2xl mx-auto w-full">
        <div className="text-body-sm font-semibold text-primary-700 mb-1">
          {q.code}
        </div>
        <div className="text-h2 text-primary-900 leading-snug">{q.text}</div>
        {q.textAm && (
          <div lang="am" className="text-body-sm text-neutral-600 mt-1">
            {q.textAm}
          </div>
        )}
        {(q.required || visibility.required.has(q.questionId)) && (
          <div className="text-caption text-danger mt-1">* Required</div>
        )}

        <div className="mt-6">
          {q.type === "TEXT" && (
            <Textarea
              rows={3}
              value={value ?? ""}
              onChange={(e) => setAnswer(q, e.target.value)}
              label="Answer"
            />
          )}
          {q.type === "NUMERIC" && (
            <Input
              type="number"
              inputMode="numeric"
              label="Answer"
              value={value ?? ""}
              onChange={(e) =>
                setAnswer(
                  q,
                  e.target.value === "" ? "" : Number(e.target.value),
                )
              }
            />
          )}
          {q.type === "DECIMAL" && (
            <Input
              type="number"
              step="any"
              label="Answer"
              value={value ?? ""}
              onChange={(e) =>
                setAnswer(
                  q,
                  e.target.value === "" ? "" : Number(e.target.value),
                )
              }
            />
          )}
          {q.type === "DATE" && (
            <DateInput
              label="Answer"
              value={value ?? ""}
              onChange={(e) => setAnswer(q, e.target.value)}
            />
          )}
          {q.type === "SINGLE" && (
            <div className="space-y-2">
              {(q.options ?? []).map((opt) => (
                <label
                  key={opt.code}
                  className={`flex items-center gap-3 p-3 border rounded-md cursor-pointer transition ${
                    value === opt.code
                      ? "border-primary-700 bg-primary-100"
                      : "border-neutral-300 hover:border-primary-300"
                  }`}
                >
                  <input
                    type="radio"
                    name={q.code}
                    value={opt.code}
                    checked={value === opt.code}
                    onChange={() => setAnswer(q, opt.code)}
                    className="sr-only"
                  />
                  <span
                    className={`w-4 h-4 rounded-full border-2 ${value === opt.code ? "border-primary-700 bg-primary-700" : "border-neutral-400"}`}
                  />
                  <span className="text-body-sm">
                    {opt.label}
                    {opt.labelAm && (
                      <span lang="am" className="text-neutral-600 ml-1">
                        · {opt.labelAm}
                      </span>
                    )}
                  </span>
                </label>
              ))}
            </div>
          )}
          {q.type === "MULTI" && (
            <div className="space-y-2">
              {(q.options ?? []).map((opt) => {
                const arr = Array.isArray(value) ? value : [];
                const checked = arr.includes(opt.code);
                return (
                  <label
                    key={opt.code}
                    className={`flex items-center gap-3 p-3 border rounded-md cursor-pointer transition ${
                      checked
                        ? "border-primary-700 bg-primary-100"
                        : "border-neutral-300 hover:border-primary-300"
                    }`}
                  >
                    <input
                      type="checkbox"
                      checked={checked}
                      onChange={(e) =>
                        setAnswer(
                          q,
                          e.target.checked
                            ? [...arr, opt.code]
                            : arr.filter((x: string) => x !== opt.code),
                        )
                      }
                      className="sr-only"
                    />
                    <span
                      className={`w-4 h-4 rounded border-2 ${checked ? "border-primary-700 bg-primary-700" : "border-neutral-400"}`}
                    />
                    <span className="text-body-sm">{opt.label}</span>
                  </label>
                );
              })}
            </div>
          )}
          {q.type === "GPS" && (
            <div className="space-y-2">
              <Button
                variant="secondary"
                leftIcon={<MapPin className="h-4 w-4" />}
                onClick={() => captureGpsForQuestion(q)}
              >
                Capture current location
              </Button>
              {value && (
                <div className="text-caption text-green-700 font-semibold">
                  ✓ {value.lat?.toFixed(5)}, {value.lon?.toFixed(5)}
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          )}
          {q.type === "PHOTO" && (
            <div className="space-y-2">
              <Button
                variant="secondary"
                leftIcon={<Camera className="h-4 w-4" />}
                onClick={() => capturePhoto(q)}
              >
                Take photo
              </Button>
              {photoData[q.questionId] && (
                <img
                  src={photoData[q.questionId]}
                  alt="Captured"
                  className="max-h-48 rounded-md border border-neutral-300"
                />
              )}
            </div>
          )}
          {q.type === "CALCULATED" && (
            <div className="text-body-sm bg-neutral-100 rounded-md p-3">
              Calculated: <strong>{value ?? "—"}</strong>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>

        {error && (
          <div role="alert" className="text-danger text-body-sm mt-3">
            {error}
          </div>
        )}
      </main>

      {/* Nav */}
      <footer className="bg-white border-t border-neutral-300 p-3 sticky bottom-0">
        <div className="max-w-2xl mx-auto flex gap-2">
          <Button
            variant="ghost"
            onClick={prev}
            disabled={currentIndex === 0}
            leftIcon={<ChevronLeft className="h-4 w-4" />}
          >
            Back
          </Button>
          <Button
            variant="primary"
            onClick={next}
            fullWidth
            rightIcon={<ChevronRight className="h-4 w-4" />}
          >
            {currentIndex === visibleQuestions.length - 1 ? "Finish" : "Next"}
          </Button>
        </div>
        <div className="max-w-2xl mx-auto mt-1 text-center text-caption text-neutral-500">
          <Clock className="h-3 w-3 inline" aria-hidden /> Autosaves every 20 s
          · {online ? "Online" : "Offline"}
        </div>
      </footer>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import { useState } from "react";

import { PlayCircle, WifiOff } from "lucide-react";

  useAssignments,

import { Card, CardHeader } from "@/components/ui/Card";

import { EmptyState } from "@/components/ui/EmptyState";
import { CapiRenderer } from "./CapiRenderer";

export default function FieldOpsPage() {

  const online = useSyncStore((s) => s.online);
  const { data: profile } = useCollectorProfile();
  const { data: assignments, isLoading } = useAssignments();

  if (isLoading) return <LoadingState />;

  return (
    <main id="main" tabIndex={-1} className="space-y-5">
      <header className="flex flex-wrap items-start justify-between gap-3">

          ) : (

          )}
        </Chip>
      </header>

      <SyncQueue />

      {!assignments?.length ? (
        <EmptyState
          title={t("field.empty")}
          description={t("field.emptyHint")}
        />

        <div className="grid md:grid-cols-2 gap-3">
          {assignments.map((a) => {
            const pct =
              a.targetCount > 0 ? (a.completedCount / a.targetCount) * 100 : 0;
            return (
              <Card key={a.assignmentId}>
                <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-2 mb-3">
                  <div>
                    <div className="text-caption text-neutral-600">
                      {a.waveCode}
                    </div>
                    <div className="text-h3 text-primary-900">{a.waveName}</div>
                  </div>
                  <Chip
                    tone={
                      a.status === "COMPLETED"
                        ? "green"
                        : a.status === "IN_PROGRESS"
                          ? "blue"
                          : "grey"
                    }
                  >
                    {a.status}
                  </Chip>
                </div>
                <div className="mb-3">
                  <div className="flex justify-between text-caption text-neutral-600 mb-1">
                    <span>Progress</span>
                    <span>
                      {a.completedCount} / {a.targetCount}
                    </span>
                  </div>
                  <Progress
                    value={pct}
                    tone={
                      pct >= 90 ? "success" : pct >= 50 ? "warning" : "danger"
                    }
                  />
                </div>
                <Button
                  variant="primary"
                  fullWidth
                  leftIcon={<PlayCircle className="h-4 w-4" />}
                  onClick={() => setActive(a)}
                  disabled={
                    a.status === "COMPLETED" || a.status === "CANCELLED"
                  }
                >
                  Start interview
                </Button>
              </Card>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      )}
    </main>
  );
}
```

## 9.26 `src/features/field/SyncQueue.tsx`

```tsx
import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";
import { RefreshCw } from "lucide-react";
import { offlineStore } from "./offlineStore";
import { fieldApi } from "./field.api";
import { useSyncStore } from "@/stores/sync.store";
import { Card, CardHeader } from "@/components/ui/Card";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/Button";
import { Chip } from "@/components/ui/Chip";
import { useToast } from "@/components/ui/Toast";

export function SyncQueue() {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const { push } = useToast();
  const online = useSyncStore((s) => s.online);
  const setPending = useSyncStore((s) => s.setPending);
  const markSynced = useSyncStore((s) => s.markSynced);
  const [queue, setQueue] = useState<
    { localId: string; assignmentId: string }[]
  >([]);
  const [syncing, setSyncing] = useState(false);

  const refresh = async () => {
    const q = await offlineStore.listQueue();
    setQueue(q);
    setPending(q.length);
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    void refresh();
  }, []);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (online) void refresh();
  }, [online]);

  const sync = async () => {
    setSyncing(true);
    const items = await offlineStore.listQueue();
    let ok = 0;
    for (const item of items) {
      try {
        const { localId, ...submission } = item;
        await fieldApi.submit(submission);
        await offlineStore.removeFromQueue(localId);
        ok++;
      } catch {
        /* stays in queue */
      }
    }
    await refresh();
    setSyncing(false);
    if (ok > 0) {
      markSynced();
      push("success", `Synced ${ok} interview(s)`);
    }
  };

  if (queue.length === 0) return null;

  return (
    <Card>
      <CardHeader
        title={`Pending sync · ${queue.length}`}
        action={
          <Button
            variant="primary"
            size="sm"
            leftIcon={<RefreshCw className="h-4 w-4" />}
            loading={syncing}
            disabled={!online}
            onClick={sync}
          >
            Sync now
          </Button>
        }
      />
      <ul className="divide-y divide-neutral-100">
        {queue.map((item) => (
          <li
            key={item.localId}
            className="py-2 flex justify-between text-body-sm"
          >
            <span className="text-neutral-600">
              Assignment {item.assignmentId.slice(0, 8)}…
            </span>
            <Chip tone="amber">Pending</Chip>
          </li>
        ))}
      </ul>
      {!online && (
        <p className="text-caption text-neutral-600 mt-2">
          Will sync automatically when online.
        </p>
      )}
    </Card>
  );
}
```

## 9.28 `src/features/qa/qa.rules.ts` — Automated Rules Engine

```ts
/**
 * QA rules engine.
 *
 * Given a submission + aggregate context (medians, means), evaluate which
 * QA rules are violated. This runs client-side for HFC-style preview and is
 * also mirrored by the backend for authoritative flag generation.
 */

export interface QASubmission {
  submissionId: string;
  collectorId: string;
  durationSeconds: number;
  answers: { questionId: string; value: string | number | null }[];
  gpsStart?: { lat: number; lon: number };
  gpsEnd?: { lat: number; lon: number };
  assignedLocation?: { lat: number; lon: number };
}

export interface QAContext {
  medianDurationSeconds: number;
  p95DurationSeconds: number;
  numericMean?: Record<string, number>;
  numericSD?: Record<string, number>;
}

export interface RuleViolation {
  ruleType: string;
  severity: "LOW" | "MEDIUM" | "HIGH" | "CRITICAL";
  details: Record<string, any>;
}

/* Haversine distance in km */
export function haversineKm(
  a: { lat: number; lon: number },
  b: { lat: number; lon: number },
): number {
  const R = 6371;
  const dLat = ((b.lat - a.lat) * Math.PI) / 180;
  const dLon = ((b.lon - a.lon) * Math.PI) / 180;
  const lat1 = (a.lat * Math.PI) / 180;
  const lat2 = (b.lat * Math.PI) / 180;
  const x =
    Math.sin(dLat / 2) ** 2 +
    Math.cos(lat1) * Math.cos(lat2) * Math.sin(dLon / 2) ** 2;
  return 2 * R * Math.asin(Math.sqrt(x));
}

export function evaluateRules(
  sub: QASubmission,
  ctx: QAContext,
): RuleViolation[] {
  const violations: RuleViolation[] = [];

  /* 1. Duration too short (< 50% of median) */
  if (
    ctx.medianDurationSeconds > 0 &&
    sub.durationSeconds < ctx.medianDurationSeconds * 0.5
  ) {
    violations.push({
      ruleType: "DURATION_SHORT",
      severity: "HIGH",
      details: {
        duration: sub.durationSeconds,
        median: ctx.medianDurationSeconds,
      },
    });
  }

  /* 2. Duration too long (> 3x median) */
  if (
    ctx.medianDurationSeconds > 0 &&
    sub.durationSeconds > ctx.medianDurationSeconds * 3
  ) {
    violations.push({
      ruleType: "DURATION_LONG",
      severity: "MEDIUM",
      details: {
        duration: sub.durationSeconds,
        median: ctx.medianDurationSeconds,
      },
    });
  }

  /* 3. Straight-lining — same answer 15+ consecutive times */
  let maxStreak = 1;
  let streak = 1;
  for (let i = 1; i < sub.answers.length; i++) {
    if (
      sub.answers[i]!.value != null &&
      sub.answers[i]!.value === sub.answers[i - 1]!.value
    ) {
      streak++;
      maxStreak = Math.max(maxStreak, streak);
    } else {
      streak = 1;
    }
  }
  if (maxStreak >= 15) {
    violations.push({
      ruleType: "STRAIGHT_LINE",
      severity: "HIGH",
      details: { consecutiveSameAnswers: maxStreak },
    });
  }

  /* 4. GPS outside target area (> 5 km) */
  if (sub.gpsStart && sub.assignedLocation) {
    const distance = haversineKm(sub.gpsStart, sub.assignedLocation);
    if (distance > 5) {
      violations.push({
        ruleType: "GPS_OUTSIDE",
        severity: "HIGH",
        details: { distanceKm: distance.toFixed(2) },
      });
    }
  }

  /* 5. GPS start vs end mismatch (> 2 km drift during interview) */
  if (sub.gpsStart && sub.gpsEnd) {
    const drift = haversineKm(sub.gpsStart, sub.gpsEnd);
    if (drift > 2) {
      violations.push({
        ruleType: "GPS_OUTSIDE",
        severity: "MEDIUM",
        details: {
          driftKm: drift.toFixed(2),
          note: "Location drift during interview",
        },
      });
    }
  }

  /* 6. Numeric outlier (|z| > 3) */
  if (ctx.numericMean && ctx.numericSD) {
    for (const a of sub.answers) {
      if (typeof a.value !== "number") continue;
      const mean = ctx.numericMean[a.questionId];
      const sd = ctx.numericSD[a.questionId];
      if (mean != null && sd != null && sd > 0) {
        const z = Math.abs((a.value - mean) / sd);
        if (z > 3) {
          violations.push({
            ruleType: "OUTLIER",
            severity: "MEDIUM",
            details: {
              questionId: a.questionId,
              value: a.value,
              zScore: z.toFixed(2),
            },
          });
        }
      }
    }
  }

  return violations;
}
```

## 9.29 `src/features/qa/qa.api.ts` + `qa.queries.ts` + `qa.mutations.ts`

```ts
// qa.api.ts
import { api } from "@/lib/api/client";
import type {
  QAFlag,
  QARule,
  CollectorScorecard,
  QAStats,
  QAFlagFilters,
} from "./qa.types";

interface Envelope<T> {
  data: T;
}

export const qaApi = {
  async listFlags(f: QAFlagFilters) {
    const p = new URLSearchParams();
    if (f.waveId) p.set("wave_id", f.waveId);
    if (f.severity?.length) p.set("severity", f.severity.join(","));
    if (f.status?.length) p.set("status", f.status.join(","));
    if (f.collectorId) p.set("collector_id", f.collectorId);
    if (f.limit) p.set("limit", String(f.limit));
    if (f.cursor) p.set("cursor", f.cursor);
    const { data } = await api.get<Envelope<QAFlag[]> & { pagination: any }>(
      `/qa/flags?${p.toString()}`,
    );
    return { data: data.data, pagination: (data as any).pagination };
  },

  async review(
    flagId: string,
    decision: "ACCEPT" | "REJECT" | "BACK_CHECK",
    notes?: string,
  ): Promise<QAFlag> {
    const { data } = await api.post<Envelope<QAFlag>>(
      `/qa/flags/${flagId}/review`,
      { decision, notes },
    );
    return data.data;
  },

  async scorecards(waveId?: string): Promise<CollectorScorecard[]> {
    const p = waveId ? `?wave_id=${waveId}` : "";
    const { data } = await api.get<Envelope<CollectorScorecard[]>>(
      `/qa/scorecards${p}`,
    );
    return data.data;
  },

  async stats(waveId?: string): Promise<QAStats> {
    const p = waveId ? `?wave_id=${waveId}` : "";
    const { data } = await api.get<Envelope<QAStats>>(`/qa/stats${p}`);
    return data.data;
  },

  async rules(): Promise<QARule[]> {
    const { data } = await api.get<Envelope<QARule[]>>("/qa/rules");
    return data.data;
  },

  async toggleRule(ruleId: string, active: boolean): Promise<QARule> {
    const { data } = await api.patch<Envelope<QARule>>(`/qa/rules/${ruleId}`, {
      active,
    });
    return data.data;
  },
};
```

```ts
// qa.queries.ts
import { useQuery, keepPreviousData } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { qaApi } from "./qa.api";
import type { QAFlagFilters } from "./qa.types";

export const qaKeys = {
  all: ["qa"] as const,
  flags: (f: QAFlagFilters) => [...qaKeys.all, "flags", f] as const,
  scorecards: (waveId?: string) =>
    [...qaKeys.all, "scorecards", waveId ?? "all"] as const,
  stats: (waveId?: string) =>
    [...qaKeys.all, "stats", waveId ?? "all"] as const,
  rules: () => [...qaKeys.all, "rules"] as const,
};

export function useQAFlags(f: QAFlagFilters) {
  return useQuery({
    queryKey: qaKeys.flags(f),
    queryFn: () => qaApi.listFlags(f),
    placeholderData: keepPreviousData,
    staleTime: 30_000,
  });
}

export function useScorecards(waveId?: string) {
  return useQuery({
    queryKey: qaKeys.scorecards(waveId),
    queryFn: () => qaApi.scorecards(waveId),
    staleTime: 60_000,
  });
}

export function useQAStats(waveId?: string) {
  return useQuery({
    queryKey: qaKeys.stats(waveId),
    queryFn: () => qaApi.stats(waveId),
    staleTime: 60_000,
  });
}

export function useQARules() {
  return useQuery({
    queryKey: qaKeys.rules(),
    queryFn: () => qaApi.rules(),
    staleTime: 5 * 60_000,
  });
}
```

```ts
// qa.mutations.ts
import { useMutation, useQueryClient } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { qaApi } from "./qa.api";
import { qaKeys } from "./qa.queries";
import { useToast } from "@/components/ui/Toast";
import { normalizeApiError } from "@/lib/api/errors";

export function useReviewFlag() {
  const qc = useQueryClient();
  const { push } = useToast();
  return useMutation({
    mutationFn: ({
      flagId,
      decision,
      notes,
    }: {
      flagId: string;
      decision: "ACCEPT" | "REJECT" | "BACK_CHECK";
      notes?: string;
    }) => qaApi.review(flagId, decision, notes),
    onSuccess: () => {
      qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: qaKeys.all });
      push("success", "Review recorded");
    },
    onError: (err) =>
      push("error", normalizeApiError(err).detail ?? "Review failed"),
  });
}

export function useToggleRule() {
  const qc = useQueryClient();
  const { push } = useToast();
  return useMutation({
    mutationFn: ({ ruleId, active }: { ruleId: string; active: boolean }) =>
      qaApi.toggleRule(ruleId, active),
    onSuccess: () => {
      qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: qaKeys.rules() });
      push("success", "Rule updated");
    },
  });
}
```

## 9.32 `src/features/warehouse/anonymize.ts` — Anonymization Engine

```ts
/**
 * Anonymization engine.
 *
 * Applies a tiered set of transformations to research data:
 *   L0: no change (internal)
 *   L1: direct identifiers replaced with pseudonyms
 *   L2: quasi-identifiers generalized
 *   L3: fully aggregated (no individual records)
 */

import type { AnonymizationConfig, AnonLevel } from "./warehouse.types";

export interface RawRecord {
  panelId: string;
  beneficiaryName?: string;
  phone?: string;
  nationalId?: string;
  age?: number;
  income?: number;
  region?: string;
  zone?: string;
  woreda?: string;
  kebele?: string;
  gpsLat?: number;
  gpsLon?: number;
  [key: string]: any;
}

const DIRECT_ID_FIELDS = [
  "beneficiaryName",
  "phone",
  "nationalId",
  "gpsLat",
  "gpsLon",
];

/**
 * Deterministic pseudonym generator for L1+.
 * In production, this uses a stored HMAC key so that the same panel is
 * always mapped to the same pseudonym across waves.
 */
function pseudonymize(value: string): string {
  // Simple deterministic hash — production must use HMAC-SHA256 with a secret key
  let h = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < value.length; i++) {
    h = (h * 31 + value.charCodeAt(i)) | 0;
  }
  return `P${Math.abs(h).toString(36).toUpperCase()}`;
}

function bracketAge(age: number, size: number): string {
  if (size <= 0) return "[SUPPRESSED]";
  const lower = Math.floor(age / size) * size;
  return `${lower}-${lower + size - 1}`;
}

function topCode(values: number[], pct: number): number {
  if (values.length === 0) return 0;
  const sorted = [...values].sort((a, b) => a - b);
  const idx = Math.ceil((pct / 100) * sorted.length) - 1;
  return sorted[Math.max(0, Math.min(sorted.length - 1, idx))]!;
}

function generalizeLocation(
  record: RawRecord,
  granularity: AnonymizationConfig["locationGranularity"],
): Pick<RawRecord, "region" | "zone" | "woreda" | "kebele"> {
  switch (granularity) {
    case "REGION":
      return { region: record.region };
    case "ZONE":
      return { region: record.region, zone: record.zone };
    case "WOREDA":
      return {
        region: record.region,
        zone: record.zone,
        woreda: record.woreda,
      };
    case "KEBELE":
      return {
        region: record.region,
        zone: record.zone,
        woreda: record.woreda,
        kebele: record.kebele,
      };
    case "REMOVED":
      return {};
  }
}

/**
 * Apply suppression: records whose combination of quasi-identifiers appears
 * fewer than `k` times are dropped entirely (k-anonymity).
 */
function suppressKAnon(
  records: RawRecord[],
  k: number,
  keys: string[],
): RawRecord[] {
  if (k <= 1) return records;
  const buckets = new Map<string, number>();
  for (const r of records) {
    const key = keys.map((kk) => String(r[kk] ?? "")).join("|");
    buckets.set(key, (buckets.get(key) ?? 0) + 1);
  }
  return records.filter((r) => {
    const key = keys.map((kk) => String(r[kk] ?? "")).join("|");
    return (buckets.get(key) ?? 0) >= k;
  });
}

export function anonymize(
  records: RawRecord[],
  config: AnonymizationConfig,
): RawRecord[] {
  const level: AnonLevel = config.level;

  /* L0 — no transformation */
  if (level === "L0") return records;

  /* Compute income top-code threshold across the dataset */
  const incomeThreshold =
    config.incomeTopCode < 100
      ? topCode(
          records.filter((r) => r.income != null).map((r) => r.income!),
          config.incomeTopCode,
        )
      : Infinity;

  /* L1 — pseudonymize direct identifiers */
  let out = records.map((r) => {
    const copy: RawRecord = { ...r };
    // Keep panelId (stable across waves)
    // Pseudonymize direct identifiers
    if (copy.beneficiaryName)
      copy.beneficiaryName = pseudonymize(copy.beneficiaryName);
    if (copy.phone) copy.phone = "[REDACTED]";
    if (copy.nationalId) copy.nationalId = pseudonymize(copy.nationalId);
    // Remove GPS (highest re-identification risk)
    delete copy.gpsLat;
    delete copy.gpsLon;
    return copy;
  });

  if (level === "L1") return out;

  /* L2 — generalize quasi-identifiers */
  out = out.map((r) => {
    const copy: RawRecord = { ...r };
    // Age → bracket
    if (copy.age != null) {
      copy.ageBand = bracketAge(copy.age, config.ageBracket);
      delete copy.age;
    }
    // Income → top-code
    if (copy.income != null && copy.income > incomeThreshold) {
      copy.income = incomeThreshold;
      copy.incomeCapped = true;
    }
    // Location → generalize
    const loc = generalizeLocation(copy, config.locationGranularity);
    copy.region = loc.region;
    copy.zone = loc.zone;
    copy.woreda = loc.woreda;
    copy.kebele = loc.kebele;
    return copy;
  });

  // Optional noise injection
  if (config.addNoise) {
    out = out.map((r) => {
      const copy = { ...r };
      if (typeof copy.income === "number") {
        // Add ±2% noise
        const noise = 1 + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.04;
        copy.income = Math.round(copy.income * noise);
      }
      return copy;
    });
  }

  // k-anonymity suppression on quasi-identifiers
  out = suppressKAnon(
    out,
    config.suppressionThreshold,
    ["ageBand", "region", "zone"].filter((k) => out.some((r) => r[k] != null)),
  );

  if (level === "L2") return out;

  /* L3 — full aggregation (returned rows are not individual records) */
  // Aggregate by region + ageBand, computing mean income and count
  const aggMap = new Map<
    string,
    { count: number; incomeSum: number; incomeCount: number }
  >();
  for (const r of out) {
    const key = `${r.region ?? "NA"}|${r.ageBand ?? "NA"}`;
    const cur = aggMap.get(key) ?? { count: 0, incomeSum: 0, incomeCount: 0 };
    cur.count++;
    if (typeof r.income === "number") {
      cur.incomeSum += r.income;
      cur.incomeCount++;
    }
    aggMap.set(key, cur);
  }
  const aggregated: RawRecord[] = [];
  for (const [key, val] of aggMap) {
    const [region, ageBand] = key.split("|");
    if (val.count < config.suppressionThreshold) continue; // suppression
    aggregated.push({
      panelId: `AGG-${region}-${ageBand}`,
      region,
      ageBand,
      count: val.count,
      avgIncome:
        val.incomeCount > 0
          ? Math.round(val.incomeSum / val.incomeCount)
          : null,
    });
  }
  return aggregated;
}
```

```ts
// warehouse.api.ts
import { api } from "@/lib/api/client";
import type {
  WaveDataset,
  ResearchDataset,
  DataRequest,
  AnonymizationConfig,
  PanelLink,
} from "./warehouse.types";

interface Envelope<T> {
  data: T;
}

export const warehouseApi = {
  async waveDatasets(): Promise<WaveDataset[]> {
    const { data } = await api.get<Envelope<WaveDataset[]>>(
      "/warehouse/wave-datasets",
    );
    return data.data;
  },

  async buildWaveDataset(
    waveId: string,
  ): Promise<{ jobId: string; statusUrl: string }> {
    const { data } = await api.post<
      Envelope<{ jobId: string; statusUrl: string }>
    >(`/warehouse/wave-datasets/${waveId}/build`);
    return data.data;
  },

  async panelLinks(waveId?: string): Promise<PanelLink[]> {
    const p = waveId ? `?wave_id=${waveId}` : "";
    const { data } = await api.get<Envelope<PanelLink[]>>(
      `/warehouse/panel-links${p}`,
    );
    return data.data;
  },

  async researchDatasets(): Promise<ResearchDataset[]> {
    const { data } =
      await api.get<Envelope<ResearchDataset[]>>("/research/datasets");
    return data.data;
  },

  async anonymize(
    waveId: string,
    config: AnonymizationConfig,
  ): Promise<ResearchDataset> {
    const { data } = await api.post<Envelope<ResearchDataset>>(
      `/research/datasets/anonymize`,
      { wave_id: waveId, config },
    );
    return data.data;
  },

  async requestAccess(
    datasetId: string,
    payload: {
      researcherName: string;
      researcherEmail: string;
      institution: string;
      purpose: string;
    },
  ): Promise<DataRequest> {
    const { data } = await api.post<Envelope<DataRequest>>(
      `/research/datasets/${datasetId}/request`,
      payload,
    );
    return data.data;
  },

  async download(
    datasetId: string,
    requestId: string,
    format: string,
  ): Promise<{ url: string }> {
    const { data } = await api.post<Envelope<{ url: string }>>(
      `/research/datasets/${datasetId}/download`,
      { request_id: requestId, format },
    );
    return data.data;
  },

  async requests(): Promise<DataRequest[]> {
    const { data } =
      await api.get<Envelope<DataRequest[]>>("/research/requests");
    return data.data;
  },
};
```

```ts
// warehouse.queries.ts
import { useQuery } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { warehouseApi } from "./warehouse.api";

export const warehouseKeys = {
  all: ["warehouse"] as const,
  waveDatasets: () => [...warehouseKeys.all, "wave-datasets"] as const,
  panelLinks: (waveId?: string) =>
    [...warehouseKeys.all, "panel-links", waveId ?? "all"] as const,
  research: () => [...warehouseKeys.all, "research"] as const,
  requests: () => [...warehouseKeys.all, "requests"] as const,
};

export function useWaveDatasets() {
  return useQuery({
    queryKey: warehouseKeys.waveDatasets(),
    queryFn: () => warehouseApi.waveDatasets(),
    staleTime: 60_000,
  });
}

export function usePanelLinks(waveId?: string) {
  return useQuery({
    queryKey: warehouseKeys.panelLinks(waveId),
    queryFn: () => warehouseApi.panelLinks(waveId),
    staleTime: 60_000,
  });
}

export function useResearchDatasets() {
  return useQuery({
    queryKey: warehouseKeys.research(),
    queryFn: () => warehouseApi.researchDatasets(),
    staleTime: 60_000,
  });
}

export function useDataRequests() {
  return useQuery({
    queryKey: warehouseKeys.requests(),
    queryFn: () => warehouseApi.requests(),
    staleTime: 60_000,
  });
}
```

```ts
// warehouse.mutations.ts
import { useMutation, useQueryClient } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { warehouseApi } from "./warehouse.api";
import { warehouseKeys } from "./warehouse.queries";
import { useToast } from "@/components/ui/Toast";
import type { AnonymizationConfig } from "./warehouse.types";

export function useAnonymize() {
  const qc = useQueryClient();
  const { push } = useToast();
  return useMutation({
    mutationFn: ({
      waveId,
      config,
    }: {
      waveId: string;
      config: AnonymizationConfig;
    }) => warehouseApi.anonymize(waveId, config),
    onSuccess: () => {
      qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: warehouseKeys.research() });
      push("success", "Dataset anonymized");
    },
  });
}

export function useBuildWaveDataset() {
  const qc = useQueryClient();
  const { push } = useToast();
  return useMutation({
    mutationFn: (waveId: string) => warehouseApi.buildWaveDataset(waveId),
    onSuccess: () => {
      qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: warehouseKeys.waveDatasets() });
      push("info", "Wave dataset build queued");
    },
  });
}

export function useRequestAccess() {
  const qc = useQueryClient();
  const { push } = useToast();
  return useMutation({
    mutationFn: ({ datasetId, payload }: { datasetId: string; payload: any }) =>
      warehouseApi.requestAccess(datasetId, payload),
    onSuccess: () => {
      qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: warehouseKeys.requests() });
      push("success", "Data request submitted");
    },
  });
}
```

```tsx
  const totalPanelMembers = panels?.length ?? 0;
  const activeMembers = panels?.filter((p) => !p.attritionWave).length ?? 0;
```

```tsx
import { useState } from "react";
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";
import { useResearchDatasets } from "./warehouse.queries";
import { useRequestAccess } from "./warehouse.mutations";
import { Card, CardHeader } from "@/components/ui/Card";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/Button";
import { Chip } from "@/components/ui/Chip";
import { EmptyState } from "@/components/ui/EmptyState";
import { Modal } from "@/components/ui/Modal";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/Input";
import { Textarea } from "@/components/ui/Textarea";
import { useToast } from "@/components/ui/Toast";
import { formatDate } from "@/lib/utils/date";
import type { ResearchDataset } from "./warehouse.types";

export default function ResearchCataloguePage() {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const { data: datasets, isLoading } = useResearchDatasets();
  const request = useRequestAccess();
  const { push } = useToast();
  const [selected, setSelected] = useState<ResearchDataset | null>(null);
  const [form, setForm] = useState({
    researcherName: "",
    researcherEmail: "",
    institution: "",
    purpose: "",
  });

  const submit = async () => {
    if (!selected) return;
    if (
      !form.researcherName ||
      !form.researcherEmail ||
      !form.institution ||
      !form.purpose
    ) {
      push("warn", "All fields are required");
      return;
    }
    await request.mutateAsync({ datasetId: selected.datasetId, payload: form });
    setSelected(null);
    setForm({
      researcherName: "",
      researcherEmail: "",
      institution: "",
      purpose: "",
    });
  };

  return (
    <main id="main" tabIndex={-1} className="space-y-5">
      <header>
        <h1 className="text-h1 text-primary-900">{t("research.title")}</h1>
        <p className="text-body-sm text-neutral-600 mt-1">
          {t("research.subtitle")}
        </p>
      </header>

      {isLoading && <EmptyState title="Loading…" />}
      {!isLoading && !datasets?.length && (
        <EmptyState
          title="No datasets yet"
          description="Ask a Data Manager to publish a research dataset."
        />
      )}

      {!isLoading && datasets?.length ? (
        <div className="grid md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-3">
          {datasets.map((d) => (
            <Card key={d.datasetId}>
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-2">
                <Chip
                  tone={
                    d.anonymizationLevel === "L2"
                      ? "teal"
                      : d.anonymizationLevel === "L3"
                        ? "green"
                        : "purple"
                  }
                >
                  {d.anonymizationLevel}
                </Chip>
                <span className="text-caption text-neutral-600">
                  {d.waveCode}
                </span>
              </div>
              <div className="font-mono text-caption text-primary-700 font-bold mb-1">
                {d.datasetId.slice(0, 20)}…
              </div>
              <div className="text-caption text-neutral-600 mb-3">
                {d.recordCount.toLocaleString()} records · v{d.version}
                {d.releasedAt && ` · ${formatDate(d.releasedAt)}`}
              </div>
              <div className="text-caption mb-3">
                Formats: {d.formats.join(", ")}
              </div>
              <Button
                size="sm"
                variant="primary"
                fullWidth
                onClick={() => setSelected(d)}
              >
                Request access
              </Button>
            </Card>
          ))}
        </div>
      ) : null}

      <Modal
        open={!!selected}
        onClose={() => setSelected(null)}
        title="Request data access"
        size="md"
        footer={
          <>
            <Button variant="ghost" onClick={() => setSelected(null)}>
              Cancel
            </Button>
            <Button
              variant="primary"
              loading={request.isPending}
              onClick={submit}
            >
              Submit request
            </Button>
          </>
        }
      >
        <div className="space-y-3">
          <Input
            label="Your name"
            required
            value={form.researcherName}
            onChange={(e) =>
              setForm({ ...form, researcherName: e.target.value })
            }
          />
          <Input
            label="Email"
            type="email"
            required
            value={form.researcherEmail}
            onChange={(e) =>
              setForm({ ...form, researcherEmail: e.target.value })
            }
          />
          <Input
            label="Institution"
            required
            value={form.institution}
            onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, institution: e.target.value })}
          />
          <Textarea
            label="Research purpose"
            required
            rows={3}
            value={form.purpose}
            onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, purpose: e.target.value })}
          />
          <p className="text-caption text-neutral-600">
            By submitting, you agree to sign a Data Use Agreement (DUA) before
            downloading. You must not attempt re-identification, and you must
            acknowledge PIIMS as the data source in publications.
          </p>
        </div>
      </Modal>
    </main>
  );
}
```
