## 9.37 `src/features/analytics/did.ts` — DiD Calculator

```ts
/**
 * Difference-in-Differences calculator.
 *
 * DiD = (Treatment_endline − Treatment_baseline) − (Control_endline − Control_baseline)
 *
 * Standard error is computed using the standard two-sample variance formula,
 * which is a reasonable approximation for the effect of adding independent
 * sampling errors across the four group×wave cells.
 *
 * For rigorous inference, researchers re-run this against the anonymized
 * dataset using their own statistical tools.
 */

import type { DiDResult } from "./analytics.types";

export interface GroupMeans {
  baselineMean: number;
  baselineN: number;
  baselineSD: number;
  endlineMean: number;
  endlineN: number;
  endlineSD: number;
}

export function computeDiD(
  indicator: {
    indicatorId: string;
    indicatorCode: string;
    indicatorName: string;
    unit: string;
  },
  treatment: GroupMeans,
  control: GroupMeans,
): DiDResult {
  const treatmentChange = treatment.endlineMean - treatment.baselineMean;
  const controlChange = control.endlineMean - control.baselineMean;
  const did = treatmentChange - controlChange;

  /* Variance of the difference:
   * Var(treatmentChange) = Var(T_end)/n_Tend + Var(T_base)/n_Tbase
   * Var(controlChange)   = Var(C_end)/n_Cend + Var(C_base)/n_Cbase
   * Var(did)             = Var(treatmentChange) + Var(controlChange)
   */
  const varTreatmentChange =
    treatment.endlineSD ** 2 / Math.max(treatment.endlineN, 1) +
    treatment.baselineSD ** 2 / Math.max(treatment.baselineN, 1);

  const varControlChange =
    control.endlineSD ** 2 / Math.max(control.endlineN, 1) +
    control.baselineSD ** 2 / Math.max(control.baselineN, 1);

  const stdError = Math.sqrt(varTreatmentChange + varControlChange);

  /* Two-sided p-value via normal approximation (z-test) */
  const z = stdError > 0 ? did / stdError : 0;
  const pValue = 2 * (1 - normalCdf(Math.abs(z)));

  return {
    indicatorId: indicator.indicatorId,
    indicatorCode: indicator.indicatorCode,
    indicatorName: indicator.indicatorName,
    unit: indicator.unit,
    treatment: {
      baseline: treatment.baselineMean,
      endline: treatment.endlineMean,
      n: treatment.endlineN,
    },
    control: {
      baseline: control.baselineMean,
      endline: control.endlineMean,
      n: control.endlineN,
    },
    treatmentChange,
    controlChange,
    did,
    stdError,
    pValue,
    significant: pValue < 0.05,
  };
}

/** Standard normal CDF approximation (Abramowitz & Stegun 7.1.26) */
function normalCdf(x: number): number {
  const t = 1 / (1 + 0.2316419 * Math.abs(x));
  const d = 0.3989423 * Math.exp((-x * x) / 2);
  const p =
    d *
    t *
    (0.3193815 +
      t * (-0.3565638 + t * (1.781478 + t * (-1.821256 + t * 1.330274))));
  return x > 0 ? 1 - p : p;
}

/** Convenience: compute DiD from raw per-group per-wave arrays of individual observations. */
export function computeDiDFromRaw(
  indicator: {
    indicatorId: string;
    indicatorCode: string;
    indicatorName: string;
    unit: string;
  },
  treatmentBaseline: number[],
  treatmentEndline: number[],
  controlBaseline: number[],
  controlEndline: number[],
): DiDResult {
  const stats = (arr: number[]) => ({
    mean: arr.reduce((s, v) => s + v, 0) / Math.max(arr.length, 1),
    n: arr.length,
    sd:
      arr.length > 1
        ? Math.sqrt(
            arr.reduce(
              (s, v) =>
                s + (v - arr.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / arr.length) ** 2,
              0,
            ) /
              (arr.length - 1),
          )
        : 0,
  });

  const tb = stats(treatmentBaseline);
  const te = stats(treatmentEndline);
  const cb = stats(controlBaseline);
  const ce = stats(controlEndline);

  return computeDiD(
    indicator,
    {
      baselineMean: tb.mean,
      baselineN: tb.n,
      baselineSD: tb.sd,
      endlineMean: te.mean,
      endlineN: te.n,
      endlineSD: te.sd,
    },
    {
      baselineMean: cb.mean,
      baselineN: cb.n,
      baselineSD: cb.sd,
      endlineMean: ce.mean,
      endlineN: ce.n,
      endlineSD: ce.sd,
    },
  );
}
```

```ts
// analytics.api.ts
import { api } from "@/lib/api/client";
import type {
  ImpactDashboard,
  DiDResult,
  DisaggregationRow,
} from "./analytics.types";

interface Envelope<T> {
  data: T;
}

export const analyticsApi = {
  async dashboard(projectId: string): Promise<ImpactDashboard> {
    const { data } = await api.get<Envelope<ImpactDashboard>>(
      `/impact/dashboard?project_id=${projectId}`,
    );
    return data.data;
  },

  async did(
    projectId: string,
    indicatorId: string,
    treatmentGroupId: string,
    controlGroupId: string,
  ): Promise<DiDResult> {
    const { data } = await api.post<Envelope<DiDResult>>(
      "/impact/analysis/did",
      {
        project_id: projectId,
        indicator_id: indicatorId,
        treatment_group_id: treatmentGroupId,
        control_group_id: controlGroupId,
      },
    );
    return data.data;
  },

  async disaggregation(
    projectId: string,
    indicatorId: string,
    by: "gender" | "region" | "wealth_quintile",
  ): Promise<DisaggregationRow[]> {
    const { data } = await api.get<Envelope<DisaggregationRow[]>>(
      `/impact/analysis/disaggregation?project_id=${projectId}&indicator_id=${indicatorId}&by=${by}`,
    );
    return data.data;
  },
};
```

```ts
// analytics.queries.ts
import { useQuery } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { analyticsApi } from "./analytics.api";

export const analyticsKeys = {
  all: ["analytics"] as const,
  dashboard: (projectId: string) =>
    [...analyticsKeys.all, "dashboard", projectId] as const,
  did: (projectId: string, indicatorId: string) =>
    [...analyticsKeys.all, "did", projectId, indicatorId] as const,
};

export function useImpactDashboard(projectId: string | undefined) {
  return useQuery({
    queryKey: analyticsKeys.dashboard(projectId ?? ""),
    queryFn: () => analyticsApi.dashboard(projectId!),
    enabled: !!projectId,
    staleTime: 60_000,
  });
}

export function useDiD(
  projectId: string | undefined,
  indicatorId: string | undefined,
  tg: string,
  cg: string,
) {
  return useQuery({
    queryKey: analyticsKeys.did(projectId ?? "", indicatorId ?? ""),
    queryFn: () => analyticsApi.did(projectId!, indicatorId!, tg, cg),
    enabled: !!projectId && !!indicatorId,
  });
}
```

```tsx
import { useSearchParams } from "react-router-dom";
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";
import { useImpactDashboard } from "./analytics.queries";
import { Card, CardHeader } from "@/components/ui/Card";
import { KPITile } from "@/components/ui/KPITile";
import { Chip } from "@/components/ui/Chip";
import { LoadingState } from "@/components/ui/LoadingState";
import { EmptyState } from "@/components/ui/EmptyState";
import { WaveComparisonChart } from "./WaveComparisonChart";
import { TreatmentVsControl } from "./TreatmentVsControl";
import { formatDate } from "@/lib/utils/date";

export default function ImpactDashboardPage() {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const [params] = useSearchParams();
  const projectId = params.get("projectId") ?? "PIIMS-2026-0042";
  const { data, isLoading } = useImpactDashboard(projectId);

  if (isLoading) return <LoadingState message="Loading impact dashboard…" />;
  if (!data) return <EmptyState title="No impact data yet" />;

  return (
    <main id="main" tabIndex={-1} className="space-y-5">
      <header>
        <div className="text-caption text-neutral-600">
          <code className="text-primary-700 font-bold">{data.projectCode}</code>
        </div>
        <h1 className="text-h1 text-primary-900 mt-1">{data.projectName}</h1>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mt-2">
          {data.waves.map((w) => (
            <Chip
              key={w.waveCode}
              tone={w.waveCode === "W2" ? "green" : "blue"}
            >
              {w.waveCode} · {w.waveName}
            </Chip>
          ))}
          <span className="text-caption text-neutral-500 ml-2">
            Last updated {formatDate(data.lastUpdated)}
          </span>
        </div>
      </header>

      <div className="grid grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-4 gap-3">
        {data.headlineIndicators.slice(0, 4).map((ind) => {
          const baseline = ind.waves[0];
          const endline = ind.waves[ind.waves.length - 1];
          const change =
            baseline && endline && baseline.mean !== 0
              ? ((endline.mean - baseline.mean) / baseline.mean) * 100
              : 0;
          return (
            <KPITile
              key={ind.indicatorId}
              label={ind.indicatorName}
              value={endline ? `${endline.mean.toFixed(0)} ${ind.unit}` : "—"}
              delta={{
                value: `${change > 0 ? "+" : ""}${change.toFixed(1)}%`,
                direction: change > 0 ? "up" : change < 0 ? "down" : "flat",
              }}
              tone={change > 0 ? "success" : change < 0 ? "danger" : "default"}
            />
          );
        })}
      </div>

      <Card>
        <CardHeader
          title="Wave trajectory"
          subtitle="Mean values across waves"
        />
        <WaveComparisonChart indicators={data.headlineIndicators} />
      </Card>

      <TreatmentVsControl projectId={projectId} />
    </main>
  );
}

```tsx
import { useState } from "react";
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";
import type { IndicatorSeries } from "./analytics.types";

/** CSS-based bar chart across waves for a selected indicator. */
export function WaveComparisonChart({
  indicators,
}: {
  indicators: IndicatorSeries[];
}) {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const [selectedId, setSelectedId] = useState(indicators[0]?.indicatorId);
  const selected =
    indicators.find((i) => i.indicatorId === selectedId) ?? indicators[0];

  if (!selected)
    return <p className="text-body-sm text-neutral-600">No data.</p>;

  const max = Math.max(...selected.waves.map((w) => w.mean), 1);

  return (
    <div>
      <select
        value={selectedId}
        onChange={(e) => setSelectedId(e.target.value)}
        className="mb-4 h-9 px-3 rounded-md border border-neutral-300 text-body-sm"
        aria-label="Select indicator"
      >
        {indicators.map((i) => (
          <option key={i.indicatorId} value={i.indicatorId}>
            {i.indicatorName}
          </option>
        ))}
      </select>

      <div className="flex items-end gap-4 h-[260px] px-4">
        {selected.waves.map((w, idx) => {
          const height = (w.mean / max) * 100;
          const isLast = idx === selected.waves.length - 1;
          return (
            <div
              key={w.waveCode}
              className="flex-1 flex flex-col items-center justify-end h-full"
            >
              <div className="text-body-sm font-bold text-primary-900 mb-1">
                {w.mean.toLocaleString(undefined, { maximumFractionDigits: 1 })}
              </div>
              <div
                className={`w-full max-w-[80px] rounded-t-md ${isLast ? "bg-green-500" : "bg-primary-700"} transition-all`}
                style={{ height: `${Math.max(height, 3)}%` }}
              />
              <div className="text-caption text-neutral-600 mt-2 text-center">
                <div className="font-semibold">{w.waveCode}</div>
                <div className="text-[10px]">n = {w.n}</div>
              </div>
            </div>
          );
        })}
      </div>
      <div className="text-caption text-neutral-600 text-center mt-2">
        {selected.unit}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";
import { Card, CardHeader } from "@/components/ui/Card";
import { Chip } from "@/components/ui/Chip";
import { useDiD } from "./analytics.queries";

export function TreatmentVsControl({ projectId }: { projectId: string }) {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  // In production, indicator and group IDs are selectors
  const { data, isLoading } = useDiD(
    projectId,
    "ind-income-001",
    "tg-treatment",
    "tg-control",
  );

  return (
    <Card>
      <CardHeader
        title={t("analytics.did.title")}
        subtitle={t("analytics.did.subtitle")}
      />
      {isLoading && (
        <p className="text-body-sm text-neutral-600">Computing DiD…</p>
      )}
      {!isLoading && !data && (
        <p className="text-body-sm text-neutral-600">
          {t("analytics.did.noData")}
        </p>
      )}
      {data && (
        <>
          <table className="w-full text-body-sm mb-4">
            <thead>
              <tr className="border-b border-neutral-300 text-left">
                <th className="py-2 text-caption uppercase text-neutral-600"></th>
                <th className="py-2 text-right text-caption uppercase text-neutral-600">
                  Baseline
                </th>
                <th className="py-2 text-right text-caption uppercase text-neutral-600">
                  Endline
                </th>
                <th className="py-2 text-right text-caption uppercase text-neutral-600">
                  Change
                </th>
                <th className="py-2 text-right text-caption uppercase text-neutral-600">
                  n
                </th>
              </tr>
            </thead>
            <tbody>
              <tr className="border-b border-neutral-100">
                <td className="py-2 font-semibold">Treatment</td>
                <td className="py-2 text-right">
                  {data.treatment.baseline.toFixed(1)}
                </td>
                <td className="py-2 text-right">
                  {data.treatment.endline.toFixed(1)}
                </td>
                <td className="py-2 text-right font-bold text-green-700">
                  +{data.treatmentChange.toFixed(1)}
                </td>
                <td className="py-2 text-right text-caption">
                  {data.treatment.n}
                </td>
              </tr>
              <tr className="border-b border-neutral-100">
                <td className="py-2 font-semibold">Control</td>
                <td className="py-2 text-right">
                  {data.control.baseline.toFixed(1)}
                </td>
                <td className="py-2 text-right">
                  {data.control.endline.toFixed(1)}
                </td>
                <td className="py-2 text-right">
                  {data.controlChange.toFixed(1)}
                </td>
                <td className="py-2 text-right text-caption">
                  {data.control.n}
                </td>
              </tr>
              <tr>
                <td className="py-3 font-bold text-primary-900">DiD effect</td>
                <td colSpan={2} />
                <td className="py-3 text-right text-lg font-bold text-primary-900">
                  {data.did.toFixed(2)}
                </td>
                <td className="py-3 text-right text-caption">{data.unit}</td>
              </tr>
            </tbody>
          </table>

          <div className="flex items-center gap-3 p-3 bg-neutral-50 rounded-md">
            <Chip tone={data.significant ? "green" : "grey"}>
              {data.significant ? "✓ Significant" : "Not significant"}
            </Chip>
            <span className="text-body-sm text-neutral-600">
              p = {data.pValue.toFixed(4)} · SE = {data.stdError.toFixed(2)}
            </span>
          </div>
        </>
      )}
    </Card>
  );
}

## 9.43 Tests

### `src/features/survey/__tests__/skipLogic.test.ts`

```ts
import { describe, it, expect } from "vitest";
import { evaluateCondition, computeVisibility } from "../skipLogic";

describe("evaluateCondition", () => {
  it("evaluates equality", () => {
    expect(evaluateCondition("${q1} = 'F'", { q1: "F" })).toBe(true);
    expect(evaluateCondition("${q1} = 'F'", { q1: "M" })).toBe(false);
  });

  it("evaluates numeric comparison", () => {
    expect(evaluateCondition("${age} > 18", { age: 25 })).toBe(true);
    expect(evaluateCondition("${age} > 18", { age: 12 })).toBe(false);
    expect(evaluateCondition("${age} >= 18", { age: 18 })).toBe(true);
  });

  it("evaluates and/or/not", () => {
    expect(
      evaluateCondition("${g} = 'F' and ${age} > 18", { g: "F", age: 25 }),
    ).toBe(true);
    expect(
      evaluateCondition("${g} = 'F' and ${age} > 18", { g: "M", age: 25 }),
    ).toBe(false);
    expect(
      evaluateCondition("${g} = 'F' or ${age} < 18", { g: "M", age: 15 }),
    ).toBe(true);
    expect(evaluateCondition("not (${x} = 'yes')", { x: "no" })).toBe(true);
  });

  it("evaluates selected()", () => {
    expect(
      evaluateCondition("selected(${hobbies}, 'reading')", {
        hobbies: ["reading", "sports"],
      }),
    ).toBe(true);
    expect(
      evaluateCondition("selected(${hobbies}, 'cooking')", {
        hobbies: ["reading", "sports"],
      }),
    ).toBe(false);
  });

  it("evaluates count-selected()", () => {
    expect(
      evaluateCondition("count-selected(${hobbies}) > 1", {
        hobbies: ["a", "b"],
      }),
    ).toBe(true);
    expect(
      evaluateCondition("count-selected(${hobbies}) > 1", { hobbies: ["a"] }),
    ).toBe(false);
  });

  it("handles parentheses precedence", () => {
    expect(
      evaluateCondition("(${a} = 'x' or ${b} = 'y') and ${c} > 0", {
        a: "x",
        b: "z",
        c: 1,
      }),
    ).toBe(true);
    expect(
      evaluateCondition("(${a} = 'x' or ${b} = 'y') and ${c} > 0", {
        a: "z",
        b: "z",
        c: 1,
      }),
    ).toBe(false);
  });

  it("fails safe on malformed expression", () => {
    expect(evaluateCondition("${unclosed", {})).toBe(true);
    expect(evaluateCondition("${x} = ", { x: 1 })).toBe(true);
  });
});

describe("computeVisibility", () => {
  it("hides target question when condition is true", () => {
    const questions = [
      { questionId: "q1", skipLogic: [] },
      {
        questionId: "q2",
        skipLogic: [
          {
            condition: "${q1} = 'yes'",
            action: "HIDE",
            targetQuestionId: "q2",
          },
        ],
      },
    ];
    const { visible } = computeVisibility(questions, { q1: "yes" });
    expect(visible.has("q2")).toBe(false);
  });

  it("shows target question when condition is true", () => {
    const questions = [
      { questionId: "q1" },
      {
        questionId: "q2",
        skipLogic: [
          {
            condition: "${q1} = 'yes'",
            action: "SHOW",
            targetQuestionId: "q2",
          },
        ],
      },
    ];
    const { visible } = computeVisibility(questions, { q1: "yes" });
    expect(visible.has("q2")).toBe(true);
  });

  it("adds question to required set", () => {
    const questions = [
      { questionId: "q1", skipLogic: [] },
      {
        questionId: "q2",
        skipLogic: [{ condition: "${q1} = 'yes'", action: "REQUIRE" }],
      },
    ];
    const { required } = computeVisibility(questions, { q1: "yes" });
    expect(required.has("q2")).toBe(true);
  });
});
```

### `src/features/warehouse/__tests__/anonymize.test.ts`

```ts
import { describe, it, expect } from "vitest";
import { anonymize } from "../anonymize";
import {
  DEFAULT_ANON_CONFIG,
  type AnonymizationConfig,
} from "../warehouse.types";

const sample = [
  {
    panelId: "P1",
    beneficiaryName: "Aster",
    phone: "+251911",
    age: 42,
    income: 3500,
    region: "Oromia",
    zone: "East Shewa",
    woreda: "Bora",
  },
  {
    panelId: "P2",
    beneficiaryName: "Tadesse",
    phone: "+251922",
    age: 38,
    income: 4200,
    region: "Oromia",
    zone: "East Shewa",
    woreda: "Bora",
  },
  {
    panelId: "P3",
    beneficiaryName: "Hanna",
    phone: "+251933",
    age: 29,
    income: 5000,
    region: "Amhara",
    zone: "North Shewa",
    woreda: "K1",
  },
  {
    panelId: "P4",
    beneficiaryName: "Yohannes",
    phone: "+251944",
    age: 51,
    income: 8000,
    region: "Oromia",
    zone: "East Shewa",
    woreda: "Bora",
  },
  {
    panelId: "P5",
    beneficiaryName: "Selam",
    phone: "+251955",
    age: 45,
    income: 3000,
    region: "Amhara",
    zone: "North Shewa",
    woreda: "K1",
  },
];

describe("anonymize", () => {
  it("L0 returns records unchanged", () => {
    const result = anonymize(sample, { ...DEFAULT_ANON_CONFIG, level: "L0" });
    expect(result).toEqual(sample);
  });

  it("L1 pseudonymizes names and redacts phone", () => {
    const result = anonymize(sample, { ...DEFAULT_ANON_CONFIG, level: "L1" });
    expect(result[0]!.beneficiaryName).not.toBe("Aster");
    expect(result[0]!.phone).toBe("[REDACTED]");
    expect(result[0]!.panelId).toBe("P1"); // panel ID preserved
  });

  it("L1 preserves panel ID across waves", () => {
    const r1 = anonymize(sample, { ...DEFAULT_ANON_CONFIG, level: "L1" });
    const r2 = anonymize(sample, { ...DEFAULT_ANON_CONFIG, level: "L1" });
    expect(r1[0]!.beneficiaryName).toBe(r2[0]!.beneficiaryName); // deterministic
  });

  it("L2 brackets age and generalizes location", () => {
    const config: AnonymizationConfig = {
      ...DEFAULT_ANON_CONFIG,
      level: "L2",
      ageBracket: 5,
      locationGranularity: "ZONE",
    };
    const result = anonymize(sample, config);
    expect(result[0]!.age).toBeUndefined();
    expect(result[0]!.ageBand).toBeDefined();
    expect(result[0]!.woreda).toBeUndefined();
    expect(result[0]!.zone).toBeDefined();
  });

  it("L2 top-codes income above 99th percentile", () => {
    const config: AnonymizationConfig = {
      ...DEFAULT_ANON_CONFIG,
      level: "L2",
      incomeTopCode: 50,
    };
    const result = anonymize(sample, config);
    const sortedIncome = result.map((r) => r.income).sort((a, b) => a - b);
    // at least the highest value should be capped at some threshold
    expect(sortedIncome[sortedIncome.length - 1]).toBeLessThanOrEqual(8000);
  });

  it("L3 aggregates and applies suppression", () => {
    const config: AnonymizationConfig = {
      ...DEFAULT_ANON_CONFIG,
      level: "L3",
      suppressionThreshold: 2,
    };
    const result = anonymize(sample, config);
    for (const row of result) {
      expect(row.panelId).toMatch(/^AGG-/);
      expect(row.count).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(2);
    }
  });

  it("noise injection changes income values", () => {
    const config: AnonymizationConfig = {
      ...DEFAULT_ANON_CONFIG,
      level: "L2",
      addNoise: true,
      suppressionThreshold: 0,
    };
    const result = anonymize(sample, config);
    expect(result[0]!.income).not.toBe(3500); // should be perturbed
    expect(result[0]!.income).toBeGreaterThan(3000);
    expect(result[0]!.income).toBeLessThan(4000);
  });
});
```

        endlineMean: 5300,
        endlineN: 95,
        endlineSD: 1200,
      },
      {
        baselineMean: 3100,
        baselineN: 100,
        baselineSD: 750,
        endlineMean: 3800,
        endlineN: 100,
        endlineSD: 850,
      },
    );
    // Treatment change: +2100; Control change: +700; DiD: +1400
    expect(result.treatmentChange).toBe(2100);
    expect(result.controlChange).toBe(700);
    expect(result.did).toBe(1400);
    expect(result.significant).toBe(true);
    expect(result.pValue).toBeLessThan(0.05);
  });

  it("computes zero DiD when changes are equal", () => {
    const result = computeDiD(
      indicator,
      {
        baselineMean: 100,
        baselineN: 50,
        baselineSD: 10,
        endlineMean: 150,
        endlineN: 50,
        endlineSD: 12,
      },
      {
        baselineMean: 100,
        baselineN: 50,
        baselineSD: 10,
        endlineMean: 150,
        endlineN: 50,
        endlineSD: 12,
      },
    );
    expect(result.did).toBe(0);
    expect(result.significant).toBe(false);
  });

  it("handles negative DiD (treatment does worse)", () => {
    const result = computeDiD(
      indicator,
      {
        baselineMean: 100,
        baselineN: 50,
        baselineSD: 10,
        endlineMean: 110,
        endlineN: 50,
        endlineSD: 12,
      },
      {
        baselineMean: 100,
        baselineN: 50,
        baselineSD: 10,
        endlineMean: 160,
        endlineN: 50,
        endlineSD: 12,
      },
    );
    expect(result.did).toBe(-50);
  });

  it("computes from raw arrays", () => {
    const result = computeDiDFromRaw(
      indicator,
      [3000, 3200, 3400, 3100, 3300],
      [5100, 5300, 5500, 5200, 5400],
      [3050, 3150, 3050, 3150, 3050],
      [3800, 3900, 3700, 3800, 3800],
    );
    expect(result.treatmentChange).toBeCloseTo(2100, -1);
    expect(result.controlChange).toBeCloseTo(700, -1);
    expect(result.did).toBeCloseTo(1400, -1);
  });
});
```

# PART A — APP-LEVEL INFRASTRUCTURE

## 10.1 `src/app/ErrorBoundary.tsx`

Root error boundary. Catches any render error, prevents blank screen, offers recovery.

```tsx
import { Component, type ErrorInfo, type ReactNode } from "react";
import { AlertOctagon, RefreshCw, Home } from "lucide-react";

interface Props {
  children: ReactNode;
  fallback?: (error: Error, reset: () => void) => ReactNode;
}

interface State {
  error: Error | null;
  errorInfo: ErrorInfo | null;
}

export class ErrorBoundary extends Component<Props, State> {
  state: State = { error: null, errorInfo: null };

  static getDerivedStateFromError(error: Error): Partial<State> {
    return { error };
  }

  componentDidCatch(error: Error, errorInfo: ErrorInfo) {
    this.setState({ errorInfo });
    // In production: forward to Sentry / logging service
    if (import.meta.env.PROD) {
      // eslint-disable-next-line no-console
      console.error("[PIIMS] Unhandled error", { error, errorInfo });
    }
  }

  reset = () => {
    this.setState({ error: null, errorInfo: null });
  };

  render() {
    if (!this.state.error) return this.props.children;

    if (this.props.fallback) {
      return this.props.fallback(this.state.error, this.reset);
    }

    return (
      <div className="min-h-screen bg-neutral-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4">
        <div className="max-w-lg w-full bg-white rounded-lg border border-neutral-300 shadow-lg p-6 text-center">
          <AlertOctagon className="h-14 w-14 text-danger mx-auto" aria-hidden />
          <h1 className="text-h2 text-primary-900 mt-4">
            Something went wrong
          </h1>
          <p className="text-body-sm text-neutral-600 mt-2">
            An unexpected error occurred. Your data is safe. Try reloading the
            page. If the problem persists, contact{" "}
            <a
              className="text-primary-700 underline"
              href="mailto:support@piims.gov.et"
            >
              support@piims.gov.et
            </a>
            .
          </p>
          {import.meta.env.DEV && this.state.error && (
            <details className="mt-4 text-left">
              <summary className="cursor-pointer text-caption font-semibold text-neutral-600">
                Error details (development only)
              </summary>
              <pre className="mt-2 p-3 bg-neutral-100 rounded-md text-caption overflow-auto max-h-64 text-danger">
                {this.state.error.message}
                {"\n\n"}
                {this.state.error.stack}
              </pre>
            </details>
          )}
          <div className="flex gap-2 mt-6 justify-center">
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={this.reset}
              className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 px-4 py-2 rounded-md bg-primary-700 text-white font-semibold hover:bg-primary-900"
            >
              <RefreshCw className="h-4 w-4" aria-hidden />
              Try again
            </button>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => {
                window.location.href = "/dashboard";
              }}
              className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 px-4 py-2 rounded-md bg-white text-primary-700 border border-primary-300 font-semibold hover:bg-primary-100"
            >
              <Home className="h-4 w-4" aria-hidden />
              Go home
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }
}
```

## 10.2 `src/app/GlobalLoadingBar.tsx`

Thin top-of-page progress bar during route transitions (already scaffolded in Step 4 — this is the refined final version with route-level suspense integration).

```tsx
import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { useNavigation } from "react-router-dom";

/**
 * Combined loading indicator:
 * - Shows for React Router navigations (`useNavigation`)
 * - Shows for slow Suspense boundaries (> 150ms)
 *
 * Uses the `accent-500` gold token from the design system.
 */
export function GlobalLoadingBar() {
  const navigation = useNavigation();
  const [progress, setProgress] = useState(0);
  const [visible, setVisible] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    const loading = navigation.state === "loading";
    if (!loading) {
      // fade out
      setProgress(100);
      const t = setTimeout(() => {
        setVisible(false);
        setProgress(0);
      }, 300);
      return () => clearTimeout(t);
    }

    // show with slow start, then ease
    setVisible(true);
    const t1 = setTimeout(() => setProgress(30), 30);
    const t2 = setTimeout(() => setProgress(65), 300);
    const t3 = setTimeout(() => setProgress(85), 900);
    return () => {
      clearTimeout(t1);
      clearTimeout(t2);
      clearTimeout(t3);
    };
  }, [navigation.state]);

  return (
    <div
      aria-hidden
      className="fixed top-0 left-0 right-0 z-[500] h-[2px] pointer-events-none"
      style={{ opacity: visible ? 1 : 0, transition: "opacity 200ms ease" }}
    >
      <div
        className="h-full bg-accent-500"
        style={{
          width: `${progress}%`,
          transition: "width 300ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1)",
        }}
      />
    </div>
  );
}
```

## 10.3 `src/components/layout/OfflineBanner.tsx`

Enhanced offline experience — persistent banner, animated pulse, sync-now button.

```tsx
import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";
import { WifiOff, RefreshCw } from "lucide-react";
import { useSyncStore } from "@/stores/sync.store";
import { flushMutationQueue } from "@/features/projects/project.mutations";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/Button";

export function OfflineBanner() {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const { online, pendingCount, markSynced } = useSyncStore();
  const [syncing, setSyncing] = useState(false);

  // Auto-sync when we come back online
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!online) return;
    void (async () => {
      setSyncing(true);
      try {
        await flushMutationQueue();
        markSynced();
      } catch {
        /* ignore */
      } finally {
        setSyncing(false);
      }
    })();
  }, [online, markSynced]);

  if (online && pendingCount === 0) return null;

  const handleSync = async () => {
    setSyncing(true);
    try {
      await flushMutationQueue();
      markSynced();
    } finally {
      setSyncing(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div
      role="status"
      className={
        "flex items-center gap-3 px-4 py-2 text-body-sm border-b " +
        (online
          ? "bg-amber-50 text-amber-900 border-amber-200"
          : "bg-red-50 text-red-900 border-red-200")
      }
    >
      <WifiOff className="h-4 w-4 shrink-0" aria-hidden />
      <span className="flex-1">
        {online
          ? t("a11y.syncPending", { count: pendingCount })
          : t("a11y.offlineBanner")}
      </span>
      {online && pendingCount > 0 && (
        <Button
          variant="ghost"
          size="sm"
          leftIcon={<RefreshCw className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />}
          loading={syncing}
          onClick={handleSync}
        >
          Sync now
        </Button>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
```

## 10.4 `src/components/layout/SyncConflictModal.tsx`

When the same record was modified offline and on server, the user chooses which version wins.

```tsx
import { useState } from "react";
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";
import { AlertTriangle, ArrowRight, Check } from "lucide-react";
import { Modal } from "@/components/ui/Modal";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/Button";
import { Chip } from "@/components/ui/Chip";

export interface SyncConflict<T> {
  entityName: string;
  entityId: string;
  local: T;
  remote: T;
  localModifiedAt: string;
  remoteModifiedAt: string;
  fields: { name: string; localValue: unknown; remoteValue: unknown }[];
}

export interface SyncConflictModalProps<T> {
  open: boolean;
  conflict: SyncConflict<T> | null;
  onResolve: (choice: "local" | "remote" | "merge") => void;
  onCancel: () => void;
}

export function SyncConflictModal<T>({
  open,
  conflict,
  onResolve,
  onCancel,
}: SyncConflictModalProps<T>) {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const [choice, setChoice] = useState<"local" | "remote" | "merge">("remote");

  if (!conflict) return null;

  return (
    <Modal
      open={open}
      onClose={onCancel}
      title={t("syncConflict.title")}
      size="lg"
      footer={
        <>
          <Button variant="ghost" onClick={onCancel}>
            Resolve later
          </Button>
          <Button variant="primary" onClick={() => onResolve(choice)}>
            Apply choice
          </Button>
        </>
      }
    >
      <div className="space-y-4">
        <div className="flex gap-3 items-start">
          <AlertTriangle
            className="h-5 w-5 text-amber-600 mt-0.5 shrink-0"
            aria-hidden
          />
          <div>
            <p className="text-body-sm font-semibold text-primary-900">
              {t("syncConflict.subtitle", { entity: conflict.entityName })}
            </p>
            <p className="text-caption text-neutral-600 mt-1">
              <code>{conflict.entityId}</code>
            </p>
          </div>
        </div>

        <table className="w-full text-body-sm border border-neutral-300 rounded-md overflow-hidden">
          <thead>
            <tr className="bg-neutral-100">
              <th className="text-left px-3 py-2 text-caption font-bold uppercase text-neutral-600">
                Field
              </th>
              <th className="text-left px-3 py-2 text-caption font-bold uppercase text-neutral-600">
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                  Local
                  <Chip tone="amber">
                    {conflict.localModifiedAt.slice(0, 16).replace("T", " ")}
                  </Chip>
                </div>
              </th>
              <th className="text-left px-3 py-2 text-caption font-bold uppercase text-neutral-600">
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                  Server
                  <Chip tone="blue">
                    {conflict.remoteModifiedAt.slice(0, 16).replace("T", " ")}
                  </Chip>
                </div>
              </th>
            </tr>
          </thead>
          <tbody>
            {conflict.fields.map((f) => (
              <tr key={f.name} className="border-t border-neutral-200">
                <td className="px-3 py-2 font-semibold">{f.name}</td>
                <td className="px-3 py-2">
                  <span
                    className={
                      f.localValue !== f.remoteValue ? "text-amber-700" : ""
                    }
                  >
                    {String(f.localValue ?? "—")}
                  </span>
                </td>
                <td className="px-3 py-2">
                  <span
                    className={
                      f.localValue !== f.remoteValue
                        ? "text-primary-700 font-semibold"
                        : ""
                    }
                  >
                    {String(f.remoteValue ?? "—")}
                  </span>
                </td>
              </tr>
            ))}
          </tbody>
        </table>

        <fieldset className="space-y-2">
          <legend className="text-caption font-semibold text-primary-900">
            Choose resolution
          </legend>
          {[
            {
              value: "local",
              label: t("syncConflict.useLocal"),
              hint: "Keep your offline edits",
            },
            {
              value: "remote",
              label: t("syncConflict.useRemote"),
              hint: "Accept the server version",
            },
            {
              value: "merge",
              label: t("syncConflict.merge"),
              hint: "Combine non-conflicting fields",
            },
          ].map((o) => (
            <label
              key={o.value}
              className={`flex items-start gap-3 p-3 border rounded-md cursor-pointer ${
                choice === o.value
                  ? "border-primary-700 bg-primary-100"
                  : "border-neutral-300 hover:border-primary-300"
              }`}
            >
              <input
                type="radio"
                name="resolution"
                value={o.value}
                checked={choice === o.value}
                onChange={() => setChoice(o.value as any)}
                className="mt-1"
              />
              <div>
                <div className="text-body-sm font-semibold">{o.label}</div>
                <div className="text-caption text-neutral-600">{o.hint}</div>
              </div>
              {choice === o.value && (
                <Check
                  className="h-4 w-4 text-primary-700 ml-auto"
                  aria-hidden
                />
              )}
            </label>
          ))}
        </fieldset>
      </div>
    </Modal>
  );
}
```

## 10.5 `src/components/pwa/UpdatePrompt.tsx`

Prompt for service worker updates. Uses vite-plugin-pwa's `useRegisterSW` hook.

```tsx
import { useRegisterSW } from "virtual:pwa-register/react";
import { RefreshCw, X } from "lucide-react";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/Button";

export function UpdatePrompt() {
  const {
    offlineReady: [offlineReady, setOfflineReady],
    needRefresh: [needRefresh, setNeedRefresh],
    updateServiceWorker,
  } = useRegisterSW({
    onRegisteredSW(_swUrl, r) {
      // Check for updates every hour
      if (r) {
        setInterval(
          () => {
            r.update().catch(() => {});
          },
          60 * 60 * 1000,
        );
      }
    },
  });

  if (!offlineReady && !needRefresh) return null;

  return (
    <div
      role="alert"
      aria-live="polite"
      className="fixed bottom-4 left-4 right-4 sm:left-auto sm:right-4 sm:max-w-md z-[100] bg-primary-900 text-white rounded-lg shadow-lg p-4 flex items-start gap-3"
    >
      <RefreshCw
        className="h-5 w-5 text-accent-500 mt-0.5 shrink-0"
        aria-hidden
      />
      <div className="flex-1">
        <p className="text-body-sm font-semibold">
          {needRefresh ? "New version available" : "App ready for offline use"}
        </p>
        <p className="text-caption opacity-80 mt-0.5">
          {needRefresh
            ? "A newer version of PIIMS is available. Reload to update."
            : "PIIMS will continue to work even without internet."}
        </p>
        <div className="flex gap-2 mt-3">
          {needRefresh && (
            <Button
              variant="primary"
              size="sm"
              onClick={() => {
                void updateServiceWorker(true);
              }}
            >
              Reload
            </Button>
          )}
          <Button
            variant="ghost"
            size="sm"
            onClick={() => {
              setOfflineReady(false);
              setNeedRefresh(false);
            }}
            className="text-white hover:bg-white/10"
          >
            Dismiss
          </Button>
        </div>
      </div>
      <button
        type="button"
        onClick={() => {
          setOfflineReady(false);
          setNeedRefresh(false);
        }}
        aria-label="Dismiss"
        className="text-white/60 hover:text-white"
      >
        <X className="h-4 w-4" />
      </button>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## 10.6 `src/lib/pwa/registerSW.ts`

```ts
/**
 * Register the service worker in production only.
 * Called from `main.tsx` after mount.
 */
export function registerServiceWorker(): void {
  if (!import.meta.env.PROD) return;
  if (!("serviceWorker" in navigator)) return;

  window.addEventListener("load", () => {
    navigator.serviceWorker.register("/sw.js", { scope: "/" }).catch((err) => {
      // eslint-disable-next-line no-console
      console.warn("[PWA] Service worker registration failed", err);
    });
  });
}
```

## 10.7 `src/main.tsx` — Final Version

```tsx
import React from "react";
import ReactDOM from "react-dom/client";
import { AppProviders } from "@/app/providers";
import { ErrorBoundary } from "@/app/ErrorBoundary";
import App from "@/App";
import { registerServiceWorker } from "@/lib/pwa/registerSW";
import "@/design/globals.css";

const rootEl = document.getElementById("root");
if (!rootEl) throw new Error("Root element not found");

ReactDOM.createRoot(rootEl).render(
  <React.StrictMode>
    <ErrorBoundary>
      <AppProviders>
        <App />
      </AppProviders>
    </ErrorBoundary>
  </React.StrictMode>,
);

registerServiceWorker();
```

## 10.8 `src/app/providers.tsx` — Final Version

Adds UpdatePrompt and GlobalLoadingBar at the root.

```tsx
import { QueryClient, QueryClientProvider } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { ReactQueryDevtools } from "@tanstack/react-query-devtools";
import { BrowserRouter } from "react-router-dom";
import { I18nextProvider } from "react-i18next";
import type { ReactNode } from "react";
import { i18n } from "@/lib/i18n";
import { ToastProvider } from "@/components/ui/Toast";
import { UpdatePrompt } from "@/components/pwa/UpdatePrompt";
import { GlobalLoadingBar } from "./GlobalLoadingBar";

const queryClient = new QueryClient({
  defaultOptions: {
    queries: {
      retry: (failureCount, error: any) => {
        const status = error?.response?.status;
        if (status && status >= 400 && status < 500) return false;
        return failureCount < 3;
      },
      staleTime: 30_000,
      gcTime: 5 * 60_000,
      refetchOnWindowFocus: false,
      networkMode: "offlineFirst",
    },
    mutations: { retry: 0 },
  },
});

export function AppProviders({ children }: { children: ReactNode }) {
  return (
    <I18nextProvider i18n={i18n}>
      <QueryClientProvider client={queryClient}>
        <BrowserRouter>
          <ToastProvider>
            <GlobalLoadingBar />
            {children}
            <UpdatePrompt />
            {import.meta.env.DEV && (
              <ReactQueryDevtools initialIsOpen={false} />
            )}
          </ToastProvider>
        </BrowserRouter>
      </QueryClientProvider>
    </I18nextProvider>
  );
}
```

            purpose: "maskable",
          },

          {
            name: "Dashboard",
            url: "/dashboard",
            description: "Open dashboard",
          },
          {
            name: "Projects",
            url: "/projects",
            description: "View project registry",
          },
          {
            name: "Field Collection",
            url: "/impact/field",
            description: "Start field interview",
          },
        ],
      },
      devOptions: { enabled: false },
    }),

          if (id.includes("node_modules")) {
            if (id.includes("react-router")) return "react-router";
            if (id.includes("react")) return "react-vendor";
            if (id.includes("@tanstack")) return "query";
            if (id.includes("i18next")) return "i18n";
            if (id.includes("leaflet") || id.includes("react-leaflet"))

          // Per-feature chunks

          if (id.includes("/features/supplier/")) return "feature-supplier";
          if (id.includes("/features/beneficiaries/"))
            return "feature-beneficiaries";
          if (id.includes("/features/geo/")) return "feature-geo";
          if (id.includes("/features/documents/")) return "feature-documents";
          if (id.includes("/features/grievances/")) return "feature-grievances";
          if (id.includes("/features/impact-indicators/"))
            return "feature-impact-indicators";
          if (id.includes("/features/survey/")) return "feature-survey";
          if (id.includes("/features/field/")) return "feature-field";
          if (id.includes("/features/qa/")) return "feature-qa";
          if (id.includes("/features/warehouse/")) return "feature-warehouse";
          if (id.includes("/features/analytics/")) return "feature-analytics";
          if (id.includes("/features/admin/")) return "feature-admin";
          if (id.includes("/components/ui/")) return "ui";
        },
      },
    },
  },
});

# PART B — DEPLOYMENT

## 10.11 `Dockerfile`

Multi-stage build: Node → nginx. Produces a ~40 MB final image.

```dockerfile
# ---------- Stage 1: build ----------
FROM node:20-alpine AS build

WORKDIR /app

# Copy manifests first for layer caching
COPY package.json package-lock.json* ./
RUN npm ci --no-audit --no-fund

# Copy source
COPY . .

# Build with production env
ARG VITE_API_BASE_URL
ARG VITE_ENV=production
ENV VITE_API_BASE_URL=${VITE_API_BASE_URL}
ENV VITE_ENV=${VITE_ENV}

RUN npm run build

# ---------- Stage 2: runtime ----------
FROM nginx:1.27-alpine AS runtime

# Remove default nginx config
RUN rm /etc/nginx/conf.d/default.conf

# Copy our custom config
COPY nginx.conf /etc/nginx/conf.d/default.conf

# Copy built assets
COPY --from=build /app/dist /usr/share/nginx/html

# Add security-hardening
RUN apk add --no-cache curl \
    && addgroup -S piims && adduser -S piims -G piims \
    && chown -R piims:piims /usr/share/nginx/html /var/cache/nginx /var/log/nginx \
    && touch /var/run/nginx.pid \
    && chown piims:piims /var/run/nginx.pid

USER piims

EXPOSE 8080

HEALTHCHECK --interval=30s --timeout=3s --start-period=5s --retries=3 \
  CMD curl -f http://localhost:8080/healthz || exit 1

CMD ["nginx", "-g", "daemon off;"]
```

## 10.12 `nginx.conf`

Security headers, SPA fallback, gzip, caching.

```nginx
server {
    listen 8080;
    server_name _;
    root /usr/share/nginx/html;
    index index.html;

    # ---------- Security headers ----------
    add_header X-Frame-Options "DENY" always;
    add_header X-Content-Type-Options "nosniff" always;
    add_header X-XSS-Protection "1; mode=block" always;
    add_header Referrer-Policy "strict-origin-when-cross-origin" always;
    add_header Permissions-Policy "geolocation=(self), microphone=(), camera=(self)" always;
    add_header Strict-Transport-Security "max-age=63072000; includeSubDomains; preload" always;

    # Content Security Policy — tune per environment
    add_header Content-Security-Policy "
        default-src 'self';
        script-src 'self' 'wasm-unsafe-eval';
        style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline';
        img-src 'self' data: blob: https://*.tile.openstreetmap.org https://*.tile.opentopomap.org;
        font-src 'self' data:;
        connect-src 'self' https://api.piims.gov.et wss://api.piims.gov.et;
        frame-ancestors 'none';
        base-uri 'self';
        form-action 'self';
        object-src 'none';
        upgrade-insecure-requests;
    " always;

    # ---------- Health check ----------
    location = /healthz {
        access_log off;
        add_header Content-Type text/plain;
        return 200 "ok\n";
    }

    # ---------- Gzip ----------
    gzip on;
    gzip_vary on;
    gzip_min_length 1024;
    gzip_proxied any;
    gzip_types
        text/plain
        text/css
        text/xml
        text/javascript
        application/javascript
        application/json
        application/xml
        application/rss+xml
        image/svg+xml
        font/woff2;

    # ---------- Cache static assets aggressively ----------
    location ~* \.(?:js|css|woff2|png|jpg|jpeg|svg|webp|avif)$ {
        expires 1y;
        add_header Cache-Control "public, immutable";
        access_log off;
        try_files $uri =404;
    }

    # ---------- Do NOT cache HTML (must revalidate) ----------
    location = /index.html {
        add_header Cache-Control "no-cache, no-store, must-revalidate" always;
    }

    # ---------- Do NOT cache service worker ----------
    location = /sw.js {
        add_header Cache-Control "no-cache, no-store, must-revalidate" always;
    }

    # ---------- SPA fallback ----------
    location / {
        try_files $uri $uri/ /index.html;
    }

    # ---------- Block common probes ----------
    location ~ /\. { deny all; access_log off; log_not_found off; }
}
```

## 10.15 `.github/workflows/ci.yml`

```yaml
name: CI

on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [main, develop]
  push:
    branches: [develop]

concurrency:
  group: ci-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  quality:
    name: Lint · Typecheck · Test · Build
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version-file: .nvmrc
          cache: npm

      - run: npm ci --no-audit --no-fund

      - name: Lint
        run: npm run lint

      - name: Typecheck
        run: npm run typecheck

      - name: Unit tests
        run: npm test -- --reporter=verbose

      - name: Build
        run: npm run build
        env:
          VITE_API_BASE_URL: https://test-api.piims.gov.et/v1

      - name: Upload build artifacts
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: dist
          path: dist/
          retention-days: 7

  e2e:
    name: E2E (Playwright)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 20
    needs: quality
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version-file: .nvmrc
          cache: npm
      - run: npm ci --no-audit --no-fund
      - run: npx playwright install --with-deps chromium
      - run: npm run build
        env:
          VITE_API_BASE_URL: https://test-api.piims.gov.et/v1
      - run: npx playwright test
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        if: failure()
        with:
          name: playwright-report
          path: playwright-report/
          retention-days: 7

  lighthouse:
    name: Lighthouse Audit
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    needs: quality
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version-file: .nvmrc
          cache: npm
      - run: npm ci --no-audit --no-fund
      - run: npm run build
        env:
          VITE_API_BASE_URL: https://test-api.piims.gov.et/v1
      - name: Run Lighthouse CI
        run: |
          npm install -g @lhci/cli@0.14.x
          lhci autorun

  docker:
    name: Build Docker image
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    needs: quality
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: docker/setup-buildx-action@v3

      - name: Build image
        uses: docker/build-push-action@v6
        with:
          context: .
          push: false
          tags: piims-frontend:ci
          build-args: |
            VITE_API_BASE_URL=https://test-api.piims.gov.et/v1
          cache-from: type=gha
          cache-to: type=gha,mode=max
```

## 10.16 `.github/workflows/deploy.yml`

```yaml
name: Deploy

on:
  push:
    tags: ["v*.*.*"]
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      environment:
        description: "Target environment"
        required: true
        default: "staging"
        type: choice
        options: [staging, production]

concurrency:
  group: deploy-${{ github.event.inputs.environment || 'production' }}
  cancel-in-progress: false

env:
  REGISTRY: ghcr.io
  IMAGE_NAME: ${{ github.repository }}/piims-frontend

jobs:
  deploy:
    name: Deploy to ${{ github.event.inputs.environment || 'production' }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 20
    permissions:
      contents: read
      packages: write
      id-token: write
    environment:
      name: ${{ github.event.inputs.environment || 'production' }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Extract version
        id: version
        run: |
          if [[ "${{ github.ref }}" == refs/tags/* ]]; then
            echo "value=${GITHUB_REF#refs/tags/}" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          else
            echo "value=dev-$(git rev-parse --short HEAD)" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          fi

      - uses: docker/setup-buildx-action@v3

      - name: Login to GHCR
        uses: docker/login-action@v3
        with:
          registry: ${{ env.REGISTRY }}
          username: ${{ github.actor }}
          password: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Build and push
        uses: docker/build-push-action@v6
        with:
          context: .
          push: true
          tags: |
            ${{ env.REGISTRY }}/${{ env.IMAGE_NAME }}:${{ steps.version.outputs.value }}
            ${{ env.REGISTRY }}/${{ env.IMAGE_NAME }}:latest
          build-args: |
            VITE_API_BASE_URL=${{ secrets.VITE_API_BASE_URL }}
          cache-from: type=gha
          cache-to: type=gha,mode=max

      - name: Deploy to environment
        run: |
          echo "Deploying ${{ steps.version.outputs.value }} to ${{ github.event.inputs.environment || 'production' }}"
          # This step is intentionally a placeholder.
          # In production, replace with:
          #   - kubectl set image deployment/piims-frontend ...
          #   - or: ssh deploy@server 'cd /opt/piims && docker compose pull && docker compose up -d'
          #   - or: aws ecs update-service ...
```

# PART C — DOCUMENTATION

## 10.18 `README.md` — Complete Handover README

````markdown
# PIIMS Frontend

**Project Inception Information Management System** — impact-enabled, bilingual, offline-capable, accessible.

Financed by the World Bank · Owned by the Ministry of Water and Energy, Federal Democratic Republic of Ethiopia.

---

## What is PIIMS?

A 23-module, 43-role information system covering:

- Project registry and pipeline (M2)
- Inception reports and stage gates (M3)
- Results framework (M4)
- Financial and procurement tracking (M5, M6)
- Supplier portal (M7)
- Beneficiary registry and service delivery (M8)
- GIS mapping (M9)
- Document management (M10)
- Reporting and dashboards (M11, M12)
- Grievance redress (M13)
- Impact measurement suite (M18–M23)
- Administration and audit (M1, M16, M17)

Full specification lives in:

- `SAD/SDD v2.0` — architecture
- `DMP & Data Dictionary v2.0` — data
- `API Spec v2.0` — interfaces
- `UI/UX Spec v2.0` — design
- `SRD v1.0` — requirements

---

## Quick start

### Prerequisites

- Node.js 20.10+ (see `.nvmrc`)
- npm 10+

### Install and run

```bash
cp .env.example .env
# edit .env with your API base URL
npm install
npm run dev
```
````

The app opens at **http://localhost:5173**.

### Login credentials (development)

The dev environment accepts any username/password against a mock API.
Use the **Role Switcher** at the bottom of the screen to simulate all 43 roles.

---

## Scripts

| Script               | Purpose                          |
| -------------------- | -------------------------------- |
| `npm run dev`        | Dev server on port 5173          |
| `npm run build`      | Production build to `dist/`      |
| `npm run preview`    | Preview production build locally |
| `npm test`           | Unit tests (Vitest)              |
| `npm run test:watch` | Tests in watch mode              |
| `npm run test:e2e`   | E2E tests (Playwright)           |
| `npm run lint`       | ESLint                           |
| `npm run format`     | Prettier                         |
| `npm run typecheck`  | TypeScript strict check          |
| `npm run analyze`    | Bundle size analysis             |

---

## Stack

| Layer        | Choice                                |
| ------------ | ------------------------------------- |
| Bundler      | Vite 5                                |
| Framework    | React 18 + TypeScript 5 (strict)      |
| Routing      | React Router v6                       |
| Server state | TanStack Query v5                     |
| Client state | Zustand                               |
| Styling      | Tailwind CSS 3 + CSS variables        |
| Forms        | React Hook Form + Zod                 |
| i18n         | react-i18next (English + Amharic)     |
| HTTP         | Axios                                 |
| PWA          | vite-plugin-pwa (Workbox)             |
| Maps         | Leaflet + react-leaflet               |
| Tests        | Vitest + Testing Library + Playwright |

---

## Architecture

```
src/
├── app/                 App bootstrap, providers, router, error boundary
├── design/              Design tokens (tokens.css, globals.css)
├── lib/                 API client, i18n, utilities, PWA registration
├── stores/              Global state (auth, UI, sync)
├── components/
│   ├── ui/              Design-system primitives (Step 2)
│   ├── layout/          App shell (Step 4)
│   └── pwa/             Service-worker UI
├── features/            Feature modules M1–M23
│   ├── auth/
│   ├── projects/
│   ├── inception/
│   ├── results/
│   ├── financial/
│   ├── procurement/
│   ├── supplier/
│   ├── beneficiaries/
│   ├── geo/
│   ├── documents/

│   ├── impact-indicators/

│   └── admin/
└── pages/               Route-level pages (compose features)
```

**Module boundaries:** every feature folder is self-contained — types, schemas, API, queries, mutations, pages, components, tests. Cross-feature imports go through public exports only.

---

## Environment variables

| Variable               | Purpose                     | Example                                  |
| ---------------------- | --------------------------- | ---------------------------------------- |
| `VITE_API_BASE_URL`    | API gateway base URL        | `https://api.piims.gov.et/v1`            |
| `VITE_ENV`             | Environment name            | `development` / `staging` / `production` |
| `VITE_SENTRY_DSN`      | Optional error tracking     | —                                        |
| `VITE_MAP_TILE_URL`    | Optional custom tile server | —                                        |
| `VITE_FEATURE_OFFLINE` | Enable offline mode         | `true`                                   |
| `VITE_FEATURE_IMPACT`  | Enable impact suite         | `true`                                   |

---

## Testing

- **Unit tests** (Vitest): components, hooks, schemas, utilities
- **E2E tests** (Playwright): critical user journeys per role
- **Accessibility**: automated via Testing Library + `jest-axe`; manual audit quarterly
- **Lighthouse CI**: runs on every PR — a11y ≥ 95, perf ≥ 85

Run locally:

```bash
npm test
npm run test:e2e
npx lhci autorun     # after `npm run build`
```

---

## Deployment

### Docker

```bash
docker build \
  --build-arg VITE_API_BASE_URL=https://api.piims.gov.et/v1 \
  -t piims-frontend:latest .

docker run -p 8080:8080 piims-frontend:latest
```

### CI/CD

- `ci.yml` — runs on every PR: lint, typecheck, test, build, e2e, Lighthouse, docker build
- `deploy.yml` — runs on `v*.*.*` tag or manual trigger: builds Docker image, pushes to GHCR, deploys to environment

### Rollback

See `RUNBOOK.md` for step-by-step rollback.

---

## Accessibility

The system targets **WCAG 2.1 Level AA**:

- Semantic HTML with ARIA where needed
- Keyboard navigation for all interactive elements
- Screen reader announcements for dynamic content (`aria-live`)
- Colour contrast ≥ 4.5:1
- Focus indicators on all focusable elements
- Reduced-motion support
- 200% zoom without content loss

Manual audit: quarterly. Report issues to `support@piims.gov.et`.

---

## Internationalisation

English and Amharic are first-class. All user-facing strings live in `src/lib/i18n/{en,am}.json`.

**Rules:**

- No hardcoded strings in components
- Amharic layout tested on every PR that adds UI
- Date formatting respects both Gregorian and Ethiopian calendars
- Currency respects ETB base with multi-currency reporting

See `CONTRIBUTING.md` for i18n workflow.

| Bug / feature request  | `support@piims.gov.et`                      |

| Operations / on-call   | See `RUNBOOK.md`                            |
| Architecture questions | See `docs/module-map.md`                    |

## 10.19 `CONTRIBUTING.md`

```markdown
# Contributing to PIIMS

## Branch strategy

- `main` — production (protected, deployable at all times)
- `develop` — integration branch
- `feature/*` — feature branches off `develop`
- `hotfix/*` — urgent fixes off `main`

## Commit convention

We use **Conventional Commits**:

````

<type>(<scope>): <subject>

<body>

<footer>
```

Types: `feat`, `fix`, `docs`, `style`, `refactor`, `test`, `chore`, `perf`, `ci`.

Scopes: `m2-projects`, `m3-inception`, `m4-results`, `m5-financial`, `m6-procurement`, `m7-supplier`, `m8-beneficiary`, `m9-geo`, `m10-documents`, `m11-reports`, `m12-dashboard`, `m13-grievance`, `m18-impact`, `m19-survey`, `m20-field`, `m21-qa`, `m22-warehouse`, `m23-analytics`, `ui`, `auth`, `i18n`, `pwa`, `infra`.

Example:

```
feat(m20-field): add offline conflict resolution UI

- Shows side-by-side local vs server values
- User picks resolution strategy
- Syncs after choice is made

Closes #142
```

## Pull request process

1. Branch off `develop`
2. Make changes
3. Run `npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test`
4. Add/update tests — PRs without tests are rejected unless explicitly agreed
5. Add i18n keys for any new user-facing string (EN + AM)
6. Update `CHANGELOG.md` under `[Unreleased]`
7. Open PR with descriptive title (conventional commit format) and link the issue
8. Two approvals required (one from feature owner, one from architecture or QA)

## Code review checklist

Every reviewer confirms:

- [ ] Types are strict — no `any` without justification
- [ ] All UI strings use `t()` — no hardcoded English
- [ ] Accessible: labels, focus, `aria-*` where needed
- [ ] `usePermissions().can()` gates every destructive / config action
- [ ] New API endpoints invalidate the right query keys
- [ ] Zod schema validates all form inputs
- [ ] Tests cover happy path + at least one failure
- [ ] No new `console.log` in production code
- [ ] Bundle impact checked (`npm run analyze`)

## Code style

- Prettier, 100-col lines, single quotes, semicolons
- Feature folders: one export per file, barrel `index.ts` for public API only
- React: function components + hooks only; no classes except `ErrorBoundary`
- State: prefer server state via TanStack Query; Zustand only for UI / cross-cutting state
- Styling: Tailwind utilities + design tokens — no inline `style={{}}` unless dynamic

## i18n

Adding a new string:

1. Add to `src/lib/i18n/en.json` under the appropriate namespace
2. Add matching Amharic translation to `src/lib/i18n/am.json`
3. Reference via `const { t } = useTranslation(); t('namespace.key')`
4. If translation is pending, use EN value in AM file and open an issue

## Accessibility requirements

Every PR that adds UI:

- Keyboard: can reach and operate every interactive element
- Screen reader: test with VoiceOver (Mac) or NVDA (Windows) for new flows
- Contrast: use only design tokens — they're pre-validated for AA
- Forms: `label` associated programmatically, error via `role="alert"`
- Tables: proper `scope="col"` on `<th>`, sortable columns use `aria-sort`

## Security

- Never commit secrets (use `.env` locally, GitHub secrets in CI)
- Sanitise user inputs — Zod handles most, but check display contexts
- Never trust client-side RBAC alone — the backend enforces; client only hides
- Report vulnerabilities privately — see `SECURITY.md`

## Testing expectations

- Unit tests for: schemas, hooks, utilities, pure components
- Integration tests for: multi-step flows (wizard, CAPI, review)
- E2E for: login → dashboard, project create → inception submit, field interview → sync
- Minimum coverage: **80%** across `src/features/**`

## Release

When ready to release:

```bash
# update CHANGELOG
# bump version in package.json
git tag v2.0.0
git push origin v2.0.0
```

The `deploy.yml` workflow builds and pushes the Docker image; ops then promotes it to production per `RUNBOOK.md`.

````

## 10.21 `RUNBOOK.md`

````markdown
# PIIMS Operations Runbook

For MoWE IT operations team. Covers routine operations and incident response.

---

## Deployment procedure

### 1. Pre-deployment checks

- [ ] CI is green on the release tag
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` reflects the release
- [ ] Database migrations (if any) reviewed by DBA
- [ ] Backup verified within the last 24 hours
- [ ] Security scan passed (`npm audit` clean or exceptions documented)

### 2. Deploy to staging

```bash
# CI auto-deploys on tag to staging
git tag v2.0.1
git push origin v2.0.1
```
````

Wait for `deploy.yml` to complete. Verify staging:

```bash
curl https://staging.piims.gov.et/healthz
# expect: ok
```

### 3. Smoke test staging

See `docs/smoke-test.md` — minimum 3 role journeys must pass:

- Login as MoWE PIU → create project → submit inception report
- Login as Data Collector → complete an interview → verify sync
- Login as World Bank TTL → review portfolio → generate ISR

### 4. Promote to production

Manual trigger in GitHub Actions:

- Workflow: `Deploy`
- Environment: `production`
- Confirm with release manager

### 5. Post-deployment verification

- [ ] `https://api.piims.gov.et/healthz` returns `ok`
- [ ] Login works for one account per user class
- [ ] Dashboard loads without errors
- [ ] Monitor Sentry / Grafana for 15 minutes
- [ ] Update `CHANGELOG.md` "Unreleased" section to the released version

---

## Rollback procedure

If production shows critical failures:

```bash
# 1. Identify the last known-good version
docker pull ghcr.io/<org>/piims-frontend:<last-good-tag>

# 2. Update the deployment
kubectl set image deployment/piims-frontend \
  piims-frontend=ghcr.io/<org>/piims-frontend:<last-good-tag>

# OR via docker compose
cd /opt/piims
sed -i 's|image: .*piims-frontend.*|image: ghcr.io/<org>/piims-frontend:<last-good-tag>|' docker-compose.yml
docker compose up -d
```

Then verify:

- `curl https://api.piims.gov.et/healthz` → `ok`
- Check Grafana for 5 minutes of stable metrics
- Open incident ticket documenting the rollback

If the rollback is caused by a database migration, coordinate with the DBA — some migrations are reversible, some are not.

---

## Common failures and fixes

### White screen after login

**Symptoms:** Login succeeds, then screen is blank.

**Likely cause:** JavaScript error in a route-level component.

**Fix:**

1. Check browser DevTools console — grab the error
2. Check Sentry for the same error
3. If a specific feature module is failing, disable it temporarily via `VITE_FEATURE_IMPACT=false` and redeploy
4. Root-cause with the frontend team

### "Unauthorized" loop

**Symptoms:** Redirected to `/login` repeatedly after login.

**Likely cause:** JWT clock skew or revoked token.

**Fix:**

1. Check server clock — it must be within 60 s of true time
2. Verify JWT `exp` claim in DevTools → Application → Local Storage → `piims.auth`
3. Clear `piims.auth` from Local Storage and re-login
4. If persists, check the API gateway's `/auth/refresh` endpoint

### FMIS sync stuck

**Symptoms:** `/financial/fmis` shows "syncing" indefinitely.

**Likely cause:** MoF IFMIS adapter is unreachable.

**Fix:**

1. Check `/v1/integrations/status` → `FMIS` should be `HEALTHY`
2. If `DEGRADED`, check network connectivity to FMIS from the PIIMS server
3. Trigger manual sync from `/financial/fmis` page
4. If still failing, check backend logs for `[fmis-adapter]` errors

### Beneficiary duplicate warnings blocking registration

**Symptoms:** Every registration is flagged as a duplicate.

**Likely cause:** Deduplication threshold too aggressive, or a bad batch import polluted the registry.

**Fix:**

1. Verify the specific match — view the candidate's record
2. If it's a legitimate duplicate, merge
3. If it's a false positive, escalate to Data Manager to adjust the threshold
4. Log a ticket for the QA team to review dedup rules

### Service worker serving stale content

**Symptoms:** Updates don't appear after deployment.

**Likely cause:** Service worker cache not invalidated.

**Fix:**

1. Users see the "New version available" prompt — clicking **Reload** forces update
2. To force update across all users, bump the `manifest.start_url` cache version and redeploy
3. Users can hard-reload: Ctrl+Shift+R (Windows) or Cmd+Shift+R (Mac)

---

## Monitoring

| Metric               | Alert threshold         | Response                          |
| -------------------- | ----------------------- | --------------------------------- |
| Error rate (5xx)     | > 5% for 5 min          | Page on-call, check Sentry        |
| API latency p95      | > 2 s for 5 min         | Check backend, DB connection pool |
| Login failures       | > 50 / 5 min            | Possible brute-force; check IPs   |
| Offline sync backlog | > 1000 items for 10 min | Check API availability            |
| Certificate expiry   | < 30 days               | Renew via ops calendar            |
| Database connections | > 80% pool              | Investigate connection leaks      |

---

## Backup and restore

- **Automated:** Database + documents backed up daily at 02:00 EAT
- **Retention:** 30 days (hot), 12 months (cold archive)
- **Verification:** Monthly restore to test environment by DBA
- **Escalation:** If backup verification fails, log P1 incident immediately

---

## Security incidents

If a security incident is suspected (breach, unauthorized access, data leak):

1. **Isolate** — do not attempt to fix; preserve evidence
2. **Notify** — Page the Security Officer immediately (`security@piims.gov.et`)
3. **Document** — Capture logs, timestamps, screenshots before any action
4. **Follow** — Cooperate with the Security Officer's incident response plan

Do **not** discuss incidents on public channels or with press until authorized.

---

## Change management

All production changes require:

- Ticket in issue tracker
- Change approval from Release Manager + Security Officer (for security-impacting changes)
- Deployment window: **Tuesday–Thursday, 09:00–15:00 EAT**
- Rollback plan documented before deployment

Emergency changes (P1 incidents) follow expedited approval — verbal approval from Release Manager, documented retrospectively.

---

## On-call rotation

See `docs/on-call.md` for schedule and escalation matrix.

**P1 escalation chain:** On-call → Team Lead → CIO → State Minister

````

## 10.22 `SECURITY.md`

```markdown
# Security Policy

## Reporting a vulnerability

**Do not open a public issue.**

Email **security@piims.gov.et** with:

- Description of the vulnerability
- Steps to reproduce
- Potential impact
- Suggested fix (if any)

You will receive an acknowledgment within 24 hours. We aim to patch critical issues within 7 days.

## Scope

In scope:
- Frontend application (this repository)
- API gateway and backend services
- Data processing pipeline
- Beneficiary data handling

Out of scope:
- Third-party dependencies (report to the vendor directly)
- Social engineering
- Physical attacks on infrastructure

## Security controls

| Control | Implementation |
|---|---|
| Authentication | OAuth 2.0 + JWT, MFA for privileged roles |
| Authorization | RBAC + org/geo scope enforcement (server + client) |
| Transport | TLS 1.3 (nginx + API gateway) |
| Headers | CSP, HSTS, X-Frame-Options, X-Content-Type-Options, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy |
| Data at rest | AES-256 (database) |
| Audit | Append-only audit log with hash chain |
| Secrets | GitHub Secrets + HashiCorp Vault (runtime) |
| Dependencies | `npm audit` on every PR, Dependabot enabled |
| SAST | ESLint security plugin + CodeQL (weekly) |
| Secrets scanning | GitHub Advanced Security |

## Compliance

- ISO 27001 aligned
- World Bank data protection requirements
- Ethiopian data sovereignty policy

## Disclosure policy

We follow coordinated disclosure. Public disclosure after a patch is available is preferred; embargoed disclosure by mutual agreement.
````

# Smoke Test Checklist

export interface CreateUserInput {
