## A.2 `src/features/admin/admin.schema.ts`

```ts
import { z } from "zod";
import { USER_STATUSES } from "./admin.types";

const phoneRegex = /^(\+251|0)[79]\d{8}$/;

export const createUserSchema = z.object({
  username: z
    .string()
    .trim()
    .min(3, "Username min 3 chars")
    .max(60)
    .regex(
      /^[a-z0-9._-]+$/i,
      "Only letters, numbers, dots, hyphens, underscores",
    ),
  email: z.string().email("Enter a valid email"),
  fullName: z.string().trim().min(2).max(200),
  fullNameAm: z.string().trim().max(200).optional().or(z.literal("")),
  phone: z
    .string()
    .regex(phoneRegex, "Enter a valid Ethiopian phone")
    .optional()
    .or(z.literal("")),
  orgId: z.string().uuid("Select an organization"),
  role: z.string().min(1, "Select a role"),
  mfaEnabled: z.boolean().default(false),
  sendInvite: z.boolean().default(true),
});
export type CreateUserFormData = z.infer<typeof createUserSchema>;

export const updateUserSchema = z.object({
  fullName: z.string().trim().min(2).max(200).optional(),
  fullNameAm: z.string().trim().max(200).optional().or(z.literal("")),
  email: z.string().email().optional(),
  phone: z.string().regex(phoneRegex).optional().or(z.literal("")),
  orgId: z.string().uuid().optional(),
  role: z.string().min(1).optional(),
  status: z.enum(USER_STATUSES).optional(),
  mfaEnabled: z.boolean().optional(),
});
export type UpdateUserFormData = z.infer<typeof updateUserSchema>;

export const auditFiltersSchema = z.object({
  userId: z.string().optional(),
  entity: z.string().optional(),
  action: z.string().optional(),
  from: z.string().optional(),
  to: z.string().optional(),
  q: z.string().optional(),
  limit: z.number().int().min(1).max(500).optional(),
  cursor: z.string().optional(),
});
```

## A.3 `src/features/admin/admin.api.ts`

```ts
import { api } from "@/lib/api/client";
import type {
  AdminUser,
  AdminUserFilters,
  CreateUserInput,
  UpdateUserInput,
  IntegrationStatus,
  SyncRun,
  AuditLogEntry,
  AuditFilters,
  SystemHealth,
  IntegrationCode,
} from "./admin.types";

interface Envelope<T> {
  data: T;
}

function userFiltersToParams(f: AdminUserFilters): string {
  const p = new URLSearchParams();
  if (f.q) p.set("q", f.q);
  if (f.status?.length) p.set("status", f.status.join(","));
  if (f.orgId) p.set("org_id", f.orgId);
  if (f.role) p.set("role", f.role);
  if (f.limit) p.set("limit", String(f.limit));
  if (f.cursor) p.set("cursor", f.cursor);
  return p.toString();
}

function auditFiltersToParams(f: AuditFilters): string {
  const p = new URLSearchParams();
  if (f.userId) p.set("user_id", f.userId);
  if (f.entity) p.set("entity", f.entity);
  if (f.action) p.set("action", f.action);
  if (f.from) p.set("from", f.from);
  if (f.to) p.set("to", f.to);
  if (f.q) p.set("q", f.q);
  if (f.limit) p.set("limit", String(f.limit));
  if (f.cursor) p.set("cursor", f.cursor);
  return p.toString();
}

export const adminApi = {
  /* ---- Users ---- */
  async listUsers(f: AdminUserFilters) {
    const { data } = await api.get<Envelope<AdminUser[]> & { pagination: any }>(
      `/admin/users?${userFiltersToParams(f)}`,
    );
    return { data: data.data, pagination: (data as any).pagination };
  },

  async getUser(userId: string): Promise<AdminUser> {
    const { data } = await api.get<Envelope<AdminUser>>(
      `/admin/users/${userId}`,
    );
    return data.data;
  },

  async createUser(input: CreateUserInput): Promise<AdminUser> {
    const { data } = await api.post<Envelope<AdminUser>>("/admin/users", input);
    return data.data;
  },

  async updateUser(userId: string, input: UpdateUserInput): Promise<AdminUser> {
    const { data } = await api.patch<Envelope<AdminUser>>(
      `/admin/users/${userId}`,
      input,
    );
    return data.data;
  },

  async resetPassword(userId: string): Promise<{ temporaryPassword: string }> {
    const { data } = await api.post<Envelope<{ temporaryPassword: string }>>(
      `/admin/users/${userId}/reset-password`,
    );
    return data.data;
  },

  async deactivateUser(userId: string, reason?: string): Promise<AdminUser> {
    const { data } = await api.post<Envelope<AdminUser>>(
      `/admin/users/${userId}/deactivate`,
      { reason },
    );
    return data.data;
  },

  async reactivateUser(userId: string): Promise<AdminUser> {
    const { data } = await api.post<Envelope<AdminUser>>(
      `/admin/users/${userId}/reactivate`,
    );
    return data.data;
  },

  /* ---- Integrations ---- */
  async integrations(): Promise<IntegrationStatus[]> {
    const { data } = await api.get<Envelope<IntegrationStatus[]>>(
      "/admin/integrations",
    );
    return data.data;
  },

  async integrationRuns(code: IntegrationCode, limit = 20): Promise<SyncRun[]> {
    const { data } = await api.get<Envelope<SyncRun[]>>(
      `/admin/integrations/${code}/runs?limit=${limit}`,
    );
    return data.data;
  },

  async triggerSync(
    code: IntegrationCode,
  ): Promise<{ jobId: string; statusUrl: string }> {
    const { data } = await api.post<
      Envelope<{ jobId: string; statusUrl: string }>
    >(`/admin/integrations/${code}/sync`);
    return data.data;
  },

  /* ---- Audit ---- */
  async auditLog(f: AuditFilters) {
    const { data } = await api.get<
      Envelope<AuditLogEntry[]> & { pagination: any }
    >(`/audit?${auditFiltersToParams(f)}`);
    return { data: data.data, pagination: (data as any).pagination };
  },

  /* ---- System health ---- */
  async systemHealth(): Promise<SystemHealth> {
    const { data } = await api.get<Envelope<SystemHealth>>(
      "/admin/system-health",
    );
    return data.data;
  },
};
```

## A.4 `src/features/admin/admin.queries.ts`

```ts
import { useQuery, keepPreviousData } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { adminApi } from "./admin.api";
import type {
  AdminUserFilters,
  AuditFilters,
  IntegrationCode,
} from "./admin.types";

export const adminKeys = {
  all: ["admin"] as const,
  users: (f: AdminUserFilters) => [...adminKeys.all, "users", f] as const,
  user: (id: string) => [...adminKeys.all, "user", id] as const,
  integrations: () => [...adminKeys.all, "integrations"] as const,
  runs: (code: IntegrationCode) => [...adminKeys.all, "runs", code] as const,
  audit: (f: AuditFilters) => [...adminKeys.all, "audit", f] as const,
  health: () => [...adminKeys.all, "health"] as const,
};

export function useAdminUsers(f: AdminUserFilters) {
  return useQuery({
    queryKey: adminKeys.users(f),
    queryFn: () => adminApi.listUsers(f),
    placeholderData: keepPreviousData,
    staleTime: 30_000,
  });
}

export function useAdminUser(userId: string | undefined) {
  return useQuery({
    queryKey: adminKeys.user(userId ?? ""),
    queryFn: () => adminApi.getUser(userId!),
    enabled: !!userId,
  });
}

export function useIntegrations() {
  return useQuery({
    queryKey: adminKeys.integrations(),
    queryFn: () => adminApi.integrations(),
    refetchInterval: 30_000,
    staleTime: 15_000,
  });
}

export function useIntegrationRuns(code: IntegrationCode | undefined) {
  return useQuery({
    queryKey: adminKeys.runs(code ?? "FMIS"),
    queryFn: () => adminApi.integrationRuns(code!),
    enabled: !!code,
    refetchInterval: 15_000,
  });
}

export function useAuditLog(f: AuditFilters) {
  return useQuery({
    queryKey: adminKeys.audit(f),
    queryFn: () => adminApi.auditLog(f),
    placeholderData: keepPreviousData,
    staleTime: 10_000,
  });
}

export function useSystemHealth() {
  return useQuery({
    queryKey: adminKeys.health(),
    queryFn: () => adminApi.systemHealth(),
    refetchInterval: 30_000,
    staleTime: 15_000,
  });
}
```

## A.5 `src/features/admin/admin.mutations.ts`

```ts
import { useMutation, useQueryClient } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { adminApi } from "./admin.api";
import { adminKeys } from "./admin.queries";
import { useToast } from "@/components/ui/Toast";
import { normalizeApiError } from "@/lib/api/errors";
import type {
  CreateUserInput,
  UpdateUserInput,
  IntegrationCode,
} from "./admin.types";

export function useCreateUser() {
  const qc = useQueryClient();
  const { push } = useToast();
  return useMutation({
    mutationFn: (input: CreateUserInput) => adminApi.createUser(input),
    onSuccess: (u) => {
      qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: adminKeys.all });
      push("success", `User ${u.username} created`);
    },
    onError: (err) =>
      push("error", normalizeApiError(err).detail ?? "Failed to create user"),
  });
}

export function useUpdateUser() {
  const qc = useQueryClient();
  const { push } = useToast();
  return useMutation({
    mutationFn: ({
      userId,
      patch,
    }: {
      userId: string;
      patch: UpdateUserInput;
    }) => adminApi.updateUser(userId, patch),
    onSuccess: () => {
      qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: adminKeys.all });
      push("success", "User updated");
    },
    onError: (err) =>
      push("error", normalizeApiError(err).detail ?? "Update failed"),
  });
}

export function useResetPassword() {
  const qc = useQueryClient();
  const { push } = useToast();
  return useMutation({
    mutationFn: (userId: string) => adminApi.resetPassword(userId),
    onSuccess: (res) => {
      qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: adminKeys.all });
      push("success", `Temporary password: ${res.temporaryPassword}`);
    },
    onError: (err) =>
      push("error", normalizeApiError(err).detail ?? "Reset failed"),
  });
}

export function useDeactivateUser() {
  const qc = useQueryClient();
  const { push } = useToast();
  return useMutation({
    mutationFn: ({ userId, reason }: { userId: string; reason?: string }) =>
      adminApi.deactivateUser(userId, reason),
    onSuccess: () => {
      qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: adminKeys.all });
      push("success", "User deactivated");
    },
    onError: (err) =>
      push("error", normalizeApiError(err).detail ?? "Deactivate failed"),
  });
}

export function useReactivateUser() {
  const qc = useQueryClient();
  const { push } = useToast();
  return useMutation({
    mutationFn: (userId: string) => adminApi.reactivateUser(userId),
    onSuccess: () => {
      qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: adminKeys.all });
      push("success", "User reactivated");
    },
  });
}

export function useTriggerIntegrationSync() {
  const qc = useQueryClient();
  const { push } = useToast();
  return useMutation({
    mutationFn: (code: IntegrationCode) => adminApi.triggerSync(code),
    onSuccess: (_, code) => {
      qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: adminKeys.runs(code) });
      qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: adminKeys.integrations() });
      push("info", `Sync job queued for ${code}`);
    },
    onError: (err) =>
      push("error", normalizeApiError(err).detail ?? "Sync trigger failed"),
  });
}
```

## A.6 `src/features/admin/AdminHomePage.tsx`

```tsx
import { useNavigate } from "react-router-dom";
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";
import {
  Users,
  Plug,
  ShieldCheck,
  Activity,
  Database,
  Server,
} from "lucide-react";
import { useSystemHealth, useIntegrations } from "./admin.queries";
import { Card, CardHeader } from "@/components/ui/Card";
import { KPITile } from "@/components/ui/KPITile";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/Button";
import { Chip } from "@/components/ui/Chip";
import { Progress } from "@/components/ui/Progress";
import { LoadingState } from "@/components/ui/LoadingState";

export default function AdminHomePage() {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const { data: health, isLoading: healthLoading } = useSystemHealth();
  const { data: integrations } = useIntegrations();

  if (healthLoading || !health)
    return <LoadingState message="Loading system health…" />;

  const statusTone = (s: "HEALTHY" | "DEGRADED" | "DOWN") =>
    s === "HEALTHY" ? "green" : s === "DEGRADED" ? "amber" : "red";

  const healthyCount = (integrations ?? []).filter(
    (i) => i.status === "HEALTHY",
  ).length;
  const degradedCount = (integrations ?? []).filter(
    (i) => i.status === "DEGRADED",
  ).length;
  const downCount = (integrations ?? []).filter(
    (i) => i.status === "DOWN",
  ).length;

  return (
    <main id="main" tabIndex={-1} className="space-y-5">
      <header className="flex flex-wrap items-start justify-between gap-3">
        <div>
          <h1 className="text-h1 text-primary-900">{t("admin.title")}</h1>
          <p className="text-body-sm text-neutral-600 mt-1">
            {t("admin.subtitle")}
          </p>
        </div>
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
          <Button
            variant="secondary"
            size="sm"
            leftIcon={<Users className="h-4 w-4" />}
            onClick={() => navigate("/admin/users")}
          >
            {t("admin.manageUsers")}
          </Button>
          <Button
            variant="secondary"
            size="sm"
            leftIcon={<Plug className="h-4 w-4" />}
            onClick={() => navigate("/admin/integrations")}
          >
            {t("admin.manageIntegrations")}
          </Button>
        </div>
      </header>

      <div className="grid grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-4 gap-3">
        <KPITile
          label="API uptime (30d)"
          value={`${health.api.uptime30d.toFixed(2)}%`}
          tone={health.api.uptime30d >= 99.5 ? "success" : "warning"}
        />
        <KPITile
          label="Active users (24h)"
          value={health.activeUsers24h.toLocaleString()}
          tone="accent"
        />
        <KPITile
          label="API calls (24h)"
          value={health.apiCalls24h.toLocaleString()}
        />
        <KPITile
          label="Integrations healthy"
          value={`${healthyCount}/${integrations?.length ?? 0}`}
          tone={
            downCount > 0 ? "danger" : degradedCount > 0 ? "warning" : "success"
          }
        />
      </div>

      <div className="grid md:grid-cols-3 gap-4">
        <Card>
          <CardHeader
            title={
              <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-2">
                <Server className="h-4 w-4" aria-hidden /> API
              </span>
            }
          />
          <div className="space-y-2">
            <div className="flex justify-between text-body-sm">
              <span className="text-neutral-600">Status</span>
              <Chip tone={statusTone(health.api.status)}>
                {health.api.status}
              </Chip>
            </div>
            <div className="flex justify-between text-body-sm">
              <span className="text-neutral-600">p95 latency</span>
              <span className="font-semibold">
                {health.api.p95LatencyMs} ms
              </span>
            </div>
          </div>
        </Card>

        <Card>
          <CardHeader
            title={
              <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-2">
                <Database className="h-4 w-4" aria-hidden /> Database
              </span>
            }
          />
          <div className="space-y-2">
            <div className="flex justify-between text-body-sm">
              <span className="text-neutral-600">Status</span>
              <Chip tone={statusTone(health.database.status)}>
                {health.database.status}
              </Chip>
            </div>
            <div className="text-body-sm">
              <div className="flex justify-between mb-1">
                <span className="text-neutral-600">Connections</span>
                <span className="font-semibold">
                  {health.database.connections}/{health.database.maxConnections}
                </span>
              </div>
              <Progress
                value={
                  (health.database.connections /
                    health.database.maxConnections) *
                  100
                }
                tone={
                  health.database.connections / health.database.maxConnections >
                  0.8
                    ? "danger"
                    : "success"
                }
              />
            </div>
          </div>
        </Card>

        <Card>
          <CardHeader
            title={
              <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-2">
                <Activity className="h-4 w-4" aria-hidden /> Storage & Queue
              </span>
            }
          />
          <div className="space-y-2 text-body-sm">
            <div>
              <div className="flex justify-between mb-1">
                <span className="text-neutral-600">Storage</span>
                <span className="font-semibold">
                  {health.storage.usedGb} / {health.storage.totalGb} GB
                </span>
              </div>
              <Progress
                value={(health.storage.usedGb / health.storage.totalGb) * 100}
                tone={

                    : "primary"

        <CardHeader
          title={
            <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-2">
              <Plug className="h-4 w-4" aria-hidden /> Integrations
            </span>
          }
          action={
            <Button
              size="sm"
              variant="ghost"
              onClick={() => navigate("/admin/integrations")}
            >
              Manage →
            </Button>
          }
        />
        <div className="grid sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-2">
          {(integrations ?? []).map((int) => (
            <div
              key={int.code}
              className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 p-2 border border-neutral-200 rounded-md"
            >
              <div className="min-w-0">
                <div className="text-body-sm font-semibold">{int.code}</div>
                <div className="text-caption text-neutral-600 truncate">
                  {int.name}
                </div>
              </div>
              <Chip tone={statusTone(int.status)}>{int.status}</Chip>
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
      </Card>

      <Card>
        <CardHeader
          title={
            <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-2">
              <ShieldCheck className="h-4 w-4" aria-hidden /> Governance
            </span>
          }
        />
        <div className="grid sm:grid-cols-2 gap-2">
          <Button
            variant="secondary"
            fullWidth
            onClick={() => navigate("/audit")}

          <Button
            variant="secondary"
            fullWidth
            onClick={() => navigate("/admin/users")}
          >
            {t("admin.manageUsers")}
          </Button>
        </div>
      </Card>
    </main>
  );
```

## A.7 `src/features/admin/AdminUsersPage.tsx`

```tsx
import { useMemo, useState } from "react";
import { useSearchParams } from "react-router-dom";
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";
import { Plus, Search, KeyRound, Power, UserCheck } from "lucide-react";
import { useAdminUsers } from "./admin.queries";
import { usePermissions } from "@/features/auth/usePermissions";
import { PERMISSIONS } from "@/features/auth/auth.types";
import { DataGrid, type Column } from "@/components/ui/DataGrid";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/Button";
import { Chip } from "@/components/ui/Chip";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/Input";
import { Pagination } from "@/components/ui/Pagination";
import { Drawer } from "@/components/ui/Drawer";
import { Card, CardHeader } from "@/components/ui/Card";
import { EmptyState } from "@/components/ui/EmptyState";
import { ErrorState } from "@/components/ui/ErrorState";
import { SkeletonTable } from "@/components/ui/Skeleton";
import { useToast } from "@/components/ui/Toast";
import { UserFormModal } from "./UserFormModal";
import {
  useResetPassword,
  useDeactivateUser,
  useReactivateUser,
} from "./admin.mutations";
import { formatDate } from "@/lib/utils/date";
import type { AdminUser, UserStatus } from "./admin.types";

const STATUS_TONE: Record<UserStatus, any> = {
  ACTIVE: "green",
  INACTIVE: "grey",
  LOCKED: "amber",
  SUSPENDED: "red",
};

export default function AdminUsersPage() {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const { can } = usePermissions();
  const { push } = useToast();
  const [params, setParams] = useSearchParams();
  const [formOpen, setFormOpen] = useState(false);
  const [editing, setEditing] = useState<AdminUser | null>(null);
  const [detail, setDetail] = useState<AdminUser | null>(null);

  const q = params.get("q") ?? "";
  const status = (params.get("status")?.split(",").filter(Boolean) ??
    []) as UserStatus[];
  const pageSize = Math.min(200, Math.max(1, Number(params.get("size") ?? 25)));
  const page = Math.max(1, Number(params.get("page") ?? 1));

  const { data, isLoading, isError, refetch } = useAdminUsers({
    q: q || undefined,
    status: status.length ? status : undefined,
    limit: pageSize,
  });

  const resetPw = useResetPassword();
  const deactivate = useDeactivateUser();
  const reactivate = useReactivateUser();

  const columns: Column<AdminUser & { id: string }>[] = useMemo(
    () => [
      {
        id: "username",
        header: "Username",
        render: (r) => (
          <code className="text-caption font-bold text-primary-700">
            {r.username}
          </code>
        ),
      },
      {
        id: "fullName",
        header: "Name",
        render: (r) => (
          <div className="min-w-0">
            <div className="text-body-sm font-semibold truncate">
              {r.fullName}
            </div>
            <div className="text-caption text-neutral-600 truncate">
              {r.email}
            </div>
          </div>
        ),
      },
      {
        id: "orgName",
        header: "Organization",
        render: (r) => <span className="text-caption">{r.orgName}</span>,
      },
      {
        id: "roleName",
        header: "Role",
        render: (r) => <Chip tone="blue">{r.role}</Chip>,
      },
      {
        id: "mfaEnabled",
        header: "MFA",
        align: "center",
        render: (r) =>
          r.mfaEnabled ? (
            <Chip tone="green">On</Chip>
          ) : (
            <Chip tone="grey">Off</Chip>
          ),
      },
      {
        id: "status",
        header: "Status",
        render: (r) => <Chip tone={STATUS_TONE[r.status]}>{r.status}</Chip>,
      },
      {
        id: "lastLoginAt",
        header: "Last login",
        render: (r) => (
          <span className="text-caption">
            {r.lastLoginAt ? formatDate(r.lastLoginAt) : "—"}
          </span>
        ),
      },
    ],
    [],
  );

  const updateParams = (patch: Record<string, string | undefined>) => {
    const next = new URLSearchParams(params);
    Object.entries(patch).forEach(([k, v]) => {
      if (v == null || v === "") next.delete(k);
      else next.set(k, v);
    });
    if (!("page" in patch)) next.set("page", "1");
    setParams(next, { replace: true });
  };

  const onResetPassword = async (userId: string) => {
    if (
      !confirm(
        "Reset this user's password? They will receive a temporary password.",
      )
    )
      return;
    await resetPw.mutateAsync(userId);
  };

  const onDeactivate = async (userId: string) => {
    const reason = prompt("Reason for deactivation?");
    if (!reason) return;
    await deactivate.mutateAsync({ userId, reason });
    setDetail(null);
  };

  const onReactivate = async (userId: string) => {
    await reactivate.mutateAsync(userId);
    push("success", "User reactivated");
    setDetail(null);
  };

  return (
    <main id="main" tabIndex={-1} className="space-y-5">
      <header className="flex flex-wrap items-start justify-between gap-3">
        <div>
          <h1 className="text-h1 text-primary-900">{t("admin.users.title")}</h1>
          <p className="text-body-sm text-neutral-600 mt-1">
            {data?.pagination?.totalCount ?? 0} {t("admin.users.total")}
          </p>
        </div>
        {can(PERMISSIONS.adminUsers) && (
          <Button
            variant="primary"
            size="sm"
            leftIcon={<Plus className="h-4 w-4" />}
            onClick={() => {
              setEditing(null);
              setFormOpen(true);
            }}
          >
            {t("admin.users.new")}
          </Button>
        )}
      </header>

      <section className="bg-white border border-neutral-300 rounded-md p-3">
        <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-3 items-end">
          <div className="flex-1 min-w-[240px]">
            <Input
              label="Search"
              placeholder="Search by name, username, or email"
              value={q}
              onChange={(e) => updateParams({ q: e.target.value || undefined })}
              leftIcon={<Search className="h-4 w-4" />}
            />
          </div>
          <div className="flex gap-2 flex-wrap">
            {(
              ["ACTIVE", "INACTIVE", "LOCKED", "SUSPENDED"] as UserStatus[]
            ).map((s) => {
              const active = status.includes(s);
              return (
                <button
                  key={s}
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => {
                    const next = status.includes(s)
                      ? status.filter((x) => x !== s)
                      : [...status, s];
                    updateParams({
                      status: next.length ? next.join(",") : undefined,
                    });
                  }}
                  aria-pressed={active}
                >
                  <Chip tone={active ? STATUS_TONE[s] : "grey"}>{s}</Chip>
                </button>
              );
            })}
          </div>
        </div>
      </section>

      {isLoading && <SkeletonTable rows={8} cols={columns.length} />}
      {isError && !isLoading && <ErrorState onRetry={() => refetch()} />}
      {!isLoading && !isError && !data?.data.length && (
        <EmptyState
          title={t("admin.users.empty")}
          description="Create the first user to begin."
        />
      )}
      {!isLoading && !isError && !!data?.data.length && (
        <>
          <DataGrid
            columns={columns}
            rows={data.data.map((u) => ({ ...u, id: u.userId }))}
            onRowClick={setDetail}
            ariaLabel={t("admin.users.title")}
          />
          <Pagination
            page={page}
            pageSize={pageSize}
            total={data.pagination?.totalCount ?? 0}
            onPageChange={(p) => updateParams({ page: String(p) })}
            onPageSizeChange={(s) =>
              updateParams({ size: String(s), page: "1" })
            }
          />
        </>
      )}

      <UserFormModal
        open={formOpen}
        onClose={() => {
          setFormOpen(false);
          setEditing(null);
        }}
        user={editing ?? undefined}
      />

      <Drawer
        open={!!detail}
        onClose={() => setDetail(null)}
        title={detail?.fullName ?? ""}
        width="max-w-md"
      >
        {detail && (
          <div className="space-y-4">
            <Card>
              <CardHeader title="Details" />
              <dl className="text-body-sm space-y-2">
                <Row label="Username" value={detail.username} />
                <Row label="Email" value={detail.email} />
                <Row label="Organization" value={detail.orgName} />
                <Row label="Role" value={detail.roleName} />
                <Row label="Status" value={detail.status} />
                <Row
                  label="MFA"
                  value={detail.mfaEnabled ? "Enabled" : "Disabled"}
                />
                <Row
                  label="Last login"
                  value={
                    detail.lastLoginAt ? formatDate(detail.lastLoginAt) : "—"
                  }
                />
                <Row label="Created" value={formatDate(detail.createdAt)} />
              </dl>
            </Card>

            {can(PERMISSIONS.adminUsers) && (
              <div className="space-y-2">
                <Button
                  variant="secondary"
                  fullWidth
                  leftIcon={<KeyRound className="h-4 w-4" />}
                  loading={resetPw.isPending}
                  onClick={() => onResetPassword(detail.userId)}
                >
                  Reset password
                </Button>
                <Button
                  variant="secondary"
                  fullWidth
                  onClick={() => {
                    setEditing(detail);
                    setFormOpen(true);
                    setDetail(null);
                  }}
                >
                  Edit user
                </Button>
                {detail.status === "ACTIVE" ? (
                  <Button
                    variant="danger"
                    fullWidth
                    leftIcon={<Power className="h-4 w-4" />}
                    loading={deactivate.isPending}
                    onClick={() => onDeactivate(detail.userId)}
                  >
                    Deactivate
                  </Button>
                ) : (
                  <Button
                    variant="primary"
                    fullWidth
                    leftIcon={<UserCheck className="h-4 w-4" />}
                    loading={reactivate.isPending}
                    onClick={() => onReactivate(detail.userId)}
                  >
                    Reactivate
                  </Button>
                )}
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        )}
      </Drawer>
    </main>
  );
}

function Row({ label, value }: { label: string; value: string }) {
  return (
    <div className="flex justify-between gap-3">
      <dt className="text-neutral-600">{label}</dt>
      <dd className="font-semibold text-neutral-900 text-right truncate">
        {value || "—"}
      </dd>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## A.8 `src/features/admin/UserFormModal.tsx`

```tsx
import { useEffect } from "react";
import { useForm } from "react-hook-form";
import { zodResolver } from "@hookform/resolvers/zod";
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";
import { Modal } from "@/components/ui/Modal";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/Button";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/Input";
import { Select } from "@/components/ui/Select";
import { Checkbox } from "@/components/ui/Checkbox";
import {
  createUserSchema,
  updateUserSchema,
  type CreateUserFormData,
  type UpdateUserFormData,
} from "./admin.schema";
import { useCreateUser, useUpdateUser } from "./admin.mutations";
import { ROLE_CODES, roleLabel } from "@/features/auth/auth.types";
import type { AdminUser } from "./admin.types";

const ORGS = [
  {
    value: "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111",
    label: "Ministry of Water and Energy",
  },
  {
    value: "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222",
    label: "Ministry of Finance",
  },
  {
    value: "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333",
    label: "Development Bank of Ethiopia",
  },
  { value: "44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444", label: "World Bank" },
];

export function UserFormModal({
  open,
  onClose,
  user,
}: {
  open: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  user?: AdminUser;
}) {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const create = useCreateUser();
  const update = useUpdateUser();
  const isEdit = !!user;

  const createForm = useForm<CreateUserFormData>({
    resolver: zodResolver(createUserSchema),
    defaultValues: {
      username: "",
      email: "",
      fullName: "",
      fullNameAm: "",
      phone: "",
      orgId: ORGS[0]!.value,
      role: "MW-PIU",
      mfaEnabled: false,
      sendInvite: true,
    },
  });

  const editForm = useForm<UpdateUserFormData>({
    resolver: zodResolver(updateUserSchema),
    defaultValues: user
      ? {
          fullName: user.fullName,
          fullNameAm: user.fullNameAm ?? "",
          email: user.email,
          phone: user.phone ?? "",
          orgId: user.orgId,
          role: user.role,
          status: user.status,
          mfaEnabled: user.mfaEnabled,
        }
      : {},
  });

  useEffect(() => {
    if (user) {
      editForm.reset({
        fullName: user.fullName,
        fullNameAm: user.fullNameAm ?? "",
        email: user.email,
        phone: user.phone ?? "",
        orgId: user.orgId,
        role: user.role,
        status: user.status,
        mfaEnabled: user.mfaEnabled,
      });
    } else {
      createForm.reset();
    }
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [user, open]);

  const onSubmitCreate = async (v: CreateUserFormData) => {
    await create.mutateAsync(v);
    createForm.reset();
    onClose();
  };

  const onSubmitUpdate = async (v: UpdateUserFormData) => {
    if (!user) return;
    await update.mutateAsync({ userId: user.userId, patch: v });
    onClose();
  };

  return (
    <Modal
      open={open}
      onClose={onClose}
      title={isEdit ? t("admin.users.edit") : t("admin.users.new")}
      size="md"
      footer={
        <>
          <Button variant="ghost" onClick={onClose}>
            {t("actions.cancel")}
          </Button>
          <Button
            variant="primary"
            loading={create.isPending || update.isPending}
            onClick={
              isEdit
                ? editForm.handleSubmit(onSubmitUpdate)
                : createForm.handleSubmit(onSubmitCreate)
            }
          >
            {t("actions.save")}
          </Button>
        </>
      }
    >
      {isEdit ? (
        <form
          onSubmit={editForm.handleSubmit(onSubmitUpdate)}
          className="space-y-4"
          noValidate
        >
          <Input
            {...editForm.register("fullName")}
            label="Full name"
            required
            error={editForm.formState.errors.fullName?.message}
          />
          <Input
            {...editForm.register("fullNameAm")}
            label="Full name (Amharic)"
          />
          <Input
            {...editForm.register("email")}
            type="email"
            label="Email"
            required
            error={editForm.formState.errors.email?.message}
          />
          <Input
            {...editForm.register("phone")}
            label="Phone"
            placeholder="+251911234567"
          />
          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4">
            <Select
              {...editForm.register("orgId")}
              label="Organization"
              required
              options={ORGS}
            />
            <Select
              {...editForm.register("role")}
              label="Role"
              required
              options={ROLE_CODES.map((r) => ({
                value: r,
                label: `${r} · ${roleLabel(r)}`,
              }))}
            />
          </div>
          <Select
            {...editForm.register("status")}
            label="Status"
            required
            options={[
              { value: "ACTIVE", label: "Active" },
              { value: "INACTIVE", label: "Inactive" },
              { value: "LOCKED", label: "Locked" },
              { value: "SUSPENDED", label: "Suspended" },
            ]}
          />
          <Checkbox {...editForm.register("mfaEnabled")} label="Require MFA" />
        </form>
      ) : (
        <form
          onSubmit={createForm.handleSubmit(onSubmitCreate)}
          className="space-y-4"
          noValidate
        >
          <Input
            {...createForm.register("username")}
            label="Username"
            required
            error={createForm.formState.errors.username?.message}
          />
          <Input
            {...createForm.register("email")}
            type="email"
            label="Email"
            required
            error={createForm.formState.errors.email?.message}
          />
          <Input
            {...createForm.register("fullName")}
            label="Full name"
            required
            error={createForm.formState.errors.fullName?.message}
          />
          <Input
            {...createForm.register("fullNameAm")}
            label="Full name (Amharic)"
          />
          <Input
            {...createForm.register("phone")}
            label="Phone"
            placeholder="+251911234567"
            error={createForm.formState.errors.phone?.message}
          />
          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4">
            <Select
              {...createForm.register("orgId")}
              label="Organization"
              required
              options={ORGS}
            />
            <Select
              {...createForm.register("role")}
              label="Role"
              required
              options={ROLE_CODES.map((r) => ({
                value: r,
                label: `${r} · ${roleLabel(r)}`,
              }))}
            />
          </div>
          <Checkbox
            {...createForm.register("mfaEnabled")}
            label="Require MFA"
          />
          <Checkbox
            {...createForm.register("sendInvite")}
            label="Send invitation email with temporary password"
          />
        </form>
      )}
    </Modal>
  );
}
```

## A.9 `src/features/admin/AdminIntegrationsPage.tsx`

```tsx
import { useState } from "react";
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";
import { RefreshCw } from "lucide-react";
import { useIntegrations, useIntegrationRuns } from "./admin.queries";
import { useTriggerIntegrationSync } from "./admin.mutations";
import { Card, CardHeader } from "@/components/ui/Card";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/Button";
import { Chip } from "@/components/ui/Chip";
import { LoadingState } from "@/components/ui/LoadingState";
import { formatDate } from "@/lib/utils/date";
import type { IntegrationCode } from "./admin.types";

const STATUS_TONE = {
  HEALTHY: "green",
  DEGRADED: "amber",
  DOWN: "red",
} as const;

export default function AdminIntegrationsPage() {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const { data: integrations, isLoading } = useIntegrations();
  const [selected, setSelected] = useState<IntegrationCode | undefined>(
    integrations?.[0]?.code,
  );
  const { data: runs } = useIntegrationRuns(selected);
  const trigger = useTriggerIntegrationSync();

  if (isLoading) return <LoadingState />;

  return (
    <main id="main" tabIndex={-1} className="space-y-5">
      <header>
        <h1 className="text-h1 text-primary-900">
          {t("admin.integrations.title")}
        </h1>
        <p className="text-body-sm text-neutral-600 mt-1">
          {t("admin.integrations.subtitle")}
        </p>
      </header>

      <div className="grid md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-3">
        {(integrations ?? []).map((int) => (
          <Card
            key={int.code}
            hoverable
            onClick={() => setSelected(int.code)}
            className={selected === int.code ? "ring-2 ring-primary-700" : ""}
          >
            <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-2 mb-2">
              <div className="min-w-0">
                <div className="text-body-sm font-bold text-primary-900">
                  {int.code}
                </div>
                <div className="text-caption text-neutral-600 truncate">
                  {int.name}
                </div>
              </div>
              <Chip tone={STATUS_TONE[int.status]}>{int.status}</Chip>
            </div>
            <div className="text-caption text-neutral-600 space-y-0.5">
              {int.lastSync && <div>Last sync: {formatDate(int.lastSync)}</div>}
              <div>{int.recordsProcessed24h.toLocaleString()} records/24h</div>
              {int.errorCount24h > 0 && (
                <div className="text-danger font-semibold">
                  {int.errorCount24h} errors/24h
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
            <div className="mt-3">
              <Button
                size="sm"
                variant="secondary"
                fullWidth
                leftIcon={<RefreshCw className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />}
                loading={trigger.isPending}
                onClick={(e) => {
                  e.stopPropagation();
                  trigger.mutate(int.code);
                }}
              >
                Sync now
              </Button>
            </div>
          </Card>
        ))}
      </div>

      {selected && (
        <Card>
          <CardHeader title={`${selected} · Recent sync runs`} />
          {!runs?.length ? (
            <p className="text-body-sm text-neutral-600">
              No sync runs recorded.
            </p>
          ) : (
            <table className="w-full text-body-sm">
              <thead>
                <tr className="border-b border-neutral-300 text-left">
                  <th className="py-2 text-caption uppercase text-neutral-600">
                    Started
                  </th>
                  <th className="py-2 text-caption uppercase text-neutral-600">
                    Kind
                  </th>
                  <th className="py-2 text-right text-caption uppercase text-neutral-600">
                    Duration
                  </th>
                  <th className="py-2 text-right text-caption uppercase text-neutral-600">
                    Records
                  </th>
                  <th className="py-2 text-right text-caption uppercase text-neutral-600">
                    Errors
                  </th>
                  <th className="py-2 text-caption uppercase text-neutral-600">
                    Status
                  </th>
                </tr>
              </thead>
              <tbody>
                {runs.map((r) => (
                  <tr key={r.runId} className="border-b border-neutral-100">
                    <td className="py-2 text-caption">
                      {new Date(r.startedAt).toLocaleString()}
                    </td>
                    <td className="py-2">{r.kind}</td>
                    <td className="py-2 text-right">
                      {r.durationMs
                        ? `${(r.durationMs / 1000).toFixed(1)} s`
                        : "—"}
                    </td>
                    <td className="py-2 text-right">{r.recordsProcessed}</td>
                    <td className="py-2 text-right">{r.recordsFailed}</td>
                    <td className="py-2">
                      <Chip
                        tone={
                          r.status === "SUCCESS"
                            ? "green"
                            : r.status === "FAILED"
                              ? "red"
                              : r.status === "PARTIAL"
                                ? "amber"
                                : "blue"
                        }
                      >
                        {r.status}
                      </Chip>
                    </td>
                  </tr>
                ))}
              </tbody>
            </table>
          )}
        </Card>
      )}
    </main>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import { useState } from "react";
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";
import { Search, Download } from "lucide-react";
import { useAuditLog } from "./admin.queries";
import { DataGrid, type Column } from "@/components/ui/DataGrid";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/Input";
import { Select } from "@/components/ui/Select";
import { DateInput } from "@/components/ui/DateInput";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/Button";
import { Chip } from "@/components/ui/Chip";
import { Pagination } from "@/components/ui/Pagination";
import { Drawer } from "@/components/ui/Drawer";
import { Card, CardHeader } from "@/components/ui/Card";
import { EmptyState } from "@/components/ui/EmptyState";
import { SkeletonTable } from "@/components/ui/Skeleton";
import { formatDate } from "@/lib/utils/date";
import type { AuditLogEntry } from "./admin.types";

const ACTIONS = [
  "CREATE",
  "UPDATE",
  "DELETE",
  "LOGIN",
  "LOGOUT",
  "APPROVE",
  "REJECT",
  "EXPORT",
  "DOWNLOAD",
];

const ACTION_TONE: Record<string, any> = {
  CREATE: "green",
  UPDATE: "blue",
  DELETE: "red",
  LOGIN: "grey",
  LOGOUT: "grey",
  APPROVE: "teal",
  REJECT: "red",
  EXPORT: "amber",
  DOWNLOAD: "amber",
};

export default function AuditPage() {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const [selected, setSelected] = useState<AuditLogEntry | null>(null);
  const [filters, setFilters] = useState({
    q: "",
    entity: "",
    action: "",
    from: "",
    to: "",
  });

  const { data, isLoading } = useAuditLog({
    q: filters.q || undefined,
    entity: filters.entity || undefined,
    action: filters.action || undefined,
    from: filters.from || undefined,
    to: filters.to || undefined,
    limit: 50,
  });

  const columns: Column<AuditLogEntry & { id: string }>[] = [
    {
      id: "createdAt",
      header: "Timestamp",
      render: (r) => (
        <span className="text-caption whitespace-nowrap">
          {new Date(r.createdAt).toLocaleString()}
        </span>
      ),
    },
    {
      id: "userName",
      header: "User",
      render: (r) => (
        <span className="text-body-sm font-semibold">{r.userName ?? "—"}</span>
      ),
    },
    {
      id: "action",
      header: "Action",
      render: (r) => (
        <Chip tone={ACTION_TONE[r.action] ?? "grey"}>{r.action}</Chip>
      ),
    },
    {
      id: "entity",
      header: "Entity",
      render: (r) => <code className="text-caption">{r.entity}</code>,
    },
    {
      id: "entityId",
      header: "Record",
      render: (r) => (
        <code className="text-caption">{r.entityId?.slice(0, 8) ?? "—"}</code>
      ),
    },
    {
      id: "ipAddress",
      header: "IP",
      render: (r) => (
        <span className="text-caption font-mono">{r.ipAddress ?? "—"}</span>
      ),
    },
  ];

  const exportCsv = () => {
    const rows = data?.data ?? [];
    const csv = ["Timestamp,User,Action,Entity,Record,IP"]
      .concat(
        rows.map(
          (r) =>
            `${r.createdAt},${r.userName ?? ""},${r.action},${r.entity},${r.entityId ?? ""},${r.ipAddress ?? ""}`,
        ),
      )
      .join("\n");
    const blob = new Blob([csv], { type: "text/csv;charset=utf-8" });
    const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    const a = document.createElement("a");
    a.href = url;
    a.download = `audit-${new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10)}.csv`;
    a.click();
    URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
  };

  return (
    <main id="main" tabIndex={-1} className="space-y-5">
      <header className="flex flex-wrap items-start justify-between gap-3">
        <div>
          <h1 className="text-h1 text-primary-900">{t("admin.audit.title")}</h1>
          <p className="text-body-sm text-neutral-600 mt-1">
            {data?.pagination?.totalCount ?? 0} {t("admin.audit.entries")}
          </p>
        </div>
        <Button
          variant="secondary"
          size="sm"
          leftIcon={<Download className="h-4 w-4" />}
          onClick={exportCsv}
        >
          {t("admin.audit.export")}
        </Button>
      </header>

      <section className="bg-white border border-neutral-300 rounded-md p-4">
        <div className="grid md:grid-cols-5 gap-3">
          <div className="md:col-span-2">
            <Input
              label="Search"
              placeholder="Search by user, entity, record ID…"
              value={filters.q}
              onChange={(e) => setFilters({ ...filters, q: e.target.value })}
              leftIcon={<Search className="h-4 w-4" />}
            />
          </div>
          <Input
            label="Entity"
            value={filters.entity}
            onChange={(e) => setFilters({ ...filters, entity: e.target.value })}
            placeholder="PROJECT, BUDGET, USER…"
          />
          <Select
            label="Action"
            placeholder="All actions"
            value={filters.action}
            onChange={(e) => setFilters({ ...filters, action: e.target.value })}
            options={ACTIONS.map((a) => ({ value: a, label: a }))}
          />
          <div className="flex gap-2">
            <DateInput
              label="From"
              value={filters.from}
              onChange={(e) => setFilters({ ...filters, from: e.target.value })}
            />
            <DateInput
              label="To"
              value={filters.to}
              onChange={(e) => setFilters({ ...filters, to: e.target.value })}
            />
          </div>
        </div>
      </section>

      {isLoading && <SkeletonTable rows={10} cols={columns.length} />}
      {!isLoading && !data?.data.length && (
        <EmptyState
          title="No audit entries"
          description="Adjust filters to see other entries."
        />
      )}
      {!isLoading && !!data?.data.length && (
        <>
          <DataGrid
            columns={columns}
            rows={data.data.map((r) => ({ ...r, id: String(r.logId) }))}
            onRowClick={setSelected}
            ariaLabel={t("admin.audit.title")}
          />
          <Pagination
            page={1}
            pageSize={50}
            total={data.pagination?.totalCount ?? 0}
            onPageChange={() => {}}
          />
        </>
      )}

      <Drawer
        open={!!selected}
        onClose={() => setSelected(null)}
        title="Audit detail"
        width="max-w-xl"
      >
        {selected && (
          <div className="space-y-4">
            <Card>
              <CardHeader title="Summary" />
              <dl className="text-body-sm space-y-2">
                <Row
                  label="Timestamp"
                  value={new Date(selected.createdAt).toLocaleString()}
                />
                <Row label="User" value={selected.userName ?? "—"} />
                <Row label="Action" value={selected.action} />
                <Row label="Entity" value={selected.entity} />
                <Row label="Entity ID" value={selected.entityId ?? "—"} />
                <Row label="IP address" value={selected.ipAddress ?? "—"} />
                <Row label="User agent" value={selected.userAgent ?? "—"} />
                <Row
                  label="Record hash"
                  value={selected.recordHash.slice(0, 16) + "…"}
                />
              </dl>
            </Card>

            {selected.oldValue && (
              <Card>
                <CardHeader title="Before" />
                <pre className="text-caption bg-neutral-100 rounded p-3 overflow-x-auto">
                  {JSON.stringify(selected.oldValue, null, 2)}
                </pre>
              </Card>
            )}

            {selected.newValue && (
              <Card>
                <CardHeader title="After" />
                <pre className="text-caption bg-neutral-100 rounded p-3 overflow-x-auto">
                  {JSON.stringify(selected.newValue, null, 2)}
                </pre>
              </Card>
            )}
          </div>
        )}
      </Drawer>
    </main>
  );
}

function Row({ label, value }: { label: string; value: string }) {
  return (
    <div className="flex justify-between gap-3">
      <dt className="text-neutral-600">{label}</dt>
      <dd className="font-semibold text-neutral-900 text-right truncate">
        {value}
      </dd>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```ts
export const REPORT_TYPES = [
  "PPMR",
  "ISR",
  "FINANCIAL",
  "PROCUREMENT",
  "BENEFICIARY",
  "GRIEVANCE",
  "IMPACT",
  "INCEPTION",
  "AD_HOC",
] as const;
export type ReportType = (typeof REPORT_TYPES)[number];

export interface ReportDefinition {
  code: ReportType;
  name: string;
  description: string;
  frequency: "MONTHLY" | "QUARTERLY" | "SEMI_ANNUAL" | "ANNUAL" | "ON_DEMAND";
  requiredParams: string[];
  formats: ("PDF" | "EXCEL" | "CSV")[];
}

export interface ReportInstance {
  instanceId: string;
  reportCode: ReportType;
  projectId?: string;
  projectCode?: string;
  period?: string;
  format: "PDF" | "EXCEL" | "CSV";
  status: "QUEUED" | "GENERATING" | "READY" | "FAILED";
  filePath?: string;
  fileSize?: number;
  generatedAt?: string;
  generatedBy: string;
  error?: string;
}

export interface GenerateReportInput {
  reportCode: ReportType;
  projectId?: string;
  period?: string;
  fiscalYear?: number;
  format: "PDF" | "EXCEL" | "CSV";
  parameters?: Record<string, unknown>;
}

export interface ReportSchedule {
  scheduleId: string;
  reportCode: ReportType;
  cron: string;
  recipients: string[];
  format: "PDF" | "EXCEL" | "CSV";
  active: boolean;
  lastRunAt?: string;
  nextRunAt?: string;
}

export interface ScheduleInput {
  reportCode: ReportType;
  cron: string;
  recipients: string[];
  format: "PDF" | "EXCEL" | "CSV";
}
```

```ts
import { z } from "zod";
import { REPORT_TYPES } from "./report.types";

export const generateReportSchema = z.object({
  reportCode: z.enum(REPORT_TYPES),
  projectId: z.string().uuid().optional().or(z.literal("")),
  period: z.string().optional().or(z.literal("")),
  fiscalYear: z.number().int().min(2000).max(3000).optional(),
  format: z.enum(["PDF", "EXCEL", "CSV"]),
});
export type GenerateReportFormData = z.infer<typeof generateReportSchema>;

export const scheduleReportSchema = z.object({
  reportCode: z.enum(REPORT_TYPES),
  cron: z.string().min(5, "Enter a valid cron expression"),
  recipients: z.string().email("Enter a valid email"),
  format: z.enum(["PDF", "EXCEL", "CSV"]),
});
export type ScheduleReportFormData = z.infer<typeof scheduleReportSchema>;
```

## B.3 `src/features/reports/report.api.ts`

```ts
import { api } from "@/lib/api/client";
import type {
  ReportDefinition,
  ReportInstance,
  GenerateReportInput,
  ReportSchedule,
  ScheduleInput,
} from "./report.types";

interface Envelope<T> {
  data: T;
}

export const reportApi = {
  async catalogue(): Promise<ReportDefinition[]> {
    const { data } =
      await api.get<Envelope<ReportDefinition[]>>("/reports/catalogue");
    return data.data;
  },

  async generate(input: GenerateReportInput): Promise<ReportInstance> {
    const { data } = await api.post<Envelope<ReportInstance>>(
      "/reports/generate",
      input,
    );
    return data.data;
  },

  async getInstance(instanceId: string): Promise<ReportInstance> {
    const { data } = await api.get<Envelope<ReportInstance>>(
      `/reports/instances/${instanceId}`,
    );
    return data.data;
  },

  async instances(limit = 50): Promise<ReportInstance[]> {
    const { data } = await api.get<Envelope<ReportInstance[]>>(
      `/reports/instances?limit=${limit}`,
    );
    return data.data;
  },

  async download(instanceId: string): Promise<{ url: string }> {
    const { data } = await api.get<Envelope<{ url: string }>>(
      `/reports/instances/${instanceId}/download`,
    );
    return data.data;
  },

  async schedules(): Promise<ReportSchedule[]> {
    const { data } =
      await api.get<Envelope<ReportSchedule[]>>("/reports/schedules");
    return data.data;
  },

  async createSchedule(input: ScheduleInput): Promise<ReportSchedule> {
    const { data } = await api.post<Envelope<ReportSchedule>>(
      "/reports/schedules",
      input,
    );
    return data.data;
  },

  async deleteSchedule(scheduleId: string): Promise<void> {
    await api.delete(`/reports/schedules/${scheduleId}`);
  },

  async exportWB(
    period: string,
    projectIds?: string[],
  ): Promise<{ url: string }> {
    const { data } = await api.get<Envelope<{ url: string }>>(
      `/reports/export/wb?period=${encodeURIComponent(period)}${projectIds?.length ? "&project_ids=" + projectIds.join(",") : ""}`,
    );
    return data.data;
  },
};
```

## B.4 `src/features/reports/report.queries.ts`

```ts
import { useQuery } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { reportApi } from "./report.api";

export const reportKeys = {
  all: ["reports"] as const,
  catalogue: () => [...reportKeys.all, "catalogue"] as const,
  instances: () => [...reportKeys.all, "instances"] as const,
  instance: (id: string) => [...reportKeys.all, "instance", id] as const,
  schedules: () => [...reportKeys.all, "schedules"] as const,
};

export function useReportCatalogue() {
  return useQuery({
    queryKey: reportKeys.catalogue(),
    queryFn: () => reportApi.catalogue(),
    staleTime: 5 * 60_000,
  });
}

export function useReportInstances() {
  return useQuery({
    queryKey: reportKeys.instances(),
    queryFn: () => reportApi.instances(50),
    refetchInterval: (q) => {
      const data = q.state.data as any[] | undefined;
      const hasGenerating = data?.some(
        (r) => r.status === "GENERATING" || r.status === "QUEUED",
      );
      return hasGenerating ? 3000 : false;
    },
    staleTime: 10_000,
  });
}

export function useReportSchedules() {
  return useQuery({
    queryKey: reportKeys.schedules(),
    queryFn: () => reportApi.schedules(),
    staleTime: 60_000,
  });
}
```

## B.5 `src/features/reports/report.mutations.ts`

```ts
import { useMutation, useQueryClient } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { reportApi } from "./report.api";
import { reportKeys } from "./report.queries";
import { useToast } from "@/components/ui/Toast";
import { normalizeApiError } from "@/lib/api/errors";
import type { GenerateReportInput, ScheduleInput } from "./report.types";

export function useGenerateReport() {
  const qc = useQueryClient();
  const { push } = useToast();
  return useMutation({
    mutationFn: (input: GenerateReportInput) => reportApi.generate(input),
    onSuccess: (inst) => {
      qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: reportKeys.instances() });
      push("info", `Report ${inst.reportCode} queued for generation`);
    },
    onError: (err) =>
      push("error", normalizeApiError(err).detail ?? "Generation failed"),
  });
}

export function useCreateSchedule() {
  const qc = useQueryClient();
  const { push } = useToast();
  return useMutation({
    mutationFn: (input: ScheduleInput) => reportApi.createSchedule(input),
    onSuccess: () => {
      qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: reportKeys.schedules() });
      push("success", "Schedule created");
    },
    onError: (err) =>
      push(
        "error",
        normalizeApiError(err).detail ?? "Schedule creation failed",
      ),
  });
}

export function useDeleteSchedule() {
  const qc = useQueryClient();
  const { push } = useToast();
  return useMutation({
    mutationFn: (scheduleId: string) => reportApi.deleteSchedule(scheduleId),
    onSuccess: () => {
      qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: reportKeys.schedules() });
      push("success", "Schedule deleted");
    },
  });
}
```

```tsx
                          Recipients
                        </th>
                        <th className="py-2 text-caption uppercase text-neutral-600">
                          Last run
                        </th>
                        <th className="py-2 text-caption uppercase text-neutral-600">
                          Next run
                        </th>
                        <th className="py-2 text-caption uppercase text-neutral-600"></th>
                      </tr>
                    </thead>
                    <tbody>
                      {schedules.map((s) => (
                        <tr
                          key={s.scheduleId}
                          className="border-b border-neutral-100"
                        >
                          <td className="py-2 font-semibold">
                            <code className="text-caption text-primary-700">
                              {s.reportCode}
                            </code>
                          </td>
                          <td className="py-2">
                            <code className="text-caption">{s.cron}</code>
                          </td>
                          <td className="py-2 text-caption">
                            {s.recipients.join(", ")}
                          </td>
                          <td className="py-2 text-caption">
                            {s.lastRunAt ? formatDate(s.lastRunAt) : "—"}
                          </td>
                          <td className="py-2 text-caption">
                            {s.nextRunAt ? formatDate(s.nextRunAt) : "—"}
                          </td>
                          <td className="py-2 text-right">
                            <Button
                              size="sm"
                              variant="ghost"
                              onClick={async () => {
                                if (confirm("Delete this schedule?")) {
                                  await deleteSchedule.mutateAsync(
                                    s.scheduleId,
                                  );
                                  refetchSchedules();
                                }
                              }}
                            >
                              Delete
                            </Button>
                          </td>
                        </tr>
                      ))}
                    </tbody>
                  </table>
                )}
              </Card>
            ),
          },
        ]}
      />

      {generating && (
        <ReportGenerateModal
          open={!!generating}
          onClose={() => setGenerating(null)}
          reportCode={generating}
        />
      )}

      {scheduling && (
        <ScheduleModal
          open={!!scheduling}
          onClose={() => setScheduling(null)}
          reportCode={scheduling}
        />
      )}
    </main>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import { useForm } from "react-hook-form";
import { zodResolver } from "@hookform/resolvers/zod";
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";
import { Modal } from "@/components/ui/Modal";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/Button";
import { Select } from "@/components/ui/Select";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/Input";
import {
  generateReportSchema,
  type GenerateReportFormData,
} from "./report.schema";
import { useGenerateReport } from "./report.mutations";
import { useProjects } from "@/features/projects/project.queries";
import type { ReportType } from "./report.types";

export function ReportGenerateModal({
  open,
  onClose,
  reportCode,
}: {
  open: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  reportCode: ReportType;
}) {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const generate = useGenerateReport();
  const { data: projects } = useProjects({ limit: 200 });

  const {
    register,
    handleSubmit,
    formState: { errors },
    reset,
  } = useForm<GenerateReportFormData>({
    resolver: zodResolver(generateReportSchema),
    defaultValues: {
      reportCode,
      projectId: "",
      period: `Q${Math.ceil((new Date().getMonth() + 1) / 3)}-${new Date().getFullYear()}`,
      fiscalYear: new Date().getFullYear(),
      format: "PDF",
    },
  });

  const onSubmit = async (v: GenerateReportFormData) => {
    await generate.mutateAsync({
      reportCode: v.reportCode,
      projectId: v.projectId || undefined,
      period: v.period || undefined,
      fiscalYear: v.fiscalYear,
      format: v.format,
    });
    reset();
    onClose();
  };

  return (
    <Modal
      open={open}
      onClose={onClose}
      title={`Generate ${reportCode}`}
      size="md"
      footer={
        <>
          <Button variant="ghost" onClick={onClose}>
            {t("actions.cancel")}
          </Button>
          <Button
            variant="primary"
            loading={generate.isPending}
            onClick={handleSubmit(onSubmit)}
          >
            {t("reports.generate")}
          </Button>
        </>
      }
    >
      <form onSubmit={handleSubmit(onSubmit)} className="space-y-4" noValidate>
        <input type="hidden" {...register("reportCode")} />
        <Select
          {...register("projectId")}
          label="Project"
          placeholder="All projects (portfolio report)"
          options={(projects?.data ?? []).map((p) => ({
            value: p.projectId,
            label: `${p.projectCode} · ${p.name}`,
          }))}
        />
        <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4">
          <Input {...register("period")} label="Period" placeholder="Q3-2026" />
          <Input
            {...register("fiscalYear", { valueAsNumber: true })}
            type="number"
            label="Fiscal year"
          />
        </div>
        <Select
          {...register("format")}
          label="Format"
          required
          options={[
            { value: "PDF", label: "PDF" },
            { value: "EXCEL", label: "Excel (.xlsx)" },
            { value: "CSV", label: "CSV" },
          ]}
        />
        <p className="text-caption text-neutral-600">
          Generation typically takes 10–60 seconds. You'll be notified when
          ready.
        </p>
      </form>
    </Modal>
  );
}
```

# PART C — MONITORING

## C.1 `src/lib/monitoring/logger.ts`

```ts
/**
 * Structured logger. In production, forwards to backend endpoint and (optionally) Sentry.
 * In development, logs to console.
 */
type LogLevel = "debug" | "info" | "warn" | "error";

interface LogEntry {
  level: LogLevel;
  message: string;
  context?: Record<string, unknown>;
  timestamp: string;
  userId?: string;
  correlationId?: string;
}

const buffer: LogEntry[] = [];
let flushTimer: number | null = null;

function flush() {
  if (buffer.length === 0) return;
  const batch = buffer.splice(0, buffer.length);
  // In production, POST to /v1/logs
  if (import.meta.env.PROD) {
    fetch(`${import.meta.env.VITE_API_BASE_URL}/logs`, {
      method: "POST",
      headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
      body: JSON.stringify({ entries: batch }),
    }).catch(() => {
      // ignore — logging must never break the app
    });
  } else {
    // eslint-disable-next-line no-console
    batch.forEach((entry) =>
      console.log(`[${entry.level}]`, entry.message, entry.context ?? ""),
    );
  }
}

function schedule() {
  if (flushTimer) return;
  flushTimer = window.setTimeout(() => {
    flush();
    flushTimer = null;
  }, 2000);
}

function log(
  level: LogLevel,
  message: string,
  context?: Record<string, unknown>,
) {
  buffer.push({
    level,
    message,
    context,
    timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
  });
  schedule();
  if (level === "error") flush();
}

export const logger = {
  debug: (m: string, c?: Record<string, unknown>) => log("debug", m, c),
  info: (m: string, c?: Record<string, unknown>) => log("info", m, c),
  warn: (m: string, c?: Record<string, unknown>) => log("warn", m, c),
  error: (m: string, c?: Record<string, unknown>) => log("error", m, c),
};

/* Flush on page unload */
if (typeof window !== "undefined") {
  window.addEventListener("beforeunload", flush);
}
```

## C.2 `src/lib/monitoring/sentry.ts` (optional)

```ts
/**
 * Optional Sentry integration.
 * Install: npm i @sentry/react
 * Enable by setting VITE_SENTRY_DSN in .env
 */
export function initSentry(): void {
  const dsn = import.meta.env.VITE_SENTRY_DSN;
  if (!dsn || !import.meta.env.PROD) return;

  import("@sentry/react")
    .then((Sentry) => {
      Sentry.init({
        dsn,
        environment: import.meta.env.VITE_ENV,
        tracesSampleRate: 0.1,
        integrations: [Sentry.browserTracingIntegration()],
        ignoreErrors: [
          "ResizeObserver loop limit exceeded",
          "Non-Error promise rejection",
        ],
        beforeSend(event) {
          // Remove beneficiary PII from breadcrumbs
          if (event.breadcrumbs) {
            event.breadcrumbs = event.breadcrumbs.map((b) => {
              if (b.data?.url) {
                b.data.url = b.data.url.replace(
                  /\/beneficiaries\/[a-f0-9-]+/,
                  "/beneficiaries/[id]",
                );
              }
              return b;
            });
          }
          return event;
        },
      });
    })
    .catch(() => {
      /* Sentry is optional — fail silently */
    });
}
```

Call from `src/main.tsx`:

```tsx
import { initSentry } from "@/lib/monitoring/sentry";
initSentry();
```

```tsx
import { describe, it, expect, vi } from "vitest";
import { render, screen } from "@testing-library/react";
import userEvent from "@testing-library/user-event";
import { Modal } from "../Modal";

describe("Modal", () => {
  it("renders when open", () => {
    render(
      <Modal open onClose={() => {}} title="Test modal">
        <p>Body content</p>
      </Modal>,
    );
    expect(screen.getByRole("dialog")).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(screen.getByText("Test modal")).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(screen.getByText("Body content")).toBeInTheDocument();
  });

  it("does not render when closed", () => {
    render(
      <Modal open={false} onClose={() => {}} title="Test">
        <p>Hidden</p>
      </Modal>,
    );
    expect(screen.queryByRole("dialog")).not.toBeInTheDocument();
  });

  it("calls onClose when close button clicked", async () => {
    const onClose = vi.fn();
    render(
      <Modal open onClose={onClose} title="Test">
        <p>x</p>
      </Modal>,
    );
    await userEvent.click(screen.getByLabelText("Close"));
    expect(onClose).toHaveBeenCalledOnce();
  });

  it("closes on Escape", async () => {
    const onClose = vi.fn();
    render(
      <Modal open onClose={onClose} title="Test">
        <p>x</p>
      </Modal>,
    );
    await userEvent.keyboard("{Escape}");
    expect(onClose).toHaveBeenCalledOnce();
  });

  it("traps focus inside", async () => {
    render(
      <Modal
        open
        onClose={() => {}}
        title="Test"
        footer={
          <>
            <button>Cancel</button>
            <button>OK</button>
          </>
        }
      >
        <input aria-label="field" />
      </Modal>,
    );
    const buttons = screen.getAllByRole("button");
    const lastButton = buttons[buttons.length - 1]!;
    lastButton.focus();
    await userEvent.tab();
    // focus should wrap to close button (first focusable)
    expect(document.activeElement).toBe(screen.getByLabelText("Close"));
  });

  it("uses aria-modal and aria-labelledby", () => {
    render(
      <Modal open onClose={() => {}} title="Accessible">
        content
      </Modal>,
    );
    const dialog = screen.getByRole("dialog");
    expect(dialog).toHaveAttribute("aria-modal", "true");
    expect(dialog).toHaveAttribute("aria-labelledby", "modal-title");
  });
});
```

```ts
import { Page, expect } from "@playwright/test";

export const ROLES = {
  PIU: { username: "mowe.piu01", password: "demo1234" },
  WB: { username: "wb.ttl01", password: "demo1234" },
  IE: { username: "mowe.ie01", password: "demo1234" },
  DC: { username: "dc.en01", password: "demo1234" },
  QA: { username: "mowe.qa01", password: "demo1234" },
  ADMIN: { username: "mowe.admin", password: "demo1234" },
} as const;

export async function login(page: Page, role: keyof typeof ROLES) {
  await page.goto("/login");
  await page.getByLabel(/Username/i).fill(ROLES[role].username);
  await page.getByLabel(/Password/i).fill(ROLES[role].password);
  await page.getByRole("button", { name: /Sign in/i }).click();
  // Wait for dashboard or redirect
  await expect(page).not.toHaveURL(/\/login/);
}

export async function switchRole(page: Page, role: string) {
  const btn = page.locator("[data-role]").filter({ hasText: role });
  if (await btn.isVisible()) await btn.click();
}

export async function waitForToast(page: Page, text: RegExp) {
  await expect(page.getByText(text)).toBeVisible({ timeout: 5000 });
}
```

```ts
    await page.getByLabel(/Implementation arrangement/i).selectOption("PIU");

    await page.getByLabel(/Region/i).selectOption("Oromia");

      .getByLabel(/Amount/i)
```

```ts
import { test, expect } from "@playwright/test";
import { login } from "./helpers";

test.describe("Field interview (CAPI)", () => {
  test("completes an interview offline", async ({ page, context }) => {
    await login(page, "DC");
    await page.goto("/impact/field");

    // Start interview
    const startBtn = page
      .getByRole("button", { name: /Start interview/i })
      .first();
    if (await startBtn.isVisible()) {
      await startBtn.click();

      // Consent
      await page.getByLabel(/agrees to participate/i).check();
      await page.getByLabel(/agrees to data use/i).check();
      await page.getByRole("button", { name: /Begin interview/i }).click();

      // Go offline mid-interview
      await context.setOffline(true);

      // Answer first question
      const textInput = page.locator('textarea, input[type="text"]').first();
      if (await textInput.isVisible()) {
        await textInput.fill("Test answer");
      }
      await page.getByRole("button", { name: /Next/i }).click();

      // Verify offline indicator
      await expect(page.getByText(/Offline|offline/i).first()).toBeVisible();

      // Go online
      await context.setOffline(false);
      await page.waitForTimeout(2000);

      // Verify sync happens
      await expect(page.getByText(/synced|Online/i).first()).toBeVisible({
        timeout: 10_000,
      });
    }
  });

  test("persists consent state", async ({ page }) => {
    await login(page, "DC");
    await page.goto("/impact/field");
    // Consent checkboxes should be usable
    const startBtn = page
      .getByRole("button", { name: /Start interview/i })
      .first();
    if (await startBtn.isVisible()) {
      await startBtn.click();
      await expect(page.getByLabel(/agrees to participate/i)).toBeVisible();
    }
  });
});
```

```ts
  test("views portfolio dashboard", async ({ page }) => {
    await login(page, "WB");
    await expect(page.getByText(/Portfolio|Welcome/i)).toBeVisible();
  });

  test("reviews pending inception reports", async ({ page }) => {
    await login(page, "WB");
    await page.goto("/inception");
    await expect(page.getByRole("heading", { level: 1 })).toBeVisible();

    // If there's a report to review, open it
    const firstRow = page.locator("tbody tr").first();
    if (await firstRow.isVisible()) {
      await firstRow.click();
      await expect(
        page.getByText(/Review|Inception report/i).first(),
      ).toBeVisible();
    }
  });

  test("generates ISR export", async ({ page }) => {
    await login(page, "WB");
    await page.goto("/reports");

    // Look for WB export button
    const wbBtn = page.getByRole("button", { name: /Export WB|ISR/i });
    if (await wbBtn.isVisible()) {
      // Prompt would need to be handled
      page.on("dialog", async (dialog) => {
        await dialog.accept("Q3-2026");
      });
      await wbBtn.click();
    }
  });
});
```

# PART A — i18n NAMESPACE SPLIT

The current `en.json` and `am.json` files have grown to ~500 keys each across 10 steps. Splitting into per-feature namespaces makes them maintainable. Since the code already calls `t('projects.title')` etc., the merged namespace must remain flat at runtime — so this is a **structural refactor, not a runtime change**.

## A.1 New structure

```
src/lib/i18n/
├── index.ts                          ← loads merged resources
├── en/
│   ├── index.ts                      ← merges all namespaces
│   ├── common.json
│   ├── auth.json
│   ├── projects.json
│   ├── inception.json
│   ├── results.json
│   ├── financial.json
│   ├── procurement.json
│   ├── supplier.json
│   ├── beneficiaries.json
│   ├── geo.json
│   ├── documents.json
│   ├── grievance.json
│   ├── impact.json
│   ├── survey.json
│   ├── field.json
│   ├── qa.json
│   ├── warehouse.json
│   ├── analytics.json
│   ├── admin.json
│   └── reports.json
└── am/
    └── (same structure)
```

## A.2 `src/lib/i18n/index.ts` — Updated

```ts
import i18n from "i18next";
import { initReactI18next } from "react-i18next";
import LanguageDetector from "i18next-browser-languagedetector";
import { en } from "./en";
import { am } from "./am";

export const defaultNS = "translation";

export const resources = {
  en: { translation: en },
  am: { translation: am },
} as const;

i18n
  .use(LanguageDetector)
  .use(initReactI18next)
  .init({
    resources,
    fallbackLng: "en",
    supportedLngs: ["en", "am"],
    defaultNS,
    interpolation: { escapeValue: false },
    detection: {
      order: ["localStorage", "navigator"],
      caches: ["localStorage"],
      lookupLocalStorage: "piims.lang",
    },
    // Merge per-namespace JSON into one flat object
    ns: [defaultNS],
    defaultNS,
  });

i18n.on("languageChanged", (lng) => {
  document.documentElement.lang = lng;
});

export { i18n };
```

## A.6 `scripts/split-i18n.ts` — Splitter automation

```ts
/**
 * One-time script to split existing en.json / am.json into per-feature namespaces.
 * Run: npx tsx scripts/split-i18n.ts
 */
import fs from "node:fs";
import path from "node:path";
import { fileURLToPath } from "node:url";

const __dirname = path.dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url));
const root = path.join(__dirname, "..", "src", "lib", "i18n");

const NAMESPACE_MAP: Record<string, string[]> = {
  common: [
    "app",
    "actions",
    "nav",
    "a11y",
    "errors",
    "shell",
    "dashboard",
    "syncConflict",
  ],
  auth: ["auth"],
  projects: ["projects"],
  inception: ["inception"],
  results: ["results"],
  financial: ["financial"],
  procurement: ["procurement"],
  supplier: ["supplier"],
  beneficiaries: ["beneficiaries"],
  geo: ["geo"],
  documents: ["documents"],
  grievance: ["grievance"],
  "impact-indicators": ["impactIndicators"],
  survey: ["survey"],
  field: ["field"],
  qa: ["qa"],
  warehouse: ["warehouse", "research"],
  analytics: ["analytics"],
  admin: ["admin"],
  reports: ["reports"],
};

for (const lang of ["en", "am"] as const) {
  const srcFile = path.join(root, `${lang}.json`);
  if (!fs.existsSync(srcFile)) {
    console.warn(`⚠ ${srcFile} not found, skipping`);
    continue;
  }
  const data = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(srcFile, "utf8"));

  const langDir = path.join(root, lang);
  fs.mkdirSync(langDir, { recursive: true });

  for (const [namespace, keys] of Object.entries(NAMESPACE_MAP)) {
    const subset: Record<string, unknown> = {};
    for (const key of keys) {
      if (key in data) subset[key] = data[key];
    }
    fs.writeFileSync(
      path.join(langDir, `${namespace}.json`),
      JSON.stringify(subset, null, 2) + "\n",
      "utf8",
    );
    console.log(`✓ ${lang}/${namespace}.json`);
  }
}

console.log(
  "\n✨ Split complete. Verify, then delete en.json / am.json at the root.",
);
```

Run once:

```bash
npx tsx scripts/split-i18n.ts
```

Then delete `src/lib/i18n/en.json` and `src/lib/i18n/am.json` (the originals).

## B.1 `src/features/qa/qa.rules.schema.ts`

```ts
import { z } from "zod";
import { QA_RULE_TYPES, QA_SEVERITIES } from "./qa.types";

export const qaRuleSchema = z.object({
  code: z
    .string()
    .trim()
    .min(2, "Code required")
    .max(40)
    .regex(/^[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]*$/, "Uppercase letters, numbers, underscores only"),
  name: z.string().trim().min(3, "Name required").max(200),
  type: z.enum(QA_RULE_TYPES),
  threshold: z.record(z.union([z.number(), z.string()])),
  severity: z.enum(QA_SEVERITIES),
  active: z.boolean().default(true),
});
export type QARuleFormData = z.infer<typeof qaRuleSchema>;

/**
 * Per-type threshold editor metadata.
 * Drives the threshold fields shown in the form.
 */
export const THRESHOLD_SCHEMA: Record<
  (typeof QA_RULE_TYPES)[number],
  {
    field: string;
    label: string;
    hint: string;
    default: number | string;
    kind: "number" | "text";
  }[]
> = {

      kind: "number",

  ],
```
