## B.2 `src/features/qa/qa.rules.mutations.ts`

```ts
import { useMutation, useQueryClient } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { api } from "@/lib/api/client";
import { qaKeys } from "./qa.queries";
import { useToast } from "@/components/ui/Toast";
import { normalizeApiError } from "@/lib/api/errors";
import type { QARule } from "./qa.types";
import type { QARuleFormData } from "./qa.rules.schema";

interface Envelope<T> {
  data: T;
}

export function useCreateQARule() {
  const qc = useQueryClient();
  const { push } = useToast();
  return useMutation({
    mutationFn: async (input: QARuleFormData) => {
      const { data } = await api.post<Envelope<QARule>>("/qa/rules", input);
      return data.data;
    },
    onSuccess: (r) => {
      qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: qaKeys.rules() });
      push("success", `Rule ${r.code} created`);
    },
    onError: (err) =>
      push("error", normalizeApiError(err).detail ?? "Failed to create rule"),
  });
}

export function useUpdateQARule() {
  const qc = useQueryClient();
  const { push } = useToast();
  return useMutation({
    mutationFn: async ({
      ruleId,
      patch,
    }: {
      ruleId: string;
      patch: Partial<QARuleFormData>;
    }) => {
      const { data } = await api.patch<Envelope<QARule>>(
        `/qa/rules/${ruleId}`,
        patch,
      );
      return data.data;
    },
    onSuccess: () => {
      qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: qaKeys.rules() });
      push("success", "Rule updated");
    },
    onError: (err) =>
      push("error", normalizeApiError(err).detail ?? "Update failed"),
  });
}

export function useDeleteQARule() {
  const qc = useQueryClient();
  const { push } = useToast();
  return useMutation({
    mutationFn: async (ruleId: string) => {
      await api.delete(`/qa/rules/${ruleId}`);
    },
    onSuccess: () => {
      qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: qaKeys.rules() });
      push("success", "Rule deleted");
    },
    onError: (err) =>
      push("error", normalizeApiError(err).detail ?? "Delete failed"),
  });
}
```

## B.3 `src/features/qa/QARuleFormModal.tsx`

```tsx
import { useEffect } from "react";
import { useForm } from "react-hook-form";
import { zodResolver } from "@hookform/resolvers/zod";
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";
import { Modal } from "@/components/ui/Modal";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/Button";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/Input";
import { Select } from "@/components/ui/Select";
import { Checkbox } from "@/components/ui/Checkbox";
import {
  qaRuleSchema,
  THRESHOLD_SCHEMA,
  type QARuleFormData,
} from "./qa.rules.schema";
import { useCreateQARule, useUpdateQARule } from "./qa.rules.mutations";
import { QA_RULE_TYPES, QA_SEVERITIES, type QARule } from "./qa.types";

export function QARuleFormModal({
  open,
  onClose,
  rule,
}: {
  open: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  rule?: QARule;
}) {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const create = useCreateQARule();
  const update = useUpdateQARule();
  const isEdit = !!rule;

  const {
    register,
    handleSubmit,
    watch,
    setValue,
    formState: { errors },
    reset,
  } = useForm<QARuleFormData>({
    resolver: zodResolver(qaRuleSchema),
    defaultValues: rule
      ? {
          code: rule.code,
          name: rule.name,
          type: rule.type,
          threshold: rule.threshold,
          severity: rule.severity,
          active: rule.active,
        }
      : {
          code: "",
          name: "",
          type: "DURATION_SHORT",
          threshold: { multiplier: 0.5 },
          severity: "MEDIUM",
          active: true,
        },
  });

  const type = watch("type");
  const thresholdFields = THRESHOLD_SCHEMA[type] ?? [];

  // When type changes, seed default threshold values
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isEdit || (rule && rule.type !== type)) {
      const defaults = Object.fromEntries(
        thresholdFields.map((f) => [f.field, f.default]),
      );
      setValue("threshold", defaults);
    }
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [type]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (rule) {
      reset({
        code: rule.code,
        name: rule.name,
        type: rule.type,
        threshold: rule.threshold,
        severity: rule.severity,
        active: rule.active,
      });
    } else {
      reset({
        code: "",
        name: "",
        type: "DURATION_SHORT",
        threshold: { multiplier: 0.5 },
        severity: "MEDIUM",
        active: true,
      });
    }
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [rule, open]);

  const onSubmit = async (v: QARuleFormData) => {
    if (isEdit && rule) {
      await update.mutateAsync({ ruleId: rule.ruleId, patch: v });
    } else {
      await create.mutateAsync(v);
    }
    onClose();
  };

  return (
    <Modal
      open={open}
      onClose={onClose}
      title={
        isEdit ? t("qa.rules.form.editTitle") : t("qa.rules.form.createTitle")
      }
      size="md"
      footer={
        <>
          <Button variant="ghost" onClick={onClose}>
            {t("actions.cancel")}
          </Button>
          <Button
            variant="primary"
            loading={create.isPending || update.isPending}
            onClick={handleSubmit(onSubmit)}
          >
            {t("actions.save")}
          </Button>
        </>
      }
    >
      <form onSubmit={handleSubmit(onSubmit)} className="space-y-4" noValidate>
        <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4">
          <Input
            {...register("code")}
            label={t("qa.rules.form.code")}
            required
            placeholder="DURATION_SHORT"
            disabled={isEdit}
            error={errors.code?.message}
            hint="Uppercase, e.g. DURATION_SHORT"
          />
          <Select
            {...register("type")}
            label={t("qa.rules.form.type")}
            required
            disabled={isEdit}
            options={QA_RULE_TYPES.map((rt) => ({ value: rt, label: rt }))}
          />
        </div>
        <Input
          {...register("name")}
          label={t("qa.rules.form.name")}
          required
          error={errors.name?.message}
        />

        <div>
          <div className="text-caption font-semibold text-primary-900 mb-2">
            {t("qa.rules.form.threshold")}
          </div>
          <div className="space-y-2 border border-neutral-300 rounded-md p-3 bg-neutral-50">
            {thresholdFields.map((f) => (
              <div key={f.field}>
                <label
                  htmlFor={`threshold.${f.field}`}
                  className="block text-caption font-semibold text-neutral-900 mb-1"
                >
                  {f.label}
                </label>
                <input
                  id={`threshold.${f.field}`}
                  type={f.kind === "number" ? "number" : "text"}
                  step={f.kind === "number" ? "any" : undefined}
                  {...register(
                    `threshold.${f.field}` as const,
                    {
                      valueAsNumber: f.kind === "number",
                    } as any,
                  )}
                  className="w-full h-9 px-3 rounded-md text-body-sm border border-neutral-300 focus:border-primary-700 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary-700/15 outline-none"
                />
                <p className="text-caption text-neutral-600 mt-1">{f.hint}</p>
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>

        <Select
          {...register("severity")}
          label={t("qa.rules.form.severity")}
          required
          options={QA_SEVERITIES.map((s) => ({ value: s, label: s }))}
        />
        <Checkbox {...register("active")} label={t("qa.rules.form.active")} />
      </form>
    </Modal>
  );
}
```

## B.4 `src/features/qa/QARulesManager.tsx`

```tsx
import { useState } from "react";
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";
import { Plus, Pencil, Trash2, Power } from "lucide-react";
import { useQARules } from "./qa.queries";
import { useToggleRule } from "./qa.mutations";
import { useDeleteQARule } from "./qa.rules.mutations";
import { usePermissions } from "@/features/auth/usePermissions";
import { PERMISSIONS } from "@/features/auth/auth.types";
import { Card, CardHeader } from "@/components/ui/Card";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/Button";
import { Chip } from "@/components/ui/Chip";
import { IconButton } from "@/components/ui/IconButton";
import { EmptyState } from "@/components/ui/EmptyState";
import { LoadingState } from "@/components/ui/LoadingState";
import { ConfirmDialog } from "@/components/ui/ConfirmDialog";
import { QARuleFormModal } from "./QARuleFormModal";
import { SEVERITIES, type QARule, type QASeverity } from "./qa.types";

const SEVERITY_TONE: Record<QASeverity, any> = {
  LOW: "grey",
  MEDIUM: "amber",
  HIGH: "red",
  CRITICAL: "red",
};

export function QARulesManager() {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const { can } = usePermissions();
  const { data: rules, isLoading } = useQARules();
  const toggle = useToggleRule();
  const del = useDeleteQARule();

  const [formOpen, setFormOpen] = useState(false);
  const [editing, setEditing] = useState<QARule | null>(null);
  const [deleting, setDeleting] = useState<QARule | null>(null);

  if (isLoading) return <LoadingState message="Loading QA rules…" />;

  const canEdit = can(PERMISSIONS.qaRules);

  return (
    <Card>
      <CardHeader
        title={t("qa.rules.title")}
        subtitle={t("qa.rules.subtitle")}
        action={
          canEdit && (
            <Button
              size="sm"
              variant="primary"
              leftIcon={<Plus className="h-4 w-4" />}
              onClick={() => {
                setEditing(null);
                setFormOpen(true);
              }}
            >
              {t("qa.rules.new")}
            </Button>
          )
        }
      />

      {!rules?.length ? (
        <EmptyState
          title={t("qa.rules.empty")}
          description={t("qa.rules.emptyHint")}
        />
      ) : (
        <table className="w-full text-body-sm">
          <thead>
            <tr className="border-b border-neutral-300 text-left">
              <th className="py-2 text-caption uppercase text-neutral-600">
                Code
              </th>
              <th className="py-2 text-caption uppercase text-neutral-600">
                Name
              </th>
              <th className="py-2 text-caption uppercase text-neutral-600">
                Type
              </th>
              <th className="py-2 text-caption uppercase text-neutral-600">
                Severity
              </th>
              <th className="py-2 text-caption uppercase text-neutral-600">
                Threshold
              </th>
              <th className="py-2 text-caption uppercase text-neutral-600">
                Active
              </th>
              <th className="py-2 text-caption uppercase text-neutral-600"></th>
            </tr>
          </thead>
          <tbody>
            {rules.map((r) => (
              <tr key={r.ruleId} className="border-b border-neutral-100">
                <td className="py-2">
                  <code className="text-caption font-bold text-primary-700">
                    {r.code}
                  </code>
                </td>
                <td className="py-2">{r.name}</td>
                <td className="py-2">
                  <Chip tone="blue">{r.type}</Chip>
                </td>
                <td className="py-2">
                  <Chip tone={SEVERITY_TONE[r.severity]}>{r.severity}</Chip>
                </td>
                <td className="py-2">
                  <code className="text-caption text-neutral-600">
                    {Object.entries(r.threshold)
                      .map(([k, v]) => `${k}=${v}`)
                      .join(", ")}
                  </code>
                </td>
                <td className="py-2">
                  <Chip tone={r.active ? "green" : "grey"}>
                    {r.active ? "Active" : "Disabled"}
                  </Chip>
                </td>
                <td className="py-2 text-right">
                  {canEdit && (
                    <div className="inline-flex items-center gap-1">
                      <IconButton
                        label={r.active ? "Disable rule" : "Enable rule"}
                        icon={<Power className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />}
                        size="sm"
                        variant="ghost"
                        loading={toggle.isPending}
                        onClick={() =>
                          toggle.mutate({ ruleId: r.ruleId, active: !r.active })
                        }
                      />
                      <IconButton
                        label="Edit rule"
                        icon={<Pencil className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />}
                        size="sm"
                        variant="ghost"
                        onClick={() => {
                          setEditing(r);
                          setFormOpen(true);
                        }}
                      />
                      <IconButton
                        label="Delete rule"
                        icon={<Trash2 className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />}
                        size="sm"
                        variant="ghost"
                        onClick={() => setDeleting(r)}
                      />
                    </div>
                  )}
                </td>
              </tr>
            ))}
          </tbody>
        </table>
      )}

      <QARuleFormModal
        open={formOpen}
        onClose={() => {
          setFormOpen(false);
          setEditing(null);
        }}
        rule={editing ?? undefined}
      />

      <ConfirmDialog
        open={!!deleting}
        danger
        title={t("qa.rules.deleteConfirmTitle")}
        message={t("qa.rules.deleteConfirmMessage", {
          code: deleting?.code ?? "",
        })}
        confirmLabel={t("actions.delete")}
        onClose={() => setDeleting(null)}
        onConfirm={() => {
          if (deleting) del.mutate(deleting.ruleId);
          setDeleting(null);
        }}
      />
    </Card>
  );
}
```

## B.6 `src/features/qa/__tests__/qa.rules.test.ts`

```ts
import { describe, it, expect } from "vitest";
import { evaluateRules, haversineKm } from "../qa.rules";
import type { QASubmission, QAContext } from "../qa.rules";

const baseCtx: QAContext = {
  medianDurationSeconds: 1800,
  p95DurationSeconds: 3600,
};

function makeSubmission(overrides: Partial<QASubmission> = {}): QASubmission {
  return {
    submissionId: "s1",
    collectorId: "c1",
    durationSeconds: 1800,
    answers: [
      { questionId: "q1", value: "a" },
      { questionId: "q2", value: "b" },
    ],
    ...overrides,
  };
}

describe("haversineKm", () => {
  it("returns 0 for identical points", () => {
    expect(haversineKm({ lat: 9, lon: 40 }, { lat: 9, lon: 40 })).toBeCloseTo(
      0,
      5,
    );
  });

  it("computes distance between Addis and Adama (~90 km)", () => {
    const d = haversineKm({ lat: 9.03, lon: 38.74 }, { lat: 8.54, lon: 39.27 });
    expect(d).toBeGreaterThan(60);
    expect(d).toBeLessThan(100);
  });
});

describe("evaluateRules", () => {
  it("flags DURATION_SHORT when interview < 50% of median", () => {
    const v = evaluateRules(makeSubmission({ durationSeconds: 500 }), baseCtx);
    expect(v.some((r) => r.ruleType === "DURATION_SHORT")).toBe(true);
  });

  it("does NOT flag short duration when interview > 50% of median", () => {
    const v = evaluateRules(makeSubmission({ durationSeconds: 1000 }), baseCtx);
    expect(v.some((r) => r.ruleType === "DURATION_SHORT")).toBe(false);
  });

  it("flags DURATION_LONG when interview > 3× median", () => {
    const v = evaluateRules(makeSubmission({ durationSeconds: 6000 }), baseCtx);
    expect(v.some((r) => r.ruleType === "DURATION_LONG")).toBe(true);
  });

  it("flags STRAIGHT_LINE for 15+ identical answers", () => {
    const answers = Array.from({ length: 20 }, (_, i) => ({
      questionId: `q${i}`,
      value: "same",
    }));
    const v = evaluateRules(makeSubmission({ answers }), baseCtx);
    expect(v.some((r) => r.ruleType === "STRAIGHT_LINE")).toBe(true);
  });

  it("does NOT flag straight-line for varied answers", () => {
    const answers = Array.from({ length: 20 }, (_, i) => ({
      questionId: `q${i}`,
      value: `v${i}`,
    }));
    const v = evaluateRules(makeSubmission({ answers }), baseCtx);
    expect(v.some((r) => r.ruleType === "STRAIGHT_LINE")).toBe(false);
  });

  it("flags GPS_OUTSIDE when > 5 km from assigned", () => {
    const v = evaluateRules(
      makeSubmission({
        gpsStart: { lat: 9.5, lon: 40.5 },
        assignedLocation: { lat: 9.03, lon: 38.74 },
      }),
      baseCtx,
    );
    expect(v.some((r) => r.ruleType === "GPS_OUTSIDE")).toBe(true);
  });

  it("flags OUTLIER for z-score > 3", () => {
    const v = evaluateRules(
      makeSubmission({ answers: [{ questionId: "income", value: 50000 }] }),
      {
        ...baseCtx,
        numericMean: { income: 5000 },
        numericSD: { income: 3000 },
      },
    );
    expect(v.some((r) => r.ruleType === "OUTLIER")).toBe(true);
  });

  it("returns empty array for clean submission", () => {
    const v = evaluateRules(makeSubmission({ durationSeconds: 1800 }), baseCtx);
    expect(v).toEqual([]);
  });
});
```

```tsx
import { useState } from "react";
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";
import { Database, Play, CheckCircle2, Clock } from "lucide-react";
import { useWaveDatasets } from "./warehouse.queries";
import { useBuildWaveDataset } from "./warehouse.mutations";
import { Card, CardHeader } from "@/components/ui/Card";

import { Modal } from "@/components/ui/Modal";
import { formatDate } from "@/lib/utils/date";

export function WaveDatasetBuilder() {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const { data: waves } = useWaveDatasets();
  const build = useBuildWaveDataset();
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const [waveId, setWaveId] = useState("");

  const onBuild = async () => {
    if (!waveId) return;
    await build.mutateAsync(waveId);
    setOpen(false);
    setWaveId("");
  };

  return (
    <>
      <Card>
        <CardHeader
          title={t("warehouse.builder.title")}
          subtitle={t("warehouse.builder.subtitle")}
          action={
            <Button
              size="sm"
              variant="primary"
              leftIcon={<Play className="h-4 w-4" />}
              onClick={() => setOpen(true)}
            >
              {t("warehouse.builder.build")}
            </Button>
          }
        />

        {!waves?.length ? (
          <p className="text-body-sm text-neutral-600">
            {t("warehouse.builder.empty")}
          </p>
        ) : (
          <ul className="divide-y divide-neutral-100">
            {waves.map((w) => (
              <li key={w.datasetId} className="py-3">
                <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-3">
                  <div className="min-w-0">
                    <div className="text-body-sm font-semibold">
                      <code className="text-primary-700 mr-2">
                        {w.waveCode}
                      </code>
                      {w.waveName}
                    </div>
                    <div className="text-caption text-neutral-600 mt-0.5">
                      v{w.version} · {w.recordCount.toLocaleString()} records
                      {w.buildCompletedAt &&
                        ` · built ${formatDate(w.buildCompletedAt)}`}
                    </div>
                  </div>
                  <Chip
                    tone={
                      w.status === "RELEASED"
                        ? "green"
                        : w.status === "READY"
                          ? "blue"
                          : w.status === "BUILDING"
                            ? "amber"
                            : "grey"
                    }
                  >
                    {w.status === "BUILDING" ? (
                      <Clock className="h-3 w-3" aria-hidden />
                    ) : null}
                    {w.status === "RELEASED" ? (
                      <CheckCircle2 className="h-3 w-3" aria-hidden />
                    ) : null}
                    {w.status}
                  </Chip>
                </div>
                {w.status === "BUILDING" && (
                  <Progress value={60} className="mt-2" label="Building…" />
                )}
              </li>
            ))}
          </ul>
        )}
      </Card>

      <Modal
        open={open}
        onClose={() => setOpen(false)}
        title={t("warehouse.builder.modalTitle")}
        size="sm"
        footer={
          <>
            <Button variant="ghost" onClick={() => setOpen(false)}>
              {t("actions.cancel")}
            </Button>
            <Button
              variant="primary"
              loading={build.isPending}
              disabled={!waveId}
              onClick={onBuild}
            >
              <Database className="h-4 w-4 mr-1" aria-hidden />
              {t("warehouse.builder.build")}
            </Button>
          </>
        }
      >
        <div className="space-y-3">
          <Select
            label={t("warehouse.builder.wave")}
            required
            placeholder="Select wave"
            value={waveId}
            onChange={(e) => setWaveId(e.target.value)}
            options={(waves ?? []).map((w) => ({
              value: w.waveId,
              label: `${w.waveCode} · ${w.waveName}`,
            }))}
          />
          <p className="text-caption text-neutral-600">
            {t("warehouse.builder.warning")}
          </p>
        </div>
      </Modal>
    </>
  );
}
```

```tsx
  L3: "L3 · Aggregated",
};

const LEVEL_TONE: Record<string, any> = {
  L0: "grey",
  L1: "purple",
  L2: "teal",
  L3: "green",
};

export function AnonymizationConfig() {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const { data: waves } = useWaveDatasets();
  const anonymize = useAnonymize();
  const [waveId, setWaveId] = useState("");
  const [config, setConfig] = useState<AnonConfig>(DEFAULT_ANON_CONFIG);
  const [previewOpen, setPreviewOpen] = useState(false);

  const { register } = useForm();

  const onRun = async () => {
    if (!waveId) return;
    await anonymize.mutateAsync({ waveId, config });
    setWaveId("");
  };

  return (
    <>
      <Card>
        <CardHeader
          title={
            <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-2">
              <Shield className="h-4 w-4" aria-hidden />
              {t("warehouse.anonymize.title")}
            </span>
          }
          subtitle={t("warehouse.anonymize.subtitle")}
        />

        <div className="space-y-4">
          <Select
            label={t("warehouse.anonymize.wave")}
            required
            placeholder="Select wave"
            value={waveId}
            onChange={(e) => setWaveId(e.target.value)}
            options={(waves ?? []).map((w) => ({
              value: w.waveId,
              label: `${w.waveCode} · ${w.waveName} (${w.recordCount.toLocaleString()} records)`,
            }))}
          />

          <div>
            <div className="text-caption font-semibold text-primary-900 mb-2">
              {t("warehouse.anonymize.level")}
            </div>
            <div className="grid grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-4 gap-2">
              {ANON_LEVELS.map((lvl) => (
                <button
                  key={lvl}
                  type="button"
                  aria-pressed={config.level === lvl}
                  onClick={() => setConfig({ ...config, level: lvl })}
                  className={`p-3 border rounded-md text-left transition ${
                    config.level === lvl
                      ? "border-primary-700 bg-primary-100"
                      : "border-neutral-300 hover:border-primary-300"
                  }`}
                >
                  <Chip tone={LEVEL_TONE[lvl]}>{lvl}</Chip>
                  <div className="text-caption text-neutral-600 mt-1">
                    {LEVEL_LABEL[lvl].split("· ")[1]}
                  </div>
                </button>
              ))}
            </div>
          </div>

          {config.level !== "L0" && (
            <div className="grid sm:grid-cols-2 gap-3 border border-neutral-200 rounded-md p-3 bg-neutral-50">
              <div>
                <label
                  htmlFor="ageBracket"
                  className="block text-caption font-semibold text-neutral-900 mb-1"
                >
                  {t("warehouse.anonymize.ageBracket")}
                </label>
                <input
                  id="ageBracket"
                  type="number"
                  min={0}
                  value={config.ageBracket}
                  onChange={(e) =>
                    setConfig({ ...config, ageBracket: Number(e.target.value) })
                  }
                  className="w-full h-9 px-3 rounded-md border border-neutral-300 text-body-sm"
                />
                <p className="text-caption text-neutral-600 mt-1">
                  {t("warehouse.anonymize.ageBracketHint")}
                </p>
              </div>
              <div>
                <label
                  htmlFor="incomeTopCode"
                  className="block text-caption font-semibold text-neutral-900 mb-1"
                >
                  {t("warehouse.anonymize.incomeTopCode")}
                </label>
                <input
                  id="incomeTopCode"
                  type="number"
                  min={1}
                  max={100}
                  value={config.incomeTopCode}
                  onChange={(e) =>
                    setConfig({
                      ...config,
                      incomeTopCode: Number(e.target.value),
                    })
                  }
                  className="w-full h-9 px-3 rounded-md border border-neutral-300 text-body-sm"
                />
                <p className="text-caption text-neutral-600 mt-1">
                  {t("warehouse.anonymize.incomeTopCodeHint")}
                </p>
              </div>
              <div className="sm:col-span-2">
                <label
                  htmlFor="locationGranularity"
                  className="block text-caption font-semibold text-neutral-900 mb-1"
                >
                  {t("warehouse.anonymize.location")}
                </label>
                <select
                  id="locationGranularity"
                  value={config.locationGranularity}
                  onChange={(e) =>
                    setConfig({
                      ...config,
                      locationGranularity: e.target.value as any,
                    })
                  }
                  className="w-full h-9 px-3 rounded-md border border-neutral-300 text-body-sm"
                >
                  <option value="REGION">Region</option>
                  <option value="ZONE">Zone</option>
                  <option value="WOREDA">Woreda</option>
                  <option value="KEBELE">Kebele</option>
                  <option value="REMOVED">Removed entirely</option>
                </select>
              </div>
              <div>
                <label
                  htmlFor="suppressionThreshold"
                  className="block text-caption font-semibold text-neutral-900 mb-1"
                >
                  {t("warehouse.anonymize.suppression")}
                </label>
                <input
                  id="suppressionThreshold"
                  type="number"
                  min={1}
                  value={config.suppressionThreshold}
                  onChange={(e) =>
                    setConfig({
                      ...config,
                      suppressionThreshold: Number(e.target.value),
                    })
                  }
                  className="w-full h-9 px-3 rounded-md border border-neutral-300 text-body-sm"
                />
                <p className="text-caption text-neutral-600 mt-1">
                  {t("warehouse.anonymize.suppressionHint")}
                </p>
              </div>
              <div className="flex items-end pb-2">
                <Checkbox
                  label={t("warehouse.anonymize.addNoise")}
                  checked={config.addNoise}
                  onChange={(e) =>
                    setConfig({ ...config, addNoise: e.target.checked })
                  }
                />
              </div>
            </div>
          )}

          <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2 pt-2">
            <Button
              variant="primary"
              leftIcon={<Shield className="h-4 w-4" />}
              loading={anonymize.isPending}
              disabled={!waveId}
              onClick={onRun}
            >
              {t("warehouse.anonymize.run")}
            </Button>
            <Button
              variant="secondary"
              leftIcon={<Eye className="h-4 w-4" />}
              onClick={() => setPreviewOpen(true)}
            >
              {t("warehouse.anonymize.preview")}
            </Button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </Card>

      <Modal
        open={previewOpen}
        onClose={() => setPreviewOpen(false)}
        title={t("warehouse.anonymize.previewTitle")}
        size="lg"
        footer={
          <Button variant="primary" onClick={() => setPreviewOpen(false)}>
            {t("actions.close")}
          </Button>
        }
      >
        <PreviewTable config={config} />
      </Modal>
    </>
  );
}

function PreviewTable({ config }: { config: AnonConfig }) {
  const { t } = useTranslation();

  // Simple client-side preview using the same logic as the engine
  const preview = MOCK_PREVIEW_RAW.map((r) => {
    const out: any = { panelId: r.panelId };
    if (config.level === "L0") {
      return { ...r };
    }
    if (config.level === "L1") {
      out.beneficiaryName = `P${(r.beneficiaryName ?? "").length}***`;
      out.income = r.income;
      out.region = r.region;
      out.zone = r.zone;
    } else if (config.level === "L2") {
      out.ageBand = r.ageBand;
      out.income = r.income;
      out.region = r.region;
      if (config.locationGranularity !== "REGION") out.zone = r.zone;
    } else {
      // L3 — aggregated
      return {
        panelId: `AGG-${r.region}`,
        region: r.region,
        count: 5,
        avgIncome: 4233,
      };
    }
    return out;
  });

  return (
    <div>
      <p className="text-body-sm text-neutral-600 mb-3">
        {t("warehouse.anonymize.previewHint")}
      </p>
      <div className="overflow-x-auto rounded-md border border-neutral-300">
        <table className="w-full text-body-sm">
          <thead>
            <tr className="bg-primary-700 text-white text-left">
              {Object.keys(preview[0] ?? {}).map((k) => (
                <th
                  key={k}
                  className="px-3 py-2 text-caption font-bold uppercase"
                >
                  {k}
                </th>
              ))}
            </tr>
          </thead>
          <tbody>
            {preview.map((row, i) => (
              <tr
                key={i}
                className="border-t border-neutral-200 even:bg-neutral-50"
              >
                {Object.values(row).map((v, j) => (
                  <td key={j} className="px-3 py-2 font-mono text-caption">
                    {String(v ?? "—")}
                  </td>
                ))}
              </tr>
            ))}
          </tbody>
        </table>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## D.1 `src/components/ui/__tests__/Select.test.tsx`

```tsx
import { describe, it, expect, vi } from "vitest";
import { render, screen } from "@testing-library/react";
import userEvent from "@testing-library/user-event";
import { Select } from "../Select";

const options = [
  { value: "a", label: "Option A" },
  { value: "b", label: "Option B" },
  { value: "c", label: "Option C" },
];

describe("Select", () => {
  it("renders all options", () => {
    render(<Select label="Choose" options={options} />);
    expect(screen.getByRole("combobox")).toBeInTheDocument();
    options.forEach((o) => {
      expect(screen.getByRole("option", { name: o.label })).toBeInTheDocument();
    });
  });

  it("renders placeholder as disabled option", () => {
    render(<Select label="Choose" options={options} placeholder="Select…" />);
    const placeholder = screen.getByRole("option", { name: "Select…" });
    expect(placeholder).toBeDisabled();
  });

  it("fires onChange when selecting", async () => {
    const onChange = vi.fn();
    render(<Select label="Choose" options={options} onChange={onChange} />);
    await userEvent.selectOptions(screen.getByRole("combobox"), "b");
    expect(onChange).toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it("associates error with aria-invalid", () => {
    render(<Select label="Choose" options={options} error="Required field" />);
    const select = screen.getByRole("combobox");
    expect(select).toHaveAttribute("aria-invalid", "true");
    expect(select).toHaveAccessibleDescription("Required field");
  });

  it("marks required with asterisk", () => {
    render(<Select label="Choose" options={options} required />);
    expect(screen.getByText("*")).toBeInTheDocument();
  });

  it("is keyboard accessible", async () => {
    render(<Select label="Choose" options={options} />);
    await userEvent.tab();
    expect(screen.getByRole("combobox")).toHaveFocus();
  });
});
```

## D.2 `src/components/ui/__tests__/Tabs.test.tsx`

```tsx
import { describe, it, expect } from "vitest";
import { render, screen } from "@testing-library/react";
import userEvent from "@testing-library/user-event";
import { Tabs } from "../Tabs";

const tabs = [
  { id: "a", label: "Tab A", content: <div>Content A</div> },
  { id: "b", label: "Tab B", content: <div>Content B</div> },
  { id: "c", label: "Tab C", content: <div>Content C</div>, disabled: true },
];

describe("Tabs", () => {
  it("renders all tabs with first active by default", () => {
    render(<Tabs tabs={tabs} />);
    expect(screen.getByRole("tab", { name: "Tab A" })).toHaveAttribute(
      "aria-selected",
      "true",
    );
    expect(screen.getByRole("tab", { name: "Tab B" })).toHaveAttribute(
      "aria-selected",
      "false",
    );
    expect(screen.getByText("Content A")).toBeVisible();
    expect(screen.queryByText("Content B")).not.toBeInTheDocument();
  });

  it("switches active tab on click", async () => {
    render(<Tabs tabs={tabs} />);
    await userEvent.click(screen.getByRole("tab", { name: "Tab B" }));
    expect(screen.getByRole("tab", { name: "Tab B" })).toHaveAttribute(
      "aria-selected",
      "true",
    );
    expect(screen.getByText("Content B")).toBeVisible();
  });

  it("navigates with arrow keys", async () => {
    render(<Tabs tabs={tabs} />);
    screen.getByRole("tab", { name: "Tab A" }).focus();
    await userEvent.keyboard("{ArrowRight}");
    expect(screen.getByRole("tab", { name: "Tab B" })).toHaveAttribute(
      "aria-selected",
      "true",
    );
    await userEvent.keyboard("{ArrowLeft}");
    expect(screen.getByRole("tab", { name: "Tab A" })).toHaveAttribute(
      "aria-selected",
      "true",
    );
  });

  it("wraps around with arrow keys", async () => {
    render(<Tabs tabs={tabs.slice(0, 2)} />);
    screen.getByRole("tab", { name: "Tab A" }).focus();
    await userEvent.keyboard("{ArrowLeft}");
    expect(screen.getByRole("tab", { name: "Tab B" })).toHaveAttribute(
      "aria-selected",
      "true",
    );
  });

  it("does not activate disabled tab", async () => {
    render(<Tabs tabs={tabs} />);
    const disabledTab = screen.getByRole("tab", { name: "Tab C" });
    expect(disabledTab).toBeDisabled();
    await userEvent.click(disabledTab);
    expect(disabledTab).toHaveAttribute("aria-selected", "false");
  });

  it("has proper ARIA attributes", () => {
    render(<Tabs tabs={tabs} />);
    expect(screen.getByRole("tablist")).toHaveAttribute("aria-label", "Tabs");
    const tabA = screen.getByRole("tab", { name: "Tab A" });
    const panelA = screen.getByRole("tabpanel");
    expect(tabA).toHaveAttribute("aria-controls");
    expect(panelA).toHaveAttribute("aria-labelledby", tabA.id);
  });

  it("honors defaultTab prop", () => {
    render(<Tabs tabs={tabs} defaultTab="b" />);
    expect(screen.getByRole("tab", { name: "Tab B" })).toHaveAttribute(
      "aria-selected",
      "true",
    );
    expect(screen.getByText("Content B")).toBeVisible();
  });
});
```

## D.3 `src/components/ui/__tests__/Toast.test.tsx`

```tsx
import { describe, it, expect, vi } from "vitest";
import { render, screen, act } from "@testing-library/react";
import userEvent from "@testing-library/user-event";
import { ToastProvider, useToast } from "../Toast";

function TriggerButton() {
  const { push } = useToast();
  return (
    <>
      <button onClick={() => push("success", "Saved successfully")}>
        Save
      </button>
      <button onClick={() => push("error", "Failed to save")}>Fail</button>
      <button onClick={() => push("info", "Loading", 0)}>Sticky</button>
    </>
  );
}

function renderWithProvider() {
  return render(
    <ToastProvider>
      <TriggerButton />
    </ToastProvider>,
  );
}

describe("Toast", () => {
  it("shows success toast", async () => {
    renderWithProvider();
    await userEvent.click(screen.getByRole("button", { name: "Save" }));
    expect(screen.getByText("Saved successfully")).toBeVisible();
  });

  it("shows error toast", async () => {
    renderWithProvider();
    await userEvent.click(screen.getByRole("button", { name: "Fail" }));
    expect(screen.getByText("Failed to save")).toBeVisible();
  });

  it("auto-dismisses after duration", async () => {
    vi.useFakeTimers();
    renderWithProvider();
    await userEvent
      .setup({ delay: null })
      .click(screen.getByRole("button", { name: "Save" }));
    expect(screen.getByText("Saved successfully")).toBeVisible();
    act(() => {
      vi.advanceTimersByTime(5500);
    });
    expect(screen.queryByText("Saved successfully")).not.toBeInTheDocument();
    vi.useRealTimers();
  });

  it("does NOT auto-dismiss when duration is 0", async () => {
    vi.useFakeTimers();
    renderWithProvider();
    await userEvent
      .setup({ delay: null })
      .click(screen.getByRole("button", { name: "Sticky" }));
    expect(screen.getByText("Loading")).toBeVisible();
    act(() => {
      vi.advanceTimersByTime(30000);
    });
    expect(screen.getByText("Loading")).toBeVisible();
    vi.useRealTimers();
  });

  it("can be dismissed manually", async () => {
    renderWithProvider();
    await userEvent.click(screen.getByRole("button", { name: "Save" }));
    expect(screen.getByText("Saved successfully")).toBeVisible();
    await userEvent.click(screen.getByLabelText("Dismiss"));
    expect(screen.queryByText("Saved successfully")).not.toBeInTheDocument();
  });

  it("shows multiple toasts independently", async () => {
    renderWithProvider();
    await userEvent.click(screen.getByRole("button", { name: "Save" }));
    await userEvent.click(screen.getByRole("button", { name: "Fail" }));
    expect(screen.getByText("Saved successfully")).toBeVisible();
    expect(screen.getByText("Failed to save")).toBeVisible();
  });

  it("uses aria-live polite for accessibility", () => {
    renderWithProvider();
    const region = document.querySelector('[aria-live="polite"]');
    expect(region).toBeInTheDocument();
  });

  it("throws when used outside provider", () => {
    const spy = vi.spyOn(console, "error").mockImplementation(() => {});
    expect(() => render(<TriggerButton />)).toThrow(
      /useToast must be used within ToastProvider/,
    );
    spy.mockRestore();
  });
});
```

```markdown
# On-Call Rotation

## Schedule

| Week | Primary       | Secondary     | Escalation |
| ---- | ------------- | ------------- | ---------- |
| W1   | MoWE Lead Dev | MoWE DevOps   | MoWE CIO   |
| W2   | MoWE DevOps   | MoWE Lead Dev | MoWE CIO   |
| W3   | MoWE Lead Dev | MoWE DevOps   | MoWE CIO   |
| W4   | MoWE DevOps   | MoWE Lead Dev | MoWE CIO   |

Rotation is Monday 09:00 EAT → Monday 09:00 EAT.

## Responsibilities

- Respond to P1 alerts within **15 minutes**
- Respond to P2 alerts within **2 hours**
- Respond to P3 (normal) within **1 business day**
- Keep the incident log updated in `docs/incidents/`

## Escalation matrix

| Severity | Definition                              | Response | Escalation                |
| -------- | --------------------------------------- | -------- | ------------------------- |
| **P1**   | Production down or data loss            | 15 min   | → CIO immediately         |
| **P2**   | Major feature broken, no workaround     | 2 hours  | → CIO within 4 h          |
| **P3**   | Minor feature broken, workaround exists | 1 day    | → Team lead within 3 days |
| **P4**   | Cosmetic or documentation               | 1 week   | No escalation             |

## Contacts

- Primary on-call: `oncall-primary@piims.gov.et`
- Secondary on-call: `oncall-secondary@piims.gov.et`
- CIO: `cio@mowe.gov.et`
- World Bank TTL: TBD

## Handover checklist

Each Monday, outgoing on-call hands over to incoming:

- [ ] Any open incidents
- [ ] Pending deployments
- [ ] Known issues and workarounds
- [ ] Upcoming maintenance windows
```
